All three people have different versions of their stories with one common link that Maya possibly killed her husband

Their experience offers new perspectives on their friendship.

By dawn, the train moves on, leaving its passengers irrevocably changed by a single journey where illusions collapse and human truths emerge.

movie:tt34964205.description: Amid the failing counteroffensive, a journalist follows a Ukrainian platoon on their mission to traverse one mile of heavily fortified forest and liberate a strategic village from Russian occupation. But the farther they advance through their destroyed homeland, the more they realize that this war may never end.

movie:tt31710990.name: Dreams

movie:tt31241595.description: Zed and Addison discover the warring worlds of Sunnyside and Shadyside on a summer road trip after their first year of college, encountering two new groups of monsters.

movie:tt33299083.name: Madea's Destination Wedding
movie:tt33299083.description: Madea and her family travel to Tiffany's rushed destination wedding in the Bahamas, where tensions arise as Tiffany doubts her fiancé Zavier, and her mother acts strangely, raising suspicions about the marriage's legitimacy.

movie:tt27675583.name: Almost Cops

movie:tt32149577.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Cinematic Cut
movie:tt32149577.description: It’s the year 1403, and the Bohemian Kingdom is in chaos. While roaming marauders sow fear and terror through a kingdom without a clear ruler, Henry of Skalitz seeks to avenge his murdered parents. As an ally of the rightful king, he is sent to accompany Sir Hans Capon on a diplomatic mission. After they are brutally attacked, however, Henry and Hans undergo a series of dangerous adventures that subject them and their friendship to the ultimate test.

movie:tt35669009.name: Ziam
movie:tt35669009.description: In a world succumbing to hunger, a Muay Thai fighter fights off zombies to save his beloved.

movie:tt36856496.name: Trainwreck: The Real Project X

movie:tt27208407.name: Please Don't Feed the Children
movie:tt27208407.description: After a viral outbreak ravaged the country’s adult population, a group of orphans heads south in search of a new life, only to find themselves at the mercy of a deranged woman harboring a dangerous secret.

movie:tt31806049.name: Brick
movie:tt31806049.description: A couple whose apartment building is suddenly surrounded by a mysterious brick wall must work with their neighbors to find a way out.

movie:tt14961624.name: The Old Guard 2
movie:tt14961624.description: Andy leads immortal warriors against a powerful enemy threatening their group. They grapple with the resurfacing of a long-lost immortal, complicating their mission to safeguard humanity.

movie:tt32307524.name: Shark Whisperer
movie:tt32307524.description: Marine conservationist and social media activist Ocean Ramsey fearlessly swims with sharks in this documentary about her risky mission to protect them.

movie:tt36856482.name: Trainwreck: The Cult of American Apparel
movie:tt36856482.description: American Apparel rises as a major fashion brand in the 2000s, but its success under CEO Dov Charney masks workplace issues. As financial troubles grow and harassment claims emerge, employees face the reality of a toxic environment.

movie:tt35520290.name: The Baltimorons

movie:tt27621210.name: Ice Road: Vengeance

movie:tt32263401.name: Reflection in a Dead Diamond
movie:tt32263401.description: A retired spy suspects his former adversaries have resurfaced when his intriguing neighbor vanishes.

movie:tt31036941.name: Jurassic World: Rebirth
movie:tt31036941.description: Five years post-Jurassic World: Dominion (2022), an expedition braves isolated equatorial regions to extract DNA from three massive prehistoric creatures for a groundbreaking medical breakthrough.

movie:tt36856455.name: Trainwreck: Poop Cruise
movie:tt36856455.description: A luxury cruise turns disastrous when an engine fire cuts power to the entire ship. 4,000 passengers face failing systems, sewage leaks, and food shortages, sparking passenger unrest and media coverage of "The Poop Cruise."

movie:tt32743685.name: Jaws @ 50: The Definitive Inside Story

movie:tt35492581.name: Kontinental '25

movie:tt21317634.name: Bride Hard
movie:tt21317634.description: When a mercenary group takes a lavish wedding hostage, they have no idea what they are in for as the maid of honor is actually a secret agent ready to rain hellfire upon anyone who would ruin her best friend's wedding.

movie:tt37024060.name: Grenfell: Uncovered
movie:tt37024060.description: Reveals decisions by officials and companies before the 2017 Grenfell Tower fire that made it preventable. Survivors, families, and firefighters share their accounts of the tragedy that took 72 lives.

movie:tt36856306.name: Trainwreck: Mayor of Mayhem
movie:tt36856306.description: Rob Ford's 2010 Toronto mayoral run shocked critics with an unexpected win. His tenure spiraled into chaos amid mounting scandals and drug allegations, drawing global media attention.

movie:tt27757546.name: Diablo

movie:tt34965625.name: Prime Minister

movie:tt35276942.name: Dollhouse

When a new daughter enters the family's life, strange things begin to happen and no matter how hard the family tries to get rid of it, the doll always finds its way back.

movie:tt30580186.name: The Old Bachelor
movie:tt30580186.description: In an Iran weighed down by a struggling economy, two middle-aged brothers live with their bullying father. A man prone to rages and driven by chauvinism, the father’s abusiveness found his second wife leaving him. Now he picks on his eldest son, while the younger sibling fantasises about ways to kill his father. When the man rents out the flat above to a young woman, with intentions of marrying her, the woman’s attraction to the older son slowly pushes this profoundly damaged family to breaking point.

movie:tt35048826.name: Broke
movie:tt35048826.description: Follows True Brandywine, a struggling rodeo rider, as he gets trapped in a blizzard and must confront his life choices while battling the elements for survival.

movie:tt35630700.name: Our Times
movie:tt35630700.description: In 1966, physicists Nora and Héctor time travel to 2025. As Nora thrives, Héctor struggles, leaving her torn between love and a world that empowers women.

movie:tt36856278.name: Trainwreck: The Astroworld Tragedy

movie:tt30150769.description: Stan Olszewski, a security guard foils a home robbery attempt at Cynthia Rand's residence. A charged friendship develops starting with late-night humorous texts. Their deepening bond shakes up both their lives.

movie:tt36293840.name: Taandob

While the nation's law enforcement agencies race to uncover the identity of the mastermind behind the attack, the mastermind reveals himself live on the channel’s program, exposing the stories of ordinary people who have fallen victim to high-level corruption. Thus begins a rampage against the injustices of the system.

movie:tt37034643.name: Utshob

As they make him revisit his past, Jahangir is forced to confront the life he has built in bitterness and solitude. A heartwarming tale of regrets, memories and rediscovering love and laughter.

movie:tt16426570.name: Barron's Cove
movie:tt16426570.description: After his son is killed, a father abducts the child responsible, hellbent on revenge.

movie:tt35231039.name: Kokuho

movie:tt34965515.description: A Russian teacher secretly documents his small town school's transformation into a war recruitment center during the Ukraine invasion, revealing the ethical dilemmas educators face amid propaganda and militarization.

movie:tt35628853.name: Titan: The OceanGate Disaster

movie:tt36240772.name: K.O.

But in the sultry atmosphere of this sun-bleached town Sofia, who has been trapped by her mother’s illness all her life, finally starts to shed her inhibitions, enticed by the persuasive charms of enigmatic traveller Ingrid.

However, with both sides harbouring secrets, and hiding their true motives, this tentative alliance between the humans and elves may bring about the downfall of them all.

movie:tt28026215.description: On the brink of leaving "The Family," a mob henchman's final job goes off the rails. With the clock ticking, the ex-cop has one night to get his unsuspecting family out of the city before he gets snuffed out.

movie:tt34682248.name: Vini Jr.
movie:tt34682248.description: Vini Jr. has it all: talent, resilience and boldness. Follow his dancing, unpredictable feet on his inspiring journey to becoming a global soccer star.

movie:tt32965688.name: Shaunki Sardar
movie:tt32965688.description: A mentor returns from prison to find his former proteges transformed. Their reunion stirs up complex bonds of loyalty and hidden tensions as they face their shared past and present challenges.

movie:tt36592065.name: A Deadly American Marriage

movie:tt25147850.description: Based upon extensive research with law enforcement, gangs, inmates, migrants, and addicts, an exposé on fentanyl trafficking, and its effect on all walks of life.

movie:tt29262075.name: Monster Island
movie:tt29262075.description: Set in the Pacific, 1942. A Japanese soldier and a British prisoner of war are stranded on a deserted island, hunted by a deadly creature. Two mortal enemies must come together to survive the unknown.

movie:tt33022710.name: Ocean with David Attenborough
movie:tt33022710.description: Attenborough explores the planet's undersea habitats, revealing the greatest age of ocean discovery and emphasizing the ocean's vital importance while exposing its problems and highlighting opportunities for marine life recovery.

movie:tt36454323.name: Forevergreen
movie:tt36454323.description: An orphaned bear cub finds a home with a fatherly evergreen tree, until his hunger for trash leads him to danger.

movie:tt11092020.name: Shadow Force
movie:tt11092020.description: An estranged couple with a bounty on their heads must go on the run with their son to avoid their former employer, a unit of shadow ops that has been sent to kill them.

movie:tt27766440.description: A couple lose their home and later discover the husband has been diagnosed with a terminal illness as they embark on a year long coastal trek.

movie:tt35301431.description: From a repressive childhood to artistic revolution, Ney Matogrosso transforms Brazil's stages - and himself - through music, creativity and inner fire.

movie:tt31249107.name: Salvable

movie:tt27674700.name: Rosario

movie:tt36722524.name: Guru Nanak Jahaz
movie:tt36722524.description: The film is based on a true incident of 20th century popularly known as Komagata Maru incident. The film unveils a poignant chapter in history when a group of Indian Sikh immigrants aboard a Japanese steamship named Komagata Maru arrived in Vancouver carrying 376 passengers from India. Canada, enforcing discriminatory immigration laws, denied entry to most passengers who were of Indian descent. After two months of legal battles and protests, the ship was forced to return to India. The incident highlights racial prejudices and immigration policies of the time, symbolising a struggle for Equality and Justice.

movie:tt35489516.name: A Friend of Dorothy
movie:tt35489516.description: Dorothy is a lonely widow whose body is failing, but her mind remains as bright as ever. When 17-year-old JJ accidentally kicks his football into her garden, he upends Dorothy's daily routine of pills, prunes, and crosswords, and an unlikely friendship blossoms. Despite being worlds apart in every way, the two come to find they have more in common than they could ever imagine.

movie:tt15766876.name: Holy Night: Demon Hunters

movie:tt34509472.name: The Old Woman with the Knife
movie:tt34509472.description: Aging assassin Hornclaw has seen it all, but she never expected to mentor a reckless rookie like Bullfight. As their unlikely bond deepens, cracks form in the underworld they navigate together. When Hornclaw discovers someone wants her dead, she's thrust into a deadly game of deception. With enemies closing in and trust in short supply, survival means staying sharp—both blade and mind.

movie:tt30700695.name: Lilies Not for Me
movie:tt30700695.description: Haunted by a forbidden affair, a young man in a 1920s “conversion” clinic finds hope in a compassionate nurse who challenges the era’s cruel norms.

movie:tt36640622.name: Louis Theroux: The Settlers

movie:tt14123284.name: Havoc
movie:tt14123284.description: After a drug deal gone wrong, a bruised detective must fight his way through the criminal underworld to rescue a politician's estranged son, unraveling a deep web of corruption and conspiracy that ensnares his entire city.

movie:tt27828550.name: Fréwaka

movie:tt1714918.name: Neighborhood Watch

movie:tt8866456.name: The Legend of Ochi

movie:tt32214413.name: The Wedding Banquet
movie:tt32214413.description: A gay man makes a deal with his lesbian friend: a green-card marriage for him, in exchange for in vitro fertilization treatments for her. Plans evolve as Min's grandmother surprises them with a Korean wedding banquet.

movie:tt32194932.name: The Ritual

movie:tt31181421.name: iHostage

movie:tt28230296.name: It Feeds

movie:tt28364592.name: Kraken
movie:tt28364592.description: A Russian missile submarine disappears without trace during a secret mission in the Greenland Sea. A vessel is deployed to search for it, captained by the brother of the missing submarine’s commander. The search crew is tasked with locating the submarine and preventing a top-secret weapon from falling into enemy hands. Meanwhile, a geological research operation at the North Pole awakens the Kraken, a giant deep-water monster with an incredible ability to camouflage and an uncanny intelligence. As the search party narrows in on the missing submarine, they will encounter the legendary creature of the deep.

movie:tt33479839.name: Pengepungan di Bukit Duri

movie:tt36351149.name: Oklahoma City Bombing: American Terror

movie:tt13610344.name: Harvest

movie:tt13491834.name: Sacramento

movie:tt27813235.name: The Surfer

movie:tt23476986.name: G20
movie:tt23476986.description: Terrorists take over the G20 summit with President Sutton, bringing her governing and military experience to defend her family, company, and the world.

movie:tt7967302.name: The King of Kings
movie:tt7967302.description: Through a father's vivid storytelling, a boy journeys through Jesus' life, from humble beginnings to ultimate sacrifice. Along the way, he discovers the transformative power of faith.

movie:tt21942598.name: Freaky Tales

movie:tt5171016.name: Mr. Burton

movie:tt33014921.name: We Girls

movie:tt20212786.name: The Shrouds

movie:tt21267296.name: Hell of a Summer

movie:tt3566834.name: A Minecraft Movie

movie:tt27433995.name: Jumbo
movie:tt27433995.description: Desperate to prove to his peers that he’s more than a chubby kid that never wins at anything, little Don wishes to win his local talent show by performing a stageplay inspired from a storybook written by his late parents. When unfortunately a bully stole that book, at the same time a little ghost appeared from the spirit world asking for Don’s help to reunite her with her parents’ spirits. The two new friends then embark on an exciting adventure to help each other and learn the true meaning of friendship.

movie:tt31951179.name: Jongli
movie:tt31951179.description: Liza made a difficult decision at the moment of the birth of her illegitimate child in the hospital. So she had no choice but to abandon the child in the dustbin. As she was leaving the baby in a dumpster on the road behind the hospital in the dark of night, she came face to face with Dr. Tithi—the very doctor who had delivered Liza's baby in the operating theater. Tithi brought her back to the hospital and began to tell her a story. A story intertwined with Tithi herself, a 6-year-old girl named Pakhi, and a wild-hearted man named Johnny.

movie:tt33349807.name: Sugar Mill

movie:tt32210485.name: Second Victims

movie:tt31314296.name: The Woman in the Yard

Forced to taste a dish, she joins the group of tasters responsible for checking that the food destined for Hitler is not poisoned.

movie:tt13498824.name: The Match

movie:tt13782222.name: Alexander and the Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Road Trip

movie:tt19837932.name: I'm Not a Robot
movie:tt19837932.description: After repeatedly failing Captcha tests, music producer Lara becomes obsessed with a disturbing question: could she be a robot?

movie:tt28239363.name: Tyler Perry's Duplicity

As Brent’s journey to his final resting place unfolds, the film chronicles the years he and his brother spent covering some of the world’s most dangerous conflicts.

movie:tt26304178.name: O'Dessa

movie:tt39384300.name: Less of a Stranger
movie:tt39384300.description: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.

movie:tt45915205.name: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself
movie:tt45915205.description: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.

movie:tt0067900.name: A Cop
movie:tt0067900.description: After a shaky first heist, a group of thieves plan an even more elaborate and risky second heist.

movie:tt46060457.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
movie:tt46060457.description: Two decades after "The Swan" shocked audiences, the women who underwent extreme makeovers and the show's creators reunite to examine the reality series that transformed their lives and sparked debate about beauty standards in Amer...

movie:tt32574149.name: Mononoke Movie: Paper Umbrella
movie:tt32574149.description: A deadly and mysterious master of the occult travels across feudal Japan, seeking malevolent spirits called Mononoke to slay. He must uncover their Form, Truth, and Reason to wield the mighty Exorcism Sword against them.

movie:tt0064579.name: The Learning Tree
movie:tt0064579.description: A bittersweet, idyllic story about a year in the life of 14-year-old Newt Winger, born into a poor Black family in Kansas, who learns about love, fear, racial injustice, and immorality.

movie:tt0101988.name: Guyver
movie:tt0101988.description: Young man merges with mechanical device, becoming cyborg superhero. Strange creatures emerge, seeking to reclaim device. He uncovers plot to genetically engineer monstrous creatures.

movie:tt0076162.name: House
movie:tt0076162.description: A schoolgirl and six of her classmates travel to her aunt's country home, which turns out to be haunted.

movie:tt42206170.name: Fragments of Belonging
movie:tt42206170.description: Tatjana is lonely. Born in Croatia, she has lived across Europe before settling in Amsterdam. Fifteen years later, her teenage son avoids bringing friends home, embarrassed by her dreadful Slavic accent and her lack of Dutch composure. But the real trouble is bigger: Tatjana feels foreign everywhere. Determined to belong, she starts knocking on doors across Europe, asking relatives and friends how they did it. Stumbling through cultural misfires and everyday bias, she finally confronts a dark pattern in her own family history.

movie:tt0072204.name: Stavisky
movie:tt0072204.description: A swindler's activity indirectly caused a political crisis in France in the last years before World War II.

movie:tt32915652.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
movie:tt32915652.description: Hathaway Noa plans his attack on the Adelaide Conference while Federation officer Kenneth Sleg prepares to defend it. With each man pursuing his own goal, Gigi Andalucia heads to Hong Kong to fulfill a role of her own.

movie:tt36282134.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
movie:tt36282134.description: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

movie:tt3983674.name: The Mask You Live In
movie:tt3983674.description: Explores how our culture's narrow definition of masculinity is harming our boys, men and society at large and unveils what we can do about it.

movie:tt0358135.name: Shall We Dance?
movie:tt0358135.description: A romantic comedy where a bored, overworked Estate Lawyer, upon first sight of a beautiful instructor, signs up for ballroom dancing lessons.

movie:tt1800741.name: Step Up: Revolution
movie:tt1800741.description: Emily arrives in Miami with aspirations to become a professional dancer. She sparks with Sean, the leader of a dance crew whose neighborhood is threatened by Emily's father's real estate development plans.

movie:tt45584335.name: Sam Morril: Incorrect
movie:tt45584335.description: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.

movie:tt35301440.name: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter II - The Ashes of Rage
movie:tt35301440.description: The Medicine Seller returns as the Edo harem faces a new crisis, with family feuds, inner turmoil and fiery envy igniting the birth of a raging spirit.

movie:tt1885299.name: Lucky Them
movie:tt1885299.description: A rock journalist is assigned to track down her ex-boyfriend.

movie:tt0120483.name: The Man Who Knew Too Little
movie:tt0120483.description: Wallace Ritchie is mistaken for a spy and must stop a plot to assassinate international leaders at a banquet.

movie:tt0092546.name: Amazon Women on the Moon
movie:tt0092546.description: A spoof of low budget 1950s science-fiction movies, interspersed with various comedy sketches and fake commercials making fun of late-night television.

movie:tt2383068.name: The Sacrament
movie:tt2383068.description: A news team trails a man as he travels into the world of Eden Parish to find his missing sister, where it becomes apparent that this paradise may not be as it seems.

movie:tt0089606.name: My Life as a Dog
movie:tt0089606.description: In the late '50s, young Ingemar learns a lot about life and himself when he is sent away from his sick mother to live with his aunt and uncle in a town full of eccentrics.

movie:tt0239894.name: Paradise Lost 2: Revelations
movie:tt0239894.description: The case of the West Memphis Three, its questionable circumstances and the parties involved are followed up years later.

movie:tt0117293.name: Paradise Lost: The Child Murders at Robin Hood Hills
movie:tt0117293.description: A horrific triple child murder leads to an indictment and trial of three nonconformist boys based on questionable evidence.

movie:tt0445965.name: Feed
movie:tt0445965.description: A cybercrime investigator tracks a man suspected of force-feeding women to death.

movie:tt32646557.name: Enzo
movie:tt32646557.description: Enzo, 16, defies his bourgeois family’s expectations by starting a masonry apprenticeship, a path far removed from the prestigious life they had envisioned for him. In their chic villa in the sun-drenched South of France, tensions simmer as relentless questions and pressures weigh on Enzo’s future and dreams. On the construction sites, however, Vlad, a charismatic Ukrainian colleague, shakes up Enzo’s world and opens the door to unexpected possibilities.

movie:tt0058001.name: Diamonds of the Night
movie:tt0058001.description: Two Jewish boys escape from a train transporting them from one concentration camp to another. The film goes beyond the themes of war and anti-Nazism and concerns itself with man's struggle to preserve human dignity.

movie:tt0073766.name: The Sunshine Boys
movie:tt0073766.description: A vaudeville duo agree to reunite for a television special, but it turns out that they can't stand each other.

movie:tt0055353.name: A Raisin in the Sun
movie:tt0055353.description: A substantial insurance payment could mean either financial salvation or personal ruin for a poor black family.

movie:tt36153493.name: Wildcat
movie:tt36153493.description: Follows an ex-black ops team that reunites to pull off a desperate heist and save the life of an eight-year-old girl.

movie:tt39667834.name: Lust Stories 3
movie:tt39667834.description: Multiple narratives delve into contemporary relationships, portraying desire in its many forms while examining how vulnerability and unspoken tensions influence the ways people connect.

movie:tt14409080.name: Alien Whispers
movie:tt14409080.description: In the Texas town of Amarillo, her family will unknowingly open the door to evil that will change their lives forever. The family will have to call upon God to help them remove the demons from the house. Based on the true story of Ashley Hays Wright.

movie:tt43492793.name: Wham! 10 Days in China
movie:tt43492793.description: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

movie:tt2028530.name: Paradise Lost 3: Purgatory
movie:tt2028530.description: A further followup of the case of the West Memphis Three and the decades long fight to exonerate them that finally gained traction with new DNA evidence.

movie:tt0158371.name: Sweet and Lowdown
movie:tt0158371.description: In the 1930s, jazz guitarist Emmet Ray idolizes Django Reinhardt, faces gangsters and falls in love with a mute woman.

movie:tt0087414.name: The Hit
movie:tt0087414.description: Ten years after Willie Parker ratted on his old mobster friends in exchange for personal immunity, two hit men kidnap him and drive him to Paris for his planned execution. However, they encounter many mishaps along the way.

movie:tt4536086.name: One Little Finger
movie:tt4536086.description: An American neurologist uproots her life to study music therapy in India and ends up helping people with disabilities by bringing them together through music.

movie:tt0790590.name: Botched
movie:tt0790590.description: During a heist in Russia, a professional thief finds himself dealing with serial killers, insane hostages, double-crossing psycho Russian hardmen and the real possibility of a horrible death.

movie:tt1471177.name: Made in America
movie:tt1471177.description: An international apocalypse bombards John with media coverage and political crusaders, threatening his sanity and beloved way of life. He must decipher their ramblings and battle a stream of advertisements to escape the USA's imminent doom.

movie:tt0780607.name: The Signal
movie:tt0780607.description: A horror film told in three parts, from three perspectives, in which a mysterious transmission that turns people into killers invades every cell phone, radio, and television.

movie:tt0478329.name: The Gray Man
movie:tt0478329.description: Obsessive manhunt to identify and capture a despicable serial killer.

movie:tt0480273.name: Walker, Texas Ranger: Trial by Fire
movie:tt0480273.description: Walker investigates a murder connected with a missing government weapon. In addition, he tries to track down a teen on the run from a crime syndicate.

movie:tt31260224.name: Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog
movie:tt31260224.description: Chickenhare embarks on an epic quest, a mysterious groundhog with the power to reverse time and save his species. His adventure takes a dangerous turn when his group discover they are not the only ones searching for this ancient power.

movie:tt0083798.name: Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid
movie:tt0083798.description: Film noir parody with a detective uncovering a sinister plot. Characters from classic noir films appear as scenes from various movies interjected into the story.

movie:tt37971717.name: One Last Shot
movie:tt37971717.description: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

movie:tt0066193.name: The Out of Towners
movie:tt0066193.description: Ohio sales executive George Kellerman accepts a higher position within the company and travels to New York City with his wife Gwen for his job interview. But things start badly and only grow worse in Neil Simon's dark urban comedy.

movie:tt21299884.name: 35 Downhill
movie:tt21299884.description: Ben arrives to his native Kibbutz and plans to ask his distant father Albert to help him recover a family apartment looted in WWII. But Albert has other plans... Completely drunk, he has bet that he could cross the country from north to south on a tractor in less than a week.

movie:tt0282744.name: Mike Bassett: England Manager
movie:tt0282744.description: Manager suffers heart attack. Unqualified replacement Mike Bassett takes over national team. Bassett makes questionable decisions, unorthodox training methods. Despite obstacles, team qualifies for World Cup tournament in Rio.

movie:tt0109965.name: Guyver: Dark Hero
movie:tt0109965.description: Sean Barker, unwilling host to an alien bio-armor known as the Guyver, must fight the Kronos Corporation again before they discover the secrets of the Guyver's origin.

movie:tt0097626.name: Johnny Handsome
movie:tt0097626.description: After being double crossed and thrown in prison, a deformed gangster gets a new face and rehabilitation, but his desire for revenge looms.

movie:tt0100029.name: Lionheart
movie:tt0100029.description: An Ex-French Soldier begins participating in underground street fights in order to make money for his brother's family.

movie:tt0110057.name: Hoop Dreams
movie:tt0110057.description: A film following the lives of two inner-city Chicago boys who struggle to become college basketball players on the road to going professional.

movie:tt2221648.name: Return to Nim's Island
movie:tt2221648.description: With the help of a young runaway, a feisty 14-year-old fights to keep her idyllic island home from the clutches of developers.

movie:tt0110538.name: Mixed Nuts
movie:tt0110538.description: The events focus around a crisis hotline business on one crazy night during the Christmas holidays.

movie:tt0283139.name: White Oleander
movie:tt0283139.description: A teenager journeys through a series of foster homes after her mother goes to prison for committing a crime of passion.

movie:tt2008633.name: Radio Rebel
movie:tt2008633.description: Tara, a painfully shy high-schooler, has a secret: she is also a confident DJ known as Radio Rebel, who lends her voice to others.

movie:tt0338512.name: Two Brothers
movie:tt0338512.description: Two tigers are separated as cubs and taken into captivity, only to be reunited years later as enemies by an explorer who inadvertently forces them to fight each other.

movie:tt31556612.name: We Will Dance Again
movie:tt31556612.description: A minute-by-minute retelling of the Supernova Music Festival Massacre, which took place on October 7th.

movie:tt0072325.name: Truck Turner
movie:tt0072325.description: While tracking a strong-armed pimp who has skipped bail, a bounty hunter discovers a contract has been put out on him and must go on the run.

movie:tt0080752.name: Forbidden Zone
movie:tt0080752.description: The bizarre and musical tale of a girl who travels to another dimension through the gateway found in her family's basement.

movie:tt4018322.name: Abductee
movie:tt4018322.description: One man's descent into madness as he tries to discover what comes for him in the middle of the night.

movie:tt0496350.name: The Marsh
movie:tt0496350.description: A young beautiful but stressed out children's writer seeks out a holiday in the country but becomes the lead character in a supernatural mystery she must solve to save her life

movie:tt0165623.name: Angst
movie:tt0165623.description: A troubled man gets released from prison and starts taking out his sadistic fantasies on an unsuspecting family living in a secluded house.

movie:tt27559902.name: Iron Within
movie:tt27559902.description: As Drukhari raiders plague an Imperial planet, the embattled Astra Militarum send out a desperate cry for help. Salvation arrives in the form of a force of Space Marines, but the population of the planet soon learn to be careful what they wish for...

movie:tt38516475.name: Siren: The Voices of Shelley Beattie
movie:tt38516475.description: Shelley Beattie, a Deaf woman and champion bodybuilder, found fame in the 1990s on the hit TV show American Gladiators, where she competed under the name "Siren" before her untimely death in 2008. While charismatic, gorgeous, and a fierce competitor, Beattie also battled personal demons, struggling with mental illness, addiction, and questions of her own identity. Framed by the insight of another Deaf woman in Hollywood who found herself in the spotlight at the same time, Academy Award-winning actress Marlee Matlin, the documentary unpacks the story of Shelley "Siren" Beattie and her complex legacy entwined with beauty, mental illness, and love.

movie:tt0989000.name: In Search of a Midnight Kiss
movie:tt0989000.description: Broke and alone on New Year's Eve, Wilson just wants to spend the rest of a very bad year in bed. But, when his best friend convinces him to post a personal ad, he meets a woman bent on finding the right guy to be with at midnight.

movie:tt24578916.name: Buying Her
movie:tt24578916.description: "Buying Her" takes a deep dive into the stories of men who buy sex.

movie:tt0410730.name: Taxidermia
movie:tt0410730.description: Story about three generations of men: pervert that constantly seeks for new kinds of satisfaction, an obese speed eater and a passionate embalmer.

movie:tt46084824.name: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J
movie:tt46084824.description: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.

movie:tt0079041.name: Demon Pond
movie:tt0079041.description: Mysterious pond near Japanese village inhabited by mythical beings. Their narrative revolves around vengeance, heartbreak, and the strength of genuine affection.

movie:tt0099385.name: Death Warrant
movie:tt0099385.description: An undercover operative infiltrates a state prison to investigate mysterious inmate deaths, only to find his psychopathic nemesis has been transferred into the same facility to execute him on behalf of a corrupt official.

movie:tt2516856.name: Watermelon Magic
movie:tt2516856.description: International audiences will delight in this nearly wordless burst of color and music that draws inspiration from film classic 'The Red Balloon'. Weaving together documentary and narrative elements, 'Watermelon Magic' chronicles a season on the family farm, as young Sylvie grows a patch of watermelons to sell market. The film employs a dynamic visual style that uses high-resolution stills at varying shutter-burst frame rates with stunning time-lapse sequences to trace the journey from seed to flower to fruit. When harvest time arrives, Sylvie must decide if she will share her precious babies with the world.

movie:tt0086214.name: The Ruffian
movie:tt0086214.description: The adventures of a group of friends who plan to recover crates full of gold from a fall in Canada.

movie:tt38616652.name: Gracias, equipo
movie:tt38616652.description: Tío Mochales, a company that, years ago, was the undisputed queen of Spanish cheese. Today, it's a somewhat rusty business trying to keep up appearances. Their latest big idea: to organise a rural team-building retreat in the vill...

movie:tt0079813.name: Rock 'n' Roll High School
movie:tt0079813.description: Ramones fanatic and delinquent Riff Randell battles it out with the strict new principal of Vince Lombardi High School, Miss Togar, with help from the Ramones.

movie:tt0053172.name: Pillow Talk
movie:tt0053172.description: An interior decorator and a playboy songwriter share a telephone party line and size each other up.

movie:tt4281724.name: Terrifier
movie:tt4281724.description: A maniac named Art the Clown terrorizes two friends on Halloween and everyone who gets in his way.

movie:tt33425631.name: House on Eden
movie:tt33425631.description: Setting out to film their next paranormal investigation, Kris, Celina and Jay encounter a malevolent, ancient spirit that resides in an abandoned house deep in the woods.

movie:tt5615976.name: Date with Love
movie:tt5615976.description: When a small-town boy's video Promposal goes viral, it scores him a Prom date with his celebrity crush. Complications arise when the celebrity falls for the boy's teacher.

movie:tt0107563.name: The Meteor Man
movie:tt0107563.description: A high school teacher from a troubled inner city Washington D.C. neighborhood becomes a super-powered hero and takes on the gang that has been terrorizing his streets.

movie:tt33510831.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
movie:tt33510831.description: A documentary tribute to the series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company, in line with the 25th anniversary of HBO's original limited series.

movie:tt0021814.name: Dracula
movie:tt0021814.description: Transylvanian vampire Count Dracula bends a naive real estate agent to his will, then takes up residence at a London estate where he sleeps in his coffin by day and searches for potential victims by night.

movie:tt18950566.name: Bull Run
movie:tt18950566.description: In the wilds of Wall Street, one junior banker discovers that the only thing more dangerous than billion-dollar deals are the men signing them.

movie:tt13829262.name: Rubikon
movie:tt13829262.description: Following a catastrophe on Earth, the planet is covered in a toxic fog. The crew in the space station, must decide whether to risk their lives to get home and search for survivors, or stay safe in the station's "algae symbiosis sy...

movie:tt7248144.name: An Affair
movie:tt7248144.description: A newly appointed teacher finds herself being followed, and soon discovers that one of her own students is obsessed with her.

movie:tt39052963.name: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face
movie:tt39052963.description: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.

movie:tt30842022.name: The Dreadful
movie:tt30842022.description: The Dreadful follows Anne and her mother-in-law Morwen who live a solitary, harsh life on the outskirts of society - but when a man from their past returns, he will set off a sequence of events that become a turning point for Anne.

movie:tt0473692.name: Neil Young: Heart of Gold
movie:tt0473692.description: A film shot over during a two-night performance by Neil Young at Nashville's Ryman Auditorium.

movie:tt8851148.name: The In Between
movie:tt8851148.description: After surviving a car accident that took the life of her boyfriend, a teenage girl believes he's attempting to reconnect with her from the after world.

movie:tt0119859.name: Paradise Road
movie:tt0119859.description: A group of women who are imprisoned on the island of Sumatra by the Japanese during World War II use music to relieve their misery.

movie:tt0359013.name: Blade: Trinity
movie:tt0359013.description: Blade, now a wanted man by the FBI, must join forces with the Nightstalkers to face his most challenging enemy yet: Dracula.

movie:tt3602106.name: Street
movie:tt3602106.description: Remo Street is a young fighter who has to choose between the long hard road to honor and glory, or succumbing to a brutal future as a cage fighter for the Russian Mafia.

movie:tt27671478.name: John Farnham: Finding the Voice
movie:tt27671478.description: John Farnham: Finding the Voice tells the untold story of an Australian music icon. In this first authorised biopic, we follow Farnham’s life from the quiet suburbs of Melbourne to ‘60s pop fame, through incredible highs and lows, and ultimately to record-breaking success as ‘Australia’s Voice’. John Farnham was 38 years old when Whispering Jack was released. Nobody ever questioned that Farnham could sing -- but the challenge to find his artistic voice and become Australia’s most trusted and beloved performer took half a lifetime. Whispering Jack is still the highest selling Australian album of all time, and this powerful documentary tracks the personal and public journey that has made Farnham Australia’s greatest and most beloved musical artist.

movie:tt3687398.name: The Runner
movie:tt3687398.description: In the aftermath of the 2010 BP oil spill, an idealistic but flawed politician is forced to confront his dysfunctional life after his career is destroyed in a sex scandal.

movie:tt0155776.name: Jawbreaker
movie:tt0155776.description: Three of the most popular girls at Reagan High accidentally kill the prom queen with a jawbreaker when a kidnapping goes horribly wrong.

movie:tt14858054.name: Wyrmwood: Apocalypse
movie:tt14858054.description: In a zombie-infested Australian wasteland, soldier Rhys has dedicated his life to tracking and capturing survivors for the Surgeon General in hopes of finding a cure.

movie:tt0109190.name: Baby's Day Out
movie:tt0109190.description: After three kidnappers lose the baby they have kidnapped, both the cops and kidnappers go looking for the baby.

movie:tt0411272.name: Mesrine: Public Enemy No. 1
movie:tt0411272.description: The story of the notorious French gangster Jacques Mesrine, with the focus on his life and death as France's Public Enemy No. 1 in the 1970s.

movie:tt0118615.name: Anaconda
movie:tt0118615.description: A "National Geographic" film crew is taken hostage by an insane hunter, who forces them along on his quest to capture the world's largest - and deadliest - snake.

movie:tt0273822.name: Mockingbird Don't Sing
movie:tt0273822.description: Based on the actual events of one of the most horrific cases of child abuse ever to be documented, this haunting drama tells the tale of a young girl who was locked in a room for over 12 years.

movie:tt0025164.name: The Gay Divorcee
movie:tt0025164.description: A woman thinks a flirting man is the co-respondent her lawyer has hired to expedite her divorce.

movie:tt24176060.name: Queer
movie:tt24176060.description: In 1950s Mexico City, an American immigrant in his late forties leads a solitary life amidst a small American community. However, the arrival of a young student stirs the man into finally establishing a meaningful connection with ...

movie:tt1063669.name: The Wave
movie:tt1063669.description: A high school teacher's experiment to demonstrate to his students what life is like under a dictatorship spins horribly out of control when he forms a social unit with a life of its own.

movie:tt38915678.name: Dorothy
movie:tt38915678.description: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion challenges the world around them.

movie:tt13315308.name: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air Reunion
movie:tt13315308.description: 30 years later, we're bringing the Banks family back together. Join Will Smith and his former co-stars for a funny and heartfelt night full of music and dancing in honor of the show that ran for six seasons and 148 episodes.

movie:tt36749000.name: The Doll
movie:tt36749000.description: Eastern France, nowadays.  Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.

movie:tt44090278.name: Baththa
movie:tt44090278.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

movie:tt43700441.name: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
movie:tt43700441.description: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

movie:tt41559858.name: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
movie:tt41559858.description: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

movie:tt13133486.name: Frightvision
movie:tt13133486.description: Prepare yourself for five twisted tales of terror hosted by everyone's favorite sinister succubus, Dr. Boobenstein. Featuring vicious vixens, flesh-eating mist, Vengeful Aztec gods, talking corpses, sinister Santas, and more. So sit back, turn out the lights, and get ready for your worst nightmares to unfold.

movie:tt35836025.name: Vishwanath and Sons
movie:tt35836025.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

movie:tt36596965.name: Mandaadi
movie:tt36596965.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

movie:tt38265603.name: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
movie:tt38265603.description: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

movie:tt34724686.name: Bagarre
movie:tt34724686.description: Gloria, a former boxing champion, raises her autistic son Antoine alone. When an incident at the swimming pool threatens Antoine's schooling, Gloria must fight her biggest battle : making others accept her son's differences.

movie:tt37529347.name: Yan Yana
movie:tt37529347.description: A wealthy man, paralysed after an accident, hires a caregiver from a completely different background. The unlikely relationship between these two opposite characters soon transforms into a powerful friendship that changes their li...

movie:tt39108319.name: Irumudi
movie:tt39108319.description: Follows an alcohol-addicted father with a violent past who lives peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall and decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha at her request.

movie:tt29540862.name: Bhooth Bangla
movie:tt29540862.description: Arjun Acharya inherits a cursed ancestral palace in Mangalpur, deciding to host his sister Meera's destination wedding there, which inadvertently triggers a violent supernatural awakening tied to their dark family history.

movie:tt36454145.name: La Fiera
movie:tt36454145.description: Three skydivers died in similar accidents within five years. Salvador Calvo wanted to tell their stories with the sole survivor, Carlos Suárez.

movie:tt37971394.name: Blast
movie:tt37971394.description: Follows a family trained to protect the powerless who become the most dangerous obstacle of all.

movie:tt37511036.name: The Furious: Pertaruhan Maruah
movie:tt37511036.description: When YouTuber-boxer Danial insults their late father's name, brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite - one fighting for redemption, the other for revenge - in a battle that will decide not just who wins, but what remains of The Furious legacy.

movie:tt38984184.description: Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

movie:tt30496762.name: Maa
movie:tt30496762.description: A mother transforms into the goddess Kali to battle a demon's curse involving fear, blood, and betrayal.

movie:tt23865918.name: Peddi

movie:tt40233113.name: Orangutan
movie:tt40233113.description: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. movie:tt31226272.name: Do Deewane Seher Mein

movie:tt38067963.name: Double Happiness
movie:tt38067963.description: Tim Kao, the meticulous head chef of a five-star hotel in Taiwan, is set to marry his Hong Kong fiance Daisy Wu. But Tim’s divorced parents refuse to attend the same ceremony, and each insists on hosting their own. To complicate things further, the Feng Shui master chooses the same auspicious date for both events. Tim, Daisy, their wedding planner Regina, and the best man Tsai must orchestrate two weddings simultaneously in the same hotel, without either parent finding out. Surrounded by a strict father, a demanding mother, and a cast of sharp-tongued relatives, Tim must confront the traumas of his upbringing and ask himself: is he truly ready to start a new family of his own?

movie:tt38219225.name: Re/Member: The Last Night

movie:tt40224365.name: Aaron Chen: Funny Garden
movie:tt40224365.description: Aussie comic Aaron Chen riffs on the absurdities of life in the U.S., from New York City sidewalk riddles to unexpected news sources, with deadpan wit.

movie:tt39773309.name: The Giant Falls
movie:tt39773309.description: Follows Boris, a charismatic tour guide who unexpectedly reunites with his estranged father Julián. Their tense and emotional encounters explore past wounds and the possibility of forgiveness.

movie:tt37172278.name: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
movie:tt37172278.description: Chronicles Kahan's rise to fame and explores his mental health challenges while dealing with his growing fame.

movie:tt39075295.name: Wednesday: Fireplace
movie:tt39075295.description: Woe to all seeking cheer — for at Nevermore, Yuletide flames cast shadows, the decor whispers doom and a hand tends the hearth.

movie:tt32223398.name: Jaat

movie:tt24225606.name: Metro in Dino

movie:tt33293194.name: Christopher - A Beautiful Real Life

movie:tt43660866.name: My Grandfather Charles Manson
movie:tt43660866.description: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

movie:tt31226985.name: The Follies
movie:tt31226985.description: Six women share a common 'friend': madness. It visits us all, pushes us to decide reality, to make daring decisions and to transform our lives.

movie:tt27411060.name: Suzzanna: Witchcraft
movie:tt27411060.description: Suzzanna is determined to exact revenge on Bisman, the cruel village ruler who killed her father with black magic. To achieve this, she learns black magic, but realizes Bisman's power is immense. In the midst of her efforts, Suzzanna falls in love with Pramuja, a religious man who doesn't know her secret, forcing her to choose between pursuing her revenge or sacrificing him for love.

movie:tt39307372.name: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas

movie:tt39554253.name: Us in the End

movie:tt39538786.name: Sniper: No Nation
movie:tt39538786.description: כאשר הצלף המומחה אייס ברנדון בקט מואשם כטרוריסט ומודח על ידי מדינתו, הוא נאלץ להיעלם מהרדאר ולצאת למשימת הצלה בלתי אפשרית לצד אביו האגדי. ללא תמיכה, ללא גבולות וללא חוקים, עליהם להתמודד עם לגיון הברזל, צבא שכירי חרב חסר רחמים, כדי לעצור משטר מושחת מלהצית מלחמה - ולהוכיח שגם ללא דגל, הקרב עדיין חשוב.

movie:tt35669054.name: Everybody Loves Me When I'm Dead

movie:tt38691426.name: Chris Hemsworth: A Road Trip to Remember
movie:tt38691426.description: In his most personal documentary yet, Chris Hemsworth turns the camera on his own family after his dad’s recent Alzheimer’s diagnosis. They embark on a road trip into their past, exploring the science of social connection and how it can support memory function. They revisit meaningful places and faces, capturing it all as a home movie, and reviving treasured recollections.

movie:tt35631328.name: The New Yorker at 100
movie:tt35631328.description: Hard-hitting journalism. Era-defining fiction. Witty cartoons. The New Yorker marks its 100th anniversary with this look at its past, present and future.  The New Yorker's centennial reveals behind-the-scenes access to editors, writers, and archives of this culturally vital magazine, one of print's last survivors.

movie:tt36118360.name: Tu Yaa Main
