movie:tt34966678.description: As an unprecedented wave of book banning is sparked in Texas, Florida, and beyond, librarians under siege join forces as unlikely defenders fighting for intellectual freedom on the front lines of democracy.

movie:tt35291758.name: Melania
movie:tt35291758.description: An intimate chronicle offers a rare glimpse into the life of Melania Trump, exploring her role as First Lady and her relationship with the former president.

movie:tt36113721.name: Southern Scares
movie:tt36113721.description: Mystery, horror, and Southern folklore collide in the 1990s when a video store worker discovers chilling secrets found in her missing sister's documentary series, Southern Scares.

movie:tt34078927.name: McWalter
movie:tt34078927.description: A madcap secret agent is faced with a series of mysteries after saving the world from a dangerous criminal.

movie:tt33202060.name: Universal
movie:tt33202060.description: A couple of academics enjoying a romantic break in a remote log cabin find their stay interrupted by someone who has tracked them down, seeking their help with what could be the biggest discovery in history...

movie:tt35718349.name: Relationship Goals
movie:tt35718349.description: Explores the ups and downs of modern romance.

movie:tt36499994.name: Iki Dünya Bir Dilek
movie:tt36499994.description: At first glance, Bilge and Jan have nothing in common: he is a world-renowned archaeologist, she is a pragmatic and successful lawyer. For the first time, fate brought them together in childhood, when an ordinary friendship turned...

movie:tt6203702.name: Baaghi 4
movie:tt6203702.description: After surviving an accident, a grief-stricken man descends into chaos as reality blurs. His loved ones question what's real while a hidden truth draws him into a web of obsession and enduring love.

movie:tt36159824.name: The Last Breath of War
movie:tt36159824.description: From empire to ashes-Japan's rise, war, and reckoning. A gripping journey through ambition, conflict, and the cost of a nation's destiny.

movie:tt36822418.name: Governor
movie:tt36822418.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

movie:tt36963493.name: Une Famille de Bâtards
movie:tt36963493.description: Paris, 1997. After his womanizing father is shot, Mohamed discovers two unknown siblings, Maurice and Morgane. Together they must save their father's seedy bar, Chez Momo, from debt and local gangsters with help from regulars.

movie:tt40232255.name: Meal Ticket
movie:tt40232255.description: Follow the untold story of the 47-year old legacy of the McDonald's All American Game and the past, present and future stars that defined it.

movie:tt34498111.name: Chand Mera Dil
movie:tt34498111.description: Aarav and Chandni's passionate college romance is struck by adulthood far too soon, forcing the two young lovers to balance their ambitions with responsibility and realize the evolved meaning of love.

movie:tt19064024.name: Complicated
movie:tt19064024.description: In a time when the failures of healthcare in America are coming under scrutiny, COMPLICATED tells the poignant story of kids with complicated illness suffering at the margins of mainstream medicine—and their parents who risk losing them if they go too far to help: a shocking look at a hidden epidemic in pediatric care when complex disease, lack of research, and the limits of child protection collide.

movie:tt13996906.name: Agony
movie:tt13996906.description: A man gets lost in the desert. No water, no signals, no hope. What begins as a fight for survival becomes a journey to the edge of the mind and body.

movie:tt23846482.name: Kuberaa
movie:tt23846482.description: A ruthless billionaire, Neeraj, uses beggars as benamis to launder money, with the help of a disgraced civil submit servant, Deepak. One of the beggars, Deva, escapes with ₹10,000 crores and becomes the target of a deadly manhunt. He meets Sameera, who joins him in his mission to use the money to uplift society's poor. With Deepak's help, Deva fights back.

movie:tt34382332.name: Old Bandits
movie:tt34382332.description: An elderly retired couple teams up with young partners to plan a daring bank robbery, while trying to outwit a detective determined to stop them.

movie:tt33996113.name: Param Sundari
movie:tt33996113.description: In Kerala's picturesque backwaters, a North Indian and South Indian find unexpected love. Their cultural differences spark a hilarious and chaotic romance, full of twists and turns. Two diverse worlds collide in a heartwarming story.

movie:tt16436848.name: Chhorii 2
movie:tt16436848.description: Sakshi must rescue her seven year old daughter from being sacrificed by an evil cult to satisfy their resident leader, while fighting societal superstitions and the horror that continues to haunt her and young women around her.

movie:tt39216314.name: Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience
movie:tt39216314.description: Featuring the global K-Pop sensation Stray Kids and a live performance from their record-breaking world tour, alongside exclusive behind-the-scenes footage and intimate interviews with the band, Stray Kids: The dominATE Experience is an epic concert film that gives fans both a spectacular front-row seat and unique access to their favourite band.

movie:tt30868610.name: Chuck Billy and The Marvelous Guava Tree
movie:tt30868610.description: Chuck Billy has spent his life picking guavas from Jed’s guava tree. But now that Dr. Agripino is going to build a road that will take down the tree, Chuck and his friends are going to do everything they can to stop it.

movie:tt39386166.name: Its Presence Between Us
movie:tt39386166.description: Jean and Brendan have been dating for a couple months now. It's that sweet spot: Brendan's still enamored with Jean's career as a painter and Jean still finds Brendan's less-than-clever jokes funny. But as they begin to enter the thrilling and butterfly-inducing journey of physical intimacy, it is revealed that all may not be well. Brendan's riddled with anxieties in the bedroom, and Jean's own residence is overshadowed by something potentially more lethal: A poltergeist.

movie:tt38207459.name: Mitski: The Land
movie:tt38207459.description: Indie singer-songwriter Mitski takes the stage at Atlanta’s Fox Theater with a seven-piece band. Over the course of three nights in September 2024, they perform music from Mitski’s acclaimed seventh album, The Land Is Inhospitable and So Are We, alongside reimaginings of her earlier work.

movie:tt42747468.name: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
movie:tt42747468.description: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

movie:tt32372983.name: My Friend Eva
movie:tt32372983.description: A 50-year-old wife and mother abandons her family to pursue a final chance at romance. Her selfish quest strains relationships with loved ones.

movie:tt29622834.name: Dashing Through the Snow
movie:tt29622834.description: A US Marshal gets stuck on Christmas Eve protecting a pregnant fugitive from a bounty hunter and a hitman Santa with his henchmen of elves.

movie:tt31969779.name: O' Romeo
movie:tt31969779.description: In post-independence Mumbai, the underworld rises amidst a changing city. This gritty tale explores the criminal landscape of a bygone era, weaving through the streets and shadows of India's bustling metropolis.

movie:tt31259625.name: The Merchants of Joy
movie:tt31259625.description: In the city that never sleeps, five families hustle each winter to turn sidewalks into holiday outposts.

movie:tt35415189.name: The King of Color
movie:tt35415189.description: At 96, Lawrence Herbert reflects on his life, from his Depression-era Brooklyn upbringing to creating the Pantone Matching System, which revolutionized the worldwide use of color.

movie:tt23899310.name: Follow My Voice
movie:tt23899310.description: After a health crisis that keeps her home, Klara does nothing but listen to her favorite radio show, Follow My Voice. But one day she wonders: is it possible to fall in love with someone she has only heard on the radio but never met? Could she really have feelings for Kang, the radio show host whose voice she has only heard once, and will she overcome her fears to step out into the world again?

movie:tt28252563.name: Madharaasi
movie:tt28252563.description: Reeling from a breakup, a man with a tragic past becomes involved in an operation to stop the mass distribution of weapons.

movie:tt38119836.name: SAQUON
movie:tt38119836.description: SAQUON began as a video diary documenting his ACL recovery five years ago. But the camera kept rolling after his return, revealing an intimate journey through his frustrations over the lack of control of his career, quiet family moments, and ultimately, his dominant year with the Eagles, culminating in a storybook Super Bowl win on his birthday. This is Saquon like you have never seen him before.

movie:tt38897659.name: Summer House
movie:tt38897659.description: Selin travels back in time at a summer house and finds herself in her mother's youth, changing her family's fate and rebuilding her own life.

movie:tt33143854.name: Couple Friendly
movie:tt33143854.description: Couple Friendly follows the journey of a Telugu boy and girl who both reside in Chennai. Their paths cross under unique circumstances, and the story deals with the challenges they face in their careers and relationship. Set in a city where they don't speak their mother tongue, the film explores the emotional highs and lows of navigating life and love in an unfamiliar environment.

movie:tt36915004.name: #Cult
movie:tt36915004.description: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

movie:tt42373992.name: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
movie:tt42373992.description: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

movie:tt30413898.name: Dacoit: A Love Story
movie:tt30413898.description: Follows an angry convict seeking vengeance against his former girlfriend who betrayed him.

movie:tt32832554.name: This Is the Tom Green Documentary
movie:tt32832554.description: Comedian Tom Green's journey takes unexpected turns as he shifts from wild MTV stunts to confronting serious health challenges, ultimately finding peace away from Hollywood on his Canadian farm.

movie:tt13186306.name: War of the Worlds
movie:tt13186306.description: A colossal invasion of Earth is coming in this off-kilter take on the legendary novel of the same name, filled with present-day themes of technology, government surveillance, and privacy.

movie:tt22264842.name: Please, After You
movie:tt22264842.description: Ali's life in Canada as a newcomer is shaken when his naive cousin Omid arrives unexpectedly from overseas. His arrival sets off a tide of misadventures threatening to cost him his cherished ambitions and driving him to wits end.

movie:tt30050236.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
movie:tt30050236.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

movie:tt31193791.name: The Last Showgirl
movie:tt31193791.description: A seasoned showgirl must plan for her future when her show abruptly closes after a 30-year run.

movie:tt24850708.name: Gunslingers
movie:tt24850708.description: In a town named Redemption, reformed gunslinger Keller and mad genius Ben are guided by spiritual leader Jericho towards vindication. While confronting their violent histories, their newfound peace is challenged by violence and re...

movie:tt21979682.name: Bare Skin
movie:tt21979682.description: Victims of extreme trauma are invited to a group therapy session to share their experiences in a safe setting, but as their stories are told, an unsettling truth reveals that they may all be connected in their misfortune.

movie:tt30486139.name: The Last Spy
movie:tt30486139.description: The riveting biography of 102-year-old CIA spymaster Peter Sichel, who unpacks the obscured roots of conflicts that plague today’s world and the toll espionage took on his personal life.

movie:tt27248255.name: We Are Guardians
movie:tt27248255.description: In this expansive character-driven exposé, Indigenous guardians of the Amazon rainforest in Brazil fight to protect their territories from the ravages of extractive industries, confronting deforestation by illegal loggers, corrupt politicians and profit hungry global corporations.

movie:tt37090900.name: Simple Plan: The Kids in the Crowd
movie:tt37090900.description: A captivating and nostalgic look at one of the most popular pop-punk bands of the 2000s. Packed with never-before-seen archival footage and exclusive access to their sold-out 2024 World Tour, the members of Simple Plan and a cast of punk-rock superstars recount the highs and lows of the first 25 years of their career. Stage-dive into a story of brotherhood, fans and resilience.

movie:tt39185163.name: Fallout: The Ghoul Log
movie:tt39185163.description: This ain't your daddy's holiday special. Join The Ghoul, Wayne Newton, and a burning arm for the most festive 90 minutes of your life.

movie:tt39402858.name: Contact in the Woods: The Dr. Jonathan Reed Story
movie:tt39402858.description: One man's hike ends in a bloody alien encounter. After killing a visitor to save his dog, Dr. Jonathan Reed captured terrifying evidence before being hunted by dark forces. The mystery that remains the world's most polarizing UFO ...

movie:tt36955820.name: Lee Soo Man: King of K-Pop
movie:tt36955820.description: From the traditional town of Jeonju, South Korea came the man that changed the world with music. Lee Soo-man, the artist who became an innovator, orchestrated one of the most viral global phenomena, K-Pop.

movie:tt33298831.name: Loner
movie:tt33298831.description: Loner follows an aspiring vlogger who retreats to an isolated cabin deep in the wilderness to rebuild his fractured sense of self, only to discover an ancient force lurking in the surrounding forest. As strange phenomena begin to escalate, his attempt at solitude spirals into a terrifying descent into paranoia and survival.  Directed by filmmaker duo Charlie Robb and Douglas Tawn, the film blends psychological horror, wilderness dread, and found-footage-style realism against the bleak backdrop of the British countryside. Debuting as a FoundTV exclusive, Loner delivers a slow-burning nightmare rooted in isolation, nature, and the fear of the unknown.

movie:tt39017403.name: Corey Feldman vs. the World
movie:tt39017403.description: With unprecedented access, this years-in-the-making vérité documentary embeds with Corey Feldman as he mounts a surreal rock tour with a band of lingerie-clad "angels". The tour goes horribly awry, forcing Feldman to confront his long-held allegations about abuse in Hollywood and his own darkest secrets.

movie:tt34582905.name: Sacred Alaska
movie:tt34582905.description: Sacred Alaska is an award-winning documentary that offers an intimate look into Native Alaskan culture and spirituality. From the Native perspective, the land, the water, the animals, and plants – all creation is sacred and connected. Through beautiful cinematography and powerful storytelling, Sacred Alaska underscores the profound, sacred bond between the Alaskan people, their faith, and the formidable landscape they call home.

movie:tt6649234.name: Be Happy
movie:tt6649234.description: A single father attempts to help his talented daughter achieve her dream of performing on the country's biggest dance reality show.

movie:tt14569236.name: Trigger Happy
movie:tt14569236.description: A repressed husband attempts to murder his bread-winning wife for her life insurance policy in this madcap, 1950s-inspired satire.

movie:tt27497165.name: In Cold Light
movie:tt27497165.description: Ava attempts to go straight after prison, but her twin is murdered and being a witness to the shooting, she is forced to run for her life.

movie:tt32944883.name: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
movie:tt32944883.description: Eight-year-old Bobo grows up on her family farm in Rhodesia in 1980 during the final days of the Bush War to end British colonial rule. Her eyes see conflict, the family's bond to the land, and the lasting wounds that war imprints on those who live through it.

movie:tt28078628.name: Soul on Fire
movie:tt28078628.description: After suffering a accident, a young boy ends up relying on his family, his faith, and his community in his fight for survival.

movie:tt35931420.name: Code Is Law
movie:tt35931420.description: Feature documentary exploring an unprecedented crime spree in the world of Decentralized Finance, where hackers routinely steal hundreds of millions of dollars with the push of a button. The film unearths a historic wave of cyber heists committed by criminals who act with impunity, including the notorious teenage math prodigy Andean Medjedovic - who stole $64 million and went on to challenge the very definition of crime before vanishing as an international fugitive.

movie:tt26439764.name: Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1
movie:tt26439764.description: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

movie:tt33063586.name: A Cursed Man
movie:tt33063586.description: Filmmaker Liam Le Guillou seeks out an occult curse to an answer to the question "is magic real?", forcing him to question the nature of reality and belief in this dangerous, never-before-seen, dark social experiment.

movie:tt33369041.name: Doğulu
movie:tt33369041.description: After being released from prison, where they had been incarcerated for many years, Fırat Doğulu and his companion Akın find themselves embroiled in a relentless quest for revenge.

movie:tt42006709.name: Siccîn 9
movie:tt42006709.description: A mother's desperate cry to protect her child awakens an ancient, forbidden spell. As a horrific murder is concealed, the buried secret festers beneath the earth, transforming into a darker force. Years later, a mysterious death resurfaces the long-hidden sin: "The Seal of Bloodline."

movie:tt31850699.name: Ghaati
movie:tt31850699.description: Follows the story of an empowered woman who gets entangled with weed trade due to circumstances.

movie:tt32150684.name: Liza: A Truly Terrific Absolutely True Story
movie:tt32150684.description: Rich with archival gems and Liza Minnelli’s own point of view, Bruce David Klein's luminous documentary celebrates a young entertainer full of boundless raw talent and the deep, creative relationships with her mentors and influences.

movie:tt34385058.name: In Whose Name?
movie:tt34385058.description: Immersed in Kanye West (Ye's) world of extremes for 6 years, Nico Ballesteros documented over 3,000 hours, bearing witness to brilliance, breakdowns, triumphs, turmoil, paranoia, and intensity that increasingly shaped Ye's world.

movie:tt40415728.name: Rory McIlroy: The Masters Wait
movie:tt40415728.description: Through years of heartbreak and resilience, Rory McIlroy's pursuit of the Green Jacket at the Masters becomes a reckoning with legacy and the final step toward completing golf's rarest achievement, the career Grand Slam.

movie:tt38366170.name: Zara Larsson - Up Close
movie:tt38366170.description: The documentary gives us a unique insight into the life of a pop star who broke through at ten years old. We follow her around the world and see a side she's never shown before. This is the story of an artist reaching for the very top, but with the knowledge that no matter how much she achieves, it'll never be enough to satisfy her.

movie:tt21062442.name: Harsens Island Revenge
movie:tt21062442.description: WWI veterans on Harsens Island square off against the infamous 'Purple Gang' over illegal liquor in the 1920s.

movie:tt31529147.name: Odela 2
movie:tt31529147.description: A savior, Odela Mallanna Swamy, protects a village from evil forces.

movie:tt32377397.name: Mockbuster
movie:tt32377397.description: A struggling filmmaker’s opportunity collides with chaos and compromise when Sharknado’s notorious studio, The Asylum, invites him to direct a "mockbuster."

movie:tt31412707.name: The Three Investigators and the Carpathian Dog
movie:tt31412707.description: A call for help from gallery owner Mr. Prentice leads the three detectives into a new adventure: his apartment is said to be haunted. When the Carpathian dog, a valuable work of art, is also stolen, events spiral out of control because all the residents have a motive. As the suspects are eliminated one by one, the three detectives find themselves in the middle of their most exciting case yet.

movie:tt36853497.name: Double Occupancy
movie:tt36853497.description: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

movie:tt34190272.name: Enemies
movie:tt34190272.description: What would you do for your enemy? This is the story of two teenagers from the neighborhood, victim and executioner, bullied and harassed, who have grown up being irreconcilable enemies.

movie:tt36201830.name: System
movie:tt36201830.description: Privileged prosecutor Neha Rajvansh and humble stenographer Sarika Rawat's lives collide in a system where power shapes truth, forcing them to question the meaning of justice.

movie:tt37537340.name: Srinivasa Mangapuram
movie:tt37537340.description: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

movie:tt42338585.name: MYSTERY ARENA
movie:tt42338585.description: Six contestants compete in a high-stakes live TV quiz show to solve a complex "closed-circle" murder mystery for a 10 billion yen jackpot.

movie:tt29606499.name: Veera Dheera Sooran: Part 2
movie:tt29606499.description: Kaali is a provision store owner and a loving husband and father, is brought back into the life of crime, when his former boss's son is being hunted by the police.

movie:tt31193547.name: Tyler Perry's Finding Joy
movie:tt31193547.description: Stranded in Colorado after a devastating holiday revelation, a talented but overlooked NYC designer finds unexpected love, transforming her life and career path.

movie:tt35146696.name: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri
movie:tt35146696.description: Two people fall in love while finding themselves, but family pressures challenge their relationship. They part, hoping to meet again.

movie:tt38624355.name: Host
movie:tt38624355.description: At a remote island reform school, Ing faces strict obedience rules and a rigid hierarchy. As strange events occur, she questions if she's their victim or cause.

movie:tt31852038.name: Cheekatilo
movie:tt31852038.description: When crime anchor Sandhya’s best friend is found dead under suspicious circumstances, she embarks on a dangerous investigation that collides with a dark past. As secrets unravel, Sandhya must face her trauma and rise as a fearless voice for the silenced.

movie:tt41157050.name: Sleeping Dog
movie:tt41157050.description: Investigative journalist Jeremy Corbell emerges as a key figure in a dangerous fight to uncover the truth about UAPs, driven by rare access and knowledge few possess. As his pursuit deepens, so do the risks of exposing what was never meant to be seen.

movie:tt35242182.name: Bears on a Ship
movie:tt35242182.description: During an airline strike in Mexico, a group of stranded passengers decide to take a ship voyage back home to the United States. Unbeknownst to them however, there are two more passengers aboard that ship. More specifically; man-eating bears!

movie:tt27991902.name: American Thunder: NASCAR to Le Mans
movie:tt27991902.description: The documentary follows Hendrick Motorsports and NASCAR’s journey to compete with a NASCAR car in the 2023, 24 Hours of Le Mans, the race’s centennial. The film explores the technical challenges, preparation and public reaction to NASCAR’s participation in the iconic European endurance race.

movie:tt27774999.name: Bonjour Tristesse
movie:tt27774999.description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. The arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend turns her world upside down.

movie:tt34487797.name: Assassin Within
movie:tt34487797.description: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.

movie:tt32565484.name: Border Hunters
movie:tt32565484.description: After his police officer brother is killed by a drug dealer who flees to the protection of his cartel-connected uncle in Mexico, an American man with a diverse law enforcement/military background goes south of the border to get re...

movie:tt38796013.name: Bowie: The Final Act
movie:tt38796013.description: The final creative chapter of one of music’s most iconic artists. Featuring rare interviews with those who knew and worked alongside Bowie as well as famous fans and figures who have been inspired by his artistry, the film will uncover the strategy behind Bowie’s artistic resurrection and the inexhaustible extraordinary creativity that defined his final decade, in which he released his critically acclaimed album Blackstar just two days before he died. This was an emergence from the turbulence of the 1990s, when Bowie had found himself at odds with a changing industry but pushed on to headline Glastonbury in 2000.

movie:tt30798612.name: Crazxy
movie:tt30798612.description: Abhimanyu Sood. Good surgeon. Bad father. Questionable human being. He is having the worst day of his life.

movie:tt38774646.name: 31 Minutes: One Hot Christmas
movie:tt38774646.description: Puppeton, the town of 31 Minutes, faces such an infernally hot Christmas that Santa Claus cancels his visit! Bodoque the rabbit heroically volunteers to rescue the presents from the North Pole, while his friends improvise a disastrous Christmas show. But what they don't expect is Bodoque giving in to some irresistible temptations along the way.

movie:tt27040807.name: Wormtown
movie:tt27040807.description: One year into a plague of flesh-eating, mind-altering worms, the nocturnal town of Ashland, Ohio, has embraced the parasites’ rule. Under cult-like Mayor Joshua, zealous Ranchers spread their gospel—by persuasion or by force. A trio of uninfected women cling to survival through scavenging, extreme hygiene, and evasion. But everyone breaks eventually, unleashing betrayal, sacrilege, and body horror.

movie:tt21349688.name: East of Wall
movie:tt21349688.description: After the death of her husband, Tabatha—a young, tattooed, rebellious horse trainer—wrestles with financial insecurity and unresolved grief while providing refuge for a group of wayward teenagers on her broken-down ranch in the Badlands.

movie:tt38793708.name: Merge
movie:tt38793708.description: In a future where technology feels more human than ever, people confront love, loss, and identity as the boundaries between man and machine disappear.

movie:tt17497960.name: BLKNWS: Terms & Conditions
movie:tt17497960.description: Adapted from Kahlil Joseph’s renowned video art installation, BLKNWS: Terms &  Conditions is a distinctive cinematic experience that mirrors the sonic textures  of a record album, weaving fiction and history in an immersive journey where the  fictionalized figures of W. E. B Du Bois and Marcus Garvey join artists, musicians,  Joseph’s family, and even Twitter chats, in a vision for black consciousness.

movie:tt32827713.name: Thalaivan Thalaivii
movie:tt32827713.description: Two headstrong lovers navigate a turbulent relationship where passion and conflict intertwine, creating an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.

movie:tt36939482.name: Terrell & T.O.
movie:tt36939482.description: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

movie:tt37998108.name: Say Who Die
movie:tt37998108.description: The tale of a set of twins whose bond is tested by secrets, family dysfunction, and choices that spiral into chaos.

movie:tt34794166.name: Nishaanchi
movie:tt34794166.description: Twin brothers, identical looks but different values, face brotherhood, betrayal, love, and redemption. Their paths weave through crime into a deeper story of human nature and its results.

movie:tt15379194.name: Remote
movie:tt15379194.description: A TV reporter and a photographer are in the fight for their lives when their investigation into a gristly murder uncovers dark secrets among a rural community.

movie:tt23732034.name: The Uninvited
movie:tt23732034.description: Rose and Sammy enjoy an idyllic life with love, a Hollywood Hills home, and a curious son. During a party, Sammy assigns unusual significance to it, while Rose juggles preparations amid distractions.  The unexpected arrival of Helen, who claims residence there, oscillates between confusion and lucidity. Strangely, Helen possesses intimate knowledge of the house and its guests. Her revelations spark drama, unearthing hidden truths and compelling Rose to confront her past, future, and the desire for change.

movie:tt36956284.name: Still Sexy
movie:tt36956284.description: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

movie:tt15180340.name: Something Divine
movie:tt15180340.description: Ray Cappo lead singer of the straightedge hardcore band Youth of Today at the height of their growing popularity, leaves the band and goes to India. Ray becomes the monk Raghunath. What follows is the confluence of two worlds coming together. Hardcore punk and spirituality. Something Divine is a pilgrimage through the holy cites of India and concert halls in America. The film highlights the connection between people of very different backgrounds coming together through self-discovery, spirituality, music, the desire to grow and transform themselves personally.

movie:tt27560723.name: Everything's Going to Be Great
movie:tt27560723.description: Follows a year in the life of the Smart family as they struggle with over-sized dreams, identity, ghosts, and regional theatre.

movie:tt35330349.name: Undercover Party Crasher
movie:tt35330349.description: In order to get evidence for her case and dismantle a criminal organization, an uptight undercover cop crashes a high school graduation trip to a party-heavy beach in Brazil.

movie:tt32394518.name: Pickleballers
movie:tt32394518.description: After racking up $25,000 in fines due to her anger issues, a young woman enters a high-stakes pickleball tournament with her friends to win the cash prize, despite having no experience and facing a ruthless rival with a champion partner.

movie:tt33043602.name: The Fire and the Moth
movie:tt33043602.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a smuggler escapes with a rare Ife bronze head into a gritty western Nigerian town.

movie:tt28145120.name: The Wedding Party
movie:tt28145120.description: A surprise engagement leads four soon-to-be step-siblings on a 1,400 mile road trip to set aside their differences and become a blended family.

movie:tt31272547.name: Myth of Man
movie:tt31272547.description: Ella embarks on a whimsical odyssey between life and death, convinced she has received a message from her creator.

movie:tt14893438.name: Wish You Were Here
movie:tt14893438.description: A woman searching for a spark finds a whirlwind night of romance with a man only to discover he is terminally ill and commits to helping him spend his last days living life to the fullest.

movie:tt33816273.name: The Alien Perspective
movie:tt33816273.description: Discover the UFO phenomenon like never before, with insights from NASA, CNES, Oxford, compelling firsthand witnesses, and even the possible viewpoint of extraterrestrial visitors.

movie:tt39549557.name: No One Cares About Crazy People
movie:tt39549557.description: No One Cares About Crazy People is a powerful and deeply human documentary that confronts one of the most urgent yet overlooked crises of our time: the reality of living with severe mental illness in America. Director Gail Freedma...

movie:tt35381166.name: Row of Life
movie:tt35381166.description: Renowned ocean rower, Marine Corps veteran, three-time Paralympian, and 14-time Guinness World Record holder Angela Madsen embarks on a solo, unassisted journey across the Pacific Ocean from Los Angeles to Hawaii in 2020. Her voyage becomes a harrowing testament to determination, resilience, and immense courage in the face of the unknown. Across the vast ocean, her wife, Deb, offers unwavering support, championing Angela’s dream despite the profound challenges and sacrifices.

movie:tt36220451.name: Holy Padel
movie:tt36220451.description: Max and Pablito love padel to the point of neglecting their families. Their wives, Helena and Soledad, try to stop them, but they also fall into obsession. The hobby becomes a battle of the sexes for control of the game and the home.

movie:tt32606918.name: From Ground Zero
movie:tt32606918.description: "From Ground Zero" is a compelling project that brings together 22 short films created by talented filmmakers from Gaza. Launched by Rashid Masharawi, a notable Palestinian filmmaker, the initiative emerged amid the backdrop of conflict, aiming to provide a platform for young artists to express themselves through their craft.  Each film, ranging from 3 to 7 minutes, presents a unique perspective on the current reality in Gaza. The project captures the diverse experiences of life in the Palestinian enclave, including the challenges, tragedies, and moments of resilience faced by its people. With a mix of genres such as fiction, documentary, docu-fiction, animation, and experimental cinema, "From Ground Zero" showcases a rich tapestry of stories that reflect the sorrow, joy, and hope inherent in Gazan life.

movie:tt21861086.name: Guns & Moses
movie:tt21861086.description: A beloved small town rabbi in the high desert becomes an unlikely gunslinger after his community is violently attacked.

movie:tt36158184.name: The Art of Destruction
movie:tt36158184.description: The unique music documentary about the legendary thrash metal band Destruction.

movie:tt15911108.name: 120 Bahadur
movie:tt15911108.description: Valiant Indian soldiers fight against Chinese troops during the 1962 Sino-Indian War, preventing a potential occupation of Ladakh region in the Battle of Rezang La.

movie:tt34194399.name: Burt
movie:tt34194399.description: Burt, a 69-year-old musician with Parkinson’s, has his life turned upside down when a man from New York shows up claiming to be his son. Having always dreamed of being a father, Burt embraces Sammy and invites him to stay for the weekend, where he lives with his grumpy landlord.

movie:tt39395735.name: His Brother's Wife
movie:tt39395735.description: A married woman's secret affair spirals out of control when her brother in law traps everyone inside the house to expose the truth. As tensions rise, a violent accident forces everyone to question loyalty, love, and who the real victim is.

movie:tt43750202.name: Livestream from Hell
movie:tt43750202.description: In the upcoming dark horror-comedy film Livestream From Hell, an ambitious, high-stakes internet broadcast hosted by the chaotic trio of Kevin Hart, Kai Cenat, and Druski spirals into absolute madness. What begins as a massive, in...

movie:tt15180032.name: Basic Psych
movie:tt15180032.description: When a psychiatrist takes a paranoid murderer as a patient, his family is thrown into a nightmare as he unwittingly invites danger into his home.

movie:tt29824649.name: Skate to Hell
movie:tt29824649.description: A group of teenagers steal a supernatural skateboard owned by Satan's son. Now the devil wants it back.

movie:tt2120152.name: The Invisible War
movie:tt2120152.description: An investigative documentary about the epidemic of rape of soldiers within the US military.

movie:tt28007064.name: Superboys of Malegaon
movie:tt28007064.description: The residents of Malegaon look to Bollywood cinema for a much-needed escape from daily drudgery. Amateur filmmaker Nasir Shaikh gets inspired to make a film for the people of Malegaon, by the people of Malegaon. He bands together his ragtag group of friends to bring his vision to life, thereby bringing a fresh lease of life into the town.

movie:tt15699652.name: Dog Patrol: Operation Santa Paws
movie:tt15699652.description: Samuel and his friends along with his trusted dog Athena have to go for the adventure of a lifetime, matching wits with a mob boss to solve Oscar's riddles in order to help Athena save Christmas for the whole town.

movie:tt27802912.name: Ace
movie:tt27802912.description: Kannan,  with a past comes to Malaysia to turn over a new leaf. But when he realises that the girl he loves needs money to get out of a difficult situation, he commits a robbery that makes him the target of a fearsome gangster and the girl’s stepfather, an immoral cop.

movie:tt14402042.name: Bad Shabbos
movie:tt14402042.description: An engaged interfaith couple are about to have their parents meet for the first time over a Shabbat dinner when an accidental death gets in the way.

movie:tt31251651.name: German Horror Story - Teutonic Terror Tales
movie:tt31251651.description: This chilling presentation consists of ten award-winning short films from up-and-coming horror storytellers. Unique frights, held together by a gripping wrap-around story whose only limits are your fears.

movie:tt15464188.name: Ikkis
movie:tt15464188.description: Set against the backdrop of the 1971 war, follows the life of second Lieutenant Arun Khetrapal.

movie:tt34769247.name: Not My Dog
movie:tt34769247.description: When a stray dog follows 12-year-old Bridget through her small town, she embarks on an unexpected journey, discovering loyalty, courage, and the joy of an unlikely friendship along the way.

movie:tt32175880.name: Kishkindhapuri
movie:tt32175880.description: A ghost walking tour group visits an abandoned radio station, inadvertently awakening a vengeful spirit.

movie:tt29764309.name: Thomas Müller - One of a Kind
movie:tt29764309.description: Title collector, popular figure, advertising icon, and the face of German football – that's how we know Thomas Müller. But who is the person behind the superstar? We accompany Thomas Müller over a season before he departs from the national team and experience him with his loved ones: honest, authentic, and quick-witted - one of a kind!

movie:tt13502512.name: Chaperone
movie:tt13502512.description: Set in rural Hawai’i and featuring an entirely AANHPI cast, Chaperone follows Misha, an unambitious 29-year-old woman who finds a dangerous acceptance in a bright 18-year-old athlete who mistakes her for a fellow high school student.

movie:tt32824944.name: Becoming Vera
movie:tt32824944.description: In Miami, 18-year-old pianist Vera, a foster child aging out of the system, struggles to pursue her passion for Latin Jazz amidst poverty and exploitation. After landing a freelance job painting a music studio, she impresses Hector, the studio owner and music producer, who offers her a chance to compose. However, Hector exploits her talent, stealing her composition for his own gain. Faced with betrayal and self-doubt, Vera almost gives up her dream. But with determination and the support of friends, she finds her voice and takes one final step toward a future in Latin Jazz, proving that anything is possible with resilience and self-belief.

movie:tt31719949.name: The Short Game
movie:tt31719949.description: Jeremy Avery is vying for a college golf scholarship, but his preparation and game are affected by family pressures related to his younger autistic brother Ethan. Jeremy’s path leads him on a journey of discovery both internal and of his brother’s savant like gifts, that if embraced can create an unstoppable pair.

movie:tt12357400.name: Going Postal: The Legacy Foretold
movie:tt12357400.description: Feature length documentary about the infamous video game franchise 'Postal' by Running with Scissors. Exploring the company's history and possible imprint violent video games bring to the real world.

movie:tt30829319.name: An Army of Women
movie:tt30829319.description: A group of women in Austin, Texas join forces and help build a movement of plaintiffs legally challenging the system that allowed their rapists to walk free. Their groundbreaking class-action lawsuit is the first to argue that sexual assault isn’t prosecuted due to gender discrimination. This is the landmark story of women fighting to hold law enforcement accountable, with resounding relevance worldwide.

movie:tt8839576.name: Bau, Artist at War
movie:tt8839576.description: Based on the true story of Joseph and Rebecca Bau, whose wedding took place in the Plaszow concentration camp during WW2. Using his artistic skills, Joseph stays alive and helps hundreds to escape. Miraculously, he finds love in the midst of despair. Years later, when called to be a key witness in the trial of the brutal Nazi officer who tortured him and killed his father, Joseph is thrust back into vivid memories of the Holocaust. Now, he calls upon this love and resilience of spirit to face the ultimate demon of his past.

movie:tt34382183.name: Rabisu: Curse of the Demon
movie:tt34382183.description: A group of paranormal hunters chase a lead for an urn holding an ancient spirit. In an abandoned warehouse, the group quickly realizes that what was supposed to be just another one of their videos, could end up having deadly consequences.

movie:tt36598704.name: Off the Air
movie:tt36598704.description: Two estranged sisters reunite to sell their late father's radio station, but unresolved issues from their past complicate their plans to move on.

movie:tt32832266.name: Maalik
movie:tt32832266.description: A gangster with political ambitions rises to power through the criminal underworld.

movie:tt31850758.name: Uppu Kappurambu
movie:tt31850758.description: A fictional village faces an extraordinary crisis as the cemetery runs out of space. Uproarious chaos ensues as the community rallies together, finding inventive solutions to overcome this unusual predicament.

movie:tt36231248.name: Out the Game
movie:tt36231248.description: Todd and Lisa are on the brink. As a big argument unfolds, we are treated to glimpses into their past when life was still ahead of them. At the end, secrets come to light, and past issues surface that threaten to tear them apart.

movie:tt31690723.name: Deadly Escape
movie:tt31690723.description: After escaping from a maximum-security prison, Freda Maxwell, a woman convicted of murdering her  abusive father, is desperate to stay ahead of the law. When she kidnaps Drew Peterson, a seemingly innocent med  student, to aid her getaway, her plan takes a horrifying turn. Drew’s polite facade unravels, revealing a dangerous  predator with dark intentions. As Freda navigates her fight for freedom, she finds herself trapped in a psychological battle with a man who views her  as a pawn in his own twisted game. With both the police and Drew closing in, Freda must confront her haunted past  and summon every ounce of will to outsmart her captor and uncover the truth that could save her—or seal her fate forever

movie:tt35987107.name: Asymmetric Disclosure
movie:tt35987107.description: Dr. Steven Greer exposes the hidden truths and the earth-changing consequences if this secrecy continues. He reveals a web of disinformation and the urgent need for disclosure before it's too late.

movie:tt32376637.name: The Beast of Trinity Texas
movie:tt32376637.description: The Beast of Trinity Texas is a murder mystery film set in a small East Texas town where a former homicide detective turned sheriff must confront a possible mythical beast

movie:tt36462054.name: An Endless Wedding
movie:tt36462054.description: During a wedding in a riad on the edge of the Moroccan desert, Paul meets Louna, the bride's sister and witness. Following a paranormal event, they both find themselves trapped in the same space-time, forced to live the same day over and over again. And so begins a love story set against the backdrop of a time loop and a never-ending marriage…

movie:tt34577313.name: Hydra
movie:tt34577313.description: Four strangers wake up in a cabin where they encounter a legendary three-headed snake.

movie:tt32646625.name: Fairest of them All
movie:tt32646625.description: The Mad Hatter has hunted down princesses from the fairytale lands; Ariel, Belle, Alice, Cinderella, Snow White, Tinkerbell and Sleeping Beauty and makes them fight in a Hunger Games style death match. Who is the fairest of them all?

movie:tt38494111.name: 15 Days: The Real Story of America's Pandemic School Closures
movie:tt38494111.description: A documentary revealing why America's school closures lasted longer than almost any other nation. Framed as a forensic analysis of what happened to children during school closures, it blends director Natalya Murakhver's perspective as a Soviet immigrant with voices of children and families nationwide, exposing devastating learning loss, mental health crises, and inequality.

movie:tt30788051.name: The ReWrite.
movie:tt30788051.description: A struggling screenwriter, obsessed with portraying Black Excellence and authenticity on the big screen, is forced to do a rewrite of his latest draft in order to save his career.

movie:tt35683795.name: Carjackers
movie:tt35683795.description: Nora is a valet driver; with Zoé, Steve and Prestance, her colleagues and friends, she has set up the Carjackers team. By day, they serve wealthy clients in palaces, but when they're not working, they rob those whose evil deeds th...

movie:tt35993050.name: A Tailor-Made Romance
movie:tt35993050.description: A struggling designer takes a job as a personal stylist for a grumpy but ridiculously handsome billionaire. As she revamps his wardrobe and he teaches her about business, they realize they just might be the perfect fit.

movie:tt37679060.name: Dragon Fury 3
movie:tt37679060.description: Deep within a high-security government bunker, an ancient nightmare has broken loose. This time, there’s nowhere to run. A daring break-in at a classified research facility quickly turns into a bloodbath when a group of intruders discovers they aren't alone. Instead of the secrets they came for, they find themselves hunted by genetically engineered, apex predators: lethal dragons with a taste for human prey. Trapped between a tactical lockdown and the jaws of prehistoric monsters, the group must fight through dark corridors and deadly traps. It’s a race against time to escape before the facility is purged - or the dragons finish their feast.

movie:tt32375450.name: Banned Together
movie:tt32375450.description: A diverse cast of visionary teenagers, stirring public protests, private threats, criminal charges, and drama-filled school board meetings: this is the explosive world of BANNED TOGETHER. The film pulls back the curtain on two of the most controversial issues in America today: book bans and curriculum censorship in public schools.

movie:tt36907564.name: After 30
movie:tt36907564.description: Four Nigerian women over 30 navigate love, friendship, and societal pressure to settle down. Balancing careers, growth, and evolving relationships, they challenge norms in a world that often defines women by status. A compelling drama about modern women redefining life on their own terms.

movie:tt38631437.name: Finding Harmony: A King's Vision
movie:tt38631437.description: In an unprecedented portrait of King Charles III, Finding Harmony: A King's Vision provides intimate insight into His Majesty's passionate quest to reunite humanity with nature. Academy Award-winner Kate Winslet narrates this journey through The King's Foundation's vital work.

movie:tt28702415.name: Rich Kid
movie:tt28702415.description: When high school senior and math prodigy, Ethan Young is enrolled in public school for the first time, his privileged, upper-class life becomes a secret he must hide if he wants to fit in and successfully lead his new school's underdog economics team to victory. And after being relegated to public school for disobeying his father (Wayne), Ethan is forced to choose between two competing priorities of becoming a successor to his father's business legacy or forging his own path and helping his newfound friends.

movie:tt14209618.name: Game Changer
movie:tt14209618.description: An honest IAS officer's fight against a corrupt political system through fair and transparent elections.

movie:tt31317401.name: Graduation Trip: Mallorca
movie:tt31317401.description: High school seniors on a graduation trip to Mallorca with teachers find their plans derailed when forced into hotel quarantine due to a new COVID-19 outbreak.

movie:tt34546353.name: Deeper
movie:tt34546353.description: In a remote part of New Zealand, lies a cold, dark and mysterious cave system with the potential to be the deepest dived cave in the world. It’s here that explorer and hero of the Thai cave rescue Richard “Harry” Harris is searching for a sense of self. There’s no question that this is the highest stakes dive he has ever attempted. Underground, underwater, with a finite amount of gas to breathe, it’s a dangerous game to play. So what drives Harry to continue in his pursuit when he knows the cost - not just to himself, but to those he loves - and will he make it back to them?

movie:tt32635940.name: Hook
movie:tt32635940.description: Driven by a hallucinogenic drug and a thirst for revenge, James Hook murders John Darling and loses his hand to Peter Pan. Eighteen years later, Wendy, now married to Peter, has a daughter, Lily. Lily discovers Hook is her biological father, leading her to a remote birthday retreat. Hook escapes prison and embarks on a killing spree, targeting Lily and her friends at the manor.

movie:tt35668907.name: Neo Nuggets: A Pulled Pork Comedy
movie:tt35668907.description: Flo Kienzl and Eddi Kovac wanted to lead a quiet life-but when Samira suddenly reappears, accompanied by a group of heavily armed figures and a mysterious treasure in Lake Toplitz, the two have no choice but to help their sister, whom they believed to be dead.

movie:tt31391925.name: A Requiem for Desire
movie:tt31391925.description: A journey to the past awakens the passion within Rose. A timeless spirited romance between the present and the Victorian Era.

movie:tt33499600.name: Sanibel
movie:tt33499600.description: Initially an offbeat comedy exploring the quirky, seashell-obsessed culture of Southwest Florida, six weeks into filming, Hurricane Ian — one of the most destructive storms in U.S. history — devastates the region. As waters recede, the crew return to find a transformed landscape and story. What was once lighthearted now grapples with a deeper question: will the community's love for shells and the coastline survive the weight of its overwhelming grief, or will it find a way to heal and rebuild?

movie:tt16763584.name: Anxiety Club
movie:tt16763584.description: ANXIETY CLUB provides a humorous and heartfelt look at our common experience of anxiety through the lens of some of the most brilliant (and anxious) comedians working today.

movie:tt34984715.name: Dhandoraa
movie:tt34984715.description: In a remote village, over a single day, four characters respond differently to the death of an upper-caste man named Shivaji.

movie:tt24578426.name: Arctic's Edge
movie:tt24578426.description: Calvin Trask lives in a dead end Arctic town on the fringes of society, until mysterious stranger Lucas Wade arrives, turning his solitary life upside down. Calvin's curiosity gets the better of him and is quickly pulled into Lucas' dangerous world. As secrets slowly unravel, Calvin realises just what kind of jeopardy he's put himself in, a place where murder and betrayal are at the forefront, in this icy Nordic thriller.

movie:tt35559925.name: With You in the Future
movie:tt35559925.description: Carlos and Elena are about to sign a divorce when they receive an unexpected gift that will allow them to travel back in time. Back in the '90s, that nostalgic era of leather jackets, rowdy hairstyles and pop-rock, they will seek to change their destiny.

movie:tt34377777.name: Torn: The Israel-Palestine Poster War on New York City Streets
movie:tt34377777.description: After Hamas kidnapped 251 people from Israel on October 7, and as Israel’s war in Gaza unfolded, a conflict thousands of miles away erupted on New York’s walls. TORN captures the emotional fallout of the now-iconic “KIDNAPPED” poster campaign - a grassroots act of solidarity that quickly became a flashpoint, igniting fierce confrontations between pro-Israel and pro-Palestinian New Yorkers. Through the voices of artists, activists, and hostage families, the film unpacks the motivations behind those putting up and tearing down the posters, exposing a complex proxy war fought in stickers, slogans, and torn paper. By revealing how a distant war fractured daily life in one of the world’s most diverse cities, the film forces a reckoning with identity, free speech, and empathy in an age of polarization.

movie:tt21257364.name: Who Wants to Marry an Astronaut?
movie:tt21257364.description: David is a dopey hopeless romantic with a hippy mother and a best friend who also works for him. After fifteen years of living together, on an impulse, he decides to ask his partner to marry him in Las Vegas. His anticipation for the dream wedding and trip is crushed when his partner answers ‘No’. David decides to power through with his plans and now he has ten days to find the knight in shining armor that will marry him in Las Vegas.

movie:tt27499420.name: The Dog Bite Murders
movie:tt27499420.description: Inspired by true events, in 1910, two army deserters are wanted for the murder of two hunters in the Arizona Territory. In the era of pioneer justice in the west, a strong-willed defense attorney bites off more than he can chew.

movie:tt36938121.name: 60 Dates in 6 Months
movie:tt36938121.description: A widowed woman in her 50s, recovering from a neck injury, sets out to go on 60 dates in six months-facing bad matches, worse advice, and unexpected healing in her hilariously messy comeback to modern love.

movie:tt28806833.name: Cruel Love
movie:tt28806833.description: After falling in love with Ivan, a stranger who once helped her, Julia marries him, but his suspicious behavior soon threatens their happiness.

movie:tt28247126.name: A Gangster's Life
movie:tt28247126.description: When two low-level criminals scam a vicious London mob and are in over their heads, they flee to rural Greece to avoid the bloody repercussions. But escape isn't that simple.

movie:tt35694565.name: #Single
movie:tt35694565.description: Vijay, a bank employee, falls in love with Purva at first sight and attempts to get closer to her in hopes of winning her affection. Meanwhile, Harini who secretly harbours feelings for Vijay, begins to follow him—turning his love life into a comedic triangle.

movie:tt39210294.name: Black Burns Fast
movie:tt39210294.description: Black Burns Fast is a queer and quirky coming of age film set in at a prestigious boarding school in South Africa. 17-year-old adorkable Luthando is on track for a normal academic year, until Ayanda arrives at the school and forces her to rethink everything. In the aftermath, Luthando struggles with juggling multiple identities to avoid rejection from her mother and her schoolmates as she comes to terms with her sexuality.

movie:tt27056066.name: Sky Force
movie:tt27056066.description: A gripping tale inspired by true events from one of the deadliest air strikes between India and Pakistan. A hero lost, a comrade's quest for truth-an epic tribute to bravery, sacrifice, and unbreakable courage.

movie:tt18225644.name: Ouija: A New Beginning
movie:tt18225644.description: Molly Price is a woman on the run, but when her oldest daughter finds a Ouija board and attempts to communicate with her deceased father, she invites the spirit of an ancient witch into her soul and puts the entire family at risk.

movie:tt39371435.name: General Butt Naked: Child Sacrifice and the Destruction of Nations
movie:tt39371435.description: A documentary directed by David Buboltz.

movie:tt33430448.name: Serious People
movie:tt33430448.description: A successful music video director and expectant father pushes his work/life balance to the extreme as he hires a doppelgänger to work in his stead.

movie:tt32658505.name: Leprechaun: The Beginning
movie:tt32658505.description: A family discovers a treasure box of gold in their late father's house. What seems like a dream come true turns into a nightmare as, one by one, they are stalked and killed by the real owner of the gold, the mischievous and deadly Leprechaun.

movie:tt36683600.name: Efendiler
movie:tt36683600.description: "Efendiler" tells the story of three comedians who find themselves caught in unexpected events on an island while auditioning for actors.

movie:tt40795889.name: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
movie:tt40795889.description: An amazing cast takes you on a journey beyond UFO Disclosure. It starts within the cement walls of Washington DC, and then guides you beyond your imagination. Prepare for an awesome adventure that will leave you questioning EVERYTHING.

movie:tt37800847.name: Don't
movie:tt37800847.description: Two women, Morgan and Rea, relive their past relationship through a series of fragmented memories, revealing not just the past, but the distance between them now.

movie:tt32452610.name: Whisper Breach
movie:tt32452610.description: Three battle-hardened friends are pulled into a web of deception when ex-Navy SEAL Kent Collins is asked "off the record" to evaluate Whisper Breach - an independently trained AI built for covert operations. What starts as a simple assessment quickly spirals out of control as the AI entangles itself in their lives. From that moment every decision they make will affect  their friendship - and possibly the future of humanity.

movie:tt32119171.name: Mouse of Horrors
movie:tt32119171.description: A group of young adults are walking the grounds of a fair after hours when they suddenly realize that they are being stalked by a killer 'mouse.'

movie:tt28377588.name: Ground Zero
movie:tt28377588.description: An Indian army officer embarks on a mission leading to India’s most successful counter-terrorism operation in history.

movie:tt36690031.name: Landline
movie:tt36690031.description: A stranded military sergeant receives eerie calls from an old landline, each guiding him to save his pregnant wife from a relentless killer—only to watch her die again and again in a nightmarish loop.

movie:tt32536745.name: Remotely Famous
movie:tt32536745.description: Tess and Steph embark on a road trip into the Australian outback, hoping to attract a social media following. Their survival skills are tested when their vehicle breaks down.

movie:tt30458710.name: Eastern Western
movie:tt30458710.description: This beautifully understated Western is the story of a son raised by two fathers, one from the European East and one from the American West. On the cusp of the 20th century, somewhere on the American frontier, Igor, an immigrant and recent widower, struggles to raise his two-year-old son Ivo on his own. When his American friend and mentor Duncan decides to move his horse-breeding business and young family to California, Igor and Ivo join the wagon train headed West.

movie:tt35051426.name: Dinner with Friends
movie:tt35051426.description: Shot in 9 days on a budget of $100k, Dinner with Friends follows eight friends trying to hold on to their group as they get older and life gets complicated. Over a series of dinners, the group deals with loyalty, loss, and an uncertain future as relationships shift and secrets are unraveled, with each dinner bringing its own dynamic-shifting announcement of reconciliation, unexpected relationships, and betrayal. The city is crumbling, the climate is changing, and worries about the future of the world are making it hard for this group of friends to stay together. But they’ll come to realize everything would be much harder if they don’t.

movie:tt36164396.name: Disconnected 2
movie:tt36164396.description: Your favorite overstimulated family is back! Chile’s favorite manic mother Victoria has swung from one extreme to the other, and is now a full-on helicopter mom. At work, she also lands a coveted opportunity for her to take the kids with her for a new position in Miami. But Julian and Clara aren’t on board to leave their friends behind, and it’s a battle of the wits in this laugh out loud sequel.

movie:tt36014845.name: Ghich Pich
movie:tt36014845.description: A coming-of-age story about middle-class Indian fathers and their relationships with their sons - entangled in rebellion, insecurities and bound by tradition. Set in '90s Chandigarh.

movie:tt32322281.name: Fatherhood
movie:tt32322281.description: Between 1979 and 2016, trans people in Norway were forced to undergo sterilisation, depriving them of their right to bear children. Kris has dreamed of becoming a father since kindergarten. Anticipating a euphoric pregnancy, he exudes a sage positivity despite past and present injustices. Together with Sindre and David, and their devoted families, Kris becomes a part of the resistance forging change

movie:tt37983291.name: The Christmas Mixer
movie:tt37983291.description: When a laid-off TV host and her cameraman launch a live stream holiday baking challenge, they whip up viral success, community spirit, and an unexpected romance

movie:tt42804668.name: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles
movie:tt42804668.description: What was once considered a childhood hobby has evolved into a billion-dollar global marketplace. Signed, Sealed & Delivered takes audiences inside the high-stakes world of sports collectibles, where rare trading cards, signed jerseys, and historic memorabilia have become status symbols, emotional investments, and financial assets. Through exclusive access, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, the documentary explores the personalities and businesses driving the hobby's modern explosion. Featuring appearances and commentary tied to sports and business icons including Lionel Messi, Kevin O'Leary, and Gary Vaynerchuk, the film uncovers the culture, psychology, risks, and financial opportunities behind the booming collectibles industry — while asking what people are truly chasing when they spend fortunes trying to own a piece of sports history.

movie:tt32421430.name: Flesh of the Unforgiven
movie:tt32421430.description: A dark, psychological, supernatural horror that follows a struggling couple tortured by the twisted games played by the Death Dealer and his manipulating legion of demons.

movie:tt33733323.name: The Time Vortex
movie:tt33733323.description: A quantum physics student must fight for his life and the girl he loves when he discovers the universe is governed by 7 parallel timelines and her estranged ex-boyfriend is out to kill her in every single one.

movie:tt27450169.name: A Gunfighter's Deal
movie:tt27450169.description: In his darkest days, Silas Johnson gets a visit from a mysterious man who promises to make him the fast-gun that he has always wanted to be. But, at what cost?

movie:tt28718656.name: Life After
movie:tt28718656.description: LIFE AFTER is a gripping investigative documentary that exposes the tangled web of moral dilemmas and profit motives surrounding assisted dying. Disabled filmmaker Reid Davenport uncovers shocking abuses of power while amplifying the voices of the disability community fighting for justice and dignity in an unfolding matter of life and death.  In 1983, a disabled Californian woman named Elizabeth Bouvia sought the “right to die,” igniting a national debate about autonomy and the value of disabled lives. After years of courtroom battles, Bouvia vanished from public view. Sundance-winner Davenport embarks on a personal investigation to find out what really happened to Bouvia and reveal why her story is disturbingly relevant today.

movie:tt22332348.name: Follow Me
movie:tt22332348.description: Pushing boundaries and blurring the lines between relationships to reveal that money, secrets and deception is a deadly mix.

movie:tt33292531.name: The Solution
movie:tt33292531.description: Allen returns home to help his father, Oscar, recover from a stroke, all while mending their strained relationship and reviving the family dry cleaning business.

movie:tt33054177.name: Halisa
movie:tt33054177.description: Sarah, 40, is a nurse at the Children’s Health Center in Halissa, a multi-ethnic and poverty neighborhood.  For two years, Sarah tries to get pregnant.  Her desire for a child is intertwined with the difficulties of a young mother until they reach an illusionary solution– the impossible gift of a baby.

movie:tt37963577.name: Last Save Point
movie:tt37963577.description: In a scorched, post-apocalyptic world, survival is fragile and trust is dangerous. When a hardened loner discovers a naive man with the mind of a child, the two form an uneasy alliance, their journey colliding with a sinister school where the once students (now adults) are still ruled by the authority figures of the past. Fear, secrets, and the threats prevent them from exploring whats beyond their gated community.

movie:tt9849644.name: Mind Thief
movie:tt9849644.description: A novelist realizes that her neighbors may be under the control of unknown forces. Little does she realize how close and sinister its influence has become. A harrowing, darkly humorous journey through the depths of the human psyche.

movie:tt39168629.name: Son Bayram
movie:tt39168629.description: Grandfather Halim, who lives in Germany, wants to spend his last holiday in his hometown. His grandson, Hami, disguises Maşukiye as Trabzon to take his grandfather to the difficult-to-reach city. Hami, who complies with Grandfather Halim's demands, maintains the lie and finds himself torn between Anna and Pelin. When his grandfather disappears, things get complicated, and his family rushes to the village for an explanation.

movie:tt27371347.name: Clown-N-Out in Valley Village
movie:tt27371347.description: In "Clown n Out," a down-on-his-luck clown gets caught up in a dangerous criminal underworld and must navigate a treacherous maze of lies, deceit, and violence to survive.

movie:tt36617646.name: The Science Adventures of Tom & Huck
movie:tt36617646.description: Tom Sawyer and Huck Finn return in all-new, science-filled adventures. With Becky Thatcher and friends, they tackle trappers, robbers, and old foes-learning real science like gravity, energy, and magnetism along the way.

movie:tt18923886.name: The Legend of El Chupacabra
movie:tt18923886.description: A young cryptozoologist hunts the legendary El Chupacabra in hopes of collecting a $50,000 reward with the help of his estranged best friend and the only girl he's ever loved.

movie:tt36164852.name: Tad and the Magic Lamp
movie:tt36164852.description: Tad, his girlfriend Sara and their friends Momia, Jeff and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.

movie:tt37759175.name: James Can Eat
movie:tt37759175.description: A gripping documentary feature that follows the extraordinary rise of James Webb, Australia's top-ranked competitive eater and the fourth in the world, as he battles physical limits, personal setbacks, and global rivals in his quest to dethrone eating icon Joey Chestnut.

movie:tt28596894.name: Braving Rapids
movie:tt28596894.description: A family heals during a river rafting trip a year after the passing of the dad but when young Grace rescues a wolf cub, she must reconcile her adoption abandonment issues as she prepares to surrender the beloved cub to wildlife authorities.

movie:tt46665146.name: Fresh Meat
movie:tt46665146.description: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

movie:tt33079076.name: Betray: Thirst
movie:tt33079076.description: Jamal Wiggins is a lawyer at Tate and Wiggins, the law firm he co-founded with his college roommate and friend, Darren Tate. While he enjoys professional success, his personal life is strained by a sexless marriage to Shavonne, his wife of 15 years. He takes on a case representing Jada Campbell, whose husband was involved in a life-altering accident. Jada, a victim of verbal and emotional abuse from her husband, develops feelings for Jamal. He, in turn, succumbs to temptation and crosses a professional boundary, soon realizing his world may be on the verge of collapse.

movie:tt31936713.name: Jitters
movie:tt31936713.description: Detective Collymore, a single divorced father, stumbles upon a mysterious case involving the death of Tiffany, initially deemed natural. Digging deeper, he discovers the horrors of Jitters.

movie:tt42467740.name: Where Is Your Faith
movie:tt42467740.description: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.

movie:tt32831759.name: Laila
movie:tt32831759.description: Sonu Model, a renowned beautician from the old city, is forced to disguise himself as Laila, leading to a series of comedic, romantic, and action-packed events. Chaos ensues in this hilarious laugh riot.

movie:tt33712667.name: A Line of Fire
movie:tt33712667.description: An ex-FBI agent is pulled back into a dangerous world when his former partner's niece asks for his help.

movie:tt37185884.name: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
movie:tt37185884.description: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

movie:tt40956890.name: Scotland's Highlands & Islands with Lewis Nunn
movie:tt40956890.description: British travel writer Lewis Nunn embarks on an epic 362-mile journey through Scotland's Inner Hebrides aboard the Hebridean Princess, tracing a route rich with Scottish history, wild beauty, and unexpected adventure. His journey c...

movie:tt36592994.name: The Christmas Decoy
movie:tt36592994.description: A socially awkward man finds himself stuck in a holiday love triangle and learns that doing the right thing can lead to something real.

movie:tt7395324.name: Past Life
movie:tt7395324.description: When an unemployed reporter is hypnotized as part of a past life regression event, he wakes not with memories of life as royalty or some other glamorous person, but instead finds himself haunted by the memories of a serial killer.

movie:tt39528902.name: Don't Be Shy!
movie:tt39528902.description: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

movie:tt34383140.name: Pennu Case
movie:tt34383140.description: A group of men realize that they are all the victim of the same serial wedding scammer.

movie:tt10533580.name: Gym Rat
movie:tt10533580.description: An ex-con bodybuilder driven by a Mr. Olympia fantasy, unravels as obsession, illegal steroids and a volatile gym boss collide; until love forces him to confront the monster within.

movie:tt14678976.name: Prison
movie:tt14678976.description: The seemingly innocent Alexander Rothstein ends up in jail for drug trafficking. In fact, he bears the responsibility of providing for his newly pregnant girlfriend Julia and their future child. To make matters worse, he ends up sharing a cell with the dangerous Russian Viktor and the unstable Arab Khalil. To fulfill his duties as a father and escape the dangers of prison, Alex needs money - a lot of money. His desperation drives him into the arms of the Kurdish gangster boss Mazlum, also known as the Dutchman, and back to his friend from drug therapy, Cem. Together, they weave the threads of an organization that casts its nets even beyond the prison walls, but at the height of euphoria, Alex suddenly finds himself caught in it. He is left with only two options: Succumb to the conspiracy of intrigue and betrayal or become a monster himself.

movie:tt36218322.name: 12A Railway Colony
movie:tt36218322.description: When easygoing Karthik falls head over heels for his charming neighbour, he thinks love is simple. But the closer he gets, the more tangled his world becomes, full of hidden truths, shocking lies, and unexpected twists

movie:tt32089596.name: Comrade Kalyan
movie:tt32089596.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

movie:tt28689422.name: 49 Miles More
movie:tt28689422.description: On their way to an annual reunion with university friends, Max—an unlucky insurance salesman struggling to find his place in life—and his carefree best friend Doug hit an unexpected roadblock when their car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

movie:tt22245582.name: Stolen Kingdom
movie:tt22245582.description: A look into the underground community of rule-breakers at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida and how their actions led to the disappearance of an Audio-Animatronic named Buzzy.

movie:tt37974010.name: Snake Creek
movie:tt37974010.description: Four friends become hunted by a giant killer snake during a canoeing trip on the Chattahoochee River and must overcome their differences in order to survive.

movie:tt20101594.name: Universe Designed
movie:tt20101594.description: "Universe Designed" is a documentary that explores some of the evidences for God's existence with interviews from some of the world's top Christian apologists.

movie:tt37886159.name: Peaky Blinders: The Real Story
movie:tt37886159.description: A behind-the-scenes documentary uncovering the real history of Birmingham’s Peaky Blinders, separating fact from fiction in the hit TV series and exploring the creative vision behind its unique style.

movie:tt33131034.name: Ebony & Ivory
movie:tt33131034.description: Two musical legends gather at a Scottish Cottage on The Mull Of Kintyre for a tense summit to discuss a potential collaboration that will ultimately result in a Global Number One smash hit single.

movie:tt13374694.name: The Story of Everything
movie:tt13374694.description: The Story of Everything is a cinematic exploration of the cosmos that reveals the hidden hand behind our universe. From the precise laws that govern the stars to the intricate patterns found in every living cell, the film traces evidence of intentional design throughout nature. Whether examining distant star-forming clouds or the spiral structure of DNA, we discover a consistent signature woven into the fabric of existence.

movie:tt36415530.name: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
movie:tt36415530.description: The tomatoes resurface, and this time the enemy is artificial. When Professor Gangreen’s young corporate prodigy goes rogue, the tomatoes start thinking for themselves. The vine gets smarter. The vine gets faster. The vine, for the first time, gets a plan.

movie:tt27677192.name: Cursed Hearse
movie:tt27677192.description: When a down on his luck hipster buys an old hearse with the hopes of converting it into a limousine service, he soon finds out that there's a lot more to the hearse than he bargained for .

movie:tt37455571.name: The Deadly Little Mermaid
movie:tt37455571.description: Some secrets are better left at the bottom of the ocean. Once she's in your house, there is no escape. When a struggling artist pulls a beautiful, unconscious woman from the freezing coastal waters, he thinks he’s performed a miracle. But as she recovers within the walls of his secluded home, a series of unsettling events leads him to a terrifying realization: her presence is no coincidence. She is inextricably linked to the same watery grave that claimed his family years ago.

movie:tt39207853.name: Creature of the Pines
movie:tt39207853.description: Creature of the Pines is a found footage horror movie set in the legendary New Jersey Pine Barrens, one of the most mysterious and unsettling stretches of wilderness in America. Locals have whispered about strange sightings and disappearances for generations, but few people are willing to talk about what they’ve seen, and even fewer dare to go looking.

movie:tt45821808.name: The Watergate Caper: Richard Nixon and the Death of the American Dream
movie:tt45821808.description: The Watergate Caper is an archival documentary, narrated by Harry Shearer (This is Spinal Tap), tracing the rise and fall of Nixon from the presidential primaries of 1968 through the Watergate break-in of June 1972 to his resignation two years later, killing trust in the political process and the American presidency in the wake of the Vietnam War.  The film draws on hundreds of hours of TV news taped off-air by the Nixon White House to tell the untold story of the Watergate burglars. How did tapping the wrong phone with a bug that didn't work lead to their arrests and Nixon's resignation?  It also explores representations of the Nixon years in popular culture, using the music, commercials, and cinema of the era to evoke a fevered political landscape of culture wars, dirty tricks, paranoia and assassination.

movie:tt39358084.name: Lulk
