Can he turn himself and his class into a success story, or will he fail spectacularly?

series:tt31925820.name: Dupahiya
series:tt31925820.description: Dhadakpur, the Belgium of Bihar, is on the cusp of celebrating 25 years of being crime free. But chaos strikes when a never-seen-before motorbike, that was purchased as a wedding gift gets stolen 7 days before the ceremony! The journey taken by the bride's family and ex-lover to find the Dupahiya forms the heart of this comedy, which explores the hopes and aspirations of simple people.

series:tt36220598.name: Heels in the Hay
series:tt36220598.description: Twelve city influencers trade their luxurious urban lives for the harsh reality of the Dutch countryside. No filters and no oat milk cappuccinos - just early mornings, dirty hands, and fierce competition. They discover that farm life holds more hidden challenges than they ever imagined. Which city dweller will hold their ground? One thing is certain: it won’t be a picture-perfect scene...

series:tt38570835.name: Hollywood Hustler: Glitz, Glam, Scam
series:tt38570835.description: From Midwest dreamer to Hollywood fraudster, Zach Horwitz constructs an elaborate over $650 million Hollywood scam to finance his obsessive quest for stardom. His former inner circle recount how Zach preyed on their trust while living extravagantly, but when investors stop receiving payments, the facade crumbles, exposing the depths of his deception.

series:tt37660537.name: Two Much with Kajol and Twinkle
series:tt37660537.description: Two of India’s sharpest women, Kajol and Twinkle, host a talk show that’s fun, unhinged and sneakily insightful - featuring celebrity guests, wild takes, and total chaos. Like the fun table at the party - everyone’s invited.

series:tt40856820.name: Chaar Yaar
series:tt40856820.description: A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

series:tt40857865.name: Jagamae Sangeetham
series:tt40857865.description: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

series:tt32832543.name: Tom Green Country
series:tt32832543.description: A funny and heartwarming glimpse into the hilarious life of the infamous comedian as he relocates from Los Angeles to a simpler life on his new remote farm. But farm life isn't easy. Tom scrambles to repair his century-old barns, build fences, install a chicken coop and take ownership of a variety of livestock! Has Tom Green finally bitten off more than he can chew?

series:tt40857820.name: Isakapatnam
series:tt40857820.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

series:tt34950769.name: Red Carpet Survival
series:tt34950769.description: Herbert Ballerina, Brenda Lodigiani, Antonio Ornano, Awed, Ginevra Fenyes, Pierluca Mariti, Michela Giraud, Gabriele Vagnato, and Francesco Arienzo are the bodyguards in the first edition of "Red Carpet Survival." The best team, at the end of the four episodes, will win the coveted Golden Pigeon. Alessia Marcuzzi will lead the bodyguards. Commenting on it all are the voices of Gialappa's Band.

series:tt35291001.name: The Tinellis
series:tt35291001.description: Marcelo Tinelli opens the doors of his mansion in Punta del Este to welcome his family and friends. He takes the opportunity to introduce them to his girlfriend, Milett, 30 years younger than him. However, the reaction of his daughters is not as expected, and it causes an emotional imbalance in the group a few months before a transcendental event: the wedding of Cande, Marcelo's second daughter.

series:tt28106758.name: Bandwaale
series:tt28106758.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

series:tt33290236.name: Taurasi
series:tt33290236.description: Basketball legend Diana Taurasi shares the inside story of her life and career - with no stone left unturned.

series:tt43702035.name: Marília Mendonça: All the Feels
series:tt43702035.description: How did an ordinary girl from the heart of Brazil become a phenomenon? Through previously unreleased footage, audio recordings and interviews, the series traces Marília Mendonça's meteoric rise from singing at a gas station to becoming one of Brazil's biggest artists.

series:tt39373808.name: MrBeast: Extreme Survival!
series:tt39373808.description: In this season, MrBeast pushes contestants and himself into the toughest survival experiments imaginable, from one hundred days in bunkers and circles to freezing expeditions and isolation tests. Every scenario is designed to strip life to its basics and reveal who has the strength, patience, and ingenuity to endure.

series:tt46658122.name: No Signal
series:tt46658122.description: Eight influencers accustomed to showcasing an idyllic life on social media attend a transformative retreat to get to know themselves better. What lies behind the perfect life they project?

series:tt39373979.name: MrBeast: Luxury Experiences!
series:tt39373979.description: In this season, MrBeast brings the height of luxury down to Earth. Everything from expensive dates, to high-paying jobs, to the world's most impressive superyachts.

series:tt39205808.name: Serious Business with Anthony Edwards
series:tt39205808.description: Anthony Edwards, the superstar guard for the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves, is all business. On the court or off, he's ready to challenge whoever, whenever. Perhaps he's crazy or maybe he's a genius, but Edwards believes he can challenge the world's most elite athletes and biggest celebrities in any competition imaginable - and believes he can win. For him, competition is Serious Business.

series:tt39230035.name: What Would You Rather?: Decide to Survive
series:tt39230035.description: Romesh Ranganathan hosts ten UK online stars playing Would You Rather for real. Fiendish dilemmas decide everything, from hilarious supersized games to how they eat and sleep. There's no right decision, but making the least worst choice could guarantee survival (in the game, not literally). You've played it hypothetically, now they're playing it for real, and only one will be crowned champion.

series:tt36851997.name: El Novicio Rebelde
series:tt36851997.description: Rogelio arrives in the El Milagro neighborhood on the run from a dangerous criminal and takes refuge inside the parish church, where he is mistaken for the new seminarian. Taking advantage of the confusion and fearing for his life, Rogelio plays along, but when he tries to escape, he realizes that not only is it impossible, but he no longer wants to leave.

series:tt29538565.name: Mama Drama
series:tt29538565.description: Four young mothers strengthen their friendship beyond their children's school chat group after an intense school camping trip, where they discover who is having an affair with one of their husbands.

series:tt41442832.name: Schnick Schnack Pumuckl treibt Schabernack
series:tt41442832.description: Pumuckl can no longer stand being alone in the workshop. Curious, the little kobold sets off on an adventure and, after an unintended boat ride on the Isar, ends up right in the middle of Munich. Starting from the English Garden, his turbulent journey back begins. Along the way, Pumuckl causes plenty of commotion, mischief, and unexpected encounters—playful, cheeky, yet always with heart and a strong sense of justice.

series:tt38639909.name: Castle Walls
series:tt38639909.description: In the eleventh century, Hasan Sabbah captures the castle of Alamut and founds a mysterious movement that challenges the established order. While his old friend Nizam al-Mulk strives to protect the empire, Azazil—a warrior freed from the dungeon—emerges as his most loyal *fedai*. In this tale where friendship turns to enmity, love, faith, betrayal, and the lust for power fuel a conflict that alters the course of history.

series:tt39653400.name: This Is Not a Dating Show
series:tt39653400.description: A live comedy and improvisation show, every episode of This Is Not A Dating Show brings together 100 singles who have been seriously unlucky in love. A difficult task, but nothing Galder Varas can't handle. And if nobody hooks up, at least we'll have had a laugh.

series:tt43308829.name: Patrocínio
series:tt43308829.description: In a world dominated by filters and controlled narratives, "Patrocinio" breaks with the formality of one of Portugal's most influential families to offer an intimate and unprecedented access to the sisters' world. The camera ceases to be a guest at gala events and instead portrays the emotional, professional, and familial structure that sustains an empire of influence, work, and sisterhood.

movie:tt10457128.name: Summer of 85
movie:tt10457128.description: When 16-year-old Alexis capsizes off the coast of Normandy, 18-year-old David heroically saves him. Alexis has just met the friend of his dreams, who opens his eyes to a new horizon of friendship, art and sexual bliss.

movie:tt5716464.name: Breathe
movie:tt5716464.description: The inspiring true love story of Robin and Diana Cavendish, an adventurous couple who refuse to give up in the face of a devastating disease.

movie:tt1825918.name: Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Across the 2nd Dimension
movie:tt1825918.description: Phineas and Ferb discover that Perry is a secret agent and they all get stuck in an alternate dimension where Doofenschmirtz is the ruler of the tri-state area.

series:tt6132720.name: Wounded Love
series:tt6132720.description: During the occupation of Izmir by Greeks, a Turkish soldier starts to work for the enemy. But he is not really on the side of the enemy. He must keep this secret at the cost of losing his family.

series:tt13315156.name: First Kill
series:tt13315156.description: Falling in love is tricky for teens Juliette and Calliope: One's a vampire, the other's a vampire hunter and both are ready to make their first kill.

series:tt22189294.name: Love in Contract
series:tt22189294.description: Contract marriage master Choi Sang-eun's alternate day romance with a long-term mystery client on Monday, Wednesday and Friday and a new superstar client on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.

series:tt7661384.name: The L Word: Generation Q
series:tt7661384.description: Bette Porter, Shane McCutcheon and Alice Pieszecki intermingle with a younger generation of Los Angelenos experiencing love, heartbreak, sex, setbacks and success.

series:tt0061266.name: Ironside
series:tt0061266.description: Paralyzed police veteran Robert T. Ironside becomes a special consultant to the force.

movie:tt11703050.name: The House
movie:tt11703050.description: Across different eras, a poor family, an anxious developer and a fed-up landlady become tied to the same mysterious house in this animated dark comedy.

movie:tt0983213.name: 5 Centimeters per Second
movie:tt0983213.description: Told in three interconnected segments, Takaki tells the story of his life as cruel winters, cold technology, and finally, adult obligations and responsibility converge to test the delicate petals of love.

movie:tt6495056.name: Migration
movie:tt6495056.description: A family of ducks try to convince their overprotective father to go on the vacation of a lifetime.

movie:tt0053285.name: Sleeping Beauty
movie:tt0053285.description: After being snubbed by the royal family, a malevolent fairy places a curse on a princess which only a prince can break, along with the help of three good fairies.

movie:tt0071679.name: It's the Easter Beagle, Charlie Brown!
movie:tt0071679.description: The Peanuts gang prepare for Easter in their own clumsy ways.

movie:tt2709768.name: The Secret Life of Pets
movie:tt2709768.description: The quiet life of a terrier named Max is upended when his owner takes in Duke, a stray whom Max instantly dislikes.

movie:tt1700841.name: Sausage Party
movie:tt1700841.description: A sausage leads a group of supermarket products on a journey to discover the truth about their existence and what really happens when they are picked off the shelf.

movie:tt1985949.name: The Angry Birds Movie
movie:tt1985949.description: When an island populated by happy, flightless birds is visited by mysterious green pigs, it's up to three unlikely outcasts to figure out what the pigs are up to.

movie:tt4624424.name: Storks
movie:tt4624424.description: Storks have moved on from delivering babies to packages. But when an order for a baby appears, the best delivery stork must scramble to fix the error by delivering the baby.

movie:tt0275847.name: Lilo & Stitch
movie:tt0275847.description: A young and parentless girl adopts a 'dog' from the local pound, completely unaware that it's supposedly a dangerous scientific experiment that's taken refuge on Earth and is now hiding from its creator and those who see it as a m...

movie:tt1985966.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
movie:tt1985966.description: Flint Lockwood now works at The Live Corp Company for his idol Chester V. But he's forced to leave his post when he learns that his most infamous machine is still operational, and is churning out menacing food-animal hybrids.

movie:tt1860353.name: Turbo
movie:tt1860353.description: A freak accident might just help an everyday garden snail achieve his biggest dream: winning the Indy 500.

movie:tt2357291.name: Rio 2
movie:tt2357291.description: It's a jungle out there for Blu, Jewel, and their three kids after they're hurtled from Rio de Janeiro to the wilds of the Amazon. As Blu tries to fit in, he goes beak-to-beak with the vengeful Nigel and meets his father-in-law.

movie:tt4853102.name: Batman: The Killing Joke
movie:tt4853102.description: As Batman hunts for the escaped Joker, the Clown Prince of Crime attacks the Gordon family to prove a diabolical point mirroring his own fall into madness.

movie:tt0358082.name: Robots
movie:tt0358082.description: In a robot world, a young idealistic inventor travels to the big city to join his inspiration's company, only to find himself opposing its sinister new management.

movie:tt0120131.name: The Lion King 2: Simba's Pride
movie:tt0120131.description: Simba's daughter is the key to a resolution of a bitter feud between Simba's pride and the outcast pride led by the mate of Scar.

movie:tt0848537.name: Epic
movie:tt0848537.description: A teenager finds herself transported to a deep forest setting where a battle between the forces of good and evil is taking place. She bands together with a ragtag group of characters to save their world--and ours.

movie:tt2279373.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
movie:tt2279373.description: When a diabolical pirate above the sea steals the secret Krabby Patty formula, SpongeBob and his friends team up in order to get it back.

movie:tt2261287.name: Leap!
movie:tt2261287.description: An orphan girl dreams of becoming a ballerina and flees her rural Brittany for Paris, where she passes for someone else and accedes to the position of pupil at the Grand Opera House.

movie:tt5595168.name: Kingsglaive: Final Fantasy XV
movie:tt5595168.description: King Regis, who oversees the land of Lucis, commands his army of soldiers to protect the kingdom from the Niflheim empire's plans to steal the sacred crystal which gives Lucis its magic and power.

movie:tt6182908.name: Smallfoot
movie:tt6182908.description: When a Yeti discovers a human and his fellow Yeti refuse to believe humans exist, he embarks on an journey to find the creature that can put him back in his community's good graces.

movie:tt0082406.name: The Fox and the Hound
movie:tt0082406.description: A fox named Tod and a hound named Copper vow to be best friends forever. But as Copper grows into a hunting dog, their unlikely friendship faces the ultimate test.

movie:tt0166813.name: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
movie:tt0166813.description: A captured mustang remains determined to return to his herd no matter what.

movie:tt0345950.name: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
movie:tt0345950.description: SpongeBob takes leave from Bikini Bottom in order to track down, with Patrick, King Neptune's stolen crown.

movie:tt0318403.name: The Lion King 3: Hakuna Matata
movie:tt0318403.description: Timon the meerkat and Pumbaa the warthog retell the story of The Lion King (1994) from their own perspective.

movie:tt0130623.name: Dinosaur
movie:tt0130623.description: An orphaned dinosaur raised by lemurs joins an arduous trek to a sanctuary after a meteorite shower destroys his family home.

movie:tt1219342.name: Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole
movie:tt1219342.description: The young owl Soren is kidnapped by the evil owls of St. Aegolious who want to turn him into a soldier. He escapes with some of his friends and warns the mythical guardians about the evil plan.

movie:tt2166834.name: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns, Part 2
movie:tt2166834.description: The Batman has returned after a 10-year absence. The Gotham authorities want to arrest him. An old foe wants a reunion. The Feds want the Man of Tomorrow to put a stop to him.

movie:tt0442933.name: Beowulf
movie:tt0442933.description: The warrior Beowulf must fight and defeat the monster Grendel, who is terrorizing Denmark, then Grendel's Mother, who begins killing out of revenge.

movie:tt0405296.name: A Scanner Darkly
movie:tt0405296.description: An undercover cop in a not-too-distant future becomes involved with a dangerous new drug and begins to lose his own identity as a result.

movie:tt3060952.name: Justice League: War
movie:tt3060952.description: The world's finest heroes found the Justice League in order to stop an alien invasion of Earth.

movie:tt0762125.name: Planet 51
movie:tt0762125.description: An alien civilization is invaded by Astronaut Chuck Baker, who believes that the planet was uninhabited. Wanted by the military, Baker must get back to his ship before it goes into orbit without him.

movie:tt0385700.name: Final Fantasy VII: Advent Children
movie:tt0385700.description: An ex-mercenary is forced out of isolation when three mysterious men kidnap and brainwash the city's children afflicted with the Geostigma disease.

movie:tt0076618.name: The Rescuers
movie:tt0076618.description: Two mice of the Rescue Aid Society search for a little girl kidnapped by unscrupulous treasure hunters.

movie:tt1185834.name: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
movie:tt1185834.description: As the Clone Wars sweep the galaxy, Anakin Skywalker and his new Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, embark on a mission to rescue the kidnapped son of Jabba the Hutt. However, the renegade Count Dooku is determined to ensure that they fail.

movie:tt0375568.name: Astro Boy
movie:tt0375568.description: When an android replica of a boy is rejected by his aggrieved creator, he goes off to find his own identity in an adventure that would make him the greatest hero of his time.

movie:tt5776208.name: Resident Evil: Vendetta
movie:tt5776208.description: Chris Redfield enlists the help of Leon S. Kennedy and Rebecca Chambers to stop a death merchant from spreading a deadly virus in New York.

movie:tt0471711.name: Futurama: Bender's Big Score
movie:tt0471711.description: Planet Express sees a hostile takeover and Bender falls into the hands of criminals where he is used to fulfill their schemes.

movie:tt3139072.name: Son of Batman
movie:tt3139072.description: Batman learns he has a violent, unruly pre-teen son, secretly raised by the terrorist group the League of Assassins.

movie:tt2483260.name: The Pirate Fairy
movie:tt2483260.description: When Zarina steals Pixie Hollow's Blue Pixie Dust and flies away, Tinker Bell and her friends sets on a journey to get them back.

movie:tt0347618.name: The Cat Returns
movie:tt0347618.description: After helping a cat, a seventeen-year-old girl finds herself involuntarily engaged to a cat Prince in a magical world where her only hope of freedom lies with a dapper cat statuette come to life.

movie:tt0095776.name: Oliver & Company
movie:tt0095776.description: A lost and alone kitten joins a gang of dogs engaged in petty larceny in New York City.

movie:tt2591814.name: The Garden of Words
movie:tt2591814.description: On a rainy morning in Tokyo, 15-year-old Takao, an aspiring shoemaker, decides to skip class to sketch designs in a beautiful garden. This is where he meets Yukari, a beautiful yet mysterious woman. They strike an unlikely friends...

movie:tt3878542.name: Justice League: Throne of Atlantis
movie:tt3878542.description: When Atlantian troops assault Metropolis as revenge for the death of their king, the Queen seeks help from the Justice League to find her son who has gone missing during the madness.

movie:tt1217213.name: Secret of the Wings
movie:tt1217213.description: Tinkerbell wanders into the forbidden Winter woods and meets Periwinkle. Together they learn the secret of their wings and try to unite the warm fairies and the winter fairies to help Pixie Hollow.

movie:tt0090633.name: An American Tail
movie:tt0090633.description: While emigrating to the United States, a young Russian mouse gets separated from his family and must locate them while trying to survive in a new country.

movie:tt0091149.name: The Great Mouse Detective
movie:tt0091149.description: Basil, the rodent Sherlock Holmes, investigates the kidnapping of a toy maker and uncovers its link to his archenemy, Professor Ratigan.

movie:tt3759416.name: Astérix: The Mansions of the Gods
movie:tt3759416.description: Asterix and Obelix oppose Julius Caesar's scheme to absorb their fellow indomitable Gauls into Roman civilization by building a luxury apartment complex next to their village.

movie:tt0275277.name: Cowboy Bebop: The Movie
movie:tt0275277.description: A terrorist explosion releases a deadly virus on the masses and it's up to the bounty-hunting Bebop crew to catch the cold-blooded culprit.

movie:tt2822672.name: Rock Dog
movie:tt2822672.description: When a radio falls from the sky into the hands of a wide-eyed Tibetan Mastiff, he leaves home to fulfill his dream of becoming a musician, setting into motion a series of completely unexpected events.

movie:tt0823671.name: Tinker Bell
movie:tt0823671.description: Enter the land of Tinker Bell and her four best fairy friends.

movie:tt0100477.name: The Rescuers Down Under
movie:tt0100477.description: R.A.S. agents Miss Bianca and Bernard race to Australia to save a little boy and a rare golden eagle from a murderous poacher.

movie:tt0076363.name: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
movie:tt0076363.description: In this collection of animated shorts based on the stories and characters by A.A. Milne, Winnie the Pooh, a honey-loving teddy bear, embarks on some eccentric adventures.

movie:tt0347246.name: Ghost in the Shell 2: Innocence
movie:tt0347246.description: In the year 2032, Batô, a cyborg detective for the anti-terrorist unit Public Security Section 9, investigates the case of a female robot--one created solely for sexual pleasure--who slaughtered her owner.

movie:tt4131800.name: My Little Pony: The Movie
movie:tt4131800.description: After a dark force conquers Canterlot, the Mane 6 embark on an unforgettable journey beyond Equestria where they meet new friends and exciting challenges on a quest to use the magic of friendship to save their homeland.

movie:tt0106364.name: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
movie:tt0106364.description: Batman is wrongly implicated in a series of murders of mob bosses actually committed by a new vigilante assassin.

movie:tt0344854.name: Arthur and the Invisibles
movie:tt0344854.description: Ten-year-old Arthur, in a bid to save his grandfather's house from being demolished, goes looking for some much-fabled hidden treasure in the land of the Minimoys, tiny people living in harmony with nature.

movie:tt0453556.name: TMNT
movie:tt0453556.description: When the world is threatened by an ancient evil, the Ninja Turtles must reunite and overcome their faults in order to stand against it.

movie:tt1494772.name: Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths
movie:tt1494772.description: A good version of Lex Luthor from a parallel Earth comes to the Justice League's dimension for help to fight their evil counterparts.

movie:tt1054486.name: Futurama: Bender's Game
movie:tt1054486.description: The Planet Express crew get trapped in a fantasy world.

movie:tt0457993.name: Lilo & Stitch 2: Stitch Has a Glitch
movie:tt0457993.description: A malfunction threatens to destroy Stitch and his friendship with Lilo!

movie:tt1673430.name: Superman/Batman: Apocalypse
movie:tt1673430.description: Batman discovers a mysterious teen-aged girl with super-human powers and a connection to Superman. When the girl comes to the attention of Darkseid, the evil overlord of Apokolips, events take a decidedly dangerous turn.

movie:tt1054485.name: Futurama: The Beast with a Billion Backs
movie:tt1054485.description: The Planet Express crew discovers a tentacle-covered, planet-sized alien that wishes to copulate with it all the inhabitants of Earth.

movie:tt0066817.name: Bedknobs and Broomsticks
movie:tt0066817.description: An apprentice witch, three kids, and a cynical magician conman search for the missing component to a magic spell to be used in the defense of Britain in World War II.

movie:tt0099472.name: DuckTales: The Movie - Treasure of the Lost Lamp
movie:tt0099472.description: Scrooge McDuck takes Huey, Dewey, and Louie to Egypt to find a pyramid and magic lamp.

movie:tt0112453.name: Balto
movie:tt0112453.description: An outcast Husky risks his life with other sled dogs to prevent a deadly epidemic from ravaging Nome, Alaska.

movie:tt1054487.name: Futurama: Into the Wild Green Yonder
movie:tt1054487.description: The team visits New Vegas. Leela tries to save eco systems. Fry gets mind-reading abilities - useful at the poker championship. Bender has an affair with the robot mafia boss's wife. Can the team stop Wong's space "mini" golf project?

movie:tt0088814.name: The Black Cauldron
movie:tt0088814.description: A young boy and a group of misfit friends embark on a quest to find a dark magic item of ultimate power before a diabolical tyrant can.

movie:tt2668134.name: Harlock: Space Pirate
movie:tt2668134.description: Mankind is dying. Only one man can do anything about it, Space Captain Harlock, but the Gaia Coalition will stop at nothing to end him.

movie:tt0923811.name: Evangelion: 1.0 You Are (Not) Alone
movie:tt0923811.description: The fate of the world is threatened by seemingly monstrous entities known as Angels. NERV is an organization set up to counter this threat and it is up to young pilots to protect Earth but exactly what are the real motives behind ...

movie:tt0465925.name: Brother Bear 2
movie:tt0465925.description: An old female friend of Kenai needs his help on a quest, much to Koda's growing consternation.

movie:tt0934706.name: Superman: Doomsday
movie:tt0934706.description: When LexCorps accidentally unleash a murderous creature, Doomsday, Superman meets his greatest challenge as a champion. Based on the "The Death of Superman" storyline that appeared in DC Comics' publications in the 1990s.

movie:tt0495596.name: Tales from Earthsea
movie:tt0495596.description: In a mythical land, a man and a young boy investigate a series of unusual occurrences.

movie:tt1216516.name: Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure
movie:tt1216516.description: Tinker Bell journey far North of Never Land to patch things up with her friend Terence and restore a Pixie Dust Tree.

movie:tt2465238.name: Lego Batman: The Movie - DC Super Heroes Unite
movie:tt2465238.description: When the Joker and Lex Luthor form an alliance, Batman must team up with the Justice League in order to stop them.

movie:tt1186373.name: Wonder Woman
movie:tt1186373.description: A modern man's trespass of the island of the Amazons enables an imprisoned war god to escape and Princess Diana wins the responsibility to recapture him.

movie:tt0902272.name: Justice League: The New Frontier
movie:tt0902272.description: In the 1950s, a new generation of superheroes must join forces with the community's active veterans and a hostile US government to fight a menace to Earth.

movie:tt5715410.name: Son of Bigfoot
movie:tt5715410.description: A young teenage boy sets out to find his missing father, only to discover that he's actually the mythical creature known as Bigfoot.

movie:tt5923962.name: Gantz: O
movie:tt5923962.description: After being brutally murdered in a subway station, a teen boy awakens to find himself resurrected by a strange computer named Gantz, and forced to fight a large force of invading aliens in Osaka.

movie:tt1398941.name: Superman/Batman: Public Enemies

movie:tt3445270.name: The Battered Bastards of Baseball
movie:tt3445270.description: The Battered Bastards of Baseball is one of baseball's last great, unheralded true stories. In 1973, Hollywood veteran Bing Russell (best known for playing Deputy Clem on "Bonanza") created the only independent baseball team in America at the time, the legendary Portland Mavericks. Bing operated without a Major League affiliation while playing in a city that was considered a wasteland for professional baseball. Tryouts for the Mavericks, which were open to the public, were filled with hopefuls who arrived in droves from every state in America, many of whom had been rejected by organized baseball. Skeptics agreed it would never work. But Bing's Mavericks generated unprecedented success: they shattered attendance records, signed Kurt Russell - Bing's son - as a player and team Vice President, produced the most successful batboy in baseball (filmmaker Todd Field), re-launched the controversial career of Jim Bouton, hired the first female general manager in Baseball, and inspired one of America's beloved bubblegums - Big League Chew. The Battered Bastards of Baseball is as much about the independent spirit as it is about baseball. The Mavericks' in your face attitude was contagious to fans, and during their short reign, they - and Bing Russell - basically held up their middle finger to the sports establishment and said we're playing this game on our terms, not yours. They were the real life Bad News Bears.

movie:tt0411498.description: Year after year hundreds of thousands of fans line the route of the Tour de France, cheering on their heroes and willing them to victory, while millions of viewers worldwide tune in on their televisions. He also shines light on the Tour's supporting cast - the director sportifs, masseurs, and, of course, the wildly enthusiastic fans. Reveling in the stunning landscape - from the Alps to the Pyrenees to the Massif Central to Paris - and with a nice dollop of Le Tour's history, HELL ON WHEELS transcends the sport it celebrates to reveal an astonishing human endeavor.

movie:tt28231777.name: Kill the Jockey

They both race for Sirena, a businessman who saved Remo's life in the past but now is determined to find him, dead or alive.

movie:tt34512232.name: WWE Elimination Chamber: Toronto

movie:tt36437006.name: Girl Climber
movie:tt36437006.description: Professional climber Emily Harrington has summited Everest, 8000-meter peaks, and dominated the competition circuit but, her greatest challenge extends beyond the physical. To cement her legacy in the male dominated world of elite rock climbing, she sets her sights on a career-defining 24-hour ascent of Yosemite's El Capitan. Caught between the pursuit of personal ambition and the ticking biological clock of life, a near-fatal fall forces Emily to reckon with what she's willing to risk. Equal parts gripping survival story and intimate portrait, Girl Climber isn't just about breaking records, it's about breaking barriers. Amongst Yosemite's legendary boy's club, Emily isn't just proving she's the best *Girl Climber-- she's proving she is one of the best. Period.

movie:tt1571929.name: Top Gear: The Great Adventures 3

Without a doubt one of the toughest challenges the `Top Gear' team has ever faced.

movie:tt1802727.name: Top Gear: The Great Adventures 4
movie:tt1802727.description: The film predates the Syrian Civil War and involves a 1,200-mile (1,900 km) road-trip from Erbil International Airport in Iraqi Kurdistan to Bethlehem, nominally recreating the journey of the Three Wise Men. Their journey takes them across the Middle East via southern Turkey, the cities of Aleppo, Palmyra and Damascus in Syria, then Jerash in Jordan and finally the Mount of Olives. movie:tt0048703.description: After Wick Campbell's ward seeks protection with rival cattleman John Stewart, the embittered, jealous rancher hires ten outlaws to help him seize power in the territory.

movie:tt2572212.name: Surrounded
movie:tt2572212.description: Former Buffalo Soldier Mo Washington travels West to lay claim on a gold mine. After her stagecoach is ambushed, Mo is tasked with holding a dangerous outlaw captive and must survive the day when the bandit's gang tries to free him.

movie:tt5226618.name: Out of the Wild
movie:tt5226618.description: Out of the Wild is the story of Henry McBride, a down and out cowboy with a painful past he can't drink away. Living on his last dollar with nowhere to go, he ends up working the last place an old cowboy wants to be: A dude ranch....

movie:tt0006780.name: Hell's Hinges
movie:tt0006780.description: When Reverend Robert Henley and his sister Faith arrive in the town of Hell's Hinges, saloon owner Silk Miller and his cohorts sense danger to their evil ways. They hire gunman Blaze Tracy to run the minister out of town. But Blaze finds something in Faith Henley that turns him around, and soon Silk Miller and his compadres have Blaze to deal with.

movie:tt3924776.name: Obrigado a Matar
movie:tt3924776.description: A man from the countryside returns home after spending some time away, only to be confronted by his archenemy. His wife ends up falling victim to his nemesis, and now he is determined to get his revenge at any cost.

movie:tt2296747.name: Come What May
movie:tt2296747.description: A German communist flees to Northern France with his son. German troops follow in May 1940. The son flees with the village towards Dieppe at the English Channel, as does the separated dad, joined by a Scottish officer.

movie:tt4686604.name: On the Road to Berlin
movie:tt4686604.description: The film is based on a novella by the well-known Soviet writer who served at the front, Emmanuil Kazakevich "Two in the Steppe" and the war diaries of Konstantin Simonov.

movie:tt0284595.name: In August of 1944
movie:tt0284595.description: The movie is set in Belarus, where a team of counter-intelligence officers is given only three days to find a German radio operator posing as a Soviet soldier, behind soviet lines, on the eve of a major offensive.

movie:tt0087742.name: The Vultures
movie:tt0087742.description: In 1943 in Tunisia, a unit of the French Foreign Legion fights the Germans over possession of a bank treasure in gold bars.

movie:tt4426656.name: The Wakhan Front
movie:tt4426656.description: While on a mission in Afghanistan, French captain Antarès Bonassieu's men start vanishing one by one without explanation.

movie:tt0284815.name: Address Unknown
movie:tt0284815.description: Romances end in blood and the frail hopes of individuals are torn apart in a vile karmic continuity of colonialism, civil war and occupation. After surviving Japanese colonization, Korea became the first war zone of the Cold War. ...

movie:tt0096744.name: 84C MoPic
movie:tt0096744.description: The title refers to the U.S. Army's former "MOS" (job code) for a combat cameraman. The story follows a unit of American G.I.s in Vietnam, all with different backgrounds and motives for being there, through the lens of his camera.

movie:tt0329111.name: Strayed
movie:tt0329111.description: Emmanuelle Béart stars as a widowed schoolteacher who flees German-occupied Paris with her children. A teenage boy comes to their rescue by leading them into the forest -- their best shot at survival.

movie:tt0450680.name: Flanders
movie:tt0450680.description: Bruno Dumont follows up the controversial Twentynine Palms with this tale of a group of young soldiers who go off to war and experience some life-changing events. Flandres won the Grand Prix Prize at the 2006 Cannes Film Festival.

movie:tt0326450.name: The Star
movie:tt0326450.description: During World War II the Red Army sends a special unit named "Zvezda" ("The Star") on a mission to conduct guerrilla warfare against the Germans in the Soviet Union.

movie:tt0098596.name: Life and Nothing But
movie:tt0098596.description: Intense character study of men and women driven by an overpowering obsession with the past.

movie:tt1797396.name: Beyond the Border
movie:tt1797396.description: December 1942. Two young soldiers leave their post at check-point 83 in Northern Värmland, Sweden, and make their way through the ice cold night toward the border of German-occupied Norway. Sweden stands on the brink of invasion a...

movie:tt2763790.name: The Wipers Times
movie:tt2763790.description: Based on the remarkable true story of a satirical newspaper published on the front lines of World War One, this poignant yet comedic drama revels in the extraordinary resilience of the human spirit in the face of overwhelming adve...

movie:tt0079700.name: The Passage
movie:tt0079700.description: During World War II, a Basque shepherd is approached by underground operatives who want him to lead a scientist and his family across the Pyrenees while they're being pursued by a sadistic German officer.

movie:tt0096243.name: The Tenth Man
movie:tt0096243.description: During World War 2 the Germans arrested people at random off the streets of Paris and in retaliation to sabotage by the resistance announced the execution of one in ten prisoners. Chosen as one of the victims, lawyer Chavel trades his place with another man in return for all his possessions. At the end of the war he returns to his house and tries to integrate himself with the family of the man who traded places with him, all the while hiding his true identity. However matters are complicated when a stranger arrives claiming to be Chavel.

movie:tt0082661.name: Lili Marleen
movie:tt0082661.description: In 1938, a German singer falls in love with a Jewish composer in Zurich, who helps Jews flee Nazi Germany. She wants to help but is forced back to Germany. Her song "Lili Marleen" becomes a hit with soldiers and the Nazi top brass.

movie:tt3032028.name: Between Worlds
movie:tt3032028.description: Jesper is a soldier in the German army. Although his brother was killed whilst serving in Afghanistan, he nevertheless reports for a new tour of duty in this war zone. He and his unit are to protect a remote village from the Taliban. One of the people accompanying Jesper is a young interpreter, Tarik, whose job includes mediating between soldiers and villagers. Both sides have a hard time trying to overcome the differences in their respective ways of life. Jesper must gain the trust of both villagers and the allied Arbaki militia and his nerves are soon on edge. He finds himself increasingly morally conflicted as a result of his superiors' orders. His association with the Germans means Tarik's life is constantly under threat, but when Tarik begins to fear for his sister's safety, Jesper has to make a decision. Feo Aladag uses this portrait of an ISAF soldier in Afghanistan to explore questions of affinity and otherness, trust and failure. How humane can your actions be if you are bound by the workings of a strict military bureaucracy? What remains of the ideals of human dignity when you are caught up in a daily struggle for survival?

movie:tt0066530.name: Long Live Death
movie:tt0066530.description: During Spanish Civil War, young Fando navigates parents' clashing ideologies after father's arrest. Explores his imagination, friendships, views on sex and death amid family upheaval. Questions mother, seeks father's fate.

movie:tt0220631.name: El mar
movie:tt0220631.description: Two young men and a woman who shared the same traumatic childhood experience during the Spanish Civil War are reunited years later at a hospital for tuberculosis treatment.

movie:tt1495823.name: Freedom
movie:tt1495823.description: A Gypsy family travels the French roads during the Second World War, followed by Little Claude, a young boy seeking a new family after his parents "left and never returned". Upon reaching a town where they traditionally stop for a...

movie:tt4687906.name: Edge
movie:tt4687906.description: A televised adaptation of the 'Edge' book series by George G. Gilman.

movie:tt6704894.name: Montford: The Chickasaw Rancher
movie:tt6704894.description: A remarkable story inspired by the life of renowned Chickasaw cattleman Montford T. Johnson, a man who overcame great hardships to establish a ranching empire along the famous cattle highway of the American West, the Chisolm Trail.

movie:tt22237964.name: The Mysterious Gaze of the Flamingo
movie:tt22237964.description: As an unknown and deadly disease begins to spread, legend has it that it is transmitted between two men, through a simple glance, when they fall in love. While people are accusing her family, Lidia must find out whether this myth is real or not.

movie:tt13055264.name: Strange Way of Life
movie:tt13055264.description: After twenty-five years Silva rides a horse across the desert to visit his friend Sheriff Jake. They celebrate the meeting, but the next morning Jake tells him that reason for his trip is not to go down the memory lane of their fr...

movie:tt27717667.name: Pedro Páramo
movie:tt27717667.description: Follows a dusty road to a town of death. Time shifts from one consciousness to another in a hypnotic flow of dreams, desires and memories, a world of ghosts dominated by the figure of Pedro Páramo, lover, overlord, murderer.

movie:tt30972810.name: Eye for an Eye 2
movie:tt30972810.description: A blind swordsman reluctantly mentors an orphan seeking vengeance for his destroyed family, teaching him martial arts skills. The orphan waits for an opportunity to avenge his kin.

movie:tt12636944.name: Same Old West
movie:tt12636944.description: In the backlands of Goiás, Brazil, brutish men who cannot deal with their weaknesses are constantly abandoned by the women they love. Sad and bitter, these men turn violently against each other.

movie:tt1716743.name: Goodnight for Justice
movie:tt1716743.description: When John Goodnight was a boy he watched in the weeds as his entire family was killed in a ruthless outlaw attack. Now as a circuit judge of the western territories Goodnight travels the west protecting the innocent from injustice.

movie:tt34142731.name: Dead Souls
movie:tt34142731.description: In 1890, the year of the U.S. census, chaos erupts when a stranger named Strindler arrives in a small town in Arizona and requests money for providing the names of dead Mexican laborers.

movie:tt0190327.name: The Cowboy and the Frenchman
movie:tt0190327.description: A grizzled, hard-of-hearing cowboy, Slim, and his two friends, Dusty and Pete, capture a mysterious, well-dressed Frenchman.

movie:tt0111903.name: Buffalo Girls
movie:tt0111903.description: The bold escapades of tough-talking Calamity Jane Canary and her illustrious cohorts. It's the waning days of the Wild West and Jane, the rough 'n' rugged cowgirl, is searching not only for her long-lost daughter, but the Wild West she once knew. Jane traverses plains, mountains and continents until she finally discovers the answer to her problems: Dora, the vivacious, gold-hearted madam who's been her one true friend all along.

movie:tt0274428.name: Divine Intervention
movie:tt0274428.description: Separated by a checkpoint, Palestinian lovers from Jerusalem and Ramallah arrange clandestine meetings.

movie:tt2007471.name: Ballada o bombere
movie:tt2007471.description: The Bomber (2011) / (Russian language title: Ballada o Bombere) Storyline During World War II, a soviet aircraft crashes on Nazi-occupied territory. But the pilot Grivtsov and his beloved radio operator Katya miraculously survive....

movie:tt0043265.name: The African Queen
movie:tt0043265.description: In WWI East Africa, a gin-swilling Canadian riverboat captain is persuaded by a strait-laced English missionary to undertake a trip up a treacherous river and use his boat to attack a German gunship.

movie:tt0023969.name: Duck Soup
movie:tt0023969.description: Rufus T. Firefly is named the dictator of bankrupt Freedonia and declares war on neighboring Sylvania over the love of his wealthy backer Mrs. Teasdale, contending with two inept spies who can't seem to keep straight which side th...

movie:tt0046359.name: Stalag 17
movie:tt0046359.description: After two American prisoners are killed by the guards in the act of escaping from a German P.O.W. camp in World War II, the barracks black marketeer, J.J. Sefton, is suspected of being an informer.

movie:tt0045793.name: From Here to Eternity
movie:tt0045793.description: At a U.S. Army base in 1941 Hawaii, a pugilistic private is cruelly punished for refusing to join his unit's boxing team. Meanwhile, his commanding officer's wife and top NCO are indulging in a torrid love affair.

movie:tt0053143.name: Operation Petticoat
movie:tt0053143.description: During World War II, a commander finds himself stuck with a decrepit (and pink) submarine, a con man executive officer, and a group of army nurses.

movie:tt0037382.name: To Have and Have Not
movie:tt0037382.description: During World War II, an American expatriate helps transport a French Resistance leader and his wife to Martinique while romancing a lounge singer.

movie:tt0056111.name: Ivan's Childhood
movie:tt0056111.description: During WWII, Soviet orphan Ivan Bondarev strikes up a friendship with three sympathetic Soviet officers while working as a scout behind the German lines.

movie:tt0037017.name: Lifeboat
movie:tt0037017.description: Several survivors of a torpedoed merchant ship in World War II find themselves in the same lifeboat with one of the crew members of the U-boat that sank their ship.

movie:tt0064040.name: Army of Shadows
movie:tt0064040.description: An account of underground resistance fighters in Nazi-occupied France.

movie:tt0035279.name: Saboteur
movie:tt0035279.description: A young man accused of sabotage goes on the run to prove his innocence.

movie:tt0050356.name: The Enemy Below
movie:tt0050356.description: During WWII an American destroyer discovers a German U-boat, and in the ensuing duel the American captain must draw upon all his experience to defeat the equally experienced German commander.

movie:tt0018578.name: Wings
movie:tt0018578.description: Two young men, one rich, one middle class, who are in love with the same woman, become fighter pilots in World War I.

movie:tt0059885.name: Von Ryan's Express
movie:tt0059885.description: An American POW leads a group of mainly British prisoners to escape from the Germans in WWII.

movie:tt0059309.name: In Harm's Way
movie:tt0059309.description: A Naval officer, reprimanded after Pearl Harbor, is later promoted to Rear Admiral and gets a second chance to prove himself against the Japanese.

movie:tt0035093.name: Mrs. Miniver
movie:tt0035093.description: A British family struggles to survive the first months of World War II.

movie:tt0052151.name: Run Silent Run Deep
movie:tt0052151.description: A U.S. submarine commander who's obsessed with sinking a particular Japanese ship butts heads with his first officer and crew.

movie:tt0050634.name: The Cranes Are Flying

movie:tt0043686.name: Forbidden Games

movie:tt0064110.name: The Bridge at Remagen
movie:tt0064110.description: As the Allied armies close in, the Germans decide to blow up the last Rhine bridge, trapping their own men on the wrong side. But will it happen?

movie:tt0041996.name: Twelve O'Clock High

movie:tt0060934.name: The Sand Pebbles
movie:tt0060934.description: In 1926, a U.S. Naval engineer gets assigned to a gunboat on a rescue mission in war-torn China.

movie:tt0063611.name: Shame

movie:tt0054749.name: Two Women
movie:tt0054749.description: In WWII Italy, a widow and her lonely daughter seek distance between themselves and the horrors of war.

movie:tt0063056.description: During World War II, an American pilot and a marooned Japanese navy captain are deserted on a small uninhabited island in the Pacific Ocean. There, they must cease their hostility and cooperate if they want to survive, but will they?

movie:tt0038823.name: Paisan
movie:tt0038823.description: American military personnel interact warily with a variety of Italian locals over a year and a half in the push north during the Italian Campaign of WWII as German forces make their retreat.

movie:tt0052415.name: The Young Lions
movie:tt0052415.description: The lives of three young men, a German and two Americans, during WWII.

movie:tt0036323.name: Sahara
movie:tt0036323.description: After the fall of Tobruk in 1942, during the Allied retreat in the Libyan desert, an American tank picks-up a motley group of survivors but they face advancing Germans and a lack of water.

movie:tt0060921.name: The Russians Are Coming the Russians Are Coming
movie:tt0060921.description: Without hostile intent, a Soviet submarine runs aground off New England. Men are sent for a boat, but many villagers go into a tizzy, risking bloodshed.

movie:tt0058962.name: The Bedford Incident
movie:tt0058962.description: An American destroyer Captain is determined to confront a Soviet submarine caught violating territorial waters. Perhaps too determined.

movie:tt0050490.name: Heaven Knows, Mr. Allison
movie:tt0050490.description: During World War II, an American marine and an Irish nun form an unlikely friendship after being stranded on a South Pacific island. They find comfort in one another while hoping for a rescue, as they try to avoid capture by the J...

movie:tt0059527.name: The Shop on Main Street
movie:tt0059527.description: A carpenter in the Fascist Slovak State is appointed "Aryan controller" of a Jewish widow's store.

movie:tt0043547.name: Flying Leathernecks
movie:tt0043547.description: Major Kirby leads The Wildcats squadron into the historic WWII battle of Guadalcanal.

movie:tt0047469.name: Senso
movie:tt0047469.description: An Italian Countess is allied with Nationalists during the Italian-Austrian war of unification. However, she risks betraying their cause when she falls in love with an Austrian lieutenant.

movie:tt0056062.name: Hell Is for Heroes

movie:tt0059549.name: Operation Crossbow
movie:tt0059549.description: Allied agents attempt to infiltrate a German rocket research site.

movie:tt0049012.name: The Burmese Harp

movie:tt0060177.name: The Blue Max
movie:tt0060177.description: A young pilot in the German air force of 1918, disliked as lower-class and unchivalrous, tries ambitiously to earn the medal offered for 20 kills.

movie:tt0059896.name: The War Lord
movie:tt0059896.description: In 11th century Normandy, a Norman duke sends one of his knights to build a defensive fortress in order to guard the borders against Frisian raiders.

movie:tt0035799.name: Destination Tokyo
movie:tt0035799.description: In order to provide information for the first air raid over Tokyo, a U.S. submarine sneaks into Tokyo Bay and places a spy team ashore.

movie:tt0048966.name: Attack
movie:tt0048966.description: In 1944, an American Infantry company sets up an artillery observation post, but tensions between Captain Cooney and Lieutenant Costa run high.

movie:tt0045679.name: The Desert Rats

movie:tt0037954.name: Objective, Burma!

movie:tt0060814.name: Is Paris Burning?
movie:tt0060814.description: August 1944. The Allies are approaching Paris and resistance groups within the city start to plan an uprising against the Germans. However, Hitler wants the city destroyed if it looks like the Allies will take it.

movie:tt0034891.name: In Which We Serve
movie:tt0034891.description: This "story of a ship", the British destroyer H.M.S. Torrin, is told in flashbacks by survivors as they cling to a life raft.

movie:tt0057809.name: 36 Hours
movie:tt0057809.description: Germans kidnap an American Major and try to convince him that World War II is over so they can get details about the Allied invasion of Europe out of him.

movie:tt0020960.name: Hell's Angels
movie:tt0020960.description: Brothers Monte and Roy leave Oxford to join the Royal Flying Corps. Roy loves Helen; Helen enjoys an affair with Monte; before they leave on their mission over Germany they find her in yet another man's arms.

movie:tt0048593.name: The Sea Chase
movie:tt0048593.description: As World War II begins, German freighter Captain Karl Ehrlich tries to get his ship back to Germany through a gauntlet of Allied warships.

movie:tt0019071.name: The Last Command
movie:tt0019071.description: A former Imperial Russian general and cousin of the Czar ends up in Hollywood as an extra in a movie directed by a former revolutionary.

movie:tt0055796.name: Billy Budd
movie:tt0055796.description: When a kind-hearted sailor is made to join an English vessel at war in 1797, he finds himself caught between devotion to his crewmates and obedience to their hated, cruel master-at-arms.

movie:tt0049474.name: The Man in the Gray Flannel Suit
movie:tt0049474.description: An ex-soldier faces ethical questions as he tries to earn enough to support his wife and children well.

movie:tt0037280.name: Since You Went Away
movie:tt0037280.description: With her husband away to fight in World War II, a housewife must care for their two daughters alone.

movie:tt0054425.name: Taxi for Tobruk
movie:tt0054425.description: During World War II, French commandos join forces with a German officer in order to survive the African desert.

movie:tt0059470.name: Morituri
movie:tt0059470.description: A war pacifist is blackmailed to pose as an SS officer and to disable the scuttling explosives on a freighter carrying rubber cargo to be captured by the Allies.

movie:tt0054159.name: Passenger
movie:tt0054159.description: While aboard a transatlantic passenger ship, a German woman, Liza, notices someone who looks like Marta, a former inmate at Auschwitz, where Liza used to be a guard.

movie:tt0064952.name: The Secret of Santa Vittoria
movie:tt0064952.description: During WWII in Italy, a wine-producing village hides a million bottles from the Germans

movie:tt0053856.name: General Della Rovere

movie:tt0050853.name: I Dutifully Report
movie:tt0050853.description: Sequel of the adaptation of the famous satiric tale of well-intending soldier Schweik by Jaroslav Hasek.

movie:tt0061176.name: What Did You Do in the War, Daddy?
movie:tt0061176.description: In World War II, a strategic Italian village agrees to surrender to the Allies only if it's allowed to organize a celebratory festival while giving aerial reconnaissance the false impression of fierce ground fighting.

movie:tt0050126.name: Bitter Victory
movie:tt0050126.description: A commander receives a citation for an attack on Erwin Rommel's headquarters, which is actually undeserved, as the commander is unfit for his job. On top of that, unbeknownst to him, his wife is having an affair with one of his of...

movie:tt0038279.name: 13 Rue Madeleine
movie:tt0038279.description: When spy chief Bob Sharkey finds out one of his agents-in-training is actually a Nazi double agent, his strategic decision not to arrest him results in tragedy.

movie:tt0055871.name: The Counterfeit Traitor
movie:tt0055871.description: Blacklisted in modern day WW2, a Swedish oil trader opts to assist British Allies, by means of infiltrating and surveying Nazi Germany.

movie:tt0058263.name: King & Country
movie:tt0058263.description: During WWI, a British Army Private is accused of desertion, and the officer assigned to defend him at his court-martial discovers that there is more to the case than meets the eye.

movie:tt0053317.name: The Destiny of a Man
movie:tt0053317.description: A Soviet soldier, Andrei Sokolov, has been separated from his family by World War II. Suffering in German captivity, he dreams of meeting his darlings after the victory. But cruel fate turned out otherwise.

movie:tt0044446.name: The Sound Barrier
movie:tt0044446.description: Fictionalized story of British aerospace engineers solving the problem of supersonic flight.

movie:tt0449671.name: Zivi i mrtvi
movie:tt0449671.description: In 1943, group of Croatian soldiers overtake a strategically important point in western Bosnia with a goal to destroy a group of communist partisans. On the way they met some supernatural phenomena, and the action itself went very...

movie:tt0064785.description: In 1668 Polish colonel Michael Wolodyjowski, who recently retired to a monastery, is recalled to active duty and takes charge of Poland's eastern frontier defenses against invading Tatar hordes and Ottoman armies.

movie:tt0062323.name: Wedding in Malinovka
movie:tt0062323.description: Civil War takes place. The power is constantly changing in Ukrainian village. In order to away with thugs, the Red commander asks local girl Yarinka to play fake wedding with their leader.

movie:tt0053403.name: The Cow and I
movie:tt0053403.description: In 1942, a French prisoner of war in Germany decides to escape to France using a cow held by a lunge as a decoy. He crosses all Germany in this way.

movie:tt0035763.name: Crash Dive

movie:tt0019649.name: Arsenal

movie:tt0036983.description: A young priest is sent to China to establish a Catholic parish.

movie:tt0056045.name: Gusarskaya ballada
movie:tt0056045.description: A young girl decides to join a Husar squadron and fight against Napoleon. Dressed as a man she has a hard time adjusting to the rude Husar life styles.

movie:tt0046712.name: Anatahan
movie:tt0046712.description: From June 1944, twelve Japanese seamen are stranded for seven years on an abandoned and forgotten island called Anatahan.

movie:tt0050803.name: The One That Got Away
movie:tt0050803.description: A cocky German fighter pilot is shot down over England in 1940 and makes numerous attempts to escape to fight again.

movie:tt0049301.name: Helen of Troy

movie:tt0056905.name: The Carabineers
movie:tt0056905.description: During a war in an imaginary country, unscrupulous soldiers recruit poor farmers with promises of an easy and happy life. Two of these farmers write to their wives of their exploits.

movie:tt0046029.name: Malta Story
movie:tt0046029.description: 1942 and the island of Malta is battling for survival. The threat of invasion by Axis forces is increasing as air raids wear down its defence. Entering this maelstrom is Flight Lieutenant Peter Ross, an RAF photo-reconnaissance pi...

movie:tt0059884.name: War and Peace, Part I: Andrei Bolkonsky

movie:tt0079177.name: D.O.A.
