Determined to find out who his murderer is, Frank, with the help of his assistant and girlfriend, Paula, begins to trace back over his last steps. As he frantically tries to unravel the mystery behind his own impending demise, his sleuthing leads him to a group of crooked businessmen and another murder.

movie:tt0210717.name: Goya in Bordeaux
movie:tt0210717.description: Francisco Goya (1746-1828), deaf and ill, lives the last years of his life in voluntary exile in Bordeaux, a Liberal protesting the oppressive rule of Ferdinand VII. He's living with his much younger wife Leocadia and their daught...

movie:tt0035209.name: Why We Fight
movie:tt0035209.description: The official World War II US Government film statement defining the various enemies of the Allies and why they must be fought.

movie:tt2368669.name: Cat Shit One
movie:tt2368669.description: Botasky and Packy are private contractors, working in the Middle East, with support from a distant helicopter-mobile base. Their jobs are as "sniper" and "spotter", although in this case ...

movie:tt0036659.name: Bon Voyage
movie:tt0036659.description: A young Scottish RAF gunner is debriefed by French officials about his escape from occupied territory, and in particular one person who may or may not have been a German agent.

movie:tt0110348.name: The Life and Extraordinary Adventures of Private Ivan Chonkin
movie:tt0110348.description: Set in a small Ukrainian village during the outbreak of war with Germany in 1941 Private Chonkin, not overly endowed with intelligence, is left to guard a downed military aircraft. The authorities appear to have forgotten about him so this leaves him free to work his chams on the village postmistress, Njura, untill the local militia are tipped off.

movie:tt0070356.name: Now Where Did the Seventh Company Get to?
movie:tt0070356.description: Three French army scouts escape capture and go behind enemy lines during WWII, urged by a lieutenant to fight rather than hide.

movie:tt0053732.name: Conspiracy of Hearts
movie:tt0053732.description: Catholic nuns risk their lives to help Jewish children in an Italian internment camp escape to Palestine during World War II.

movie:tt9573150.name: Occupied City
movie:tt9573150.description: The past collides with the present in this excavation of the Nazi occupation of Amsterdam: a journey from World War II to recent years of pandemic and protest and a provocative, life-affirming reflection on memory, time and what's to come.

movie:tt9848962.name: Soldier Boy
movie:tt9848962.description: This is a story about exciting events that occurred in the life of the smallest soldier - the hero of the Great Patriotic War, six-year-old Sergei Aleshkov. He lost all his relatives and got into the army. With a six-year-old boy, they started playing the soldier game in order to preserve his childhood, and he, in order to comply with this honorary title, became a real defender of the Motherland.

movie:tt0481390.name: Kokoda: 39th Battalion
movie:tt0481390.description: A bitter battle is fought between Australian and Japanese soldiers along the Kokoda trail in New Guinea during World War II.

movie:tt0995854.name: A Journal for Jordan
movie:tt0995854.description: 1st Sgt. Charles Monroe King, before he is killed in action in Baghdad, authors a journal for his son intended to tell him how to live a decent life despite growing up without a father.

movie:tt12979636.name: Hunger Ward
movie:tt12979636.description: Filmed from inside two of the most active therapeutic feeding centers in Yemen, HUNGER WARD documents two female health care workers fighting to thwart the spread of starvation against the backdrop of a forgotten war. The film provides an unflinching portrait of Dr. Aida Alsadeeq and Nurse Mekkia Mahdi as they try to save the lives of hunger-stricken children within a population on the brink of famine.

movie:tt0036693.name: Candlelight in Algeria
movie:tt0036693.description: An American sculptress in wartime Algiers gets mixed up with a British agent and a Nazi spy who knows that a top-secret meeting of Allied military leaders will be taking place in Algeria--and that the British agent has a camera th...

movie:tt5652768.name: Across the River and Into the Trees
movie:tt5652768.description: Set in post-World War II Italian Venice, war-torn U.S. Army Colonel Richard Cantwell is a true hero who faces the news of his illness with indifference.

movie:tt23630030.name: Harbin
movie:tt23630030.description: Follows Korean independence activists who launched a daring attack in Harbin against the Japanese to gain their country's independence.

movie:tt0096737.description: When the war breaks out, Annika lives with her parents in Värmland, close to the border to Norway. Her cousin Harald is a dealer in the black market but has to escape from the police to Norway. Annika moves to Stockholm and gets a job as a waitress. She meets the happy-go-lucky Berit and together they have a wonderful time. She also meets a young man, Bengt, whom she marries. But almost immediately she discovers that her husband is different from the man who was courting her. Plot by Mattias Thuresson.

movie:tt14232442.name: Brothers
movie:tt14232442.description: Adaptation of controversial real-life story from the 1950s.

movie:tt0070861.name: Only Old Men Are Going to Battle
movie:tt0070861.description: During World War II, a Soviet veteran pilot teaches newcomers that war is transient, and music is eternal.

movie:tt0269461.name: Safe Conduct
movie:tt0269461.description: During the Nazi occupation of France, two filmmakers try to build a career without compromising their ideals.

movie:tt0104812.name: Map of the Human Heart
movie:tt0104812.description: Arctic, 1965: Avik tells his story starting in 1931. A mapmaker flies Avik, then a preteen Eskimo boy with TB, to a hospital in Montreal where he meets Albertine. They meet again when Avik joins World War II in the UK.

movie:tt11892482.name: All the Moons
movie:tt11892482.description: In late 19th century, a little girl hurt by a bomb at the end of the third Carlist war is saved by a woman who brings her the eternal life.

movie:tt10360772.name: My Best Friend Anne Frank
movie:tt10360772.description: Hannah and Anne, imprisoned at Bergen-Belsen during WWII's early years, share memories from their time in Amsterdam before learning they're separated by a wall on the eve of Hannah's family's exchange for German captives.

movie:tt13328732.name: A Radiant Girl
movie:tt13328732.description: Paris, summer 1942. Irene is Jewish and French. She is 19 and living a life of passions - Her friendships, her new love, her desire to be an actress - Nothing suggests that Irene's time is running out.

movie:tt8995252.name: Gaza
movie:tt8995252.description: A beautiful portrait of everyday Gazan citizens, leading meaningful lives beyond the rubble of perennial conflict.

movie:tt0099772.name: Hiroshima: Out of the Ashes
movie:tt0099772.description: Life in Hiroshima, following different Japanese, a German priest and church, and some American POWs, before and after the atomic bomb was dropped August 6, 1945.

movie:tt0444518.name: Un amour à taire
movie:tt0444518.description: A young Jewish girl looking to escape the clutches of the Third Reich after seeing her parents and sister brutally slain while attempting to make their way to England is sheltered by an old friend whose status as a member of the "...

movie:tt0058336.name: McHale's Navy
movie:tt0058336.description: The crew of PT-73 get into trouble when they back the wrong horse in a race. Now they have to come up with a way to raise the money to pay off the winners.

movie:tt0078341.name: Summer of My German Soldier
movie:tt0078341.description: Patty Bergen is a teenager in a Jewish family living in the American South during World War II. Patty feels like an outcast even in her own family and is unable to understand why her father can't seem to love her. Her town eventually becomes host to a prisoner of war camp. A young German soldier escapes from this camp, and Patty finds him hiding in her secret place in the woods outside of town. After getting to know him, she ends up harboring him from his captors and, in the way of many adolescents, falls in love with him. Patty knows what she is risking by helping him, but in his company, she feels important, special, and respected as she has never been. In the end, his regard lifts her self-esteem and helps her to face the heartbreaking events to come.

movie:tt0206348.name: Tjoet Nja' Dhien
movie:tt0206348.description: Set in 1896, "Tjoet Nja' Dhien" celebrates one of Indonesia's great heroes who fought for independence from the Dutch. The pious Muslim people of Aceh, a city that had flourished since ancient times as a trade port, enter into a fierce war with the Dutch. Tjoet Nja' Dhien, the widow of a rebel leader operating in Aceh in Sumatra, assumes the leadership when her husband Teuku Uma is killed in an ambush. Dhien's charismatic presence and power of survival motivate the locals to join and later continue their opposition to the Dutch. Despite personal obstacles, she remained in the thick of the struggle for ten years.

movie:tt4061620.name: Firebird
movie:tt4061620.description: Firebird follows a handsome, soulful young soldier who embarks on a clandestine sexual affair with a charismatic fighter pilot on a Soviet Air Force Base at the height of 1970's Communist rule.

movie:tt10381014.name: The War Below
movie:tt10381014.description: During World War I, a group of British miners are recruited to tunnel underneath no man's land and set bombs from below the German front in hopes of breaking the deadly stalemate of the Battle of Messines.

movie:tt11478458.name: Berenshtein
movie:tt11478458.description: The last of the great partisans, who located Hitler's "wonder weapon", returns to the war that took away his feelings and identity, but failed to rob him of his values as a human being.

movie:tt14338074.name: Sniper
movie:tt14338074.description: According to the true story of Abdolrasoul Zarrin, he was the Iranian sniper of the Iran-Iraq war, who is known as the best sniper in the contemporary world wars with a record of 3,000 successful shootings with Dragunov weapons.

movie:tt13475382.name: Danny Boy
movie:tt13475382.description: Follows Brian Wood who is humbled when he is accused of war crimes in Iraq by the human rights lawyer Phil Shiner.

movie:tt0327890.name: Hornblower: Loyalty
movie:tt0327890.description: Hornblower is given a dangerous mission to deliver an emigre French nobleman to a secret rendezvous near Brest while coping with enemy agents in his own ranks.

movie:tt0352410.name: Hornblower: Duty
movie:tt0352410.description: Admiral Pellew interrupts Hornblower's wedding reception and tasks him to locate a British ship which has disappeared off the French coast, where Napoleon's troops are engaged in covert activities.

movie:tt5806814.name: Charlotte
movie:tt5806814.description: An account of German-Jewish artist Charlotte Salomon's life in the south of France between 1941 and 1943, before she was sent to Auschwitz during World War II. Inspired by her memoir "Life? or Theatre?".

movie:tt11369540.name: The Champion
movie:tt11369540.description: The story of the pre-war boxing champion Tadeusz "Teddy" Pietrzykowski, who in 1940 arrives with the first transport of prisoners to the newly created Auschwitz concentration camp.

movie:tt12017738.name: Three Minutes: A Lengthening
movie:tt12017738.description: A snippet of 16mm film offers an emotionally charged, meditative glimpse into the lives of the unsuspecting Jewish citizens of a small Polish village at the precipice of World War II.

movie:tt6979756.name: Creation of the Gods I: Kingdom of Storms
movie:tt6979756.description: A magnificent eastern high fantasy epic that recreates the prolonged mythical wars between humans, immortals and monsters, which happened more than three thousand years ago.

movie:tt9201772.name: Mending the Line
movie:tt9201772.description: A Marine wounded in Afghanistan is sent to a V.A. facility in Montana where he meets a Vietnam Vet who teaches him how to fly fish as a way of dealing with his emotional and physical trauma.

movie:tt20259704.name: Pravednik
movie:tt20259704.description: During the WWll, Nikolai Kiselyov faces an unthinkable task: he must withdraw more than 200 people doomed to death in captivity from the Belarusian village of Dolginovo occupied by the Nazis behind the front line. Will he be able ...

movie:tt14556392.name: Image of Victory
movie:tt14556392.description: In 1948, Hassanin joins a platoon going to Palestine to liberate farmers. While documenting their mission, Hassanin's values are tested and both sides re-evaluate what they understand about war.

movie:tt13445076.name: The Ambush
movie:tt13445076.description: When three Emirati soldiers are ambushed in a hostile territory, their commander leads a daring mission to rescue them.

movie:tt16250658.name: Hvidstengruppen II - De efterladte
movie:tt16250658.description: We follow Tulle Fiil and her sister Gerda Fiil during WW2, who are sentenced to the horrors of German prison. At home at the inn in Hvidsten, Gudrun fights with her daughter Bitten to get her daughters home.

movie:tt14454876.name: Golda
movie:tt14454876.description: Focuses on the intensely dramatic and high-stakes responsibilities and decisions that Golda Meir, also known as the 'Iron Lady of Israel,' faced during the Yom Kippur War.

movie:tt14852188.name: Lost Transport
movie:tt14852188.description: In the spring of 1945 a train deporting hundreds of Jewish prisoners gets stranded near a small German village occupied by the Red Army. Condemned to each other and in a context of deep mistrust, desperation and revenge, an unexpe...

movie:tt22507524.name: 12.12: The Day
movie:tt22507524.description: Following the assassination of President Park in 1979, various military factions wrestle for control during a violent coup in this tense South Korean period action drama.

movie:tt17424334.name: Ordinary Men: The "Forgotten Holocaust"
movie:tt17424334.description: Six million Jews died during World War II, both in the extermination camps and murdered by the mobile commandos of the Einsatzgruppen and police battalions, whose members shot men, women and children, day after day, obediently, as if it were a normal job, a fact that is hardly known today. Who were these men and how could they commit such crimes?

movie:tt17162524.name: Forgive Us Our Trespasses
movie:tt17162524.description: Targeted by Nazis as they hunt down and murder people with disabilities, a boy with a limb difference makes a daring decision while running for his life.

movie:tt14439178.name: The Fox
movie:tt14439178.description: At the dawn of WW2, a young soldier encounters a wounded fox cub and takes it with him to occupied France. The story of an unlikely friendship.

movie:tt0827709.name: The Green Hornet
movie:tt0827709.description: Several episodes of the 1966 TV series "The Green Hornet" edited together and released as a feature.

movie:tt0079542.name: Meetings with Remarkable Men
movie:tt0079542.description: G.I. Gurdjieff is a spiritual teacher and mystic who, after a lifetime study, developed a form of meditation incorporating modern dance.

movie:tt1787758.name: Mad Bastards
movie:tt1787758.description: TJ's quest to find the son he's never known, takes him on a journey across the remote and stunning Kimberley landscape. On the road, TJ questions his life of violence... he meets a host of amazing characters who open up a way of l...

movie:tt0105377.name: Shadow of the Wolf
movie:tt0105377.description: In Canada's North during the 1930s, a young Inuit kills a White trader and is pursued by the police but his father is determined to protect his fugitive son at any cost.

movie:tt6570098.name: Ainbo
movie:tt6570098.description: An epic journey of a young hero and her Spirit Guides, "Dillo" a cute and humorous armadillo and "Vaca" a goofy oversized tapir, who embark on a quest to save their home in the spectacular Amazon Rainforest.

movie:tt0076451.name: New York, New York
movie:tt0076451.description: An egotistical saxophonist and a young lounge singer meet on VJ Day and embark upon a strained and rocky romance, even as their careers begin a long, uphill climb.

movie:tt2039345.name: Grand Piano
movie:tt2039345.description: A pianist with stage fright endures a performance under the eyes of a mysterious sniper, who will shoot and kill him if a wrong note is played.

movie:tt0060268.name: Cul-de-sac
movie:tt0060268.description: A fugitive and his partner invade a recluse's castle.

movie:tt0267248.name: Abandon
movie:tt0267248.description: An investigation of a college student's missing boyfriend becomes quite strange when she begins to see him periodically.

movie:tt0013025.name: Cops
movie:tt0013025.description: A series of mishaps manages to make a young man get chased by a big city's entire police force.

movie:tt0014538.name: Three Ages
movie:tt0014538.description: The misadventures of Buster in three separate historical periods.

movie:tt10996076.name: The Proud Princess
movie:tt10996076.description: Time has come for young and handsome King Benjamin to marry. He is captivated by Princess Carolina's portrait, and disguised as a gardener, he infiltrates her castle to win her heart after she rejects him.

movie:tt0115640.name: Beautiful Thing
movie:tt0115640.description: Jamie is a shy teenager, often bullied at school. His neighbour Ste has a rough time at home, being beaten by his father and brother. This issues bring them together and they find that what they feel for each other is more than fr...

movie:tt0086216.name: Rumble Fish
movie:tt0086216.description: An absent-minded street thug struggles to live up to his legendary older brother's reputation and longs for the days of gang warfare.

movie:tt0069097.name: Play It Again, Sam
movie:tt0069097.description: A film critic obsessed with Casablanca (1942) seeks to get over his wife leaving him by dating again with the help of a married couple and his illusory idol, Humphrey Bogart.

movie:tt28185868.name: Kina & Yuk
movie:tt28185868.description: The adventure following two foxes who are preparing to become parents for the first time at a time when global warming is altering the rules for everyone.

movie:tt11240348.name: The Exorcism
movie:tt11240348.description: A troubled actor begins to exhibit a disruptive behavior while shooting a horror film. His estranged daughter wonders if he's slipping back into his past addictions or if there's something more sinister at play.

movie:tt0047184.name: Living It Up
movie:tt0047184.description: An unsophisticated stationmaster from provincial New Mexico fraudulently claims that he is dying in order to get an expense-paid dream tour of New York.

movie:tt0064381.name: Goodbye, Columbus
movie:tt0064381.description: Young librarian Neil Klugman falls for beautiful 'nouveau riche' Radcliffe student Brenda Patimkin. His liberal sensibilities clash with the conservative values of Brenda's family creating a stressful clash of opinions on many sub...

movie:tt0085297.name: Carmen
movie:tt0085297.description: A group of flamenco dancers are rehearsing a very Spanish version of Bizet's dramatization of Prosper Merimee's novella Carmen. The choreographer Antonio falls in love with Carmen, the main dancer. Their story then turns similar t...

movie:tt7370936.name: The Christmas Train
movie:tt7370936.description: A cynical journalist decides to take a train from Washington, D.C. to Los Angeles for Christmas to get inspiration for a story in honor of his late father. He gets to know the other passengers and runs into an old flame while aboard.

movie:tt12631486.name: Half Baked: Totally High
movie:tt12631486.description: Three potheads sell a strain of magical weed to raise funds for their friend's funeral.

movie:tt0110365.name: Little Odessa
movie:tt0110365.description: A cold-blooded hitman visits his estranged Russian immigrant family in Brooklyn.

movie:tt1497874.name: Cold Weather
movie:tt1497874.description: A guy who moves back to Portland, Oregon becomes involved in the mystery of his ex-girlfriend's disappearance.

movie:tt6205872.name: Assassination Nation
movie:tt6205872.description: Anger erupts into violence as four teenagers fight for their lives against an armed mob.

movie:tt44147164.name: The Last Scene
movie:tt44147164.description: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

movie:tt20564678.name: Landship
movie:tt20564678.description: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

movie:tt32916648.name: The Party's Over!
movie:tt32916648.description: Mehdi had planned to spend a quiet summer in his in-laws' sumptuous home. But as soon as he arrives, a conflict breaks out between his girfriend's family and the villa's janitor couple. As Mehdi comes from a modest background, he thinks he can lead the negotiations between the two parties and bring everyone back to their senses. But things start to escalate...

movie:tt1133985.name: Green Lantern
movie:tt1133985.description: Reckless test pilot Hal Jordan is granted an alien ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers that inducts him into an intergalactic police force, the Green Lantern Corps.

movie:tt0097474.name: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
movie:tt0097474.description: One year after the events of Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers (1988), the Shape returns to Haddonfield once again in an attempt to kill his now-mute niece.

movie:tt37540328.name: Back to the 90s
movie:tt37540328.description: When a glitch hurls the hottest rising boy band of five friends into the year 1995, they must find a way back — together.

movie:tt0067048.name: Emitaï
movie:tt0067048.description: As World War II rages in Europe, a conflict arises between the French and the Diola-speaking tribe of Africa, prompting the village women to organize their men to sit beneath a tree to pray.

movie:tt1621180.name: The Karski Report
movie:tt1621180.description: An extended interview with Polish resistance fighter Jan Karski, consisting largely of footage gathered for but not included in Claude Lanzmann's epic 9-hour documentary "Shoah".

movie:tt0070531.name: Phase IV
movie:tt0070531.description: Suddenly, desert ants form a group intelligence and wage war on the humans. It's up to a couple of scientists and a girl to stop them

movie:tt21068758.name: Jungle Beat 2: The Past
movie:tt21068758.description: The animals from the African jungle fall through a time portal that the aliens forgot to close behind them. To return to the future, friends will need the help of dinosaurs. But the ancient lizards have their own problems. After all, their world is about to be invaded by cave aliens armed with clubs.

movie:tt35454004.name: All I Had Was Nothingness
movie:tt35454004.description: Forty years after the release of Claude Lanzmann’s monumental film Shoah, Guillaume Ribot reveals the director’s relentless pursuit to tell the untold, using only Lanzmann’s words and unseen footage from the masterpiece.

movie:tt0236784.name: The Tailor of Panama
movie:tt0236784.description: A tailor living in Panama reluctantly becomes a spy for a British Agent.

movie:tt0026174.name: Captain Blood
movie:tt0026174.description: After treating a Monmouth rebel against King James II in 1680s England, a young Irish doctor is exiled as a slave to Jamaica where he captures a Spanish galleon and becomes the most feared pirate of the Caribbean.

movie:tt0345591.name: Love Comes Softly
movie:tt0345591.description: A young woman on her way to a new life in the 1800s suddenly becomes a widow and must live with a recently-widowed young man and his daughter. Can any of them find love again?

movie:tt2555268.name: Maidentrip
movie:tt2555268.description: 14-year-old Laura Dekker sets out on a two-year voyage in pursuit of her dream to become the youngest person ever to sail around the world alone.

movie:tt0113305.name: Higher Learning
movie:tt0113305.description: People from all different walks of life, encounter racial tension, rape, responsibility, and the meaning of an education on a university campus.

movie:tt0037120.name: National Velvet
movie:tt0037120.description: A jaded former jockey helps a young girl prepare a wild but gifted horse for England's Grand National Sweepstakes.

movie:tt8322060.name: Tremors: Shrieker Island
movie:tt8322060.description: When a group of hunters genetically modify Graboid eggs, they face an all-out war against the larger, terrifyingly intelligent Graboids, and the swiftly multiplying Shriekers.

movie:tt0048728.name: To Catch a Thief
movie:tt0048728.description: A retired jewel thief sets out to prove his innocence after being suspected of returning to his former occupation.

movie:tt9867616.name: Almost Human
movie:tt9867616.description: The filmmaker Jeppe Rønde has invited 10 of the world's foremost researchers - and a robot! - to rethink our relationship with technology and its dilemmas from the outside. Philosophers, anthropologists, archaeologists and programmers show us through their thought experiments that our relationship with technology is just as much about our relationship with ourselves.

movie:tt0028373.name: Three Smart Girls
movie:tt0028373.description: Three sisters scheme to reunite their divorced parents before their wealthy father marries a conniving gold digger.

movie:tt3410834.name: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
movie:tt3410834.description: After the earth-shattering revelations of Insurgent, Tris must escape with Four beyond the wall that encircles Chicago to finally discover the shocking truth of the world outside.

movie:tt0077147.name: The Rutles: All You Need Is Cash
movie:tt0077147.description: Charts the adventures of the prefab four, possibly the most famous band of all time.

movie:tt41184263.name: Vengeance
movie:tt41184263.description: Special forces hero Carlos Estrada's wife is murdered. After unexpectedly becoming a millionaire, he uses his wealth to arm himself and his loyal soldiers to track down and exact revenge on those responsible.

movie:tt2077833.name: Rowdy Rathore
movie:tt2077833.description: A con man uncovers a deadly secret and must save his lady love, the small-town locals and the little girl who insists she's his daughter, from the mob.

movie:tt0075936.name: Desperate Living
movie:tt0075936.description: A neurotic society woman murders her husband with her maid's help; on the lam, they escape to Mortville, a homeless community ruled by a fascist queen.

movie:tt10740926.name: Rob Peace
movie:tt10740926.description: Based on a true story, a brilliant young man puts his bright future at risk to help his father.

movie:tt0490076.name: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
movie:tt0490076.description: A group of high-schoolers invite Mandy Lane, an innocent, desirable girl, to a weekend party on a secluded ranch. While the festivities rage on, the number of revelers begins to drop mysteriously.

movie:tt33372918.name: The Outer Threat
movie:tt33372918.description: An astrophysicist's alien discovery forces him and his family to flee their home, chased by a mysterious pursuer. Their escape tests the limits between cosmic truth and paranoia.

movie:tt0064638.name: Marlowe
movie:tt0064638.description: A young woman from Kansas hires LA private investigator Philip Marlowe to find her missing brother. Matters become more complicated when her sister, a successful actress who's being blackmailed, becomes connected to the case.

movie:tt0044954.name: The Narrow Margin
movie:tt0044954.description: A woman planning to testify against the mob must be protected against potential assassins on the train trip from Chicago to Los Angeles.

movie:tt0970866.name: Little Fockers
movie:tt0970866.description: Family-patriarch Jack Byrnes wants to appoint a successor. Does his son-in-law, the male nurse Greg Focker, have what it takes?

movie:tt0119707.name: Mortal Kombat: Annihilation
movie:tt0119707.description: A group of martial-arts warriors must save the Earth from an extra-dimensional invasion.

movie:tt0099242.name: Chattahoochee
movie:tt0099242.description: In 1955 Florida, a Korean vet has a breakdown and is incarcerated in a "maximum security" mental health prison, where patients are abused.

movie:tt0113855.name: Mortal Kombat
movie:tt0113855.description: Smart Earthlings must win a martial-arts battle in another dimension or see their world enslaved.

movie:tt20420628.name: Freud's Last Session
movie:tt20420628.description: Psychoanalyst Sigmund Freud invites professor C.S. Lewis to debate the existence of God, Freud's unique relationship with his daughter, and Lewis' unconventional relationship with his best friend's mother.

movie:tt0059063.name: Man Is Not a Bird
movie:tt0059063.description: A love romance between older, respectable engineer that came in the industrial town to do some expert job and young hairdresser in whose house he stayed in and the consequences of that relationship, especially after young driver g...

movie:tt2099556.name: Antiviral
movie:tt2099556.description: In a blackly satirical near future, a thriving industry sells celebrity illnesses to their obsessed fans. Employee Syd March's attempts to exploit the system backfire when they involve him in a potentially deadly mystery.

movie:tt30192483.name: Louise Violet
movie:tt30192483.description: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

movie:tt0080009.name: Tess
movie:tt0080009.description: A strong-willed young peasant girl attracts the affection of two men.

movie:tt0076301.name: The Late Show
movie:tt0076301.description: A grumpy semi-retired private investigator partners with a quirky female client to catch the people who murdered his partner.

movie:tt43725831.name: Jurassic Sharks
movie:tt43725831.description: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

movie:tt0054286.name: Cruel Story of Youth
movie:tt0054286.description: A harsh young man seduces a freeloading young woman and eventually takes advantage of her knack for hitch-hiking to rob middle-class men.

movie:tt27850528.name: The Green Dinosaur
movie:tt27850528.description: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

movie:tt1758795.name: The To-Do List
movie:tt1758795.description: Feeling pressured to become more sexually experienced before she goes to college, Brandy Klark makes a list of things to accomplish before hitting campus in the fall.

movie:tt0091541.name: The Money Pit
movie:tt0091541.description: A young couple struggles to repair a hopelessly dilapidated house.

movie:tt40815155.name: Wild Sing
movie:tt40815155.description: Twenty years after a scandal tears apart a popular 2000s K‑pop trio, the three reunite for a one-off gig — if they can overcome one snag after another.

movie:tt0848542.name: Arranged
movie:tt0848542.description: ARRANGED centers on the friendship between an Orthodox Jewish woman and a Muslim woman who meet as first-year teachers at a public school in Brooklyn. Over the course of the year they learn they share much in common - not least of...

movie:tt22525442.name: I Wish You All the Best
movie:tt22525442.description: A non-binary teen is kicked out of their North Carolina home after coming out to their ultra-religious parents. As a result, they move in with their estranged sister and her husband. Though the two are welcoming, they continue to struggle with anxiety further exacerbated by their parents' rejection. As such, they try to keep a low profile at school. However, after they meet a proudly bisexual classmate, their life begins to look a little more hopeful.

movie:tt0099566.name: The Field
movie:tt0099566.description: When a field (which has been farmed by the McCabe family for generations) goes up for auction, the patriarch of the McCabe family will stop at nothing to prevent a rich American from buying it.

movie:tt9286990.name: Thai Cave Rescue
movie:tt9286990.description: Rescue workers race against the clock to save twelve boys and their soccer coach trapped in a cave system in Thailand.

movie:tt7034316.name: Eat, Play, Love
movie:tt7034316.description: Veterinarian Dr. Carly Monroe (Jen Lilley) falls for Dan Landis (Jason Cermak), the owner of a dog shelter she frequently visits. Unfortunately, Dan is about to marry his glamorous girlfriend and move to New York City.

movie:tt7131870.name: Wolf Warrior 2
movie:tt7131870.description: China's deadliest special forces operative settles into a quiet life on the sea. When sadistic mercenaries begin targeting nearby civilians, he must leave his newfound peace behind and return to his duties as a soldier and protector.

movie:tt0064573.name: Last Summer
movie:tt0064573.description: During summer vacation on Fire Island, three young people become very close. When an uncool girl tries to infiltrate the trio's newly found relationship, they construct an elaborate plot that has violent results.

movie:tt0472156.name: Pu-239
movie:tt0472156.description: A worker at a Russian nuclear facility gets exposed to a lethal dose of radiation. In order to provide for his family, he steals some plutonium and sets out to sell it on Moscow's black market with the help of an incompetent crimi...

movie:tt37660536.name: Marc by Sofia
movie:tt37660536.description: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer.

movie:tt35854600.name: Robot Chicken: Self-Discovery Special
movie:tt35854600.description: The hapless Robot Chicken Nerd seeks self-discovery America's way: going on reality shows. Will he find a 90 Day Fiancé - or end up Shark Week chum?

movie:tt3125220.name: Little Accidents
movie:tt3125220.description: In a small American town still living in the shadow of a terrible coal mine accident, the disappearance of a teenage boy draws together a surviving miner, the lonely wife of a mine executive, and a local boy in a web of secrets.

movie:tt0078389.name: The Thirty Nine Steps
movie:tt0078389.description: In March 1914, a mining engineer named Richard Hannay tries to prevent Prussian Agents from executing a political assassination designed to trigger World War I.

movie:tt0490499.name: The Tiger's Tail
movie:tt0490499.description: After a chance encounter, a wealthy businessman is stalked by an evil doppelganger.

movie:tt33565722.name: A Child of My Own
movie:tt33565722.description: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

movie:tt0245090.name: Edges of the Lord
movie:tt0245090.description: A twelve-year-old Jewish boy hides with a family of Catholic peasant farmers to escape the Nazis.

movie:tt0259393.name: Lantana
movie:tt0259393.description: The relationships of four couples unravel after the discovery of a young woman's body in Lantana bush in suburban Sydney.

movie:tt0274155.name: Tanguy
movie:tt0274155.description: Tanguy is 28 years old and still living with his parents. They think it's time he moves out. He doesn't, so they hatch a plan...

movie:tt43683795.name: Euphoria: A Look Back
movie:tt43683795.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

movie:tt4636068.name: The Fourth Direction
movie:tt4636068.description: Fear and paranoia pervade life in rural Punjab of the ’80s, before and after Operation Blue Star, as separatists clash with security forces.

movie:tt11241510.name: Eerie Fairy Tales
movie:tt11241510.description: An anthology of bizarre, fantastic and spooky tales from the past, present and future, dealing with curses, witches, perfect crime and science experiments.

movie:tt24300758.name: Puntos suspensivos
movie:tt24300758.description: It follows Leo, an author. He is visited by a man claiming to be a journalist in a secret location where Leo is penning his next novel, but only his agent knows where he is.

movie:tt0378109.name: Into the Blue
movie:tt0378109.description: Four divers cross paths with drug smugglers in the Bahamas.

movie:tt32140922.name: Ya No Quedan Junglas
movie:tt32140922.description: An elderly gentleman, haunted by a brutal murder, embarks on a quest for vengeance, navigating a complex web of emotions and moral dilemmas.

movie:tt0020112.name: The Love Parade
movie:tt0020112.description: Queen Louise's cabinet are worried that she will become an old maid, and are delighted when she marries the rougish Count Renard. Unfortunately, he finds his position as Queen's Consort unsatisfying and without purpose, and the marriage soon runs into difficulties.

movie:tt15507128.name: The Trouble with Jessica
movie:tt15507128.description: Sarah and Tom are in terrible financial trouble. On the brink of losing everything, they’ve managed to find a buyer for their stylish London home. When their best friends Richard and Beth come round for a final dinner, an uninvited old friend, Jessica, tags along.

movie:tt27909030.name: The Child Who Measured the World
movie:tt27909030.description: Alexandre Varda, a powerful property developer of Greek origin, finds his life suddenly turned upside down. On the same day, he is sacked by his sharhold- ers and learns of the death of his daughter, whom he has not seen for 12 years. When he arrives in Greece the next day to repatriate the body, he also discovers that he is the grandfather of a 9-year-old boy with autistic syndrome...

movie:tt29218808.name: Infiltrate
movie:tt29218808.description: A mysterious voice compels an ordinary woman to delve into the dark underbelly of organized crime, determined to rescue her kidnapped husband from its clutches.

movie:tt36610602.name: Personhood
movie:tt36610602.description: In a near-future world, a lonely, physically challenged man purchases a companion robot to escape his isolation, but his own insecurities and a jealous brother threaten his chances of ever finding love.

movie:tt0116277.name: The Fan
movie:tt0116277.description: An all-star baseball player becomes the unhealthy focus of an obsessive salesman.

movie:tt27714840.name: Classified
movie:tt27714840.description: A career CIA hitman who's been solely using the classified section of various newspapers to receive his orders suddenly discovers that his division's actually been shut down for years.

movie:tt34487826.name: Spices and Lies
movie:tt34487826.description: Mehdi's life lies on a fragile balance. He plays the role of the perfect Algerian son for his mother Fatima, while hiding his relationship with Léa and his passion for French cuisine and wine, which he pursues as a chef at the bistro where he works. But Léa can no longer tolerate his family secrets and demands to meet Fatima. Cornered, Mehdi comes up with the worst possible solution...

movie:tt14488886.name: Paper & Glue
movie:tt14488886.description: A documentary following JR's artwork giving a global voice to everyday people.

movie:tt28497662.name: Speak Out
movie:tt28497662.description: Colin, 14, enters a new school and he's freaking out: how do you get by when, like him, you're a stutterer? His meeting with Mr. Devarseau, a charismatic French teacher, will push him to face his fears and break out of his isolation. Now Colin has a group of friends and a project: to go on stage to play Cyrano in front of the whole school.

movie:tt3970854.name: The Perfect Dictatorship
movie:tt3970854.description: After accepting a colossal bribe, a powerful TV conglomerate gins up fake news stories to enhance the image of a notoriously corrupt politician.

movie:tt33022412.name: The Myth of Maracuda
movie:tt33022412.description: The son of Chief Marakud should become a real warrior, but he does not know how to hunt at all and disappoints his father. Marakuda goes alone into the forest and finds the sacred bird Tink, which gives him the gift of understanding the language of animals and birds. Marakuda and Tink return home with honors. The boy does not know that according to tradition, the sacred bird must be sacrificed for the prosperity of the tribe.

movie:tt3484312.name: Zoe and the Astronaut
movie:tt3484312.description: Zoe has suffered with Leukemia her whole life. When her condition worsens, she's given months to live. One day, a Young Astronaut crash lands near her home. Zoe spends her last days showing the Astronaut the wonders of Planet Earth.

movie:tt31707271.name: Bring the Law
movie:tt31707271.description: A disgraced LA cop is chosen to lead a task force against a local crime syndicate and uncovers a conspiracy of corruption in his own department.

movie:tt41933893.name: My CEO Thinks I’m a Robot
movie:tt41933893.description: Angela Muji teams up with acclaimed actor Carlo Aquino in a quirky rom-com where an AI developer pretends to be a robot for her longtime crush and CEO. Expect kilig, chaos, and a surprising chemistry you won't see coming.

movie:tt0079781.name: Real Life
movie:tt0079781.description: A film crew sets out to record a year in the life of an average family, but things quickly start going wrong.

movie:tt35077924.name: Bon Voyage, Marie
movie:tt35077924.description: An unexpected road trip brings a dysfunctional family together for one last journey with their elder, sparking moments of connection, joy, and reconciliation.

movie:tt1131734.name: Jennifer's Body
movie:tt1131734.description: A newly-possessed high-school cheerleader turns into a succubus who specializes in killing her male classmates. Can her best friend put an end to the horror?

movie:tt28182919.name: And the Party Goes On
movie:tt28182919.description: In Marseille, Rosa, 60, dedicated her life to family and politics with the same sense of duty. Everyone considers her unwavering, until the day she falls in love with Henri. For the first time, Rosa is afraid to commit. Between the pressure of his family, politics and a desire to indulge in her feelings, the conflict is difficult to sustain.

movie:tt2002718.name: Machete Kills
movie:tt2002718.description: The U.S. government recruits Machete to battle his way through Mexico in order to take down an arms dealer who looks to launch a weapon into space.

movie:tt0110200.name: Fist of Legend
movie:tt0110200.description: In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

movie:tt6997574.name: My Teacher, My Obsession
movie:tt6997574.description: Riley struggles to make friends after transferring to a new high school where her father is an English teacher. When she meets fellow loner Kyla, they become close friends--until Riley learns that Kyla is obsessed with her father.

movie:tt0405336.name: Southland Tales
movie:tt0405336.description: During a three-day heat wave just before a huge 4th of July celebration, an action star stricken with amnesia meets up with a porn star who is developing her own reality TV project, and a policeman who holds the key to a vast cons...

movie:tt0062138.name: Point Blank
movie:tt0062138.description: After being double-crossed and left for dead, a mysterious man named Walker single-mindedly tries to retrieve the money that was stolen from him.

movie:tt37244013.name: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
movie:tt37244013.description: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most audacious mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean’s most famous and feared predators, the great white shark. Diving in the shallows without a cage, Bertie will attempt to film these huge sharks. By entering their domain, he discovers the challenges they face on our rapidly changing planet.

movie:tt10260294.name: Guests
movie:tt10260294.description: Young Katya meets a merry company of visiting guys who have a specific entertainment - to organize parties in other people's empty houses. And Katya knows the right place: an old summer cottage on the coast, the owner of which lef...

movie:tt35303601.name: The Roughneck
movie:tt35303601.description: An oil worker and his dog embark on a journey to his wedding, but after a violent attack at a rest stop, he teams with his ex-convict father to seek revenge, uncovering dark secrets in their rural community.

movie:tt42907611.name: The Welcome Table
movie:tt42907611.description: Tells the story of climate refugees across six continents, celebrating the voices and experiences of people living at the forefront of the climate crisis, displaced from their homes by climate disasters.

movie:tt26470786.name: The Cure
movie:tt26470786.description: Ally Braun, a 16-year-old adopted girl with a mysterious illness, discovering her biotech billionaire parents are harvesting her blood for sinister reasons.

movie:tt0081375.name: Private Benjamin
movie:tt0081375.description: A sheltered young high-society woman joins the United States Army on a whim and finds herself in a trickier situation than she ever expected.

movie:tt8354218.name: Fireheart
movie:tt8354218.description: Sixteen-year-old Georgia Nolan dreams of being the world's first-ever female firefighter. When a mysterious arsonist starts burning down Broadway, New York's firemen begin vanishing. The Mayor of New York calls Georgia's father Sh...

movie:tt31863738.name: The Polar Bear Prince
movie:tt31863738.description: An adventurous girl, Liv, lives with her beloved grandfather in a small village nestled among majestic mountains and forests. One day she encounters a polar bear, who turns out to be a prince enchanted into animal form. To break the spell, they will have to face an evil witch.

movie:tt37520831.name: Robot Girlfriend: Revenge
movie:tt37520831.description: A robot girlfriend begins to have murderous impulses when she discovers feelings of love.

movie:tt15389042.name: Maria Montessori
movie:tt15389042.description: In 1900, a Parisian courtesan flees to Rome to protect her reputation when her daughter's learning disability could become exposed. There she meets Maria Montessori, who is pioneering a teaching method that may help the child.

movie:tt36591348.name: Boy George & Culture Club
movie:tt36591348.description: Set against the backdrop of 1980s Britain, four young men – Boy George, Roy Hay, Mikey Craig, and Jon Moss – formed a multi-racial, ethnically diverse, and sexually liberated band with a style and sound that challenged the status quo during the era of New Romantics and Margaret Thatcher’s Britain.

movie:tt28833698.name: Two to One
movie:tt28833698.description: After the fall of the Berlin Wall, a communist family discovers a bunker full of money soon to be worthless. With the help of their neighbors, they embark on a race against time to enter the capitalist world in style.

movie:tt33030375.name: The New Year That Never Came
movie:tt33030375.description: On the brink of revolution in 1989 Romania, six lives intersect amid protests and personal struggles, leading to the explosive fall of Ceausescu and the communist regime.

movie:tt28171985.name: The Ice Tower
movie:tt28171985.description: Jeanne, a 15-year-old orphan, witnesses the shoot for a film adaptation of the fairy tale The Snow Queen, and she becomes fascinated by its star, Cristina, an actress who is just as mysterious and alluring as the Queen she is playing.

movie:tt0110657.name: The Next Karate Kid
movie:tt0110657.description: Mr. Miyagi is back and he takes a new pupil under his wing: a troubled adolescent girl.

movie:tt0367631.name: D.E.B.S.
movie:tt0367631.description: Plaid-skirted schoolgirls are groomed by a secret government agency to become the newest members of the elite national-defense group, D.E.B.S.

movie:tt0077497.name: Emmanuelle 3
movie:tt0077497.description: Emmanuelle and her architect husband continue their amoral lifestyle in the Seychelles. But when a casual dalliance between her and a film director starts to turn serious her husband shows very traditional signs of jealousy

movie:tt29634258.name: Shepherds
movie:tt29634258.description: A young Montreal advertising executive, converted to a Provençal shepherd, has various misadventures with a civil servant who has cavalierly quit her job.

movie:tt11952626.name: Tenement
movie:tt11952626.description: Soriya goes back to Cambodia in a quest to find herself after her mother's death, there she finds a family she has never known and an old building full of dark secrets.

movie:tt26743414.name: Monsieur Aznavour
movie:tt26743414.description: Follows the beginnings of the iconic French-Armenian singer, songwriter and actor, Charles Aznavour, from zero to fame.

movie:tt14367552.name: Tomorrow Before After
movie:tt14367552.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a young woman, with the help of an abandoned dog, searches for other survivors while trying to cope with an unborn child growing inside of her.

movie:tt35526133.name: Badh
movie:tt35526133.description: BADH is a French secret agent tasked with eliminating a powerful arms dealer in Syria. Betrayed by the French foreign intelligence, she disappears without a trace and rebuilds her life in Morocco, until the day her husband is targ...

movie:tt11394168.name: Be Water
movie:tt11394168.description: Rejected by Hollywood, Bruce Lee returned to Hong Kong to complete four films. Charting his struggles in two worlds, Be Water explores questions of identity and representation through rare archive, intimate interviews, and his wri...

movie:tt29362046.name: The Sloth Lane
movie:tt29362046.description: After a terrifying storm destroys their home, a speedy sloth named Laura and her kooky family move to the big city in their rusted old food truck, Gordito, hoping to make their business a success. The family's delicious food catches the eye of a quick-witted cheetah who will stop at nothing to revive her failing fast-food business.

movie:tt14972766.name: Dominique
movie:tt14972766.description: Trained assassin Dominique, escaping her troubled past, crash lands her plane in a Colombian town rife with violence. Sheltered by a family, she faces attacks from police and must choose between self-preservation or defending her ...

movie:tt18362444.name: The Year of the Dog
movie:tt18362444.description: Matt, a loner alcoholic, struggles to maintain sobriety and honor his mother's dying wish to see him get sober.  His AA sponsor offers him refuge at his farm where Matt finds Yup'ik, a stray husky with a unique talent. Their relationship struggles at first, but with the help of their Montana community, the two strays find a connection and discover what it takes to pull thru to the finish line.

movie:tt1334102.name: The Resident

movie:tt10013512.name: The Problem with People

movie:tt0036126.name: Madame Curie
movie:tt0036126.description: Despite himself, accomplished physicist and avowed bachelor Pierre Curie falls for brilliant student Marie, and together they embark on the discovery of radium.

movie:tt21072246.name: Haw
movie:tt21072246.description: Tamio Akanishi works at a public office in Yokohama. He is going through one of the worst periods of his life, having been left by his fiancée. One day, his boss tells him to take care of a big, white dog, abandoned by its previous owner. Tamio begins to live with the dog, who doesn't bark and only makes a sound that sounds like "haw", and thus he names it Haw. While living together, the connection between the two deepens.

movie:tt16280900.name: Shatner in Space
movie:tt16280900.description: The special details the events before, during, and after Shatner's life-changing flight - which made him the oldest person to ever travel to the cosmos - and the growing friendship between the Star Trek icon and Blue Origin founder Jeff Bezos, whose dreams of space travel, like many, were inspired by the original Star Trek series.

movie:tt0127353.name: Water Easy Reach
movie:tt0127353.description: Tells the story of Almar, a young Norwegian sailor whose gold watch, of great sentimental value, has been broken. While waiting for repairs in a remote Spanish town, he meets a number of unusual characters: Windy, an Australian seafarer with unusual experiences, real or imaginary; Marta, a beautiful Spanish girl; Martha's bizarre grandfather; and two old watchmakers who are painfully methodical. It seems to Almar that real time has also stopped when his watch did.

movie:tt0133363.name: Lovers of the Arctic Circle
movie:tt0133363.description: In Lapland's cold Arctic Circle, under the eternal midnight sun, unfavourable circumstances reunite two kindred spirits. And governed by circular motifs woven by faith and love, they must answer a pivotal question. Can they deny d...

movie:tt0120274.name: Tango
movie:tt0120274.description: Mario Suarez is a forty-something tango artist, whose wife Laura has left him. He leaves his apartment and starts preparing a film about tango.

movie:tt32250381.name: Million Dollar Madness
movie:tt32250381.description: Under immense pressure and amidst competition with a duplicitous colleague, Stan, the ambitious and very serious operations manager of a construction firm reaches breaking point when he learns that he’s been unfairly laid off by the company’s tyrannical CEO. He impulsively steals one million euros from the company’s vault, tosses away the key to the safe and hastily flees with his fiancée Marine… Before discovering that his termination was a mistake, and he is actually being promoted! Stan has until sunrise to return the money to the vault. But having thrown away his key, and with the only spare inside the CEO’s own apartment, he must reluctantly enlist the help of Hippolyte, Paris’s most unpredictable locksmith. The night promises to be full of twists and turns!

movie:tt35620409.name: Like Friends
movie:tt35620409.description: Achille, a successful, solitary broker, buys Kelly, the first woman android with a perfectly human body. After a period of cohabitation that is anything but simple, Kelly mysteriously disappears. This is only the beginning of a whirlwind of events that will upend his life.

movie:tt1568337.name: Loosies
movie:tt1568337.description: A young pickpocket in the New York subways, living a fast, free, lifestyle is confronted by a woman with whom he had a one night affair.

movie:tt0114134.description: A woman with a body-writing fetish seeks to find a combined lover and calligrapher.

movie:tt0838232.name: The Pink Panther 2

movie:tt0417751.name: Her Minor Thing

movie:tt8637446.name: Noah's Ark

movie:tt0326208.name: Stander

movie:tt31614921.name: Under the Stars

movie:tt4225012.name: A Little White Lie

movie:tt21861446.name: Valley of Shadows
movie:tt21861446.description: Quique, Clara and little Lucas are vacationing in northern India. One night, sleeping outside during a storm, they are brutally attacked. Hours later, Quique is rescued by a native and taken to a remote isolated village in the mou...

movie:tt0456149.name: The Death of Mr. Lazarescu
movie:tt0456149.description: Mr. Lãzãrescu, a dying old man, is shuttled from hospital to hospital by a loyal paramedic as doctors refuse to operate and no one can agree on a diagnosis.

movie:tt39088896.name: Adult Swim's The Elephant
movie:tt39088896.description: Crafted in three parts by four animation superstars, Adult Swim's The Elephant brings to life a very human journey of self-discovery in varied styles.

movie:tt15721088.name: High Heat
movie:tt15721088.description: When the local mafia shows up to burn down her restaurant, Ana, a chef with a meticulous past, defends her turf and proves her knife skills both in and out of the kitchen.

movie:tt35838700.name: The Confession
movie:tt35838700.description: A musician returns to her childhood home and finds her late father's recorded murder confession, made to ward off an evil force. As her son's behavior grows disturbing, she fights to end the darkness.

movie:tt33060102.name: Men of War

movie:tt1210801.name: Command Performance

movie:tt7743120.name: This Is the Night

movie:tt0393685.name: Santa's Slay

movie:tt7211010.name: War Dog: A Soldier's Best Friend

movie:tt10768328.name: Double Holiday
