movie:tt1547090.name: Without Men
movie:tt1547090.description: The women of a remote Latin American town are forced to pick up the pieces and remake their world when all the town's men are forcibly recruited by communist guerrillas.

movie:tt33083649.name: Ghost Train
movie:tt33083649.description: Da-kyung, a horror YouTuber desperate for views, uploads a video about the eerie urban legends surrounding Gwanglim Station—the site of the highest number of missing person cases in the country. The video goes viral overnight. Despite everyone's warnings, Da-kyung's thirst for views only grows stronger. But as she digs deeper, she uncovers a shocking secret behind the station…

movie:tt31392191.name: Where the Wind Comes From
movie:tt31392191.description: Alyssa, a rebellious 19 year-old girl, and her friend Mehdi — a shy and introverted 23-year-old young man — who use their imagination to escape their unpromising reality.  When they discover a contest in the south of Tunisia that may allow them to flee for real, they decide to undertake the road trip regardless of the obstacles in their way.

movie:tt0144201.name: Girl on the Bridge
movie:tt0144201.description: One night, a fading entertainer intervenes when a woman contemplates suicide, beginning a strange, unpredictable relationship.

movie:tt0082175.name: The Chosen
movie:tt0082175.description: In 1944, in Brooklyn, two Jewish kids become friends. One is from a very conservative family, and the other is more liberal. The issues of importance of tradition, parental expectations and the formation of Israel cause constant f...

movie:tt0236157.name: Disco Pigs
movie:tt0236157.description: Pig and Runt - born on the same day, in the same hospital, moments apart. Twins, all but by blood.

movie:tt0106579.name: Clean, Shaven
movie:tt0106579.description: After a man suffering from schizophrenia is released from a mental institution, he attempts to get his daughter back from her adoptive family.

movie:tt5137222.name: Cigarettes et chocolat chaud
movie:tt5137222.description: A single father struggles with the education of his two daughters and his two jobs until he's forced by a social investigator to attend parenting classes.

movie:tt0417056.name: Pledge This!
movie:tt0417056.description: At South Beach University, a beautiful sorority president takes in a group of unconventional freshman girls seeking acceptance into her house.

movie:tt11753696.name: Little Girl
movie:tt11753696.description: The touching portrait of eight-year-old Sasha, who questions her gender and in doing so, evokes the sometimes disturbing reactions of a society that is still invested in a biological boy-girl way of thinking.

movie:tt26740887.name: The Final Run
movie:tt26740887.description: Pierce Butler, a former Marine and long-retired marijuana smuggler, whose wife is suffering from a rare type of cancer, must return to his drug-running ways and make one Final Load in order to save his house, his company, and his wife.

movie:tt0070825.name: The Train Robbers
movie:tt0070825.description: A gunhand named Lane is hired by a widow, Mrs. Lowe, to find gold stolen by her husband so that she may return it and start fresh.

movie:tt2262315.name: The Good Neighbor
movie:tt2262315.description: A pair of mischievous high school kids create the illusion of a haunting on an unsuspecting elderly neighbor while keeping his every reaction under surveillance. A series of coincidences leads to tragedy.

movie:tt9542818.name: The Snow Wolf: A Winter's Tale
movie:tt9542818.description: A dramatized tale of how wolves recovered in Europe after almost going extinct.

movie:tt1711525.name: Office Christmas Party
movie:tt1711525.description: When his uptight CEO sister threatens to shut down his branch, the branch manager throws an epic Christmas party in order to land a big client and save the day, but the party gets way out of hand...

movie:tt0086192.name: Revenge of the Ninja
movie:tt0086192.description: After ninjas killed his family, Cho and his son Kane come to America to start a new life. He opens a doll shop but is unwittingly importing heroin in the dolls. When his friend betrays him, Cho must prepare for the ultimate battle.

movie:tt0116026.name: Dark Breed
movie:tt0116026.description: Captain Saxon, an agent for the top secret Omega agency, has been given the assignment of tracking down and either capturing or killing the crew members of a secret space mission who returned to Earth against orders. It seems that they were all infected with an alien parasite, and they were trying to bring its eggs back to Earth. The eggs were lost in an accident, and both Saxon and the astronauts are trying to locate them.

movie:tt0033373.name: Ball of Fire
movie:tt0033373.description: A group of professors working on a new encyclopedia while residing in a Manhattan mansion take in a sassy nightclub singer who the police need to help them bring down her mob-boss lover.

movie:tt37679220.name: Junk World
movie:tt37679220.description: 1,042 years before JUNK HEAD, a robot named Robin escorts a human commander on a mission to the underground city of Carp Bar.

movie:tt34959976.name: The Drift
movie:tt34959976.description: A survival drama about an ice skater stranded on an ice floe at the Arctic Sea. When the ice floe starts to float towards south and melt, the ice skater must use all means necessary to survive.

movie:tt0095882.name: Police Academy 5: Assignment: Miami Beach
movie:tt0095882.description: Eric Lassard is about to retire, which Harris plans to exploit to take over his position. In Miami, where Lassard is to be honored, a mix-up leads to an adventure involving diamonds, kidnapping and betrayal.

movie:tt35453969.name: Leave One Day
movie:tt35453969.description: Cécile is about to open her own gourmet restaurant, finally making her dream come true, when suddenly her father has a heart attack and she is called back to the village where she was born. Far from the hubbub of Paris life, she runs into her teenage crush. The memories come flooding back, destabilizing her certainties.

movie:tt29731445.name: Buying Time
movie:tt29731445.description: It is the year 2028 and antibiotics are no longer effective. A corporation called Lifeline has invented a health chip which everyone can get for free via the NHS.  You can buy an upgrade which is effective against more infections and diseases. In 2028 computing and processing power is restricted however for someone to have an upgrade some one has to die for the power to be transferred. People are dieing randomly. Lifeline are launching their 2nd upgrade which is expected to earn them billions along with their ministerial backer.  Daniel Avery has lost his wife and daughter in such circumstances and recent nightmares and flashbacks have instigated him to investigate.  He slowly uncovers the truth with the help of a rebel group of the pull for power and greed that goes right to the top.

movie:tt4714896.name: On Wings of Eagles
movie:tt4714896.description: Eric Liddell - China's first gold medalist and one of Scotland's greatest athletes - returns to war-torn China.

movie:tt0091538.name: Mona Lisa
movie:tt0091538.description: A man recently released from prison manages to get a job driving a call girl from customer to customer.

movie:tt2620590.name: Leatherface
movie:tt2620590.description: A teenage Leatherface escapes from a mental hospital with three other inmates, kidnapping a young nurse and taking her on a road trip from hell, while being pursued by a lawman out for revenge.

movie:tt0483607.name: Doomsday
movie:tt0483607.description: A futuristic action thriller where a team of people work to prevent a disaster threatening the future of the human race.

movie:tt0302498.name: Raising Flagg
movie:tt0302498.description: A comedy centered on a handyman (Arkin) and his lifelong competition with his neighbor (Pendleton.)

movie:tt7737224.name: Turtles All the Way Down
movie:tt7737224.description: A teenager with OCD tries to solve a mystery surrounding a fugitive billionaire.

movie:tt6246322.name: Don't Breathe 2
movie:tt6246322.description: A blind war veteran trains his adopted daughter to face any danger, but they are ambushed when a vengeful stranger emerges from the past.

movie:tt0353489.name: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
movie:tt0353489.description: Ginger's sister Brigitte, now a werewolf herself, must try to find a cure for her blood lust before the next full moon while hiding out in a rehab clinic from a relentless werewolf.

movie:tt2869728.name: Ride Along 2
movie:tt2869728.description: As his wedding day approaches, Ben heads to Miami with his soon-to-be brother-in-law James to bring down a drug dealer who's supplying the dealers of Atlanta with product.

movie:tt8980622.name: Silver Star
movie:tt8980622.description: When Billie learns that her estranged parents' lives are at risk, she tries to help them by robbing a bank. In her botched robbery attempt, she takes a hostage named Franny, who turns out to be a charmingly impulsive pregnant teenager with nothing left to lose. Together, Billie and Franny embark on a chase through scenic American landscapes, clashing and struggling for common ground in hopes for a brighter future.

movie:tt8540428.name: Flatwoods
movie:tt8540428.description: A documentary filmmaker uncovers an alien conspiracy in Flatwoods, West Virginia.

movie:tt0085121.name: 10 to Midnight
movie:tt0085121.description: A veteran LA detective becomes personally entangled in a serial killer case when the nude, knife-wielding suspect targets his daughter, forcing him to choose between the law and fatherly protection.

movie:tt40332136.name: Robot Girls
movie:tt40332136.description: When a robot girl companion fails to listen to its developer, the developer uses an advanced model to train the robot girl. But when the training turns deadly, the developer finds himself in trouble.

movie:tt0116531.name: High School High
movie:tt0116531.description: Richard Clark has just left the well-known Wellington Academy to teach at Marion Barry High School. Now, he will try to inspire the D-average students into making good grades and try to woo a fellow teacher.

movie:tt38637477.name: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
movie:tt38637477.description: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

movie:tt3317234.name: Game Over, Man!
movie:tt3317234.description: Three friends are on the verge of getting their video game financed when their benefactor is taken hostage by terrorists.

movie:tt2654124.name: Iron Man: Rise of Technovore
movie:tt2654124.description: Iron Man is framed by a technological terrorist and breaks out to clear his name.

movie:tt14349032.name: The Good Neighbor
movie:tt14349032.description: The budding friendship between two very different neighbours takes a tragic turn when David runs over a young woman and causes her death.

movie:tt27819388.name: Cinderella's Curse
movie:tt27819388.description: Based on the same folktale that Disney updated and popularized for children, back in the 1950s.

movie:tt0086443.name: Timerider: The Adventure of Lyle Swann
movie:tt0086443.description: A maverick motorbike racer wanders into a top-secret time-travel research test site which unintentionally teleports him to the mid-1800s and ends up having to fight violent outlaws for his survival.

movie:tt0065032.name: The Stalking Moon
movie:tt0065032.description: U.S. Army soldiers round up a group of Apache, mostly women and children. Surprisingly, they find among them a white woman and her half-Apache son.

movie:tt36424914.name: Pets on a Train
movie:tt36424914.description: When a train unexpectedly starts up, taking only pets with it, the animals discover that Hans, a badger with a grudge is behind it all. While the crash seems inevitable, the animals can count on Falcon, a roguish Raccoon who will do anything to save them.

movie:tt28639152.name: Super Charlie
movie:tt28639152.description: Wille has always dreamed of becoming a superhero and fight crime alongside his father. This dream is shattered when Wille's brother, Charlie, is born. Charlie gets all the attention, and on top of that – he has superpowers. When a supervillain and an evil scientist enact a plan to overthrow the city, Wille and Charlie must put their differences aside and work together as a team. Can an infant and his envious brother save the city?

movie:tt0066549.name: Waterloo
movie:tt0066549.description: Facing the decline of everything he has worked to obtain, conqueror Napoleon Bonaparte and his army confront the British at the Battle of Waterloo.

movie:tt1744776.name: Legend of the Boneknapper Dragon
movie:tt1744776.description: Hiccup and the gang join Gobber on a quest to find a legendary boneclad Dragon.

movie:tt6956566.name: Laboratory Conditions
movie:tt6956566.description: A physician investigating a missing body disrupts an unlawful experiment.

movie:tt31948263.name: Prodigies
movie:tt31948263.description: Claire and Jeanne are twin sisters, united by the same passion: the piano. Coached by their father like athletes, they join the prestigious Karlsruhe Conservatory. They are now competing to be soloists and training for a concert that will make or break their careers. But Claire and then Jeanne discover they are suffering from a serious illness and are slowly losing the use of their hands. With the support of their family and their undying love of music, they will find a unique way to change their fate. An inspiring and moving tale, based on a true story.

movie:tt16527824.name: Warhorse One
movie:tt16527824.description: A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

movie:tt27742699.name: Tabby McTat
movie:tt27742699.description: Set in London's streets, follows a musical cat and Fred, a gifted busker, and their warm, amazing friendship.

movie:tt0011071.name: Convict 13
movie:tt0011071.description: Buster is playing golf with Sybil when he gets knocked out. An escaped prisoner changes clothes with him. Buster goes to prison and learns that he is to be hanged. He changes clothes with a guard just as prisoner Roberts attacks all the guards.

movie:tt0299902.name: The Flintstones: Fred's Final Fling
movie:tt0299902.description: Due to a mix-up at the doctor's office, Fred believes he has only 24 hours left to live.

movie:tt9843192.name: Clouds
movie:tt9843192.description: A single father's optimism is tested when he faces an unfortunate turn of events.

movie:tt34967068.name: Touch Me
movie:tt34967068.description: Two codependent best friends become addicted to the heroin-like touch of an alien narcissist who may or may not be trying to take over the world.

movie:tt0011984.name: The Boat
movie:tt0011984.description: Buster's handmade boat, The Damfino, is finished and is, of course, too large to get through the basement door. When he drives off with it in tow, the side of his house, then the whole thing, collapses. At the harbor he rides the boat out only to have it sink beneath him. The rest is a series of adventures he and his family have with the restored boat.

movie:tt0012255.name: The Haunted House
movie:tt0012255.description: Buster is a bank clerk. Overturned glue gets everything, mostly the money, stuck to everything else. When robbers show up he can't "stick 'em up" because his hands are stuck in his pockets. The robbers' hideout is a haunted house designed to scare off police.

movie:tt0011508.name: Neighbors
movie:tt0011508.description: The Romeo and Juliet story played out in a tenement neighborhood with Buster and Virginia's families hating each other over the fence separating their buildings.

movie:tt1971458.name: Smugglers' Songs
movie:tt1971458.description: Early on in this engaging historical drama, a marquis (played by the singularly droll Jacques Nolot) offers a peddler a carriage ride on a remote country road. After sizing up his benefactor, the peddler fights motion sickness to deliver his sales pitch: “I have here a few objects of wonder, pious images, pamphlets against men of the cloth, newspapers from Amsterdam and London, holy cards, quills, writing paper…”

movie:tt0012253.name: Hard Luck
movie:tt0012253.description: Out of work, Buster tries various ways to commit suicide. At last he tries "poison" from a bottle containing booze. The president of a sporting club speaks of the need for a sportsman to promote the club and drunken Buster gets the job for which he must learn fishing, hunting and riding.

movie:tt0013422.name: My Wife's Relations
movie:tt0013422.description: When a large Irish woman falsely accuses Buster of breaking a window he is hauled before a Polish judge who speaks no English and assumes they are there to be married. She takes her new husband home to meet her four gorilla-like brothers.

movie:tt0012224.name: The Goat
movie:tt0012224.description: Buster is inadvertently identified as the notorious outlaw Dead Shot Dan. He is pursued throughout the city by the local police chief, using disguises and quick-thinking to elude the lawman. He encounters Virginia, a young lady friend, and goes to her home to visit and hide out, only to discover that Virginia's father is the police chief.

movie:tt0012278.name: The 'High Sign'
movie:tt0012278.description: Buster is thrown off a train near an amusement park. There he gets a job in a shooting gallery run by the Blinking Buzzards mob. Ordered to kill a businessman, he winds up protecting the man and his daughter by outfitting their home with trick devices.

movie:tt0300660.name: The Flintstones: Wind-Up Wilma
movie:tt0300660.description: Wilma is a celebrity when she gets a shot at the big leagues and becomes a pitcher for the Bedrock Dodgers after nailing a couple of robbers with a melon at the grocery store; however, she and Fred argue over her ambition to pitch for the team because Fred thinks a woman's place is in the home.

movie:tt0094792.name: Braddock: Missing in Action III
movie:tt0094792.description: Braddock mounts a one-man assault to free his wife and son who are still being held in a Vietnam prison camp.

movie:tt28554021.name: Shaman
movie:tt28554021.description: A Missionary converting an Indigenous Community in a remote Ecuadorian volcano must come to terms with her own Faith when her son is possessed by dark forces.

movie:tt31513400.name: A Man Is Dead
movie:tt31513400.description: Pushed to the edge, a reclusive man takes vengeance on those that wronged him.

movie:tt11671040.name: Riverdance 25th Anniversary Show
movie:tt11671040.description: A powerful and stirring reinvention of the show, celebrated the world over for its Grammy Award-winning music and the thrilling energy and passion of its Irish and international dance.

movie:tt0046008.name: The Living Desert
movie:tt0046008.description: Although first glance reveals little more than stones and sand, the desert is alive. Witness moving rocks, spitting mud pots, gorgeous flowers and the never-ending battle for survival between creatures of every shape, size and des...

movie:tt0051818.name: King Creole
movie:tt0051818.description: A troubled youth's singing sets New Orleans rockin'. With a sweet girl to love him and nightclubbers cheering, it seems he will shake off his past and head for the top. But will a mobster and his man-trap moll snare him in a life ...

movie:tt4158624.name: 3 Generations
movie:tt4158624.description: After Ray decides to transition from female to male, Ray's mother Maggie must come to terms with the decision while tracking down Ray's biological father to get his legal consent.

movie:tt0342735.name: Manderlay
movie:tt0342735.description: A story of slavery, set in the southern U.S. in the 1930s.

movie:tt0391891.name: Cruel Intentions 3
movie:tt0391891.description: Two guys at a college prep school make wagers on seducing naive young girls, and then meet their match when they agree to see which one can seduce the most popular and devious girl who has her own agenda to everything.

movie:tt0196267.name: Cruel Intentions 2
movie:tt0196267.description: Takes place before Cruel Intentions (1999), when Kathryn first meets Sebastian. Explores their sexual attraction to each other and their enjoyment in destroying the lives of their peers.

movie:tt0065522.name: Captain Nemo and the Underwater City
movie:tt0065522.description: When Captain Nemo saves the passengers of a sinking ship and takes them to his Utopian underwater city he discovers that not all of his guests agree to remain there forever.

movie:tt3660770.name: Monkey Kingdom
movie:tt3660770.description: Life is an adventure for a young monkey and her son, living among ancient ruins in the jungle. But when her family is forced from their home, she must lead them to safety amidst strange new creatures and surroundings.

movie:tt0061401.name: The Big Mouth
movie:tt0061401.description: On a San Diego beach, Gerald Clamson fishes out of the water a look-alike frog man who gives him a map to a stash of stolen-diamonds coveted by several crime syndicates.

movie:tt26745321.name: Armand
movie:tt26745321.description: Armand, a 6-year-old boy, is accused of crossing boundaries against his best friend at elementary school. While no one knows what actually happened between the two boys, the incident triggers a series of events, forcing parents and school staff into a captivating battle of redemption where madness, desire and obsession arise.

movie:tt0093828.name: Real Men
movie:tt0093828.description: A womanizing CIA agent and an insecure insurance agent are paired together to make sure a deal goes through with aliens for the future of mankind.

movie:tt6928060.name: My Favorite Wedding
movie:tt6928060.description: Tess is paired with the best man in her best friend's wedding to save it from disaster. But by the time the couple say "I do," Tess realizes that her own longtime boyfriend may not be the right guy for her "to have and to hold" af...

movie:tt0109951.name: Guarding Tess
movie:tt0109951.description: A former U.S. First Lady wants a particular Secret Service agent to head her bodyguard detail, even though he can't stand her.

movie:tt4564618.name: GARY
movie:tt4564618.description: Documentary of the music of outsider artist Gary R Forney. Interviews with the artist as well as his other musicians and producers. An inspiring story of never giving up your dream..

movie:tt32573118.name: Scared Shitless
movie:tt32573118.description: A plumber and his germophobic son are forced to get their hands dirty to save the residents of an apartment building, when a genetically engineered, blood-thirsty creature escapes into the plumbing system.

movie:tt33055004.name: Wisdom of Happiness
movie:tt33055004.description: A deeply intimate and highly cinematic documentary featuring the Dalai Lama, who, at nearly ninety year of age, offers practical advice for navigating the 21st century's challenges.

movie:tt31116965.name: My Dearest Señorita
movie:tt31116965.description: A young woman's medical discovery challenges everything she knows about herself, leading her on an unexpected path toward self-acceptance and a love that defies convention.

movie:tt0086823.name: V: The Final Battle
movie:tt0086823.description: A small group of human resistance fighters fight a desperate guerilla war against the genocidal extra-terrestrials who dominate Earth.

movie:tt0061328.name: Accident
movie:tt0061328.description: A beautiful Austrian coed attending Oxford University is betrothed to a fellow student, but she ends up getting involved with two unhappily married professors instead.

movie:tt22697898.name: Kryptic
movie:tt22697898.description: A woman searches for a missing monster hunter, realizing she has an inextricable bond with the creature being pursued.

movie:tt0017825.name: Downhill
movie:tt0017825.description: Bound by honor, a successful schoolboy takes the blame for his roommate's indiscretion, and it's all downhill from there.

movie:tt0041509.name: The Inspector General
movie:tt0041509.description: A town's corrupt officials think a fool is actually an investigator in disguise.

movie:tt22490428.name: Naples to New York
movie:tt22490428.description: Follows two Neapolitan kids as they journey to New York to escape Italy's early postwar poverty.

movie:tt0086508.name: Uncommon Valor
movie:tt0086508.description: Ten years after his son went M.I.A. in Vietnam, U.S. Marine retired Colonel Jason Rhodes assembles a private rescue team to find Americans held in P.O.W. camps in Laos.

movie:tt0102984.name: Stone Cold
movie:tt0102984.description: A tough Alabama cop is blackmailed by the FBI into going undercover in a violent Mississippi biker gang.

movie:tt0123209.name: The Other Sister
movie:tt0123209.description: A mentally challenged young woman seeks independence by obtaining her own apartment and attending college while her family plans her sister's wedding.

movie:tt0096073.name: The Seventh Sign
movie:tt0096073.description: Abby Quinn is eagerly awaiting childbirth but is haunted by dreams in which she miscarries. When she decides to rent a room to a mysterious stranger, she releases a chain of events that will unleash the end of humanity.

movie:tt0071324.name: The Valiant Ones
movie:tt0071324.description: The emperor dispatches an officer and a small band of men to deal with pirates.

movie:tt0049233.name: Friendly Persuasion
movie:tt0049233.description: The pacifist attitude of a Quaker family is tested as a result of the American Civil War.

movie:tt1776340.name: The Whistler
movie:tt1776340.description: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

movie:tt0292522.name: Garfield: His 9 Lives
movie:tt0292522.description: Garfield plays multiple roles including ancient Egyptian royalty, a fairyland kitten, a movie "stunt cat" and more!

movie:tt0347473.name: Main Hoon Na
movie:tt0347473.description: An army major goes undercover as a college student. His mission is both professional and personal: to protect his general's daughter from a radical militant, and to find his estranged half-brother.

movie:tt0878647.name: The Art of War III: Retribution
movie:tt0878647.description: A Secret Agent must prevent North Korean terrorist from acquiring a nuclear device.

movie:tt41378543.name: Ramy Youssef: In Love
movie:tt41378543.description: In his third HBO special, Ramy Youssef approaches a vast spectrum of personal topics, including marriage, AI, and being a dog parent.

movie:tt0017739.name: The Cat and the Canary
movie:tt0017739.description: Relatives of an eccentric millionaire gather in his spooky mansion on the 20th anniversary of his death for the reading of his will.

movie:tt27304026.name: Damaged
movie:tt27304026.description: Chicago detective Dan Lawson travels to Scotland to link up with Scottish detective Glen Boyd following the resurgence of a serial killer whose crimes match an unsolved case he investigated 5 years previously.

movie:tt0052749.name: Don't Give Up the Ship
movie:tt0052749.description: The Navy expects a veteran to pay for the ship he commanded, as they have no record of its return.

movie:tt1839642.name: The Face of Love
movie:tt1839642.description: A widow falls for a guy who bears a striking resemblance to her late husband.

movie:tt28117354.name: Tropicana
movie:tt28117354.description: A lonely middle-aged woman divides her time between her monotonous job at the supermarket and taking care of her disabled mother and estranged family members. The mysterious murder of the head cashier at the supermarket, sends her on a journey into the depths of her repressed desire revealing her deep longing for warmth and human connection.

movie:tt20204886.name: Kangaroo
movie:tt20204886.description: Ex TV personality, Chris Masterman, becomes stranded in an Outback town outside Alice Springs. There, he teams up with 12-year-old Indigenous girl Charlie. The pair form an unlikely friendship and work together to rescue and rehabilitate orphaned joeys in the remote but stunning Outback community—an endeavour that proves to be life-changing for them both.

movie:tt0108045.name: Save Me
movie:tt0108045.description: An accountant beleaguered by personal and professional problems gets involved with a femme fatale and her mysterious psychiatrist.

movie:tt0034012.name: Penny Serenade
movie:tt0034012.description: A couple's big dreams give way to a life full of unforeseen sadness and unexpected joy.

movie:tt32055882.name: Burner
movie:tt32055882.description: Ex-con single mom Kiki rebuilds her life and regains custody of her teen daughter, until her violent drug-dealer ex returns. To protect herself and her daughter, she must eliminate him without getting caught.

movie:tt10661180.name: The Last Shift
movie:tt10661180.description: Stanley's last shift at his fast food job takes an unexpected turn when he befriends a young African-American work employee.

movie:tt0025862.name: Tarzan and His Mate
movie:tt0025862.description: The idyllic life of Tarzan and Jane is challenged by men on safari who come seeking ivory, and come seeking Jane as well.

movie:tt0060232.name: The Chase
movie:tt0060232.description: The citizens of a small Texas town become worried and panicked when a local bad boy escapes prison and heads for his hometown.

movie:tt13165898.name: Ballistic
movie:tt13165898.description: A mother who works for an ammunition manufacturing company finds out she made the bullet that killed her son.

movie:tt12209830.name: Last Ride
movie:tt12209830.description: In the winter of 1982, three American boys find themselves stranded in a cable car with a dead body, suspended midair in the mountains of Norway during a rare celestial event.

movie:tt0412523.name: Boa vs. Python
movie:tt0412523.description: After a genetically-altered python escapes, a scientist is enlisted to help kill it by releasing a giant boa constrictor that he owns.

movie:tt33336813.name: The Flamenco Guitar of Yerai Cortés
movie:tt33336813.description: A thoughtful exploration of gypsy culture, an intimate portrait of flamenco guitar player Yerai Cortés and a healing family exorcism through music. Antón Álvarez (aka C. Tangana) makes his filmmaking debut with this documentary.

movie:tt37506041.name: Predator: Wastelands
movie:tt37506041.description: When an alien hunter arrives on Earth, it takes down a gang of warlords and unexpectedly becomes a folk hero to the oppressed locals. Now, with their support, the alien sets its sights on the warlords' ruthless leader.

movie:tt15430628.name: Ride On
movie:tt15430628.description: A washed-up stuntman and his stunt horse become an overnight social media sensation when their real-life fight with debt collectors goes viral.

movie:tt0108171.name: Sniper
movie:tt0108171.description: A veteran US Marine sniper is partnered with a rookie sniper as his spotter to take out a politician and a rebel leader in the jungles of Panama.

movie:tt40224422.name: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill

The plot thickens as the unique tiara that belonged to the Queen of Great Britain and that Anastasia has to wear in the fourth act, is stolen from the dressing room. Without the tiara, the show cannot go on, so Margot and Samson have to save the day to the sounds of the great Georges Bizet.

movie:tt0323298.name: The Mother
movie:tt0323298.description: A woman has a passionate affair with a man half her age, who is also sleeping with her daughter.

movie:tt5457454.name: Robert and the Toymaker
movie:tt5457454.description: In Germany, 1941, the Nazis pursue a Toymaker who has acquired a mystical book which gives life to inanimate objects.

movie:tt6254796.name: Ari Shaffir: Double Negative
movie:tt6254796.description: Comedian Ari Shaffir steps outside of his yamaka to expose the uncomfortable truth that children are trash, and becoming an adult also brings about its own greasy problems.

movie:tt0087072.name: Comfort and Joy

movie:tt27674706.name: Oscar Shaw

movie:tt15547806.name: Finnick

movie:tt7710486.name: Sympathy for the Devil

movie:tt0070460.name: Day for Night

movie:tt0051390.name: Cairo Station
movie:tt0051390.description: A newspaper salesman at the train station in Cairo develops an unhealthy obsession with a woman who sells refreshments.

movie:tt14672882.name: The Tomorrow Job

movie:tt0398033.name: Throttle
movie:tt0398033.description: Every day, millions of people descend into underground parking garages, get into their cars and drive to the safety of their homes. But tonight, five levels down in a deserted corporate parking structure, financial analyst Tom Wea...

movie:tt0138749.name: The Road to El Dorado
movie:tt0138749.description: Two swindlers get their hands on a map to the fabled city of gold, El Dorado.

movie:tt0857265.name: Sleuth
movie:tt0857265.description: On his sprawling country estate, an aging writer matches wits with the struggling actor who has stolen his wife's heart.

movie:tt6462750.name: Glass Garden
movie:tt6462750.description: Despite her disabled leg, Ph.D. student Jae-yeon is a brilliant researcher with a rare ability to communicate with nature. Having been hurt by her hypocrite colleague and lover, she turns her back on the world and goes deep into t...

movie:tt35521365.name: Strange Journey: The Story of Rocky Horror
movie:tt35521365.description: A wild journey into the origins of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, the biggest cult film of all time, its impact on popular culture and socio-political resonance to this day.

movie:tt0118632.name: The Apostle

movie:tt39765131.name: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
movie:tt39765131.description: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.

movie:tt0193560.name: Texas Rangers
movie:tt0193560.description: A ragtag group of youngsters band together after the American Civil War to form the Texas Rangers, a group charged with the dangerous, ruthless duty of cleaning up the West.

movie:tt0200550.name: Coyote Ugly
movie:tt0200550.description: Aspiring songwriter Violet Sanford, after getting a job at a women-run NYC bar that teases its male patrons, comes out of her shell.

movie:tt0758746.name: Friday the 13th

movie:tt1622979.name: Final Destination 5
movie:tt1622979.description: Death returns to claim the lucky survivors of a deadly bridge collapse in this fifth frightening installment in the series.

movie:tt0293815.name: Friday After Next
movie:tt0293815.description: Working as security guards, Craig and Day-Day run into the thief who stole their Christmas presents.

movie:tt1144884.name: The Final Destination
movie:tt1144884.description: A horrifying premonition saves a young man and his friends from death during a racetrack accident but terrible fates await them nonetheless.

movie:tt0112679.name: Circle of Friends
movie:tt0112679.description: Three women, who've been friends since childhood, meet at university in Dublin in 1957. Student and boyfriend life begins.

movie:tt28500290.name: Grizzly Night
movie:tt28500290.description: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: On the same night, nine miles apart, there were not one-but two-fatal grizzly bear attacks.

movie:tt0057261.name: Lord of the Flies

movie:tt6041048.description: Two former childhood sweethearts are forced to work side-by-side on a vineyard during a legal dispute.

movie:tt0245479.name: Just a Kiss
movie:tt0245479.description: A group of thirtysomethings having problems with fidelity gets an opportunity to turn back the clock.

movie:tt4290974.name: Taking Earth
movie:tt4290974.description: The human race is thrown into chaos as an alien invasion takes control of the planet in an effort to find one boy out of 7 billion people who holds the power to destroy them.

movie:tt6343988.name: Mommy's Secret
movie:tt6343988.description: When a teenage girl discovers her own mother is behind the recent rash of nearby bank robberies, she's determined to help her come clean.

As she battles a surreal descent into darkness, her sleepwalking episodes intensify. Plagued by haunting visions of her husband inside their home, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.

movie:tt0097481.name: Harlem Nights
movie:tt0097481.description: During the 1930s, a New York City illegal gambling house owner and his associates must deal with strong competition, gangsters, and corrupt cops in order to stay in business.

movie:tt0404978.name: Gambit

movie:tt0075932.name: The Lacemaker
movie:tt0075932.description: A reserved young woman moves into an apartment with a young student she met while on vacation.

movie:tt0478165.name: The Butcher
movie:tt0478165.description: A tragic car accident in the middle of nowhere finds six stranded college students fighting for their lives after making a horrifying discovery in a remote farmhouse in this rural frightener.

movie:tt2802136.name: Home Sweet Hell
movie:tt2802136.description: Don Champagne seems to have it all, but when his wife Mona learns of his affair with a pretty new salesgirl, she will stop at nothing to maintain their storybook life.

movie:tt2295196.name: Hunting Elephants
movie:tt2295196.description: In Jerusalem, a bullied teen befriends his grandfather and long lost uncle and soon they decide to solve their financial problems by robbing a bank.

movie:tt21422618.name: Bisons
movie:tt21422618.description: “Respect for the vanquished”, remarks Steve “is what separates man from beast.” As a champion in Swiss-style wrestling, Steve knows a thing or two about observing codes of combat. But when his family farm faces repossession, he is forced to join hands with his ex-convict brother Joel and enter the lucrative, clandestine world of no-rules fighting.

movie:tt0086072.name: Master of the World
movie:tt0086072.description: Primitive humans had to adapt to their brutal and savage environment or disappear into oblivion. For Bog, a great warrior, this struggle means conquering the land and gaining supremacy over his rivals.

movie:tt27722491.name: Striking The Palace
movie:tt27722491.description: Eva, 20, joins Safietou, Djaoua, Violette and Simone, a team of chambermaids at one of Paris’s finest Palace Hotels. She discovers the poor working conditions of these invisible women, who work tirelessly to keep the high standards of these luxurious hotels, where one night can cost their annual salary. Many are not even employed by the hotels directly but by sub-contractors, and are therefore particularly vulnerable. While on strike to fight against subcontracting and to obtain better working conditions, they come up with a colorful idea : having their own “Fashion Week” in front of the hotel!

movie:tt30836081.name: She Looks Like Me
movie:tt30836081.description: A legless girl abandoned at birth is adopted and becomes an acclaimed gymnast. She idolizes Olympic champion Dominique Moceanu, not knowing Dominique is actually her biological sister.

movie:tt28245146.name: Hearts Under the Olive Tree

movie:tt28336131.name: Elyas
movie:tt28336131.description: A former Special Forces soldier who has become solitary and paranoid since serving Afghanistan and recruited to provide the security for Amina and her daughter Nour.

movie:tt0118804.name: The Butcher Boy

movie:tt28637027.name: Into the Deep

movie:tt0361467.name: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
movie:tt0361467.description: A teenage girl is convinced that her home city revolves around her until her family packs up and moves to the suburbs, where she finds herself competing for attention.

movie:tt1699225.name: Beyond the Blackboard
movie:tt1699225.description: A 24-year-old first-time teacher overcomes her initial fears and prejudices and makes a difference in the lives of the homeless children she teaches in a shelter's makeshift classroom.

movie:tt12598606.name: Gunner
movie:tt12598606.description: Lee Gunner tries to save his sons, Luke and Travis, from a dangerous drug gang.

movie:tt0092843.name: The Dead

movie:tt0313680.name: Tarzan & Jane
movie:tt0313680.description: After being married an entire year, Jane thinks back on some of her and Tarzan's adventures as she searches for something special to mark the occasion with.

movie:tt1300853.name: Green Street Hooligans 2

movie:tt1975159.name: Flight 7500

movie:tt27218960.name: Y2K

movie:tt11433906.description: Winner is a brilliant young misfit from Texas who finds her morals challenged while serving in the U.S. Air Force and working as an NSA contractor.

movie:tt5534434.name: Victor Crowley
movie:tt5534434.description: Ten years after the events of the original movie, Victor Crowley is mistakenly resurrected and proceeds to kill once more.

movie:tt0758789.name: Tsunami: The Aftermath
movie:tt0758789.description: Inspired by true accounts, this HBO miniseries focuses on a group of fictional characters caught up in the harrowing aftermath of the tsunami that devastated the coast of Thailand in 2004.

movie:tt1411664.name: Bucky Larson: Born to Be a Star
movie:tt1411664.description: A kid from the Midwest moves out to Hollywood in order to follow in his parents footsteps, and become a porn star.

movie:tt0146063.name: The Princess and the Pea
movie:tt0146063.description: It is loosely based on Hans Christian Anderson's classic fairy tale. Because the evil prince Laird did not inherit the crown of Corazion, he sought his revenge by secretly switching his newborn daughter with that of his brother's,...

movie:tt36589671.description: ​In a ruthless underground tournament, the world's top assassins fight to the death. But hidden among them is a rogue crew with its own deadly agenda: infiltrate the competition, survive the bloodbath, and take down the mastermind pulling the strings.

movie:tt0089461.name: The Last Dragon

movie:tt16160708.name: Nikki Glaser: Good Clean Filth
movie:tt16160708.description: Nikki Glaser dishes about sex, dating do's and don't's, and private parts in her first HBO comedy special. It's sex ed like you've never seen it before.

movie:tt27977862.name: Last Days
movie:tt27977862.description: A 26-year-old missionary journeys to the remote North Sentinel Island, determined to convert an isolated tribe, while authorities attempt to intervene before potential harm occurs.

movie:tt0102485.name: A Murder of Quality
movie:tt0102485.description: Taken from the book by John le Carré, George Smiley rallies to the aid of his former intelligence colleague, Ailsa Brimley, to investigate a mysterious letter from a junior master's wife at Carne School, a boy's school. When Smile...

movie:tt2557256.name: Iceman

movie:tt15451150.name: You Can't Run Forever
movie:tt15451150.description: A teenage girl suffering from anxiety due to a tragic event from her past finds herself hunted through the woods by a sociopath on a murderous rampage.

movie:tt4034208.description: A teenager who went missing and was presumed dead returns home after eight years to find a family deeply affected by his disappearance. Gradually, doubts arise about whether he really is the missing boy or an impostor.

movie:tt37437810.name: Brown Bread
movie:tt37437810.description: After years in New York, Áine returns to rural Ireland for her godmother’s memorial, confronting buried family tensions and unexpressed grief in her childhood home.

movie:tt34966032.name: Gladiator Underground
movie:tt34966032.description: Two brothers compete in the world's deadliest underground fighting tournament, where they must decide whether to play by the rules or to cast their honor aside and team up to bring down the dark syndicate running the tournament.

movie:tt20420538.name: All the Names of God

movie:tt31042115.description: An urgent, timely and compelling portrait of Hollywood icon Greta Garbo, whose fame, isolation and loneliness still captures us.

movie:tt37249795.name: Mr. & Mrs. Aslan
movie:tt37249795.description: Luna Aslan (Yolanthe Cabau) is an undercover agent who, with the help of her colleague Niels (Thijs Boermans), arrests top criminal Baris (Murda) after a blood-curdling mission. At home, however, Luna has to deal with an even bigger challenge: her husband Emre (Sinan Eroglu). He knows nothing about her double life, but is beginning to notice her secretive behavior. Thanks to his conniving cousin Ferhat (Nesim El Ahmadi), Emre becomes convinced that Luna is cheating. When misunderstandings pile up and it turns out that Baris is targeting both Luna and Emre, Mr. and Mrs. Aslan pull out all the stops to save their lives and marriage.

movie:tt0234516.name: The President's Man
movie:tt0234516.description: A U.S. president's highly classified secret agent must find a fearless replacement to take over his extremely dangerous military missions.

movie:tt1091751.name: The Longshots
movie:tt1091751.description: The true story of Jasmine Plummer who, at the age of eleven, became the first female to play in Pop Warner football tournament in its 56-year history.

movie:tt0118928.name: Dante's Peak

movie:tt10515988.name: Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin
movie:tt10515988.description: Margot, a young woman who was abandoned by her mother as a baby, travels to a secluded Amish community with a documentary film crew seeking answers about her mother and extended family.

movie:tt0090037.name: Smooth Talk

movie:tt0079258.name: Bubble Bath
movie:tt0079258.description: Zsolt Mohai, an eccentric shop window decorator in his 40s, drops by Anna Parádi on his wedding day, asking her to phone his bride Klára Horváth and call off the event. Drama, discussions and musical numbers ensue over topics like romance, loyalty, ambition, and settling for a family life in a modern day city.

movie:tt0073697.name: 'Sheba, Baby'

movie:tt0068282.name: Black Mama White Mama

movie:tt31520900.name: Out of the Nest
movie:tt31520900.description: Teenage delivery boy Arthur the Goat wants nothing more than to be Castilia's greatest barber. When the royal fledglings are taken, it falls to Arthur to rescue them and save the kingdom, but first he must discover his own past.

movie:tt19800112.name: Leave No Trace
movie:tt19800112.description: The Boy Scouts Of America reached a $2.7 billion agreement over sex abuse claims, the largest such settlement in history.

movie:tt0069956.name: Sacrifice!
movie:tt0069956.description: In Thailand, a photographer is initiated into a primitive tribe after the chief's daughter falls in love with him, and must help them face modern dangers and a rival clan of cannibals.

movie:tt0050997.name: The Crucible
movie:tt0050997.description: Salem 1692. The young Abigail, seduced and abandoned by John Proctor, accuses John's wife of being a witch in revenge. It will be the beginning of a series of witchcraft trials and a dark moment in American history.

movie:tt0120595.name: Babe: Pig in the City
movie:tt0120595.description: Babe, fresh from his victory in the sheepherding contest, returns to Farmer Hoggett's farm, but after Farmer Hoggett is injured and unable to work, Babe has to go to the big city to save the farm.

movie:tt0089489.name: Lifeforce
movie:tt0089489.description: A race of space vampires arrives in London and infects the populace, beginning an apocalyptic descent into chaos.

movie:tt31727191.name: Preparation for the Next Life
movie:tt31727191.description: Aishe, a Uyghur woman trained by her military father, migrates to New York City where she finds herself laboring in Chinatown’s underground kitchens. She fatefully encounters Skinner, a young American soldier who has just returned from three tours in the Middle East. While falling in love, they discover the possibility of a better life together than the ones they believed they were destined to live alone.

movie:tt0105690.name: Under Siege
movie:tt0105690.description: Former Navy SEAL, Casey Ryback, is the only person capable of stopping a group of terrorists led by a rogue former CIA agent who seize the USS Missouri, a U.S. Navy battleship, in an attempt to steal its nuclear arsenal.

movie:tt28485522.name: My Freaky Family
movie:tt28485522.description: On the cusp of her 13th birthday, Betty Flood – budding musician and magical being – just wants to be like the rest of her fabulous, but very different family, so why is her magical Mum so against it? As Betty wrestles with this, she also learns the amazing truth about her family and discovers that the not so normal, the magical and the musical are all a part of her fabulously freaky family. It's very freaky, so be freaked freaky ahh deaky peaky neaky seaky peaky poo.

movie:tt0120604.name: Beowulf

movie:tt0056541.name: Sweet Bird of Youth

movie:tt0417148.name: Snakes on a Plane

movie:tt29713815.name: Pose
movie:tt29713815.description: Two couples arrive at countryside mansion they unknowingly double booked. There are strange occurrences during their stay.

movie:tt0091828.name: Raw Deal

movie:tt0183056.name: Esther Kahn

In February 2022 Russia invades Ukraine. In early March, using the cover of a documentary film festival, Muratov secretly negotiates free passage for forty journalists with the Latvian government. Then he returns to Moscow to look after his paper and its remaining staff.  To this day, he refuses to leave Moscow, whatever the pressure on him and his team. "Putin stands for death. I stand for life."

movie:tt0279830.name: Garfield in Disguise

As winter deepens, Soo-Ha and the artist form an unspoken connection through food and art.

movie:tt30150917.name: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths - Part Three

As their 10-year friendship anniversary nears, this extraordinary true story showcases the power of personal connection between two ordinary people-one American and one Chinese-who look beyond political tensions to form a profound bond.

movie:tt26060006.name: The Good Teacher

movie:tt0061369.description: Asterix, the most cunning warrior of a village resisting the Roman occupation of Gaul, must save their magic potion-brewing druid when he is kidnapped by an ambitious Centurion.

movie:tt0497116.name: An Inconvenient Truth
movie:tt0497116.description: Filmmaker Davis Guggenheim follows Al Gore on the lecture circuit, as the former presidential candidate campaigns to raise public awareness of the dangers of global warming and calls for immediate action to curb its destructive ef...

movie:tt9048840.name: Charm City Kings

movie:tt32352172.name: A Sudden Case of Christmas

movie:tt26656556.name: Niki
movie:tt26656556.description: French-American artist Niki de Saint-Phalle, from the age of 23, is a model and an aspiring actor who is married and has a two year old daughter. Together, they flee the U.S. during the oppressive McCarthy era and come to France, where they experience a short-lived euphoria. Soon, distant and frightening memories begin to emerge in Niki’s mind. Her vocation as an artist will be her salvation.

movie:tt30325268.name: Three Friends
movie:tt30325268.description: Joan is no longer in love with Victor, but it pains her to feel she is being dishonest with him. Alice, her best friend, reassures her: She herself doesn’t feel passionate about her partner Eric and yet their relationship is smooth sailing. She has no idea he is having an affair with Rebecca, their mutual friend. When Joan finally decides to leave Victor and he disappears, the lives of the three friends and their relationships are turned upside down.

movie:tt37673029.name: Revealed: Surviving Malka Leifer
movie:tt37673029.description: In 2008, allegations emerged that Malka Leifer, the headmistress of the girls' campus of an ultra-Orthodox Jewish school in Melbourne's inner south-east, had committed grievous crimes against three young students under her care, sisters Dassi Erlich, Nicole Meyer and Elly Sapper. It was the catalyst for a reckoning; but before police investigations could get underway, Leifer fled overseas under the cloak of darkness with the assistance of the school. Thus began an extradition battle that would last for the better part of a decade, and a broader quest for justice that revealed a web of international intrigue, legal loopholes and political corruption as well as a deeper culture of silence around sexual abuse.

movie:tt0044409.name: Beauties of the Night

movie:tt1623008.name: The Arbor
movie:tt1623008.description: Portrayal of the late Bradford playwright Andrea Dunbar.

movie:tt34622936.name: Secrets of the Spy Whale
movie:tt34622936.description: In April 2019, a seemingly tame beluga whale approaches a Norwegian fishing boat seeking help. It is wearing a harness fitted with a camera mount. When the words 'Equipment St Petersburg' are discovered printed on the buckle, speculation breaks out that he has been engaged in some kind of sinister undercover activity.  This documentary explores the mystery of the strange whale and asks where he came from, who trained him and why, and what he was doing in a critically important part of the Arctic, close to Russian waters. With exclusive interviews and access to unseen footage, the film explores the secret world of marine mammal training and international espionage, and sheds new light on the true identity of Hvaldimir, the 'Spy Whale'.

movie:tt0469897.name: Diggers

movie:tt0367854.name: The Hollow

movie:tt0052311.name: Touch of Evil

This film is a tribute to legendary singer, Stelios Kazantzidis, whose voice touched the hearts of all Greeks around the world. A film for those who loved him and those who wish to discover him.

All three are coming to terms with the recent death of Sophia’s mother in very different ways.

movie:tt0435665.name: House of the Dead 2

movie:tt0317676.name: House of the Dead

movie:tt1412528.name: Table 19

movie:tt37359791.name: Before Your Father Finds Us
movie:tt37359791.description: Sophia and baby daughter, Emily, are forced to go into witness protection after she has to testify against her ex-husband Mason for his crimes. After years of living a seemingly normal life with new friends and relationships, Sophia learns that Mason has escaped from his maximum security prison. Knowing his strength and connections, Sophia is forced to reveal the truth to her now teenage daughter about who her father really is – and having to leave everything behind. Escaping to an old remote cabin in the woods together, Sophia and Emily must do everything it takes to survive Mason and his ruthless intent to make the family whole again.

movie:tt35669717.name: High Ground

movie:tt28090401.name: Family Therapy

With the arrival of 25-year-old Julian in their home, their lives are turned upside down and their dysfunctional relationships are revealed. Redemption through humour explores the theme of emotionally drained elites and places it in the context of contemporary social issues.

movie:tt31456973.name: Alarum

movie:tt18076284.description: A group of young travellers discover their dream vacation has turned into a nightmare when an infestation of top-secret deadly spiders escapes mid-flight. When the pilots are killed by the aggressive arachnids, the group must fend for themselves against the relentless swarm and their monstrous "mother" spider, measuring a massive 5 feet.

movie:tt28319139.name: Wild Diamond
movie:tt28319139.description: Liane, 19 years old, daring and fiery, lives with her mother and little sister under the dusty sun of Fréjus in the South of France. Obsessed with beauty and the need to become “someone”, she sees reality TV as her opportunity to be loved... Fate smiles upon her when she auditions for “Miracle Island”.

movie:tt3569978.name: Next to Her
movie:tt3569978.description: Rachel, 27, is raising her mentally challenged sister Gabby, 24, all by herself. When the social worker finds out she leaves her sister alone in the house while at work, she is forced to place her in a day-care center. For the first time in her life she shares the upbringing of her dear sister with someone else, her daily routine collapses and the huge void, left by her sister's absence, makes room for a man in Rachel's life. That man, Zohar, tears another crack in the symbiotic relationship of the two sisters. Rachel hangs on to his love as if it was a life belt. But her inability to lead a normal, intimate and emotional relationship with anyone but her sister, forces them into a twisted threesome, where boundaries between love, sacrifice, nurturing and torturing - are broken.

movie:tt22002058.name: All the Lost Ones
movie:tt22002058.description: A future civil war is sparked by government-imposed measures due to climate change. Nia, her sister Penny, and her boyfriend Ethan are hiding out when a militia leader and his followers arrive on their doorstep.

movie:tt26597953.name: The Successor
movie:tt26597953.description: Follows a newly-announced artistic director of a famous fashion house, who after getting his expectations high, starts experiencing chest pain and discovers that he may have inherited much worse than his estranged father's weak he...

movie:tt19894774.name: The Braid
movie:tt19894774.description: Three women, Smita, Giulia and Sarah, are from different parts of the world and have never met, but are bound by something intimate and unique.

movie:tt13968482.name: Walking with the Tall Whites
movie:tt13968482.description: A look at the life of Charles J. Hall who claims to have worked with Tall White Aliens in Nevada

movie:tt15768848.name: The Pod Generation
movie:tt15768848.description: In a not-so-distant future, tech giant Pegazus offers couples the opportunity to share their pregnancies via detachable artificial wombs or pods. And so begins Rachel and Alvy's wild ride to parenthood in this brave new world.

movie:tt30402052.name: La petite vadrouille
movie:tt30402052.description: Justine, her husband and their gang of friends come up with a solution to their money problems: organize a fake romantic cruise for Franck, a major investor, who is looking to seduce a woman.

movie:tt30442596.name: N'avoue jamais
movie:tt30442596.description: A former French general married for 50 years learns that his wife cheated on him 4 decades ago. He is resolved to avenge his honor and, surrounded by his wife and their 3 children, he goes hunting for the culprit on the Côte-d'Azur.

movie:tt34965984.name: Enigma
movie:tt34965984.description: Two legends contested their identities as women in the court of public opinion: April Ashley, who was immortalized as a trailblazer by embracing her transgender history; and Amanda Lear, who has consciously denied and obfuscated her history for decades. Their divergent paths reveal disparate but intertwined legacies.

movie:tt0469111.name: I'll Always Know What You Did Last Summer
movie:tt0469111.description: A group of teenagers in Colorado find themselves being stalked and killed one by one by a mysterious figure with a hook, exactly one year after they covered up a friend's accidental death.

movie:tt21478426.name: Life After Fighting
movie:tt21478426.description: A martial arts instructor is confronted with the disappearance of two of his students, leading him into a direct confrontation with a group of international child traffickers.

movie:tt29293152.name: Here Now
movie:tt29293152.description: Sophie is a twenty-year-old American who has lived her life in isolation, cut off from the world. While on vacation in Palermo with her sister, she meets Giulio and his group of Sicilian friends during her final 24 hours before returning to California. Eager to break free from her sheltered past, Sophie embarks on a whirlwind romance with Giulio.

movie:tt0066601.name: Zabriskie Point
movie:tt0066601.description: At a time of chronic civil unrest in late 1960s America, a young revolutionary suspected of murder steals a plane and meets a girl.

movie:tt22695080.name: Encanto at the Hollywood Bowl
movie:tt22695080.description: A musical celebrating the world, characters, and songs of Disney Animation's "Encanto."

movie:tt9320170.name: The Beautiful Summer
movie:tt9320170.description: Ginia, seventeen, experiences the ecstasy and turmoil that characterize the mysterious journey into adulthood. Meeting with Amelia confronts her with new and shocking emotions. But only by recognizing this love, she can be herself.

movie:tt15791144.name: Last County
movie:tt15791144.description: An alcoholic woman with a marriage on the rocks finds an unlikely ally in a wounded drug mule when the two of them are forced to defend her home from a violent siege of corrupt small town cops.

movie:tt10887344.name: Blade: The Iron Cross
movie:tt10887344.description: In 1945 a psychic war journalist gains a telekinetic link to a murderous puppet and uses its help to sabotage a top secret Nazi experiment that involves using a Death Ray to transform people into zombies.

movie:tt10580188.name: Guardians of Time
movie:tt10580188.description: Four cousins discover a secret passage in their family mansion leading to Keoherus, a mysterious realm. Trapped in this strange land, they face the Time Guardian, dark forces, and fearsome beasts while searching for a way back home.

movie:tt18073066.name: Leave
movie:tt18073066.description: A young woman tries to find her origins after having been abandoned as an infant at a cemetery wrapped in a cloth with satanic symbols, but as she gets closer to answers a malevolent spirit is telling her to leave.

movie:tt16025158.name: Take My Hand
movie:tt16025158.description: At the peak of her career in London, an Australian woman is diagnosed with MS. After losing her job and the death of her husband, she moves home with her three sons, where a chance encounter with a childhood sweetheart changes her...

movie:tt16311464.name: Silver Haze
movie:tt16311464.description: Fifteen years after she got burnt when the pub where she slept as a child caught fire, Franky (23) seeks revenge because she still hasn't found any answers.

movie:tt0164184.name: The Sum of All Fears
movie:tt0164184.description: CIA analyst Jack Ryan must stop the plans of a Neo-Nazi faction that threatens to incite a catastrophic conflict between the United States and Russia by detonating a nuclear weapon at a football game in Baltimore, Maryland.

movie:tt1659324.name: Depravity
movie:tt1659324.description: A group of tenants, suspecting that their neighbor could be is a serial killer, stumble upon an art heist worth millions.

movie:tt32150607.name: I'm Your Venus
movie:tt32150607.description: A documentary following the unsolved murder of Venus Xtravaganza, star of the legendary film "Paris Is Burning," as Venus' two families — biological and ballroom — come together to seek answers and celebrate her legacy.

movie:tt0033253.name: The Westerner
movie:tt0033253.description: Judge Roy Bean, a self-appointed hanging judge in Vinegarroon, Texas, befriends saddle tramp Cole Harden, who opposes Bean's policy against homesteaders.

movie:tt0306685.name: Cradle 2 the Grave
movie:tt0306685.description: A jewel thief's daughter is kidnapped after he steals a collection of prized black diamonds, which aren't at all what they seem.

movie:tt0470761.name: First Born
movie:tt0470761.description: A pregnant couple buys a mansion and moves out of NYC. Strange things start happening to the C-sectioned, anxious, new mom.

movie:tt0064356.name: The Cow
movie:tt0064356.description: An old villager deeply in love with his cow goes to the capital for a while. While he's there, the cow dies and now the villagers are afraid of his possible reaction to it when he returns.

movie:tt0091982.name: The Loner
movie:tt0091982.description: A cop is looking for the killer of his friend.

movie:tt0382602.name: Charlie Brown's Christmas Tales
movie:tt0382602.description: The Peanuts gang have more misadventures at Christmas time.

movie:tt8316840.name: The Triangle
movie:tt8316840.description: Time Travel Action/Adventure that will change the history of the world forever.

movie:tt21810682.name: The End We Start From
movie:tt21810682.description: A woman tries to find her way home with her newborn while an environmental crisis submerges London in floodwaters.

movie:tt12972134.name: Hounds of War
movie:tt12972134.description: After a mission goes wrong, only one of a group of mercenaries is left alive to take revenge for his brothers.

movie:tt0087291.name: Frankenweenie
movie:tt0087291.description: A young boy sets out to revive his dead pet using the monstrous power of science.

movie:tt27759716.name: Cassino in Ischia
movie:tt27759716.description: The next generation of action heroes push Nic Cassino off his perch. He goes to Italy to work with struggling Italian directors on the first-ever "Neo-Realist" action movie in an effort to revitalize his career.

movie:tt0060437.name: Funeral in Berlin
movie:tt0060437.description: Sent to East Berlin to retrieve a Communist defector, British spy Harry Palmer suspects the situation is not what his superiors believe it to be.

movie:tt0499375.name: Guru
movie:tt0499375.description: A villager, Gurukant Desai, arrives in Bombay 1958, and rises from its streets to become the GURU, the biggest tycoon in Indian history.

movie:tt0099697.name: Graveyard Shift
movie:tt0099697.description: In a very old textile mill with a serious rat infestation, deadly accidents start happening, but the corrupt foreman continues to put his workers in danger, until they discover a horrifying secret deep in the basement.

movie:tt0791304.name: Georgia Rule
movie:tt0791304.description: A troubled young woman is sent to live with her grandmother for the summer, while hiding a secret that could potentially tear her family apart.

movie:tt0772168.name: Grace Is Gone
movie:tt0772168.description: Upon hearing his wife was killed in the Iraq war, a father takes his two daughters on a road trip.

movie:tt0097289.name: Erik the Viking
movie:tt0097289.description: Erik the Viking and his men travel across the sea to find Valhalla to ask the gods to end the Age of Ragnarok.

movie:tt0475286.name: Graduation
movie:tt0475286.description: Four best friends plot to rob a bank during their high school graduation ceremony in order to help out one of the teen's sick relatives.

movie:tt0198545.name: Horton Hears a Who!
movie:tt0198545.description: In this story, Horton discovers there is a microscopic community of intelligent beings called the Who's living on a plant that only he can hear. Recognising the dangers they face, he resolves to keep them safe. However, the other animals around him think Horton has gone crazy thinking that there are such beings.

movie:tt0362004.name: Palindromes
movie:tt0362004.description: Aviva is thirteen, awkward and sensitive. Her mother Joyce is warm and loving, as is her father, Steve, a regular guy who does have a fierce temper from time to time. The film revolves around her family, friends and neighbors.

movie:tt29567635.name: A King Like Me
movie:tt29567635.description: Follows members of the Zulu Club, New Orleans’ first Black Mardi Gras, as they work to bring the Zulu parade back to the streets for Mardi Gras Day 2022, in the face of a global pandemic, hurricane Ida and the loss of members due to COVID and gun violence.

movie:tt22874848.name: The Silent Hour
movie:tt22874848.description: A detective with hearing loss and a deaf witness to a murder must lean on each other to outsmart killers they can't hear coming when cornered in an abandoned apartment block.

movie:tt20255028.name: Uproar
movie:tt20255028.description: A 17 year-old student is forced to get off the fence he has actively sat on all his life to stand up for himself, his whanau (family) and his future in this heartwarming story of identity.

movie:tt7838252.name: K.G.F: Chapter 1
movie:tt7838252.description: In the 1970s, a gangster named Rocky goes undercover as a slave to assassinate the owner of a notorious gold mine known as the Kolar Gold Fields.

movie:tt0395565.name: Gracie's Choice
movie:tt0395565.description: For as long as she can remember, 16 year-old Gracie has been raising her four siblings, each of whom has a different, absent father and their mother is on the fast track to self-destruction. When these children's lives are about to be pulled apart, Gracie will have to do the impossible and make the ultimate sacrifices to keep her family together.

movie:tt4163636.name: Florida
movie:tt4163636.description: Although he's now eighty years old, Claude Lherminier is still as imposing as he ever was. His moments of forgetfulness and confusion are becoming increasingly more frequent, but he stubbornly refuses to admit that anything is wrong.

movie:tt19381382.name: Cocorico
movie:tt19381382.description: The daughter of the Bouvier-Sauvage family of aristocrats is in love with the son of a Peugeot dealer. When the children announce their marriage, the aristocratic family does not agree.

movie:tt0091759.name: Dead Man's Letters

movie:tt21368190.name: Love You Charlie
movie:tt21368190.description: A nerdy director and his crazy crew are filming for a reality show a glittery singer who stays for a week at the house of Charlie, the head of a brutal crime family. Charlie drags them into their dark and deadly world.

movie:tt13234058.name: My Son
movie:tt13234058.description: Edmond Murray searches for answers deep in the Highlands after receiving a frantic call from his ex-wife that their seven-year-old son went missing from a campsite.

movie:tt0287471.name: Late Marriage
movie:tt0287471.description: Zaza is a 31-year old Israeli bachelor, handsome and intelligent, and his family wants to see him married. But tradition dictates that Zaza has to choose a young virgin. She must be beautiful and from a good family, preferably ric...

movie:tt0070698.name: Sisters
movie:tt0070698.description: A small-time reporter tries to convince the police that she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

movie:tt32499895.name: Millers in Marriage
movie:tt32499895.description: A tale of three middle-aged married couples coming to grips with universal questions about marriage and fidelity, professional success and failure, and the challenge of finding a second act.

movie:tt25969960.name: Take a Chance on Me
movie:tt25969960.description: An unlikely friendship forms between a troubled young woman and an uptight court judge.

movie:tt0094921.name: Crossing Delancey
movie:tt0094921.description: A Manhattan single meets a man through her Jewish grandmother's matchmaker.

movie:tt2965408.name: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
movie:tt2965408.description: A 12-year-old boy, separated from his family by a fast-moving storm, must fight to stay alive during his nine-day adventure lost in the backwoods of Maine.

movie:tt0483812.name: Stephanie Daley
movie:tt0483812.description: Pregnant forensic psychologist Lydie Crane is hired to learn the truth behind the case of 16-year-old Stephanie Daley, who is accused of concealing her pregnancy and murdering her infant.

movie:tt23558280.name: Elevation
movie:tt23558280.description: A single father and two women venture from the safety of their homes to face monstrous creatures to save the life of a young boy.

movie:tt30007864.name: The American Society of Magical Negroes
movie:tt30007864.description: A young man is recruited into a secret society of magical black people who dedicate their lives to a cause of utmost importance: making white people's lives easier.

movie:tt32086069.name: Marcello Mio
movie:tt32086069.description: Pressured from all sides by the figure of her father, Chiara Mastroianni decides to bring him back to life through her own self. She goes by the name of Marcello, dresses like him and asks to now be considered an actor, not an actress. The people around her believe this to be a temporary joke, but Chiara is determined not to give up her new identity…

movie:tt27047448.name: Til Death Do Us Part
movie:tt27047448.description: After bailing on her wedding, a former bride-to-be must fight off her ex-groom and seven angry killer groomsmen in order to survive the night.

movie:tt14263818.name: Surviving Ohio State
movie:tt14263818.description: Delves into the sexual abuse scandal surrounding athletics doctor Richard Strauss, whose two-decade tenure at The Ohio State University saw the abuse of hundreds of students, and the ongoing quest for justice and accountability by his survivors.

movie:tt24429218.name: Genie
movie:tt24429218.description: The film is a fairy-tale comedy about a workaholic man who enlists the help of a magical genie to help win his family back before Christmas.

movie:tt20258920.name: Tin Soldier
movie:tt20258920.description: A former agent is recruited by the government for a dangerous mission that will force him to confront a past he would rather forget.

movie:tt28547657.name: The Girl in the Pool
movie:tt28547657.description: A well-to-do family man is forced to struggle through a surprise birthday party moments after hiding the murdered corpse of his mistress.

movie:tt0058206.name: Hole in the Moon
movie:tt0058206.description: A new immigrant, Tzelnik, arrives at the port of Jaffa. He goes to live in the Negev desert where he opens a kiosk in the middle of nowhere. Mizrachi comes along and opens a competing business across the way. The two make a living...

movie:tt5243424.name: Buddymoon
movie:tt5243424.description: When a former child actor is dumped by his fiancé days before the wedding, his excitable German best man takes him on the honeymoon instead: a backcountry trek in the remote mountains of Oregon.

movie:tt0295274.name: Garfield on the Town
movie:tt0295274.description: Garfield escapes from the car on a trip to the vet and finds the place where he grew up.

movie:tt21928528.name: Reawakening
movie:tt21928528.description: A couple whose daughter aged 14 went missing and then reappears after a decade.

movie:tt0119695.name: Money Talks
movie:tt0119695.description: Sought by police and criminals, a small-time hustler makes a deal with a TV newsman for protection.

movie:tt0115683.name: Bio-Dome
movie:tt0115683.description: Moronic best friends get themselves locked inside the Bio-Dome, a science experiment, along with a group of environmental scientists for one year.

movie:tt1063685.name: Bittersweet
movie:tt1063685.description: The sudden arrival and prophecies of a fortune teller unexpectedly throws a wrench into the lives of three couples.

movie:tt0758784.name: Starting Out in the Evening

movie:tt0814331.name: Spring Breakdown

movie:tt1548635.name: Siren
movie:tt1548635.description: Strange goings on ensue, when a few friends on a sailboat find an island with a beautiful lone female inhabitant.

movie:tt21800162.name: There's Still Tomorrow
movie:tt21800162.description: In this moving comedic drama set in postwar Rome, a working-class wife and mother dreams of a better future. Winner of 6 Italian Academy Awards.

movie:tt0491145.name: Shadow Puppets
movie:tt0491145.description: Eight strangers with no memories find themselves trapped in an abandoned facility. As they desperately try to find answers and escape, their own Shadows attempt to consume them from the darkness.

movie:tt0073535.name: The Night Caller
movie:tt0073535.description: Commissaire Letellier and Inspector Moissac are tracking Minos, a serial killer whose victims are women.

movie:tt0834955.name: Someone to Run With
movie:tt0834955.description: Through the streets of Jerusalem two teenagers' stories will unite to tell the summer adventure of their lives. Tamar is an amazingly talented but very quiet and insecure girl, who leaves behind her home and all she knows, changin...

movie:tt0166203.name: Garfield Goes Hollywood
movie:tt0166203.description: Jon, Garfield and Odie audition for the talent show "Pet Search" in hopes of winning the $1000 prize and a chance at the finals in Hollywood.

movie:tt9608818.name: Our Friend
movie:tt9608818.description: After receiving life-altering news, a couple finds unexpected support from their best friend, who puts his own life on hold and moves into their family home, bringing an impact much greater and more profound than anyone could have...

movie:tt0068168.name: Across 110th Street
movie:tt0068168.description: Two New York City cops go after amateur crooks who are trying to rip off the Mafia and start a gang war.

movie:tt2429870.name: Summoned

movie:tt1942961.name: Saving Winston
movie:tt1942961.description: When a troubled teen is forced to leave a self-destructive lifestyle, she discovers an abandoned horse along her journey to redemption. Will temptation from the dark shadows of her past lead her astray or will her newfound love of...

movie:tt0149151.description: Fame, fortune and fornication drove the British rock band in the '70s until a divine end. 20 years later, Strange Fruit reunites and goes on a tour with ups and downs on the continent.

movie:tt0007880.name: Easy Street
movie:tt0007880.description: A reformed tramp becomes a police constable who must fight a huge thug who dominates an inner city street.

movie:tt0052427.name: Tom Thumb
movie:tt0052427.description: A boy (Russ Tamblyn), no bigger than a thumb, manages to outwit two thieves (Terry-Thomas and Peter Sellers) determined to make a fortune from him.

movie:tt0356336.description: Moles threaten to foil a team of secret agents' plan.

movie:tt28999532.description: Over 60 years, three guests of a cursed home discover an eternal witch who lives beneath it with an insatiable thirst for living souls.

movie:tt2479478.name: The Ridiculous 6

movie:tt0068359.name: A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving
