series:tt8619822.description: A group of teenage girls must deal with supernatural fallout stemming from an innocent game of "Light as a Feather, Stiff as a Board" when they start dying off in the exact way predicted.

series:tt0102847.name: 3x3 Eyes
series:tt0102847.description: The story of a young man named Yakumo Fuuji, who through a strange series of events becomes the immortal slave of the last of a race of 3 Eyed immortals. The immortal absorbs his soul to save his life, making him immortal in the process. Now, he begins a journey with the female immortal in an attempt to find a way of becoming human. Of course, there are many complications along the way, not the least of which being that the immortal is a female with a split personality, one achingly cute and the other being no-nonsense destructive power, and the romances that develop between.

series:tt0065327.name: Night Gallery
series:tt0065327.description: Rod Serling presents tales of horror illustrated in various paintings.

series:tt9027772.name: The Birch
series:tt9027772.description: A teenager seeks out the help of a monster who lives in the woods. Based on the short film 'The Birch'.

series:tt7108184.name: Tokyo Vampire Hotel
series:tt7108184.description: Manami suddenly encounters mass murder at a pub on her 22nd birthday as she is hunted down by two warring vampire clans, the Draculas and the Corvins. Manami is a child of prophecy who is meant to help the Draculas overcome their Corvin enemies who have driven them underground. Meanwhile, droves of young men and women are gathered at the Hotel Requiem by a Corvin named Yamada who informs them that the world is about to end, with this hotel being the only refuge.

series:tt0076981.name: The Awakening Land
series:tt0076981.description: A lusty frontier saga about a pioneer woman and her love for her family, the man she marries, and the land on which she lives, dramatized from Conrad Richter's Pulitzer Prize-winning trilogy: 'The Trees;' 'The Fields;' and 'The Town.' The series originally aired on NBC in three installments from February 19 to February 21, 1978 and stars Elizabeth Montgomery and Hal Holbrook.

series:tt0157216.name: Berkeley Square
series:tt0157216.description: Three young women from very different backgrounds meet, become friends and share experiences when they all gain positions as nannies in the wealthy households of London's exclusive Berkeley Square.

series:tt0085077.name: Reilly: Ace of Spies
series:tt0085077.description: Reilly, Ace of Spies is a 1983 television miniseries dramatising the life of Sidney Reilly, a Russian Jew who became one of the greatest spies ever to work for the British. Among his exploits, in the early 20th-century, were the infiltration of the German General Staff in 1917 and a near-overthrow of the Bolsheviks in 1918. His reputation with women was as legendary as his genius for espionage.

series:tt0083387.name: The Blue and the Gray
series:tt0083387.description: America just before and during the Civil War, as seen through the eyes of an artist correspondent.

series:tt3101352.name: 37 Days
series:tt3101352.description: A TV mini-series that unveils the behind-closed-doors story of the final weeks before the outbreak of World War I.

series:tt0118453.name: Rough Riders
series:tt0118453.description: Undersecretary of the Navy Theodore Roosevelt resigns to form a volunteer militia unit called "The Rough Riders" to fight in the Spanish-American War.

series:tt1841462.name: Towards the Republic
series:tt1841462.description: Set in the late 19th century and early 20th century. The Qing Dynasty goes extinct and the Republic of China is born.

series:tt0087244.name: Fatal Vision
series:tt0087244.description: A retiree spends nine years relentlessly seeking to prove that his son-in-law, a former Green Beret Army doctor, murdered his pregnant wife and two daughters.

series:tt1100959.name: The Passion
series:tt1100959.description: Follows Jesus' last days and crucifixion.

series:tt0074072.name: When the Boat Comes In
series:tt0074072.description: Set in Gallowshields on Tyneside between the 2 World Wars, this story follows the life of ex-sergeant Jack Ford and the Seaton family as they deal with the aftermath of the Great War, the Great 1920s Depression and trade union act...

series:tt0835007.name: Diversant 2. Konets voyny
series:tt0835007.description: The Germans are preparing a reconnaissance group of former Soviet prisoners of war, which will be thrown into the Crimea in a false partisan detachment. The task of the heroes is to destroy the group and infiltrate the false squad...

series:tt1162595.name: Dream in Red Mansions
series:tt1162595.description: Dream of the Red Chamber, first released in 1987, was a television series produced by CCTV, adapted from the classic 18th century Chinese novel of the same name. It gained enormous popularity for its music, cast, and plot adaptation, being regarded by many within China as being a near-definitive adaptation of the story.

series:tt0424754.name: The Rose and the Thorn
series:tt0424754.description: Young journalist Feriha faces personal challenges while attempting to depict the violent era of 70s Turkey.

series:tt5515410.name: Making History
series:tt5515410.description: Three friends from two different centuries try to balance the thrill of time travel with the mundane concerns of their present-day lives.

series:tt0194608.name: The Spider
series:tt0194608.description: A reporter is drawn into the dark side of post-war Copenhagen as he attempts to uncover a crime syndicate on an unprecedented level.

series:tt10721998.name: Inés of My Soul
series:tt10721998.description: Inés Suárez, a young, humble woman from Extremadura who sets out for the New World to look for her husband, lost on the other side of the Atlantic along with his dreams of glory. Once there, Inés does not find her husband, but she does find the passionate love of Pedro de Valdivia, Francisco Pizarro's Field Master.

series:tt6424870.name: Ming Dynasty 1566
series:tt6424870.description: During the Ming dynasty, as economic prosperity masked social unrest, the corrupt official Yan Song's oppressive policies spark a power struggle and intrigue within the imperial court.

series:tt4787028.name: The Magnificent Century: Kosem
series:tt4787028.description: Anastasia a young Greek woman in Ahmed I's harem takes on the name 'Kosem' (leader, pioneer). In a world of men, she rules of the Ottoman Empire through her sons and grandson.

series:tt1805647.name: Aoi Bungaku Series
series:tt1805647.description: The story of a man who struggles with relating to humans. The man feels utterly detached from everything that makes one truly human. A truly harrowing portrait of brokenness, made all the more frightening for how relatable it is.

series:tt0118443.name: The Rag Nymph
series:tt0118443.description: It’s 1854 and ten-year-old Millie is taken in by ‘Raggie Aggie’ after her mother dies in a Newcastle brothel. The spirited young Millie is exposed again to the corrupting influences of the streets of Newcastle.

series:tt9050352.name: The Bonfire of Destiny
series:tt9050352.description: After a devastating fire in 1897 Paris, three women find their lives upended by betrayals, deceptions and romantic turmoil. Inspired by real events.

series:tt4855286.name: Os Dez Mandamentos
series:tt4855286.description: The story of Moses from his birth to his death, following the well known story of the Plagues and Commandments and weaving in many other stories of the Hebrews and Egyptians who touched his life.

series:tt11080420.name: The Red River
series:tt11080420.description: May 1895. Our story begins when the family of George Pavlides engages their 12-year-old son, Miltos, with the 9-year-old daughter of Michalis Nikolaidis, Ifigenia. The attacks of fanatical Turks will force the two families to flee their homeland. The two youngsters will meet again in Istanbul 11 years later. Unaware of the family relationship that binds them, they instantly fall in love. The two lovers try to live their love, while being dragged by the whirlwind of historical events of the time.

series:tt3109682.name: Palestinian Alienation
series:tt3109682.description: The first comprehensive dramatic telling of the Palestinian Nakba, seen through the eyes of a poor rural family from the 1930s British Mandate era through the massacres of 1948 and the defeat of 1967. Written by Palestinian poet Walid Seif — based on his own family history — and directed by the late Syrian master Hatem Ali, this is widely considered one of the greatest Arab television dramas ever produced. A monumental work of collective memory, historical witness and human endurance.

series:tt10244612.name: Oktoberfest: Beer and Blood
series:tt10244612.description: A young girl falls in love with a poor brewer's son. Their relationship is opposed by the girl's father, a rich mobster who has come to town to try to bully his way into the inner circle of Munich's brewery dynasties.

series:tt11299488.name: The Promise of Chang’an
series:tt11299488.description: Helan Mingyu, a bright young woman, forms a deep bond with the 9th Prince, Xiao Chengxu. Though they develop mutual feelings, fate intervenes—news of Chengxu’s death on the battlefield forces Mingyu to marry his older brother, King Xiao Chengrui. As Chengxu achieves military victories that strengthen the kingdom, Chengrui grows increasingly jealous. When the truth about Chengxu's mother's death emerges, Chengxu sets out to claim the throne and seek justice.

series:tt0227975.name: The Water Margin
series:tt0227975.description: Nearly a thousand years ago in ancient China, there was a cruel government. 108 renegade will try to change the story.

series:tt4195264.name: Five Brothers
series:tt4195264.description: This is one of the five brothers, not like in the slightest way to another.

series:tt0083500.name: Voyagers!
series:tt0083500.description: A member of a league of time travelers and a boy travel through time repairing errors in world history.

series:tt1018269.name: Conta-me Como Foi
series:tt1018269.description: The life of a family during the last days of the "Estado Novo" (fascist regime installed in Portugal in 1933)

series:tt0096635.name: Life Goes On
series:tt0096635.description: A modern All-American family deals with the struggles of life and love in mid-western suburbia.

series:tt0275849.name: Mad Jack the Pirate
series:tt0275849.description: Series about a luckless pirate and his anthropomorphic rat sidekick, Snuk.

series:tt0281447.name: Big Family
series:tt0281447.description: Sitcom about a dysfunctional but loving average Brazilian family.

series:tt0992966.name: Yedi Numara
series:tt0992966.description: A couple with no kids, four city girls and three country boys, all under the same roof: arguing, fighting and sometimes understanding they are not that much different.

series:tt0075500.name: Eight Is Enough
series:tt0075500.description: This comedy drama focused on a family with eight very independent children.

series:tt1315336.name: Ties of Shooting Stars
series:tt1315336.description: Based on a novel by mystery writer Keigo Higashino, Ryūsei no Kizuna tells the story of three orphans, whose parents were murdered long ago. Together, the three vowed on a shooting star to one day avenge their parents. After many years, the two brothers have found the murderers, and are set to carry out their plan for vengeance when they realize they've made a serious miscalculation; you see, their sister...

series:tt0078714.name: You Can't Do That on Television
series:tt0078714.description: Sketch-TV by young amateur actors in true classic Nick-style. Whatever you do, never ask for water or admit that you don't know.

series:tt0229878.name: Archie's Weird Mysteries
series:tt0229878.description: Based on the comic book series of the same name, Archie Andrews and the gang tackle weird mysteries and write about them in the school newspaper.

series:tt10285320.name: Lego Masters Australia
series:tt10285320.description: Each week, contestants are set tasks to build items out of LEGO in line with a designated theme and are judged on their results. Contestants are then eliminated from the competition on a knock out basis culminating in a winner.

series:tt7278550.name: My Golden Life
series:tt7278550.description: A woman has a chance for success, but falls into a bottomless pit of her life. She looks for ways to find happiness through her circumstance.

series:tt0902735.name: På spåret
series:tt0902735.description: Two teams of Swedish celebrities compete. In the main part of the show the two teams see a video-clip from a train's (usually) point-of-view traveling towards a specific city and the teams guess which city the train is heading to....

series:tt1680044.name: One Step from Heaven
series:tt1680044.description: Pietro, a veteran climber who witnessed his wife's fatal fall while attempting to scale an imposing wall, must face his grief and guilt in order to conquer his fear of the mountain that took her life.

series:tt0199214.name: Faerie Tale Theatre
series:tt0199214.description: A miscellany of numerous classic fairy tales' adaptations.

series:tt0423746.name: Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go!
series:tt0423746.description:
Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go! is an American/Japanese animated television series, and was created by Ciro Nieli, one of the directors of Teen Titans, with animation being done by a Japanese studio known as The Answer Studio. Set mainly on the fictional planet of Shuggazoom, the series follows the adventures of five cyborg monkeys and a human boy named Chiro as they struggle to protect their planet - and the rest of the universe - from the forces of evil.

As is obvious from the visual appearance of the show, there is a significant anime influence present, despite being produced for American television. It was also influenced by Star Trek, Super Sentai, Voltron, and Star Wars. The show also contains various references to pop culture, a notable example being the episode "Season of the Skull", which is a parody of the 1970s thriller The Wicker Man.

series:tt0391683.name: Rubí
series:tt0391683.description: An ambitious woman of humble background and stunning beauty is determined to change her poor situation, using her seductive skills on a millionaire doctor.

series:tt9657792.name: What Did You Eat Yesterday?
series:tt9657792.description: Lawyer Shiro pours his heart into home-cooked meals for his partner, hairstylist Kenji, as they navigate life as a middle-aged gay couple in Tokyo.

series:tt4196686.name: The Kicks
series:tt4196686.description: Devin, a soccer prodigy, relocates to California where her new school's team struggles. Undeterred, she steps up to lead them out of their losing streak, rising to the challenge.

series:tt4226226.name: Holiday Baking Championship
series:tt4226226.description: Eight bakers compete in making delicious and innovative holiday treats for a chance to be named the Holiday Baking Champion and win $50,000.

series:tt0403806.name: De slimste mens ter wereld
series:tt0403806.description: Entertaining and humorous quiz where famous Belgians compete to be "the smartest man on earth"

series:tt0337550.name: Liberty's Kids
series:tt0337550.description: The American Revolutionary War is seen through the eyes of an American teenaged lad, a young English lady, and a French boy, all three of whom work as reporters for Benjamin Franklin.

series:tt7944260.name: Jet Sosyete
series:tt7944260.description: The story of a middle class family that wants to enter the jet set.

series:tt0401933.name: Flinderella
series:tt0401933.description: After she performs with her band for them, a humble young woman becomes part of the lives of five wealthy siblings, and falls for the eldest.

series:tt0218744.name: 100 Deeds for Eddie McDowd
series:tt0218744.description: A bully is transformed into a dog that must perform one hundred good deeds with the help of a shy classmate.

series:tt10038600.name: Press Your Luck
series:tt10038600.description: A game of wits, strategy and high stakes as contestants try to avoid the iconic WHAMMY for a chance at life-changing cash and prizes.

series:tt0377134.name: 15/Love
series:tt0377134.description: "15/Love" is a comedy-drama about coming-of-age in a unique, high-pressure environment. The series follows a group of young hopefuls at the internationally renowned Cascadia Tennis Academy, where they live, love, laugh, fight, cry...

series:tt4412548.name: I'm Home
series:tt4412548.description: Ieji Hisashi, a salaryman who works for a securities company, has a fuzzy memory of the recent five years because of an accident at his job posting. His wife of five years, Megumi and their 4-year-old son seem to wear masks. He can neither tell their facial expressions nor their emotions. He also struggles about his love for them. On the other hand, Ieji feels an attachment to his ex-wife, whom he divorced five years ago, and their daughter. What sort of days did he have in those five years which are a blank to him? Ieji sets out on a journey to find his past self with a mysterious bunch of 10 keys that he has. He becomes aware that he was a cold, career-minded man before the accident, and the persona that is gradually revealed is beyond the imagination of his present kindhearted self.

series:tt0050022.name: The Gumby Show
series:tt0050022.description: The adventures of Gumby, a being made of clay and who can transform into several shapes, without losing his anatomy. He is accompanied by his red pony Pokey.

series:tt0081869.name: Gimme a Break!
series:tt0081869.description: Nell agrees to look after the Kanisky's home, as a special favor to her dying friend, and takes on the role of housekeeper to widowed police chief Carl and a parental figure to his three teenage daughters, and eventually a foster ...

series:tt0125622.name: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids: The TV Show
series:tt0125622.description: Wayne Szalinski is a clumsy genius who comes up with new gadgets and experiments all the time. But something usually goes wrong and gets him and his family into trouble, danger and fantastical adventure.

series:tt0080266.name: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show and Scrappy Too!
series:tt0080266.description: The Richie Rich/Scooby-Doo Show and Scrappy Too! is a package show produced by Hanna-Barbera Productions in 1980 for ABC Saturday mornings. The program contained segments from Scooby-Doo and Scrappy-Doo and Richie Rich. The Scooby-Doo and Scrappy-Doo shorts represents the sixth show in which Scooby-Doo appears. This was the only Hanna-Barbera package series for which Scooby-Doo was given second billing and also notable for Richie Rich's debut in animation.

series:tt0115289.name: The New Adventures of Robin Hood
series:tt0115289.description: Sherwood Forest outlaw Robin Hood and his partners -- Marion Fitzwalter, Little John and Friar Tuck -- use magic, sorcery and courage to fight royal soldiers, evil knights and others who try to oppress the impoverished people of 12th-century England.

series:tt0047763.name: The Phil Silvers Show
series:tt0047763.description: Master Sergeant Bilko, regularly helped by the soldiers at Fort Baxter's motor pool, spends little time performing his duties by constantly trying to obtain money through various get-rich-quick scams and promotions.

series:tt1496198.name: Sidika
series:tt1496198.description: Sidika is the story of Saka family and their young daughter Sidika who live in a poor neighborhood of Istanbul. Sidika was not allowed to go to high school, raised to wait her husband-to-be at her fathers home, not even allowed to leave their house on her own. But she educated herself through books, newspapers and TV. She approaches her life, half-witted older brother, oppressive and alcoholic father and traditionalist mother in a satirical and fun manner along with the current political and sociological events of Turkey and the world. She gazes the world through her window as she hungers for all the intellectual accumulation of the universe.

series:tt0856757.name: Yaprak Dökümü
series:tt0856757.description: The travails of a tightly knit family that moves to Istanbul.

series:tt0423642.name: Dog Whisperer
series:tt0423642.description: Cesar Millan has been called the Dr. Phil for Dogs. With an uncanny ability to rehabilitate problem dogs of all shapes and sizes. Each episode of the Dog Whisperer documents the remarkable transformations that take place under Cesar's guidance and teaching, helping dogs and their owners live happier lives together.

series:tt3665674.name: Alaskan Bush People
series:tt3665674.description: A journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

series:tt6603254.name: Marvel's Rocket & Groot
series:tt6603254.description: Before becoming Guardians of the Galaxy, Rocket and Groot were bounty hunters trying to get a ship.

series:tt0086800.name: Sharon, Lois & Bram's Elephant Show
series:tt0086800.description: The musical adventures of the singing trio Sharon, Lois, and Bram and their friend, Elephant.

series:tt1444382.name: Cake Boss
series:tt1444382.description: The staff at Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken, N.J., led by Buddy Valastro, shows how he prepares elaborate themed cakes for various occasions.

series:tt0439341.name: 6Teen
series:tt0439341.description: Set in a giant shopping mall, this show follows the after-school lives of six 16-year-olds.

series:tt5568740.name: Mech-X4
series:tt5568740.description: Ryan Walker mysteriously awakens MECH-X4, a giant robot built to defend Bay City against impending doom. When monsters begin to descend, Ryan recruits his two best friends and his brother to help pilot the robot that is their only...

series:tt0247117.name: Moomin
series:tt0247117.description: The eerie and charming animated adventures of a creature called Moomin and his friends and family.

series:tt0267237.name: The Zack Files
series:tt0267237.description: Growing up is hard enough but for Zack Greenburg, it's harder, especially when supernatural and paranormal events effect his life. Fortunately, he has his best friends Cam Dunleavey, Spencer Sharpe and Gwen Killerby to help him th...

series:tt0247120.name: Night Visions
series:tt0247120.description: "Night Visions" was a hosted anthology series similar to "The Twilight Zone" - some tales are supernatural, others are just commentaries on twisted human nature. Each hour show is made up of two half-hour stories aired back-to-back.

series:tt0324864.name: Kingdom Hospital
series:tt0324864.description: The quirky staff and patients of an ultramodern (albeit increasingly dilapidated) Maine hospital gradually become familiar with the supernatural occurrences that take place there, uncovering a dark secret in the process.

series:tt8347410.name: Heirs of the Night
series:tt8347410.description: Set in 1889, the story about the five remaining vampire clans in Europe who are training to survive. In their midst is Alisa (14) who has the power to choose between eternal life as a vampire or for all vampires to live as humans.

series:tt10681780.name: The Stranger
series:tt10681780.description: An unassuming young rideshare driver is thrown into her worst nightmare when a mysterious Hollywood Hills passenger enters her car.

series:tt0068074.name: Circle of Fear
series:tt0068074.description: An anthology of suspense dramas concentrating on individuals confronted with supernatural occurrences.

series:tt6209442.name: Nightmare Teacher
series:tt6209442.description: A homeroom teacher of Yosan Private High School has an accident, and thus a substitute comes to fill in. Han Bong-Gu  is a mysterious man, and after strange occurrences the class president Ye-Rim tries to get to the bottom of this mystery.

series:tt6053538.name: Ghosted
series:tt6053538.description: A skeptical tough ex-cop is forced to team up with a nerdy scientist who is a firm believer in the paranormal. They must help a secret L.A.-based government agency deal with unexplained and paranormal occurrences.

series:tt4999820.name: Au-delà des murs
series:tt4999820.description: Lisa inherits an abandoned house from an unknown benefactor. On her first night in the house, after hearing noises, she knocks a hole in the wall and crawls through to discover an inescapable, infinite, labyrinthine "house."

series:tt9861934.name: Alien: Isolation - The Digital Series
series:tt9861934.description: Fifteen years have passed since the deep-space freighter Nostromo disappeared with all hands. Representatives from the Weyland-Yutani Corporation approach Amanda Ripley with news that the Nostromo's flight recorder has finally been found and brought to the space station Sevastopol.

series:tt2316082.name: Sex House
series:tt2316082.description: Six sexy Americans locked in a house for a reality show about getting nasty, but by the end of the first night things start to get terrible.

series:tt8403570.name: Mortel
series:tt8403570.description: A group of French teenagers are bound together by a supernatural force.

series:tt2197797.name: 666 Park Avenue
series:tt2197797.description: At the 203 apartments Drake, NYC, residents are granted one wish - any wish. But beware of the price. There's something supernatural and evil about The Drake that only the owners, Gavin and Olivia. know about/control.

series:tt4877736.name: BrainDead
series:tt4877736.description: A government employee discovers that the cause of the tensions between the two political parties is a race of extraterrestrial insects eating the brains of the politicians.

series:tt7801780.name: Origin
series:tt7801780.description: A group of strangers struggle for survival aboard a spaceship heading to a distant planet.

series:tt2193053.name: Cult
series:tt2193053.description: Tracks the investigation of a string of mysterious deaths and disappearances surrounding the show-within-a-show.

series:tt3184674.name: The Master's Sun
series:tt3184674.description: Tae Gong Sil has the ability to see ghosts, but their constant demands for help make her life impossible until she meets Joo Jong Won, a handsome CEO who measures everything by money, since when she touches him, the ghosts disappear.

series:tt1305562.name: Psychoville
series:tt1305562.description: A group of seemingly unrelated strangers all receive a mysterious note stating "I know what you did", which sends their lives into a downward spiral.

series:tt6712390.name: Requiem
series:tt6712390.description: When her mother commits suicide, a cellist's life is turned upside down by mysterious questions raised about her past.

series:tt0808013.name: Blood Ties
series:tt0808013.description: Vicki Nelson, a former homicide detective turned private investigator, and Henry Fitzroy, a 470-year-old vampire, form a unique team solving cases and dealing with the supernatural world.

series:tt4460878.name: Wolf Creek
series:tt4460878.description: An anthology series which centers on different characters being targeted by crazed serial killer Mick Taylor in the Australian outback.

series:tt2761354.name: Nowhere Boys
series:tt2761354.description: Four teenage boys, after getting lost in the forest, return to a parallel reality where they were never born, compelling them to navigate this alternate world.

series:tt5768840.name: Bring It On, Ghost
series:tt5768840.description: Hyun Ji is a 19-year-old wandering ghost. One day she meets an exorcist named Bong Pal. They team up to listen to and solve the problems of various ghosts so that they can rest peacefully.

series:tt9815502.name: Bloodride
series:tt9815502.description: In this deliciously macabre horror anthology series, doomed passengers tell their stories aboard a spectral bus headed toward an unknown destination.

series:tt8773080.name: The Curious Creations of Christine McConnell
series:tt8773080.description: Part cooking show, part sitcom in the vein of the Addams Family and the Muppet Show set inside the enchanted home of Christine McConnell, who has attracted hundreds of thousands of social media followers with her creepy edible cre...

series:tt1140939.name: Apparitions
series:tt1140939.description: Apparitions" is a supernatural drama series about a priest (Martin Shaw, "The Chief") who is working to promote candidates for sainthood and becomes drawn into the world of exorcism as he discovers a dark battle between good and e...

series:tt0115232.name: Kindred: The Embraced
series:tt0115232.description: Julian Luna, the undead Prince of the City, leads the Vampire Clans as he falls in love with Caitlin, a human reporter.

series:tt0435937.name: Afterlife
series:tt0435937.description: University lecturer Robert Bridge becomes involved in a series of supernatural events surrounding medium Alison Mundy in this chilling TV series.

series:tt12313914.name: Ju-on: Origins
series:tt12313914.description: Honjo Haruka is a rookie actress. She hears the sounds of footsteps at night in her house. When she learns of psychic researcher Odajima Yasuo from a TV variety program, she seeks counseling from him about her problem.

series:tt10404664.name: Zomboat!
series:tt10404664.description: A Zombie apocalypse is unleashed in Birmingham and sisters Kat and Jo, together with unlikely travel companions Sunny and Amar must flee for their lives...by canal boat.

series:tt6289132.name: The Boulet Brothers' Dragula
series:tt6289132.description: Extreme drag artists from around the world compete in challenges including costume design and creation, makeup and special effects, live performance, and craftsmanship.

series:tt8801670.name: Son: The Guest
series:tt8801670.description: A psychic, a Catholic priest, and a detective team up to fight crimes caused by supernatural forces.

series:tt7048386.name: The Bronze Garden
series:tt7048386.description: A new story created by the bestseller author Gustavo Malajovich inspired the first season of the series, along with Marcos Osorio Vidal.

series:tt5603186.name: Black Lake
series:tt5603186.description: A group of young friends visit an abandoned ski resort in northern Sweden, where strange noises from the basement are just the start of a series of horrifying events.

series:tt7965440.name: The Dead Lands
series:tt7965440.description: A new TV series from writer Glenn Standring based on his movie The Dead Lands (2014). In ancient Maori times, an undead warrior and a young tribeswoman team up to find a way to stop the evil dead from rising.

series:tt0320075.name: Miracles
series:tt0320075.description: Paul investigates modern miracles for the Catholic Church. After he witnesses a true supernatural miracle, only for his findings to be dismissed, he leaves the Church behind and is approached by Alva Keel to join his organization.

series:tt0320028.name: Haunted
series:tt0320028.description: After a near death experience, ex-policeman Frank Taylor learns that he has the ability to see and communicate with restless ghosts of murdered people who ask for his help in resolving their deaths.

series:tt0491560.name: Lucy, the Daughter of the Devil
series:tt0491560.description: Lucy is the 21 year old daughter of Satan in this dark comedy.

series:tt1935066.name: 49 Days
series:tt1935066.description: After an accident shatters her storybook life, a comatose woman gets a second chance at life when a reaper from above intervenes, at a cost.

As she tries to win back his love, Xiaoyao embarks on a quest to find her when she mysteriously disappears, uncovering hidden secrets along the way.

series:tt4016612.name: Blade Man

series:tt0955346.description: An immortal vampire and private investigator struggles to exist after he was bitten 60 years ago by his vampire bride. He is also internally tormented as he falls in love with one he should not.

series:tt4136774.name: The Ministry of Time
series:tt4136774.description: A warrior from the 16th Century, the first female university student from the 19th Century, and a paramedic from the 21st Century join a secret agency to prevent people from changing Spanish history using time-traveling doors.

series:tt2816734.name: Gu Family Book
series:tt2816734.description: Human/were-fox half-breed Choi Kang Chi discovers the truth about his origins and searches for the mystical Gu Family Book, which holds the secret to becoming fully human.

series:tt5637108.name: Twin Star Exorcists
series:tt5637108.description: Rokuro and Benio are named the future parents of a child of prophecy. But before they can have a baby, they'll have to raise a little hell.

When they regain their wits, they realize that they have swapped bodies. As time progresses, the two realize that this is not the only mysterious happening in the school.

series:tt10055734.name: Abyss
series:tt10055734.description: After meeting an untimely demise in separate incidents, Cha Min and Go Se-yeon discover they’ve come back to life in new bodies they don’t recognize.

series:tt6819736.name: WorldEnd: What are you doing at the end of the world? Are you busy? Will you save us?
series:tt6819736.description: The fleeting and sad story about little girls known as fairy weapons and an associate hero that survived. This is a world after it was attacked by unidentified monsters known as beasts and many of the species in the world, including humans, had been destroyed. The species that had managed to survived left the ground and were living on a floating island called Regal Ele. Willem Kmetsch wakes up above the clouds 500 years later and couldn’t protect the ones who he wanted to protect. Actually, he was living in despair because he was the only survivor.

series:tt11988478.name: Gleipnir
series:tt11988478.description: Shuichi Kagaya and Claire Aoki are navigating a bizarre, new world. With his monstrous superpowers and her thirst for revenge, this troubled pair forms a strong emotional bond.

series:tt8801708.description: The series tells the love story of Han Se Gye, an actress who must spend one week out of each month living in someone else's body, and Seo Do Jae, a man who suffers from Prosopagnosia.

series:tt9193770.name: Isekai Quartet
series:tt9193770.description: The worlds of isekai sagas collide and cross over, resulting in comical chaos.

series:tt8824648.name: Girl from Nowhere
series:tt8824648.description: A mysterious, clever girl named Nanno transfers to different schools, exposing the lies and misdeeds of the students and faculty at every turn.

series:tt7395992.name: The Rook
series:tt7395992.description: This London-set series centers on a young woman pursued by shadowy paranormal adversaries while grappling with extraordinary abilities of her own.

series:tt6212990.description: This fantasy drama follows an indie band singer who repeatedly undergoes unwanted time slips and the girlfriend he must save from an unlucky fate.

series:tt0154147.description: Five teenagers and an alien with the ability to turn into any beast they touch vs. an army of parasitic aliens who are slowly infiltrating Earth.

series:tt2185220.name: Queen In Hyun's Man
series:tt2185220.description: Kim Boong Do is a scholar who had supported the reinstatement of Queen In Hyun when Jang heebin's schemes resulted in her being deposed and replaced as King Sukjong's queen consort. He travels 300 years into the future of modern Seoul and meets Choi Hee Jin, a no-name actress who is expecting a career renaissance through her role as Queen In Hyun in a TV drama.

series:tt3888026.name: Lord Marksman and Vanadis
series:tt3888026.description: Tigre, a young noble, is captured by a beautiful female general from an enemy country. Though enchanting, her curves aren't the only dangerous thing about her. She's backed by an army of desirable warrior-goddesses called the Vana...

series:tt5497708.description: Overworked employee Young Soo and ex-mobster Gi Tak die, board a heavenly train but jump off, reincarnating as opposites to aid loved ones, facing struggles in their new lives.

series:tt3726584.name: Bride of the Century
series:tt3726584.description: A young woman named Choi Kang-soon is betrothed to an wealthy and powerful man, but she falls in love with another man and must choose between him and her duty.

series:tt6516076.name: Chicago Typewriter
series:tt6516076.description: Writers that lived under Japanese rule in the 1930s are reincarnated into a bestselling writer who is in a slump, a mysterious ghostwriter, and a devoted fan of the bestselling writer.

series:tt4219244.name: World Break: Aria of Curse for a Holy Swordsman
series:tt4219244.description: Akane Academy is just like any other school...except the students just happen to be reincarnated legendary heroes.

series:tt4583316.name: The Girl Who Sees Smells
series:tt4583316.description: Detective Tae Ho lost his younger sister to a barcode-murder case and lost his ability to taste, smell, and feel pain. He then meets Oh Cho Rim, the only witness to the murder case who possesses a special sense: she can see smells.

series:tt6477270.name: Grimoire of Zero
series:tt6477270.description: When a half-beast mercenary teams up with a witch who is in search of a magical tome that can destroy the world, a grand adventure ensues.  Despite his hatred of witches, he enters an agreement that shewill make him human once she reaches her goal.

series:tt6889072.name: The Best Hit
series:tt6889072.description: A free-spirited famous idol, a struggling singer, and their crew of "twenty-something-year-olds." When they meet, it will be an orchestra of disaster.

series:tt5994346.name: Tomorrow with You
series:tt5994346.description: The drama tells the story of Yoo So-joon, who can travel through time by a subway. After seeing his future-self living miserably, Joon decides to marry Ma Rin in order to avoid that fate. As time passes, he learns to love her self...

series:tt8826128.name: October Faction
series:tt8826128.description: A semi-retired couple who work for a clandestine monster-hunting agency discover dark family secrets and the truth about their employer after their magically-inclined near-adult kids reawaken a witch bent on revenge.

series:tt8001250.name: Always a Witch
series:tt8001250.description: A time-traveling witch from the 17th century escapes death and finds herself in modern-day Cartagena.

series:tt0155446.name: Samson en Gert
series:tt0155446.description: Gert and his speaking dog Samson live together in the 'Dorpstraat 101', where they have lots of funny adventures with their friends. The tubby hairdresser Albert, the clumsy mayor and his hyperactive secretary as well as grocery s...

series:tt0172049.name: Rolie Polie Olie
series:tt0172049.description: Olie, his sister Zowie, and his best friend Billy live as robots and discover the values of friendship, family, and growing up to be a great kid.

series:tt0042171.name: You Bet Your Life
series:tt0042171.description:
You Bet Your Life is an American quiz show that aired on both radio and television. The original and best-known version was hosted by Groucho Marx of the Marx Brothers, with announcer and assistant George Fenneman. The show debuted on ABC Radio in October 1947, then moved to CBS Radio in September 1949 before making the transition to NBC-TV in October 1950. Because of its simple format, it was possible to broadcast the show simultaneously on the radio and on television. In 1960, the show was renamed The Groucho Show and ran a further year. Most episodes are in the public domain.

The play of the game, however, was secondary to the interplay between Groucho, the contestants, and occasionally Fenneman. The program was rerun into the 1970s, and later in syndication as The Best of Groucho. As such, it was the first game show to have its reruns syndicated.

series:tt1070806.name: A Kitten Named Woof
series:tt1070806.description: Tells about the adventures of a kitten with the unusual name of Woof and his friend - the puppy of Sharik. Woof constantly gets into ridiculous situations and finds adventures as soon as he leaves the house.

series:tt0090474.name: A Little Princess
series:tt0090474.description: Sara Crewe enters a London boarding school a wealthy lady when she bids her father farewell as he enters the British Army, but her lifestyle quickly vanishes when her father suddenly dies, and Sara must endure a life of servitude.

series:tt0487813.name: Charlie and Lola
series:tt0487813.description: Animation following a boy's efforts to get his stubborn little sister to try new things.

series:tt0273366.name: Lizzie McGuire
series:tt0273366.description: Clumsy middle-schooler Lizzie McGuire navigates through teenage issues while enjoying her tween years with genuine friends, an annoying younger brother, and loving parents.

series:tt0078713.name: Worzel Gummidge
series:tt0078713.description: Children's series about the adventures of Worzel Gummidge (Jon Pertwee), a scarecrow who comes to life.

series:tt0217910.description: A comedy sketch show centered around All That (1994) alum Amanda Bynes.

series:tt0108825.description: "The Julekalender" is a Christmas story about three "nisser" who have to go from the North Pole and back to the "hule" (cave) in the Norwegian province of Trondelag to find the life melody of the head nisse "Good old gammel nok" w...

series:tt0294196.name: Pirlimpimpim
series:tt0294196.description: The adventures in science, history, and fantasy of a girl, a boy, and their two living toys, starting from the ranch where they live, known as the Yellow Woodpecker.

series:tt0084996.name: The Charlie Brown and Snoopy Show
series:tt0084996.description: Every Saturday morning The Peanuts Gang does skits, mostly taken from newspaper strips.

series:tt0304999.name: Barbapapa
series:tt0304999.description: The Barbapapas are creatures that can change their form, and those are the adventures is this unusual family in his struggle to find his place in the planet while helping other people and animals

series:tt0081929.name: Silas
series:tt0081929.description:
Silas was a 1981 ZDF Adventure TV mini-series based on the Danish children's book „Silas og den sorte hoppe“ by Cecil Bødker who kept on writing instalments until 2001.

The series was Patrick Bach's debut and because the series did so well he also starred the very next year in another adventure series about a young orphan: Jack Holborn

Silas was a German production and filmed solely in German. Still it received attention beyond German-speaking countries and consequently the successor Jack Holborn involved international producers and was filmed in English.

series:tt0135114.name: Around the World with Willy Fog
series:tt0135114.description: A furry version of Jules Verne's classic adventure story of a British gentleman's challenge to circumnavigate the world in 80 days.

series:tt0283721.description: The fantastic adventures of David and his wife Lisa traveling around the world to save the animals and defeating the trolls.

series:tt6710836.description: The wild west adventures of a free-spirited girl and her wild stallion horse companion.

series:tt0112197.description: The further misadventures of the lovable warthog Pumbaa and his meerkat buddy Timon from The Lion King (1994).

series:tt0144036.description: In the royal archives of Denmark, everything goes incredibly wrong when resident elf Pyrus decides to meet Santa Claus.

series:tt0395413.description: Berk, a blue plasticine creature, lives as a servant to the unseen "Thing Upstairs" in an ancient castle. Every time the trap door opens, a new adventure begins for Berk and his pals, the skull Boni and the spider Drutt.

series:tt0078611.description: Modern adaptation of Enid Blyton's adventure stories about Julian, Dick, Anne, George and Timmy the dog.

series:tt0090444.description: A laidback teacher provides needed guidance about life for a special class of exceptional students.

series:tt0206511.description: The Stevens family live in Sacramento, California, where the two younger children in the family, Ren and Louis, who have opposing personalities, often clash.

series:tt0078644.name: The Littlest Hobo
series:tt0078644.description: The wandering adventures of an intelligent German shepherd dog.

series:tt0048907.description: Classic game show in which a person of some notoriety and two impostors try to match wits with a panel of four celebrities. The object of the game is to try to fool the celebrities into voting for the two impostors.

series:tt0173548.description: It's a game show where two teams take on each other in various tasks. They normally have a time limit and whoever wins gets to go in the tigers cage to win money.

series:tt1138300.description: We pick up with our heroes and the challenges faced by the members of DATS ("Digital Accident Tactics Squad"), an organization created to conceal the existence of the Digital World and Digimon from the rest of mankind.

series:tt0762067.description: Join Wubbzy and all of his Wuzzleburg friends! Widget is the busiest builder and fix-it whiz, Walden knows all about science and art, Daizy is the sweet girly-girl next door.

series:tt7150060.description: A young ballet dancer from 1905 is transported into the 21st century with the power of a magical necklace. While her boyfriend looks for a way to bring her back, she must find a way to fit in and dodge the sinister time agents.

series:tt1781715.description: A mysterious science experiment sends everyone over the age of 15 into a parallel dimension. Now, the last remaining children of Earth must find a way to bring their parents home before all hope is lost.

series:tt1815377.name: Strawberry Shortcake's Berry Bitty Adventures
series:tt1815377.description: A girl named Strawberry and her friends go on thrilling adventures.

series:tt0827972.description: The naive Prince Duen Yu flees his home, gaining powerful skills ironically. Kiu Fung, the Beggars' Sect chief, is exiled after a murder accusation. Monk Hui Juk inherits the Carefree Sect's powers by chance as their stories inter...

series:tt1173202.description: The year is 1896. The Ottoman Empire is slowly losing its dominance in the Balkans. The events that develop around Milkman Ramiz and his family also hold a mirror to the years of the Ottoman Empire retreating from the Balkans.
