series:tt0204082.description: 18th-century England and Ireland viewed through the eyes of four beautiful high-born sisters - Caroline, Emily, Louisa, and Sarah Lennox, great-granddaughters of a king, daughters of a cabinet minister, and wives of politicians an...

series:tt0081955.name: Velo misto
series:tt0081955.description: This series, mostly humorous, yet epic in proportions, chronicles the city of Split in turbulent times between 1910 and 1947. Although the story has numerous subplots and dozens of different characters, the main accent is given to...

series:tt0182782.name: Data Tutashkhia
series:tt0182782.description: A just man becomes an outlaw. He is pursued by the police over the years, while he tries to fight the injustice in the world, but he can't figure out the minds of his fellow men, and is often misunderstood.

series:tt5458128.name: The White Slave
series:tt5458128.description: In Colombia in 1821, a Spanish plantation gets burned down, and only the planters' baby is spared. She gets sent to Spain, but concocts a plan to return home and become an abolitionist.

series:tt3811304.name: Sanadamaru
series:tt3811304.description: Spanning over 50 episodes, we follow the historical fiction of the Sanada clansmen as they plotted and fought their ways to survive the changing political alliances during the Warring States Period of Japan.

series:tt0076998.name: D'artagnan and Three Musketeers
series:tt0076998.description: D'Artagnan and his musketeer comrades thwart the plans of Cardinal Richelieu to usurp King Louis XIII's power.

series:tt1785914.name: Bitter Coffee
series:tt1785914.description: Being transported into the past by drinking a cup of mysterious coffee, a man makes a living by predicting the future for the royal family.

series:tt0108914.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
series:tt0108914.description: Adapted from the classical 14th century novel of the same title by Luo Guanzhong, Romance of the Three Kingdoms is part historical, part legend, and part mythical – romanticises and dramatises the lives of feudal lords and their retainers, who tried to replace the dwindling Han dynasty or restore it. The focus is mainly on the three power blocs that emerged from the remnants of the Han dynasty, and would eventually form the three states of Cao Wei, Shu Han, and Eastern Wu.

series:tt3142876.name: Lovebird
series:tt3142876.description: Feride became orphaned as a child and is forced to attend a boarding school while also visiting her aunt during breaks and vacations. During this time she has fallen in love with her charming older cousin Kamran.

series:tt0092411.name: Napoleon and Josephine: A Love Story
series:tt0092411.description: Epic story about the romance between the most powerful man in the world and the woman who conquered his heart.

series:tt0142036.name: Isaura: Slave Girl
series:tt0142036.description: The difficulties faced by a gentle-hearted young white slave targeted by the obsession of her lord in the Brazilian colonial period.

series:tt0469703.name: Hezar Dastan
series:tt0469703.description:
Hezar-Dastan was an Iranian epic historical drama television series from 1987, developed and directed by Ali Hatami. Hezar Dastan is considered one of the most important and most influential works of art in the history of Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting. The production of the show took almost 8 years, starting in 1979 and ending in 1987, during which Hatami established a large set to represent Tehran in both Qajar dynasty and World War II, retroactively creating Iran's first movie studio and backlot (named Ghazali Cinema Town).

The show tells the story of Reza Khoshnevis (also known as Reza Tofangchi), and his life and entanglement with corruption in government, and trying to correct it using not conventional means. The story is split into two section and it features Iran during the turbulent times of the latter days of Qajar Dynasty and during the events of World War II and Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran.

series:tt4040530.name: Tokyo Trial
series:tt4040530.description: In the wake of World War II, 11 Allied judges are tasked with weighing the fates of Japanese war criminals in a tense international trial.

series:tt5193662.name: Tutankhamun
series:tt5193662.description: The remarkable story of the chance meeting that transformed penniless, ostracised archaeologist Howard Carter into a household name following his discovery of the tomb of the boy-king, Tutankhamun.

series:tt0074024.name: Michael Strogoff
series:tt0074024.description: Captain Michael Strogoff is chosen in Moscow to be the courier of the Tsar, 5,523 km far to Irkutsk, to warn the governor about the traitor Ivan Ogareff, a former colonel, who was once demoted and exiled and now seeks revenge.

series:tt2293522.name: Das Adlon. Eine Familiensaga
series:tt2293522.description: The mini-series follows the construction and history of the famous Adlon hotel in Berlin, as seen through the eyes of Sonja Schadt, the youngest member of the wealthy fictional Schadt family who are friends with the Adlons.

series:tt1203269.name: Les Miserables: Shoujo Cosette
series:tt1203269.description: Cosette, daughter of the unfortunate Fantine, suffers under the cruel Thénardiers. Jean Valjean, a former convict disguised as Monsieur Madeleine, seeks redemption while Inspector Javert pursues him.

series:tt10405220.name: Romulus
series:tt10405220.description: The story of Romulus and his twin brother Remus, in eighth century B.C. as seen through the eyes of three people marked by death, loneliness and violence.

series:tt9604400.name: Unknown Soldier
series:tt9604400.description: The Unknown Soldier miniseries expands the story of the 2017 film of the same name. The World War II series based on Väinö Linna's classic novel closely follows a machine gun company of the Finnish Army on the Karelian front during the Continuation War between Finland and the Soviet Union, from mobilization in 1941 to the Moscow Armistice in 1944. It's a story about how camaraderie, humor, and a desire to survive connect men on their journey. War upends the lives of both the individual soldiers and those left on the home front, and leaves its mark on the entire nation.

series:tt10840070.name: Paris Police 1900
series:tt10840070.description: Paris, France, 1899. The corpse of an unknown woman is found in the river Seine. The investigation will push a young ambitious inspector to discover a heavy state secret.

series:tt5833846.name: Maximilian and Marie De Bourgogne
series:tt5833846.description: Known as The Last Knight for his bravery and battle skills, the great European emperor Maximilian and his story is as spectacular as it is familiar: It is the story of a prince who must learn to be king. But above all, it is the struggle of a son who steps out of his father's shadow with the help of a most unexpected ally: Marie de Bourgogne.

series:tt1442136.name: Sisi
series:tt1442136.description: Austrian Emperor Franz Joseph falls in love with young Elisabeth. It's love at first sight but Franz Joseph's mother Sophie doesn't approve of the relationship.

series:tt10689614.name: El Cid
series:tt10689614.description: The story of Rodrigo Díaz de Vivar, a Castilian nobleman and war hero in medieval Spain.

series:tt10681240.name: The Vineyard
series:tt10681240.description: Mauro Larrea and Soledad Montalvo are two strangers whose destinies cross in the second half of the 19th century, leading to their lives changing forever. A history of glories and defeats, of silver mines, family intrigues, vineyards, wineries, and fascinating cities whose splendor faded over time.

series:tt0102879.name: Separate But Equal
series:tt0102879.description: A dramatization of the American court case that destroyed the legal validity of racial segregation.

series:tt3658364.name: Line of Separation
series:tt3658364.description: A story of one village in Germany at the end of WW2.

series:tt0280770.name: The Infinite Worlds of H.G. Wells
series:tt0280770.description: Each episode adapts — and sometimes quite radically alters — a short story written by Wells: The New Accelerator, The Queer Story of Brownlow's Newspaper, The Crystal Egg, The Remarkable Case of Davidson's Eyes, The Truth About Pyecraft and The Stolen Bacillus. Each is presented as if it were a 'real' incident that Wells had investigated with his girlfriend, Jane Robbins, and as if it had served as an inspiration for a short story. The flashbacks are to 1893 within the 1946 frame story, near the end of Wells's life, when he is interviewed by a secret military research institute interested in his past exploits.

series:tt0291419.name: Pet Shop of Horrors
series:tt0291419.description: Welcome to the most magnificent pet shop in Chinatown! Operated by the shadowy Count D, the shop specializes in rare and hard to come by pets... but with each sale comes a contract. And if that contract is broken, watch out! Detective Orcott has linked many odd and unexplained deaths to Count D's shop. Will he solve the mystery or fall prey to it?

series:tt8290362.name: The Head
series:tt8290362.description: Winter has fallen on the South Pole. A small team, known as the Winterers, will remain at the Polaris VI Antarctic Research Station to continue their innovative research, a crucial part in the fight against climate change.

series:tt9104072.name: 50 States of Fright
series:tt9104072.description: Quibi series explores stories based on urban legends from different places in the United States, taking viewers deeper into the horrors that lurk just beneath the surface.

series:tt1097194.name: Ghost Hound
series:tt1097194.description: The experiences of three boys who have had traumatic experiences in childhood from which they have learned to transfer their souls to a parallel world known as the "Unseen World".

series:tt2016670.name: Shiki
series:tt2016670.description: When many deaths occur in the quiet village of Sotoba, Doctor Toshio Ozaki initially suspects an epidemic but soon becomes convinced that something else is causing them.

series:tt0856346.name: Ayakashi - Samurai Horror Tales
series:tt0856346.description: Made up of three stories: "Yotsuya Ghost Story", an adaptation of the classic Japanese ghost story; "Goddess of the Dark Tower", and Goblin Cat.

series:tt7612938.name: Shaitaan Haveli
series:tt7612938.description: When B-grade filmmaker Hariman shows up to shoot his horror film at an old haveli, freak occurrences make the crew suspect that instead of shooting a horror film, they will soon be living one.

series:tt8670784.name: Angels of Death
series:tt8670784.description: When Rachel wakes up with no memories in the basement of an unfamiliar building, she runs into Zack, a scythe-carrying serial killer.

series:tt2239964.name: Acayip Hikayeler
series:tt2239964.description: Turkish television series adapted from Galip Tekin's fantastic story line.

series:tt0045436.name: The Quatermass Experiment
series:tt0045436.description: Professor Bernard Quatermass, Director General of the British Experimental Rocket Group, launches the first manned space flight from Australia. A malfunction sends the rocket and its three man crew thousands of miles off course. W...

series:tt7084536.name: Kafr Delhap
series:tt7084536.description: Set in a remote, cursed village in an ancient era, Kafr Delhab follows a doctor named Saad who arrives to find no children have been born for years — women miscarry, villagers are possessed by jinn, and all speak of a vengeful woman's spirit seeking retribution against the entire hamlet. Starring Youssef El Sherif, the series is a rare foray into horror-mystery for Egyptian drama, filmed on location in the haunting landscape of Siwa Oasis.

series:tt1988235.name: Blade
series:tt1988235.description: Legendary half-vampire, half-human vampire hunter Blade is tracking Deacon Frost, a very powerful and influential vampire who killed his mother and who heads Existence, a secretive vampire organization that operates in Southeast A...

series:tt9018490.name: Deadwax
series:tt9018490.description: A mind-bending neo-noir set in the obsessive world of vinyl collecting. Etta Pryce, a vinyl tracker, is hired by a rich collector to hunt a legendary rare record that has driven its owners mad and killed anyone that has dared to p...

series:tt9154158.name: You're Not a Monster
series:tt9154158.description: Max Seward's patients really are the horrifying monsters they think they are... because they really are horrifying monsters. But as this para-therapist struggles with his own demons - and his vampire great-grandfather who left him his practice - he learns that the only thing worse than being undead is being unloved.

series:tt7704636.name: Jul i Blodfjell
series:tt7704636.description: 24 episode countdown Christmas murder story inspired by And Then There Were None. Rich Uncle Conrad has invited the Soot family to Blodfjell for celebrations. They are of course killed off one by one.

series:tt1670375.name: Bright Falls
series:tt1670375.description: Live action prequel to 'Alan Wake'. After arriving in the small Pacific Northwestern town of Bright Falls, reporter Jake Fischer is plagued by blackouts and finding disturbing evidence plans his escape.

series:tt0051305.name: Quatermass and the Pit
series:tt0051305.description: A team of scientists search for the origin and purpose of a mysterious capsule found on a building site.

series:tt0092480.name: Werewolf
series:tt0092480.description: Grad student Eric Cord becomes infected with lycanthropy after his friend turns into a werewolf and attacks him. Now, Eric and his girlfriend are after the monster that infected his friend, and a tough cowboy bounty hunter pursues...

series:tt0386224.name: Monkey Dust
series:tt0386224.description: A definitely-not-for-children animated series with each episode made up of an array of perverse skits.

series:tt0229916.name: The Others
series:tt0229916.description: A young female college student who can see ghosts joins a team of friends from various age groups and walks of life who use their psychic abilities to investigate cases involving ghosts, demons and other entities from 'the other s...

series:tt1653313.name: Board James
series:tt1653313.description: A new series from Cinemassacre's James Rolfe, creator of the infamous Angry Video Game Nerd. As Board James he still takes us back to the past, but this time to revisit the classic board games of years gone by.

series:tt1314008.name: Lost Tapes
series:tt1314008.description: Explores the possibility of hidden creatures through "found footage" videos and information provided by experts.

series:tt2104664.name: The Heart, She Holler
series:tt2104664.description: When "Boss" Hoss Heartshe dies, he bequeaths his town to his long-hidden and dim-witted son Hurlan, who has just been introduced to human society. Thus begins the bizarre and horrifying saga of Heartshe Holler.

series:tt0047766.name: Quatermass II
series:tt0047766.description: Professor Bernard Quatermass of the British Experimental Rocket Group is sought to examine strange meteorite showers. His investigations lead to his uncovering a conspiracy involving alien infiltration at the highest levels of the British Government. As even some of Quatermass's closest colleagues fall victim to the alien influence, he is forced to use his own unsafe rocket prototype, which recently caused a nuclear disaster at an Australian testing range, to prevent the aliens from taking over mankind.

series:tt1450620.name: When Seagulls Cry
series:tt1450620.description: A family reunion is held on a secluded island. The dying patriarch wants to see his lost love one last time, so he tries summoning her with black magic and that's when the murders begin. Third installment in the "When They Cry" se...

series:tt0052442.name: One Step Beyond
series:tt0052442.description: A collection of tales about paranormal events, horrifying folklore, and the world of the unknown.

series:tt3292726.name: Tim and Eric's Bedtime Stories
series:tt3292726.description: Tim and Eric's parody of horror anthology TV shows.

series:tt4568372.name: Residue
series:tt4568372.description: The government cover-up of the causes behind a massive explosion in a futuristic UK metropolis spur photo journalist Jennifer Preston on to search for the truth and in the process blow open a paranormal phenomenon haunting the city.

series:tt0385405.name: The Befallen
series:tt0385405.description: One night a nameless force sweeps over Sweden, and scattered over the country are a few chosen, who are gifted with supernatural powers. These powers are the exact opposite to what the biggest issue in their lives are - the woman unable to give birth to a child gains the ability to heal dead people. A White Leader and a Black Leader seek out these people, to prepare for the final battle between good and evil.

series:tt1000779.name: 10i entoli
series:tt1000779.description: Stories of ordinary people that at a crucial point of their lives cross the limits in a shocking way.

series:tt0179585.name: The Little Vampire
series:tt0179585.description: 13 part television series based on the books: "The Little Vampire" and "The Little Vampire Moves In" by Angela Sommer-Bodenburg.

series:tt2014681.name: Holliston
series:tt2014681.description: Two down and out aspiring filmmakers struggle with life, career, and the opposite sex as they attempt to make it out of the small New England town they are trapped in and into the big time.

series:tt7949196.name: Sacred Lies
series:tt7949196.description: A teenager with no hands is suspected of knowing who killed her cult's leader and lands in juvenile detention.

series:tt3120568.name: Darknet
series:tt3120568.description: A macabre web site called Darknet links the tales in this chilling anthology series whose protagonists face a range of unnamable horrors.

series:tt0257885.name: MPD Psycho
series:tt0257885.description: After his wife is murdered, a homicide detective develops multiple personalities and takes revenge on her killer. Years later the killer seems to reappear from the dead.

series:tt12367868.name: Higurashi: When They Cry - NEW
series:tt12367868.description: New kid Keiichi Maebara is settling into his new home of peaceful Hinamizawa village. Making quick friends with the girls from his school, he's arrived in time for the big festival of the year. But something about this isolated town seems "off," and his feelings of dread continue to grow. With a gnawing fear that he's right, what dark secrets could this small community be hiding?

series:tt6016316.name: Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak Academy - Hope Arc
series:tt6016316.description: Set before the events of "Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc," The Despair side of Danganronpa 3 shows the events leading to the rise of the Remnants of Despair and the fall of Hope's Peak and the world into anarchy.

series:tt0077399.name: The Dark Secret of Harvest Home
series:tt0077399.description: A New York commercial artist and his wife and daughter move to a quiet, rustic New England village they visited during their travels, only to find themselves mixed up in ritualistic lifestyle full of foreboding secrets.

series:tt2043616.name: Penance
series:tt2043616.description: The murder of a young girl is never solved. Her mother who is torn by grief puts a curse on the four of the girl's classmates. These four girls are forced into adulthood which eventually triggers a tragic chain of events.

series:tt0143353.name: The Guyver: Bio-Booster Armor
series:tt0143353.description: Sho and Tetsurou find an alien artifact that bonds with Sho, transforming him into the Guyver. He must battle the evil Chronos corporation and their Zoanoids, who want to recapture the Guyver.

series:tt7403736.name: V-Wars
series:tt7403736.description: Dr. Luther Swann enters a world of horror when a virus is released from ice melting due to climate change.

series:tt8284230.name: The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs
series:tt8284230.description: Joe Bob Briggs watches and provides behind-the-scenes information on an eclectic pairing of films, running the gamut from horror classics to obscurities and international cult favorites.

series:tt3136332.name: Hellbenders
series:tt3136332.description: The adventures of two young boys, Chris and Zach, who live in a world surrounded by not so normal things.

series:tt13106334.name: The Girl in the Mirror
series:tt13106334.description: After losing her memory in a bizarre accident that kills most of her classmates, Alma tries to unravel what happened that day and regain her identity.

series:tt10532640.name: The Legends
series:tt10532640.description: Formerly a powerful demon queen, Zhao Yao reincarnates as a human girl moments before claiming ultimate power, losing her memories and abilities. Her quest to regain her former glory unfolds.

series:tt3513704.name: The Messengers
series:tt3513704.description: A mysterious object crashes on earth and a group of unconnected strangers die from an energy pulse it emits, but then re-awaken to find out that they have been deemed responsible for preventing the impending apocalypse.

series:tt4799574.name: Oh My Ghost
series:tt4799574.description: Timid Na Bong Sun gets possessed by the ghost of a confident young woman who seeks to solve her one unfinished business by hooking up with Bong Sun's boss, famous chef Kang Sun Woo.

series:tt1461312.name: Alice
series:tt1461312.description: Everything you know about Alice's Adventures in Wonderland is about to be turned upside down in this modern-day mini-series. The cast includes Kathy Bates, Caterina Scorsone, Matt Frewer, Harry Dean Stanton, and Tim Curry.

series:tt0386917.name: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon
series:tt0386917.description: Live-action series which is an original re-telling of the original Bishoujo Senshi Sailormoon manga and anime series.

series:tt1739796.name: My Bride Is a Mermaid
series:tt1739796.description: A cute mermaid saves Nagasumi from drowning and to avoid the wrath of her yakuza merman father he agrees to marry her.

series:tt9573854.name: Lord El-Melloi II's Case Files {Rail Zeppelin} Grace note
series:tt9573854.description: Waver Velvet – The boy who fought side by side with the King of Conquerors - Iskandar - during the Fourth Holy Grail War in Fate/Zero. Time has passed, and the mature Waver has now adopted the name of Lord El-Melloi. As Lord El-Melloi II, he challenges numerous magical and mystical cases in the Clock Tower, the mecca of all mages...

series:tt6138612.name: Granblue Fantasy: The Animation
series:tt6138612.description: In a world of floating islands, Gran meets Lyria fleeing the sky-conquering Erste Empire. Following his father's note, they journey towards the Island of Stars Istalucia.

series:tt0948538.name: Journeyman
series:tt0948538.description: A San Francisco journalist mysteriously travels to the past and alters the path of people's lives. When his travels reunite him with his long-lost fiancée Livia, life with his present-day wife gets very interesting.

series:tt5679572.name: Another Miss Oh
series:tt5679572.description: A romantic television series about two women who not only share the same name Oh Hae Young but they also share a destiny with the same man, Park Do Kyung, who can see the future.

series:tt5646548.name: Mirror of the Witch
series:tt5646548.description: Can a young royal physician change the fate of a cursed princess? When Queen Shim (Jang Hee Jin) is unable to conceive, she visits shaman Hong Joo (Yum Jung Ah). Hong Joo's powerful black magic helps the Queen give birth to a twin...

series:tt8750956.name: Arthdal Chronicles
series:tt8750956.description: "Arthdal Chronicles" depicts the birth of civilization and nations in ancient times. It is a story of mythical heroes--their struggle, unity, and love of people living in a virtual land called Arth.

series:tt1299897.name: Kröd Mändoon and the Flaming Sword of Fire
series:tt1299897.description: Monty Python meets The Princess Bride (1987) in this Comedy Central original series. Follow Kröd Mändoon and his band of ineffectual freedom fighters as they fight evil and save the world.

series:tt9883346.name: The Helpful Fox Senko-san
series:tt9883346.description: Sometimes the cure to a hard day’s work is the tender love and care of…a fox girl?! Salaryman Nakano’s stressful life is suddenly intruded upon by the fox, Senko-san, who is eager to help him heal his exhaustion. Whether she’s cooking, cleaning, or finding other ways to care for Nakano, she’s there to take away his stress!

series:tt0197139.name: O Auto da Compadecida
series:tt0197139.description: The (mis)adventures of João Grilo and Chicó in Brazil's Northeastern region. The four-chapter miniseries original version of O Auto da Compadecida.

series:tt9690302.name: The Ghost Bride
series:tt9690302.description: In 1890s Malacca, Li Lan finds herself in the afterlife and becomes mired in a mystery linked to the sinister, deceased son of a wealthy family.

series:tt6912356.name: The Flame's Daughter
series:tt6912356.description: The story of Ruge and Zhang Feng whose lives are interchanged after they are switched at birth. They meet and fall in love but their relationship takes a tragic turn due to the machinations of a man hell-bent on revenge.

series:tt7514476.name: Shuang Shi Chong Fei
series:tt7514476.description: When two sides of the same woman fall in love with two different princes, can either find true love?

series:tt0838800.name: Fallen
series:tt0838800.description: 18-year-old Aaron Corbett (Wesley) struggles to come to terms with his newly discovered identity - that he's half-angel.

series:tt1402376.name: Eastwick
series:tt1402376.description: A mysterious man bestows unique powers to three women.

series:tt2401919.name: Mayday
series:tt2401919.description: Mayday in a small town steeped in pagan traditions where the crowning of the May Queen is the highlight of the day until suddenly she goes missing.

series:tt1954804.name: Saving Hope
series:tt1954804.description: A supernatural medical drama that centers on the lives of the doctors and nurses of Hope Zion Hospital.

series:tt0103417.name: Forever Knight
series:tt0103417.description: 800-year-old vampire Nick Knight quests for redemption as a cop in Toronto, trying to hide his vampiric nature from the rest of the world.

series:tt4649420.name: Cleverman
series:tt4649420.description: In the very near future, creatures from ancient mythology must live among humans and battle for survival in a world that wants to silence, exploit, and destroy them.

series:tt0062565.name: The Ghost & Mrs. Muir
series:tt0062565.description: Derived from the 1947 movie with the same name, a house is haunted by a deceased sea captain who wreaks havoc with the new tenants who were not advised of his existence.

series:tt5628740.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Vrains
series:tt5628740.description: The theme for the new work is "Let's take one step forward and try it!" Yuusaku hates standing out, and at his school he doesn't. However, Yuusaku starts meeting others through duels, and starts moving forward.

series:tt0247119.name: Mysterious Ways
series:tt0247119.description: An anthropologist investigates potential miracles while his psychiatrist friend tries to keep him grounded. Together, they explore the line between belief and reality.

series:tt2647586.name: Resurrection
series:tt2647586.description: The lives of the people of Arcadia, Missouri are forever changed when their deceased loved ones return.

series:tt2802008.name: Once Upon a Time in Wonderland
series:tt2802008.description: In Victorian England, the young and beautiful Alice tells a tale of a strange new land that exists on the other side of a rabbit hole.

series:tt2705602.name: Atlantis
series:tt2705602.description: Far from home, Jason washes up on the shores of the ancient and mysterious city of Atlantis.

series:tt2215797.name: Zero Hour
series:tt2215797.description: Revolves around a bizarre twist of fate that pulls a man who's spent 20 years as the editor of a skeptics magazine into one of the most compelling conspiracies in human history.

series:tt10874298.name: My Girlfriend Is an Alien
series:tt10874298.description: In this star-crossed love story, a girl from another planet gets stuck on Earth and encounters a hotshot CEO who suffers from rain-induced amnesia.

series:tt1117666.name: Lost in Austen
series:tt1117666.description: Amanda, an ardent Jane Austen fan, lives in present day London with her boyfriend Michael, until she finds she's swapped places with Austen's fictional creation Elizabeth Bennet.

series:tt1079959.name: The Color of Magic
series:tt1079959.description: A cowardly wizard is roped into a life of adventure. A tale from the first two books of Terry Pratchett's fantasy series "Discworld".

series:tt0133312.name: Tales of King Matthias
series:tt0133312.description: Tales of King Matthias is a Hungarian television animated film series about King Mátyás, shown in 1984, produced by Pannónia Filmstúdió from 1981 to 1982. The director of the animated feature film series is László Újváry. Ábel Kőszegi and László Újváry wrote the script, the music was composed by the band Kaláka and produced by Ferenc Mikulás. It first aired between February 18, 1984 and May 12, 1984. In Hungary, it was broadcast by M1, M2, Duna TV, Fox Kids / Jetix, Kiwi TV and Super TV2.

series:tt4622118.name: Vikings: Athelstan's Journal
series:tt4622118.description: Viking culture is seen from a first-hand experience through the perspective of Athelstan.

series:tt1185446.name: Apostol
series:tt1185446.description: During World War II, a teacher pretends to be a criminal spy.

series:tt3077282.name: Once Upon a Time
series:tt3077282.description: A popular bandit, Morad, is robbing trade caravans. During a fight with another bandit, he has been rescued from death by the rural family. He takes a profound challenge in his life with these villagers.

series:tt0088471.name: A.D.
series:tt0088471.description: Set just after the death of Jesus Christ, this mini-series chronicles the life & adventures of Jesus's disciples, and events in Rome during the reigns of the Emperors Tiberius, Caligula, Claudius and Nero.

series:tt7165256.name: Madame K
series:tt7165256.description: A glimpse into the fate of Estonia during the world-shattering years of World War II (1939-1944), as told through the eyes of the people working at and frequenting a small elite brothel in Tallinn. Followed by The Women's War (2021).

series:tt13064634.name: Glória
series:tt13064634.description: In the 1960s, at the height of the Cold War, in the small village of Glória do Ribatejo, João Vidal will take on several high-risk espionage missions that could change the course of Portuguese and world history.

series:tt12305222.name: Puppet History
series:tt12305222.description: "The Professor," an expert accredited by Puppet U, hosts a ruthless competition for the title of History Master, quizzing contestants on subjects from history.

series:tt3850118.name: Al-Nakba (The Catastrophe)
series:tt3850118.description: For Palestinians, 1948 marks the “Nakba” or “catastrophe”, when hundreds of thousands were forced out of their homes. For Israelis, the same year marks the creation of their own state. This four-part series attempts to present an understanding of the events of the past that are still shaping the present.

series:tt1999065.name: The Neighbourhood's Gate
series:tt1999065.description: The social life of a syrian village in the 1930s under the french colonialism.

series:tt8439812.name: The Storm
series:tt8439812.description: Set in 1970s and 80s Riyadh, this landmark Saudi drama follows the Al-Tayan family navigating sweeping societal change — from the oil boom and the rise of religious conservatism, to the 1979 Grand Mosque seizure and the Gulf War. What begins with a foundling child at the mosque ripples outward into a rich multigenerational portrait of a country transforming before its people's eyes.

series:tt7302168.name: Raafat Al Haggan
series:tt7302168.description: Based on the true story of Egyptian spy Refaat Al-Gammal, Raafat Al Haggan follows a young Egyptian Muslim recruited by intelligence to assume a false Jewish identity and embed himself deep within Israeli society for over a decade. Starring Mahmoud Abdel Aziz and Yusra, the series charts his dangerous double life, his sacrifices, and his pivotal role in gathering intelligence ahead of the 1973 October War.

series:tt0120926.name: Battlefield
series:tt0120926.description: Major battles of World War II are recounted in depth.

series:tt6176636.name: Legend of Lu Zhen
series:tt6176636.description: To escape her cruel stepmother, Lu Zhen enters the palace and rises through the ranks with her pottery skills. Despite capturing the heart of Crown Prince Gao Zhan, social barriers and jealous enemies prevent their union. She dedicates herself to politics, helping him thwart a coup, and is eventually honored with the position of female prime minister.

series:tt11612380.name: The Story of Late Night
series:tt11612380.description: Tracking the history of late-night TV from its inception, featuring stories about hosts such as Johnny Carson, Jay Leno, David Letterman, O'Brien, Jimmy Fallon, Kimmel, Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert.

series:tt0370053.name: Walking with Cavemen
series:tt0370053.description: The great follow-up to 'Walking with Dinosaurs' and 'Walking with Beasts', presented by Professor Robert Winston, explains the story of human evolution.

series:tt1078267.name: Casualty 1907
series:tt1078267.description: Uses case notes, ward diaries and memoirs from archives at the Royal London Hospital in Whitechapel, to bring real doctors, nurses and patients from a Edwardian London hospital back to life.

series:tt5895684.name: Every Frame a Painting
series:tt5895684.description: Every Frame a Painting is dedicated to the analysis of film form.

series:tt13175494.name: Estonia - funnet som endrer alt
series:tt13175494.description: In 1994 MS Estonia cruise ferry sank in the baltic sea, this documentary reveals new information what actually might have happened on that stormy night.

series:tt12632132.name: The Great Seljuks
series:tt12632132.description: The war of the Great Seljuk Emperor, Meliksah and her loyalist, Sencer against Hasan Sabbah, who is sworn to destroy the Seljuks.

series:tt1242512.name: The Supersizers Go...
series:tt1242512.description: A comedienne and a humor writer try their hand at living in different eras. They dress, eat, and live the past. Before and after, their vitals are tested to see how these lifestyles affect their health.

series:tt9103932.name: Greatest Events of WWII in Colour
series:tt9103932.description: A series of colorized archive footage of important events during World War II.

series:tt2715024.name: Sesir profesora Koste Vujica
series:tt2715024.description: The story of german professor Kosta Vujic and his students:future famous.All set in 1885.

series:tt11342986.name: Legend of Fei
series:tt11342986.description: After growing up in a mountain stronghold created to oversee the martial arts world, Zhou Fei finally sets out to explore life beyond its walls. On her journey, she reunites with the enigmatic Xie Yun, and together they navigate a world of danger, secrets, and adventure across the martial arts realm.

series:tt11455654.name: Dead Mountain
series:tt11455654.description: In the Ural Mountains, nine students go on a ski hike, but never return. Local investigators must piece together what happened to them when their bodies are found a month later.

series:tt8917542.name: La Línea Invisible
series:tt8917542.description: Based on the birth of Basque terrorists group ETA and their first terror attack, of which military police member José Antonio Pardines was a victim.

series:tt14859224.name: Dirty Lines
series:tt14859224.description: The story of Dirty Lines starts in 1987's Amsterdam, at a time when Dutch society was changing rapidly. Psychology student Marly Salomon takes on a side job working for a brand new firm: Teledutch - a company started by two brothers, Frank and Ramon Stigter, who established Europe’s first erotic telephone lines. Frank and Ramon become rich overnight and Marly finds herself immersed in this wild and rapid transformation. The final years of the Cold War sparked a sense of hope and inspired a new generation to celebrate life to its fullest. Amsterdam became the center of that cultural revolution with a radically new form of music: house and a new love drug: XTC. The erotic phone lines offer the opportunity to experience anonymous sex in a new way, changing the morality of its consumers, but also very much the people creating it.

series:tt11947238.name: History's Greatest Mysteries
series:tt11947238.description: Investigating a range of mysteries surrounding the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell and John Wilkes Booth.

series:tt14504008.name: There Will Be People
series:tt14504008.description: The series is built in the form of saga and depicts the turbulent periods of the beginning of the 20th century through the eyes of ordinary people: the First World War, the revolution, the emergence of Soviet regime. Each of the characters faced the changes in their own way through their concept of truth. However, all of them shared fundamental desire to live, love and find their own place in the new era.

series:tt13317582.name: The Club
series:tt13317582.description: In cosmopolitan 1950s Istanbul, a mother with a troubled past works at a nightclub to reconnect with and help the rebellious daughter she couldn't raise.

series:tt13634686.name: River Where the Moon Rises
series:tt13634686.description: Born a princess and raised a soldier, Pyeong Gang is a woman with big dreams and limitless ambition. Determined to become the first Empress of Goguryeo, Pyeong Gang will stop at nothing to make her dream come true. Clever and level headed, Pyeong Gang is well aware of the obstacles that stand in her way and she’s more than capable of taking them on. With meticulous planning, she sets out to make her dream come true. But things take an unexpected turn, the day she meets On Dal.

series:tt13795432.name: The Rebel Princess
series:tt13795432.description: A princess trapped by prophecy and political intrigue finds love with her reluctant husband as they battle rebels and fight to protect their realm.

series:tt13973190.name: Can't Get You Out of My Head
series:tt13973190.description: Love, power, money, ghosts of empire, conspiracies, artificial intelligence and You. An emotional history of the modern world by Adam Curtis.

series:tt13773600.name: Rashash
series:tt13773600.description: Inspired by real events, the powerful series narrates the story of the notorious criminal of the same name in the 1980s, and the Saudi police’s efforts to bring him to justice.

series:tt3084140.name: Men of Anjolos
series:tt3084140.description: The story of six nobles and one sheepman who become Christian, run away from Romans to a cave where they will sleep 309 years, from Islamic view

series:tt8392956.name: Konak kod Hilmije
series:tt8392956.description: During WW2 in Sarajevo, tavern owner Hilmija navigates running his business with Serbian, Croatian, and Jewish coworkers while dealing with Nazi occupation, endangering his safety.

series:tt0108961.name: Time Team
series:tt0108961.description: A group of archaeologists have 3 days to discover historical artifacts in different sites around Britain.

series:tt1229401.name: Gary Unmarried
series:tt1229401.description: Newly divorced after fifteen years of marriage, Gary Brooks, a painting contractor, strives to balance work, shared custody of his two children, a controlling ex-wife, and his foxy new girlfriend.

series:tt1887491.name: Take Two with Phineas and Ferb
series:tt1887491.description: Animated characters Phineas and Ferb interview live-action celebrities on their talk show.

series:tt5231950.name: A Touch of Green

series:tt0090553.name: Zoobilee Zoo
series:tt0090553.description:
Zoobilee Zoo is an Emmy Award-winning children's television series featuring costumed performers dressed as animal characters. It originally aired from 1986–1987, then in syndication until 2001 on several television channels including commercial network television stations, public television stations, The Learning Channel, and the Hallmark Channel. Only 65 episodes of the original incarnation of the show were made. While it was in syndication for 15 years, it was no longer airing on television as of July 2011. The original 65 episodes are currently owned by Hallmark Properties and were produced by WQED Pittsburgh.

Generally the plot of each episode consists of the main characters, called Zoobles, encountering difficulties usually common to young children and then learning a moral lesson about dealing with such problems, such as being apprehensive of going to a doctor or learning to appreciate others. Each character has a certain gimmick in his behavior or interests that gives him a unique view on each problem faced. Mayor Ben, who usually appears at the beginnings and ends of each episode, calls the fans and viewers of the show Zoobaroos.

series:tt1389648.name: Kurozuka

In a forest, they come across a house and a strange woman by the name of Kuromitsu, who agrees to harbor them under one condition: that they do not peer into the inner chambers. Soon, they are attacked by the Red Army; they are searching for Kuromitsu, whose blood holds immortality. Fatally wounded, Kurou drinks some of Kuromitsu's blood and gains immortality along with strange abilities; but shortly after, Kurou is seemingly decapitated and wakes up centuries later in a ruined city. In this twisted future the Red Army is omnipresent and still searching for Kuromitsu’s blood, while a rebel army seeks to keep them from acquiring it. With threats at every turn and fueled by his obsession, Kurou sets forth to find Kuromitsu and seek his revenge on the Red Army.

HIM is a British three-part miniseries created by Andy de Emmony and Paula Milne for ITV. A supernatural drama, it stars Fionn Whitehead as the titular character, with supporting roles by Katherine Kelly and James Murray.

series:tt0324431.name: Veritas: The Quest
series:tt0324431.description: The show is about a group of relic hunters searching around the world for mysterious artifacts and their meaning.

series:tt12015466.name: 365: Repeat the Year
series:tt12015466.description:
A story where ten people get the chance to go back in time by one year, but unexpectedly mysterious situations start to arise when their fates are changed and twisted in the process.

Ji Hyung Joo is a detective in the violent crimes division. He used to be part of the traffic police but was promoted when he arrested a wanted criminal.

It's been seven years since the change, and he's a talented individual who always knows how to relax. Though he is happy at first to have the chance to go back in time by one year and "reset" his life, he begins to search for the truth when a series of mysterious events befall on the group of people he goes back in time with. Based on the Japanese novel, "Repeat"

series:tt11885790.name: Find Me in Your Memory
series:tt11885790.description: A deep connection forms between a news anchor who remembers every moment he's ever lived and an actress who's lost the memories of her past.

series:tt1524415.name: Spirited
series:tt1524415.description: A dentist Suzy meets the ghost of an 80s English rock star Henry Mallet.

series:tt2475848.name: Startling by Each Step
series:tt2475848.description: After a car accident plunges a woman into the dreamy Chinese past that gave the whole life in the Beijing imperial palace after that she returns to her life in the modern world.

series:tt5022298.name: Ice Fantasy
series:tt5022298.description: A fantasy story happens in a fictional universe. Ka Suo, the prince of the Snow Nation, takes the journey to the magical holy shrine with his entourages, and incidentally discover the secrets related to his fate and beloved ones.

series:tt1712150.name: SPEC ~ First Blood
series:tt1712150.description: An eccentric genius and a demoted special forces officer team up in Tokyo's Unidentified Crimes Unit to tackle criminals with supernatural abilities.

series:tt8174330.name: Raven
series:tt8174330.description: A police inspector is sent to his hometown to investigate a kidnap case, but apart from solving the mystery, he has to face the demons of his past.

series:tt0168326.name: Cupid
series:tt0168326.description: Trevor Hale is attractive, witty, and uncommonly intelligent--and he may be Cupid, the Greco-Roman god of erotic love. Probably not, but he thinks so. Trevor's insistence that he is Cupid lands him in a mental hospital, where he m...

series:tt3543634.name: Ängelby
series:tt3543634.description: Vera, a mother of two children, simultaneously loses her job and is left by her husband.

series:tt14045562.name: Mendirman Jaloliddin
series:tt14045562.description: Jalal al-Din Khwarazmshah, the ruler of the Khwarazmian Empire, initiated a tragic but united struggle against the Mongol invasion. After unsuccessful attempts by the Khwarazm shahs to stop the Mongol invasion that began in the Central Asian steppes, Jalal al-Din, the last ruler of the empire, put dynastic fights between Seljuks and Khwarazmians aside, and tried to establish a united front to stop the Mongols.

series:tt2069688.name: World War II in Colour
series:tt2069688.description: Recounts the events of world War II in color.

series:tt13381804.name: Once Upon a Time in Cyprus
series:tt13381804.description: The series takes place during the period of Bloody Christmas and depicts attacks carried out on Turkish Cypriots. It focuses on the activities of the Greek Cypriot nationalist group EOKA-B. The series is based on the island-wide violence that led to the civil war between Turkish and Greek Cypriots that ended in 1974.

series:tt1503278.name: Drunk History
series:tt1503278.description: The original sketches from Funny or Die where someone gets drunk and tries to recount a historical event.

series:tt14390970.name: The Long Ballad
series:tt14390970.description: After her family falls prey to political intrigue, Li Changge disguises herself to exact revenge and forms an alliance with tribal prince Ashina Sun.

series:tt13972246.name: Amend: The Fight for America
series:tt13972246.description: Will Smith hosts this look at the evolving, often lethal, fight for equal rights in America through the lens of the US Constitution's 14th Amendment.

series:tt11717010.name: Fall River
series:tt11717010.description: Re-investigation of the murder of three young women in 1979 - Fall River, MA.

series:tt15766736.name: The Center Seat: 55 Years of Star Trek
series:tt15766736.description: Chronicles rare and fascinating details of how "Star Trek" began, where it's been, and how it's going where no television series has gone before.

series:tt14236200.name: The Sword and the Brocade
series:tt14236200.description: Despite being born with low status, Luo Shiyiniang is extremely assertive and believes that a woman's vision should not be limited to the household. She hopes to rely on her embroidery skills as a ticket to freedom. However, the once-esteemed Luo family is in a state of decline. Hoping to save the clan through a marriage alliance, Shiyiniang is selected to become the wife of Yongping Duke and great general Xu Lingyi. Things were not easy for Shiyiniang due to the Xu family's biases towards her. Nonetheless, she manages to win their trust through her optimism and sincerity. Xu Lingyi also becomes attracted to Shiyiniang's various beautiful qualities such that husband and wife find love after marriage.

series:tt14322370.name: Nobleman Ryu’s Wedding
series:tt14322370.description: Ryu Ho Sun and Choi Hwa Jin are set to have arranged marriage, but she disappears during their wedding. Choi Ki Wan pretends and dresses up as a woman.

series:tt11173308.name: The Family
series:tt11173308.description: The story takes place around 2001, which follows the last 48 hours of Slobodan Milošević's life together with his family at large until his arrest and subsequent extradition to The Hague.

series:tt11507982.name: Legacy
series:tt11507982.description: The story of Alexander Münninghoff who is forced to dive into his dark family Nazi-history when convincing the love of his life Ellen to stay with him.

series:tt8682114.name: Pride
series:tt8682114.description: Six renowned LGBTQ+ directors explore heroic and heartbreaking stories that define America as a nation. The limited series spans the FBI surveillance of homosexuals during the 1950s Lavender Scare to the “Culture Wars” of the 1990s and beyond, exploring the queer legacy of the Civil Rights movement and the battle over marriage equality.

series:tt13156316.name: The Sons of Sam: A Descent into Darkness
series:tt13156316.description: The Son of Sam case grew into a lifelong obsession for journalist Maury Terry, who became convinced that the murders were linked to a satanic cult.

series:tt14540468.name: High on the Hog: How African American Cuisine Transformed America
series:tt14540468.description: Black food is American food. Chef and writer Stephen Satterfield traces the delicious, moving throughlines from Africa to Texas in this docuseries.

series:tt16924358.name: One and Only
series:tt16924358.description: Zhou Sheng Chen was raised by his brother, the Emperor, until the age of thirteen, when he set out to defend the border and establish himself as a loyal and accomplished general. Cui Shi Yi, the well-read daughter of an esteemed family, has been betrothed to the Crown Prince since birth. However, political scheming and tragic events result in Cui Shi Yi falling mute, her former fiance becoming a child Emperor, and Zhou Sheng Chen returning to the capital amidst a cloud of political turmoil.

series:tt14719590.name: Somos.
series:tt14719590.description: The lives of the people of Allende, a Mexican border town, are overtaken by a powerful cartel's operations, leading to tragedy. Inspired by true events.

series:tt11069436.name: Behind the Attraction
series:tt11069436.description: Explore the history of how popular Disney attractions and destinations came to be, how they have changed over time and how fans continue to obsess over them.

series:tt16527564.name: Luoyang
series:tt16527564.description: Gao Bingzhu, wrongly accused, teams up with Baili Hongyi to investigate his father's poisoning and Wu Siyue's case. Despite class differences and initial clashes, they uncover a sinister conspiracy that could destroy the city.

series:tt0108956.name: World War II: When Lions Roared
series:tt0108956.description: As the Nazi war machine stood poised to invade and vanquish every corner of Europe in the Second World War, the fragile alliance formed between Franklin D. Roosevelt, Winston Churchill, and Joseph Stalin proved to be of pivotal im...

series:tt14821384.name: History of the Sitcom
series:tt14821384.description: Examines how sitcoms have evolved to reflect the changing face of American families.

series:tt15157576.name: Once Upon a Time in Iran
series:tt15157576.description: It is the story of a family on the first of September 1941, which undergoes changes during the occupation of Iran by the Allies.

series:tt14550060.name: Sparking Joy with Marie Kondo
series:tt14550060.description: In this reality series, Marie Kondo brings her joyful tidying tactics to people struggling to balance work and home life and shares her own world.

series:tt15181018.name: Secret Royal Inspector & Joy
series:tt15181018.description: A secret royal inspector works as an undercover official who inspects local provinces to expose corruption. He teams up with a lady who is searching for happiness by getting divorced with her current husband. The duo then go on a grand scheme to discover the truth and find corruptions.

series:tt15267458.name: Stand By Me
series:tt15267458.description: Set in the late Tang Dynasty during Emperor Wenzong's reign, powerful eunuchs control the court. An attempted coup to overthrow the influential eunuch Qiu Ziliang fails, leading Qiu to order the massacre of Prime Minister Wang Yang’s family. Two granddaughters escape, but they are separated. Seven years later, the new emperor, Qi Yan, establishes the Purple Clothes Bureau to confront his godfather, Qiu Ziliang. Now grown, the sisters return under new identities: Qiu Yanzhi as Qiu Ziliang’s adopted daughter and Chen Ruoyun as Qi Yan’s sword-bearer. Although on opposing sides, both seek to dismantle Qiu Ziliang’s power and restore balance to the Tang Dynasty.

series:tt15122138.name: Stephen
series:tt15122138.description: Follows the Lawrences and their quest for justice 18 years after the death of Stephen Lawrence.

series:tt14473896.name: Barbaroslar
series:tt14473896.description: Barbaroslar: Sword of the Mediterranean will take viewers on a historic journey across the Ottoman Empire based on the life of 16th-century Ottoman admiral "Barbaros" Hayreddin Pasha and the adventures of four brothers who become seafarers. The drama series retells this adventure through the stories of four brothers; Ishak, Oruc, Hizir, and Ilyas, fighting high tides and the secrets of the seas. It focuses on their pursuit of a holy secret with the help of Master Suleyman, and during the course of their journey, they make enemies in, Pietro; the Pope's hand reaching out to the Mediterranean who is also pursuing the secret and organizes an attack against their ship. But this doesn't stop the brothers and they continue their original quest to find the holy secret all the while fighting their enemies at high tides.

series:tt15262600.name: Fever Pitch: The Rise of the Premier League
series:tt15262600.description: Once upon a time, football was just a game... From those who lived it, and those who made the beautiful game a billion pound business. The goals, the glamour, the glory.

series:tt15353550.name: The Heike Story
series:tt15353550.description: A young orphan named Biwa is taken in by the powerful Taira Clan—also known as the Heike—after their leader witnesses her extraordinary psychic abilities. Unfortunately, what she predicts is a future of bloodshed, violence, and civil war. Inspired by the 12th-century epic tale Heike Monogatari.

series:tt15087526.name: Alparslan: The Great Seljuks
series:tt15087526.description: It deals with the state structure, political events, wars of the Great Seljuk Empire and the life of Sultan Alparslan.

series:tt14872600.name: Aziz
series:tt14872600.description: Aziz Payidar, the son of the Payidar family, the largest and only carpet manufacturer in Antakya, leads a prosperous and wealthy life. Aziz's fate changes when he kills the French delegate Monsieur Pierre's son, Lieutenant Andre. He is forced to leave behind the land of his birth, his only love, in short, everything he has. Two years later, when he is thought to be dead, his return is unexpected for everyone. Nothing is the same anymore. Not only did Aziz lose everything he owned, but Antakya, which is now under French occupation, became worse than before he left. Moreover, his first love Dilruba is engaged to his uncle Galip Payidar's son Adem. He will be in a dilemma emotionally when Efnan, a simple peasant girl, unexpectedly enters his life, and after the intense emotional turmoil he experiences, he will find both himself and his true love over time.

series:tt15484900.name: The Raincoat Killer: Chasing a Predator in Korea
series:tt15484900.description: Follows a serial killer who came to light as a psychopath to the Korean public in 2004.

series:tt14676562.name: The Gallows Pole
series:tt14676562.description: Follows Hartley as he assembles a gang of weavers and land-workers for a criminal enterprise that will capsize the economy and become the biggest fraud in British history.

series:tt14779804.name: The Warrior Princess
series:tt14779804.description: The epic love between Akkiz, the legendary warrior mountain girl orphaned by Gök Khan Korkut Khan in the harsh steppes of Central Asia, and Gök Tegini Batuga, who was orphaned by Korkut Khan in the Gök Palace during Gokturk Khaganate.

series:tt1733412.name: Nepobedivo srce
series:tt1733412.description: Serbian television series filmed in 2010, produced by Radio Television of Serbia and Kosutnjak film, based on the novel by Milica Jakovljevic.

series:tt20772270.name: Room 207
series:tt20772270.description: Upon starting his post as a hotel receptionist, Gamal hears the rumors about the mysterious Room 207 and finds himself obsessed with discovering the truth.

series:tt14881288.name: Stories to Stay Awake
series:tt14881288.description: "Historias Para No Dormir" is four independent horror stories that pay tribute to the classic format of Narciso Ibáñez Serrador, directed by and starring well known names in Spanish cinema.

series:tt22797236.name: Red Iron Road
series:tt22797236.description: Red Iron Road is an animated horror anthology series, based on the works of famous European authors. Each of the episodes are between 10-20 minutes, produced with different creative partners in unique visual styles to suit each story.

series:tt16676408.name: Blood Curse
series:tt16676408.description: A young woman witnessing black magic attack on her family which changes her view towards the world. Driven to protect them at any cost, the woman will go to the ends of the earth to find out who is responsible and hold them to account.

series:tt0075882.name: Count Dracula
series:tt0075882.description: Count Dracula is a British television adaptation of the novel Dracula by Bram Stoker. It first aired 22 December 1977. It is among the more faithful of the many adaptations of the original book. Louis Jourdan played the title role.

series:tt18926116.name: Fear the Walking Dead: Dead in the Water
series:tt18926116.description: Riley is serving as a weapons officer aboard the USS Pennsylvania near the Gulf of Mexico when a mysterious outbreak forces the crew to strategize a way off the sub before it becomes their tomb, in this prequel to Fear the Walking Dead.

series:tt21844490.name: Dark Gathering
series:tt21844490.description: A withdrawn college kid with psychic powers teams up with a strange little girl who's searching for her dead mother's abducted soul.

series:tt22696582.name: Delete
series:tt22696582.description: A complicated relationship with secrets to hide, and a grim question to ponder: who do you want to delete from your life?

series:tt22336786.name: Kohlrabenschwarz
series:tt22336786.description: The focus is on the psychologist Stefan Schwab, who after overwork, burnout and divorce is actually just looking for the proverbial “Boarische Rua” ("Bavarian peace") in the tranquil foothills of the Alps. However, this wish is not fulfilled; instead, he is reluctantly drawn into the bloody awakening of ancient legends: children disappear, “sinners” are murdered and archaic legends suddenly take on a deadly relevance.

series:tt0403783.name: Master i Margarita
series:tt0403783.description: The devil and his attendants visit Moscow at the times of the Stalin regime. Official atheistic ideology confronts with a series of supernatural events.

series:tt23874798.name: Enigma
series:tt23874798.description: There is something wrong with Fa's high school, strange events have been happening around her. In which way is it related to the new teacher, Ajin?

series:tt14226626.name: The Burning Girls
series:tt14226626.description: A reverend and her daughter start a new life in a village that soon reveals its community's dark history and where ancient superstitions and mistrust of outsiders are quite common.

series:tt22169620.name: Memento Mori
series:tt22169620.description: Explores the relationship between a murderer and a police officer, who pursues him in a duel of life or death. Carapocha helps the policeman.

series:tt28754301.name: Living for the Dead
series:tt28754301.description: Five amazing gay ghost hunters travel the country saving the living by repairing the dead.

series:tt6203010.name: Fear the Walking Dead: Passage
series:tt6203010.description: A fearsome survivor agrees to help an injured woman in exchange for apocalyptic sanctuary.

series:tt23739418.name: The Other Side
series:tt23739418.description: Nacho Nieto, a journalist specialized in the paranormal, is going through his worst professional and personal moment. At this moment, perhaps the most important paranormal case of recent years crosses his life.

series:tt27690974.name: Darker Passages
series:tt27690974.description: Continuing with the exploration of lesser known supernatural events, unsolved mysteries, and urban legends.

series:tt0070074.name: Frankenstein: The True Story
series:tt0070074.description: Victor Frankenstein witnesses his creation turn uncontrollable after he's duped by his associate, Dr. Polidori.

series:tt26006612.name: Zomvivor
series:tt26006612.description: When an apocalyptic virus that turns people into zombies ravages a city, a group of students take shelter in a school and fight to survive.

series:tt27518944.name: Styx
series:tt27518944.description: The series is a mysterious crime series with a horror twist and is based on the international bestseller by Bavo Dhooge. Styx is a corrupt policeman whose body washes up on the beach. He opens his eyes, but he can't feel a pulse anymore.

series:tt32237678.name: Goddess Bless You from Death
series:tt32237678.description: A gifted young man and a rational detective investigate brutal forest murders, uncovering ancient beliefs and dangers that defy all logic.

series:tt1830238.name: Salad Fingers
series:tt1830238.description: The surreal life of Salad Fingers, an unknown creature living in an apocalyptic wasteland.

series:tt11408218.name: Kouklotheatro
series:tt11408218.description: Kouklotheatro is a mini-series of short episodes, which takes advantage of the interaction that YouTube offers, between the creators and the audience. In this series, it is you, the viewers, who will determine the course of the story. Not just with predetermined choices (A or B), but you will take the whole plot in your hands. You, then, will give the background of the characters, add new characters, "write" the next events. The project is difficult and ambitious, but we want to dare it. The puppets are in your hands now...

series:tt1068433.name: When They Cry: Kai
series:tt1068433.description: In this continuation of the hit horror anime, secrets are revealed as Rika Furude desperately attempts to save Hinamizawa and her friends from their tragic fate

series:tt33334940.name: Black Paintings
series:tt33334940.description: A young schoolgirl, brutally murdered. A country town, full of secrets and lies. A ruthless killer who uses a chilling pattern. A race to catch him, before he strikes again...

series:tt33292398.name: Spectral Shadows
series:tt33292398.description: This five-part docuseries explores the facts and fiction behind the world's most creepy, strange and inexplicable legends, mysteries, and creatures. From Japanese horror to tales of Cryptids and the supernatural, Spectral Shadows delves deep for answers.

series:tt6390600.name: Perfect Days
series:tt6390600.description: Téo, a solitary medical student burdened by the care of his paraplegic mother, becomes infatuated with Clarice, an aspiring screenwriter he meets at a barbecue. When she rejects his advances, he resorts to an extreme measure: drugging and kidnapping her. He forces Clarice—sedated and trapped as his passenger—on a road trip through the very locations she scripted in her screenplay, attempting to awaken her love through repetition and manipulation.

series:tt36919952.name: Three Mirrors Creature's Flashes of Flesh
series:tt36919952.description: Days in the life of Dangel Fox, a surefire, relentless, top financial manager. Until she is confronted with her daimon and, pervaded by a sensory spirit, embarks on a piercing and purifying journey.

series:tt5244362.name: Blood Cruise
series:tt5244362.description: Ordinary booze-cruise between Sweden and Finland turns into a terrifying events,  when the ferry is suddenly cut off from the outside world. There is no way to contact the mainland and nowhere to escape.

series:tt35683797.name: Mamnik
series:tt35683797.description:
In the village of Vrakola, nestled in the Tran region, mysterious and unexplainable events unfold. People are found murdered in bizarre ways, while others wake up with peculiar marks on their bodies resembling bird claw prints. A sinister, inhuman force seems to have descended upon the village.

Amid the chaos, Emil Slavov, a resident of a nursing home, teams up with border officers Bozhana Gorneva and her colleague Mitko to investigate these chilling occurrences. Their search uncovers long-buried secrets from the past and brings them face-to-face with the "Mamnik" – a demonic bird from Bulgarian folklore.

As the darkness deepens, Emil’s son, Delyan Slavov, mysteriously vanishes. Joining the fight against the evil are Dana, a vrazhalitsa with mystical knowledge, and Lazar Karaivanov, a platenik – a resurrected soul with unfinished business in the mortal world.

Prepare to delve into a world of folklore, mystery, and suspense in this gripping tale of the supernatural!

series:tt10949454.name: Outer Wilds
series:tt10949454.description: A critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

series:tt7415686.name: The Kill Count
series:tt7415686.description: Hosted by James A. Janisse, venture into the world of horror to discover the lives taken throughout centuries of horror films.

series:tt0118350.name: Intensity
series:tt0118350.description: Chyna Shepherd is a 26-year-old psychology student who survived an extremely troubled past. While spending Thanksgiving at the home of her friend Laura's family, a farm in the Napa Valley, she finds herself in the clutches of a disturbed serial killer.

series:tt12429024.name: The Magnus Archives
series:tt12429024.description: The Magnus Archives is a weekly horror fiction anthology examining the mysteries within the archives of London based The Magnus Institute, an organization dedicated to documenting and researching the esoteric and the weird. New head archivist Jonathan Sims attempts to organize and record a collection of seemingly unconnected statements of mysteries, supernatural and the occult, converting them to audio and supplementing them with follow-up work from his dedicated archival team. Individually the statements within the archives are unsettling. Together they begin to form a clear and disturbing picture. As you look deeper in to the archives something stares back.

series:tt9089912.name: The comedian
series:tt9089912.description: A stand-up comedian incorporates details about people he knows into his routines, unaware that every joke results in someone being erased from existence.

series:tt8836798.name: Local 58
series:tt8836798.description: A series of horror shorts all under the banner of the mysterious 'Local 58' channel.

series:tt2022190.name: The Walking Dead: Webisodes
series:tt2022190.description: Follow the path of the red-handled weapon used by Rick Grimes to kill Terminus leader Gareth; from its innocent beginnings on a hardware store shelf at the start of the apocalypse into the hands of various survivors, familiar and ...

series:tt12245638.name: Ordem Paranormal
series:tt12245638.description: Living double lives, Ordo Realitas agents spread around the world, secretly investigate and prevent the paranormal from being formed, fighting against those who only want to wreak havoc in the world.

series:tt6353134.name: Seven First Kisses
series:tt6353134.description: Min Soo Jin meets a goddess who allows her to choose one guy among seven as her first kiss.

series:tt0937403.name: Kamen Rider: Dragon Knight
series:tt0937403.description: In a parallel realm, warlord Xaviax ravages Ventara. Wing Knight, a surviving Kamen Rider, brings Advent Decks to Earth where Xaviax creates evil Riders. Kit Taylor becomes Dragon Knight, allying with Wing Knight to defeat Xaviax.

series:tt0300859.name: Mrs. Pepper Pot
series:tt0300859.description: Mrs. Pepper Pot lives in a small village with her husband, and enjoys a unique life because she has a small magic spoon that helps her reduce her size, and during that, Mrs. Pepper Pot embarks on a series of adventures during which she communicates with animals easily.

series:tt5260254.name: The Wizards of Aus
series:tt5260254.description: Fed up with the Magical Realm's obsession with large-scale fantasy warfare, Jack the Wizard decides to migrate to the sanest place he can think of: Melbourne's Western suburbs. After accidentally causing Flinders Street Station to turn ever so slightly into a giant Fish monster, his existence (and that of his fellow magical immigrants) is revealed to the Australian public. Fearing a backlash against himself and his kind, Jack swears off using magic in a bid to better assimilate into human life. But of course, fitting in was never going to be easy when people tend to get a bit 'explode-y' whenever you sneeze...

series:tt11534210.name: The Game: Towards Zero
series:tt11534210.description: Tae Pyeong is a prophet. When he looks into someone's eye, he can see the moment right before they die. Tae Pyeong is smart, rich and handsome. Despite his special ability, he is a bright person. A mysterious serial murder case draws Tae Pyeong's attention. He partners with Detective Joon Young to solve the string of murders.

series:tt4216878.name: Absolute Duo
series:tt4216878.description: This is the story of Tooru Kokonoe who has enrolled at Kouryou Academy, a school which trains students in wielding Blaze, soul powered weapons to prepare them for the Dorn Agency's special peacekeeping corps. When Tooru is partnered with a mysterious girl: Julie Sigtuna, he finds he has to overcome many hurdles to ensure their teamwork and fighting skills are up to par for the duration of their training.

series:tt0285368.name: Ghost Stories
series:tt0285368.description: A group of school kids and a possessed cat fight ghosts in their neighborhood.

series:tt9225320.name: Radiant
series:tt9225320.description: Aspiring sorcerer Seth seeks power to vanquish Némésis monsters. He angers villagers with recklessness until a Némésis attack prompts a quest to their lair, the Radiant, making allies and overcoming obstacles.

series:tt2320220.name: Kamisama Kiss
series:tt2320220.description: Nanami is left homeless after her father runs away due to debts. When she saves a man named Mikage from dogs, he gives her his house which turns out to be a shrine and she becomes the new deity.

series:tt5621006.name: Flying Witch
series:tt5621006.description: Young witch Makoto moves to the beautiful countryside to live with her distant relatives and study witchcraft.

series:tt5334364.name: Undefeated Bahamut Chronicle
series:tt5334364.description: Lux, the former prince of Arcadia, accidentally enters the bathing area of a female dormitory, where he sees the kingdom's new princess, Lisesharte, naked, which provokes her wrath.

series:tt2942202.name: Unbreakable Machine Doll
series:tt2942202.description: During the early 20th century, along with technological advancements, scientists were able to develop sophisticated magic. The combination of science and sorcery was Makinot, circuits made from spells that were put into objects to...

series:tt11131980.name: Nobody's Looking
series:tt11131980.description: A new guardian "angelus" uncovers a secret behind the Angelus System's bureaucracy that leads him to break its official rules about protecting humans.

series:tt12312004.name: Monster Girl Doctor
series:tt12312004.description: In the town of Lindworm where monsters and humans coexist, Dr. Glenn runs an exemplary medical clinic for monster girls with his lamia assistant, Sapphee. Whether receiving a marriage proposal by a centaur injured in battle, palpating the injury of a mermaid, or suturing the delicate wounds of a flesh golem, Dr. Glenn performs his job with grace and confidence. But when an unsavory character seeks to steal a harpy egg, how will the unflappable Dr. Glenn respond...?

series:tt8228732.name: Kakuriyo: Bed & Breakfast for Spirits
series:tt8228732.description: A young girl with the ability to see ayakashi is sent to another realm to repay her grandfather's debt and marry an ogre.

series:tt9050480.name: IRODUKU: The World in Colors
series:tt9050480.description: Hitomi Tsukishiro may be the child of a family of witches, but after losing her ability to see color, she also lost her sense of magic. Nothing has helped her regain that gift until Hitomi's grandmother sends her back in time to 2...

series:tt3147316.name: Deadbeat
series:tt3147316.description: Kevin is a medium for hire, who attempts to solve various ghosts' unresolved problems, so that they can move on to a final resting place, occasionally with the help of his best friend and drug dealer, Roofie.

series:tt7224994.name: Restaurant to Another World
series:tt7224994.description: A chef runs a restaurant that serves as a Portal between our World & a Fantasy land every 7 Days, where he serves Western Style Food to Elves, Demons, Dragons & more.

series:tt5321046.name: Myriad Colors Phantom World
series:tt5321046.description: In the near future, in a world born of human imagination, what humans would call ghosts or monsters appear, and they come to be called "phantoms." Haruhiko Ichijō, is a first year at Hosea Academy along with his upperclassman Mai Kawakami, who fights phantoms with the ability "Spirit of Five Elements," Reina Izumi, who has the ability "Phantom Eater," and Koito Minase, who fights phantoms in solitude. They experience the ups and downs of high school life before a certain incident leads them to the truth of this world.

series:tt6185782.name: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
series:tt6185782.description: Office worker Kobayashi's boring life changes after she drunkenly saves a dragon. To pay her back, Tohru takes human form and becomes her maid.

series:tt0315081.name: Tripping the Rift
series:tt0315081.description: CGI sci-fi comedy series set in universe divided between Confederation and Dark Clown Empire. Follows outlaw group led by Chode aboard Spaceship Bob evading both powers while pursuing schemes in lawless "Rift" border region.

series:tt9050366.name: Karakuri Circus
series:tt9050366.description: The protagonist, Masaru, has just inherited a big fortune after the death of his father. However, people are trying to get their hands on it by any means necessary, even if it means killing him. Narumi helps Masaru from being kidn...

series:tt6064882.name: Room 104
series:tt6064882.description: Anthology series set in room 104 of a seemingly average American motel, each time telling a different story of the assorted guests who pass through, which can range from funny and fantastical to dramatic and horrifying.

series:tt6755926.name: Re:Creators
series:tt6755926.description: Humans have created many stories. Joy, sadness, anger, deep emotion. Stories shake our emotions, and fascinate us. However, these are only the thoughts of bystanders. But what if the characters in the story have "intentions"? To them, are we god-like existences for bringing their story into the world? Our world is changed. Mete out punishment upon the realm of the gods. In Re:CREATORS, everyone becomes a Creator.

series:tt0207919.name: Relic Hunter
series:tt0207919.description: History Professor Sydney Fox and her linguistic assistant Nigel recover ancient artifacts from around the world, while battling rival hunters.

series:tt8844798.name: La Dernière Vague
series:tt8844798.description: In Brizan, a peaceful seaside resort in the Landes, everything changes with the arrival of a first Wave  : a surge of clouds which will cause the disappearance of surfers. The first in a series of phenomena that the inhabitants of this small community will be confronted with, disrupting their intimate lives.

series:tt7573686.name: Erased
series:tt7573686.description: After finding his mom killed, Satoru's time-traveling ability takes him back 18 years for a chance to prevent her death and those of three classmates.

series:tt4302062.name: Paradise City
series:tt4302062.description: The lives of a rock star who seems to have it all and a young rookie kid who idolizes him collide through their broken homes built by the music business.

series:tt2269368.name: Aesthetica of a Rogue Hero
series:tt2269368.description: After saving a fairy-tale kingdom, Akatsuki returns to the real world with his prize--Miu, the busty daughter of the Demon King. It's one hell of a happy ending until they're force to enroll at a school for magic users.

series:tt5066664.name: Cannon Busters
series:tt5066664.description: Explore fantastic land of Gearbolt as we follow a motley crew of travelers on an unforgettable journey to reunite 2 best friends.

series:tt0233084.name: My Hero
series:tt0233084.description: Thermoman is a multiple-powered superhero who originates from the planet Ultron. In an attempt to do his best to fit in with life on earth, he creates the human alias of George Sunday.

series:tt4266154.name: Hybrid Child
series:tt4266154.description: The Hybrid Child is an amazing doll that can grow if it is lavished with enough love and care from its owner. Neither fully machine nor fully human, the various Hybrid Child models develop strong emotional bonds with their owners.

series:tt0280347.name: Vampire High
series:tt0280347.description: Young vampires are taken in by a boarding school that also houses mortal teens. Problems face both sets of students, incl. typical issues of love, friends & enemies. Prof Murdoch is on hand to help, but he has problems of his own.

series:tt3448272.name: Kamigami no asobi
series:tt3448272.description: Yui must teach detached gods to understand human emotions before the school year is over,or Yui and the gods will be stuck in school forever.

series:tt0807675.name: Girls Bravo
series:tt0807675.description: Yukinari is allergic to girls except Miharu, a cheerful girl from a female-dominated realm. When she becomes his roommate, their escapades take them to suggestive places.

series:tt0092448.name: The Secret of the Sahara
series:tt0092448.description: In 1925, Desmond Jordan, an American archaeologist, tries to find the mysterious Speaking Mountain that is supposed to be in the middle of the Sahara desert, where he meets a bunch of deserters from the French Foreign Legion, who are pursued by the ruthless Lieutenant Ryker.

series:tt5033322.name: The Journey of Flower
series:tt5033322.description: Born under an ominous star with a mysterious scent that attracts demons, a young woman sets out to find a master who can teach her to protect herself from the supernatural forces drawn to her.

series:tt16348586.name: Attack on Pearl Harbor: Minute by Minute
series:tt16348586.description: Covers the 1941 Japanese military strike on a Hawaiian naval base in never before seen detail.

series:tt16027926.name: Crime Scene: The Times Square Killer
series:tt16027926.description: In 1970s NYC, the "Torso Killer" preys on women to fulfill his grotesque fantasies while eluding police. A docuseries dive into crime's darkest places.

series:tt16477402.name: WWII in Color: Road to Victory
