series:tt43730117.description: Following the Pahalgam terror attack in April, India's military leadership deliberates and plans Operation Sindoor, an 88-hour military operation launched on May 7, featuring accounts from operatives and experts.

series:tt1312203.name: 102 Minutes That Changed America
series:tt1312203.description:
102 Minutes That Changed America is a 102-minute American television special documentary film that was produced by the History channel and premiered commercial-free on September 11, 2008, marking the seventh anniversary of the 2001 attacks. The film depicts, in virtually real time, the New York-based events of the attacks primarily using raw footage from mostly amateur citizen journalists. The documentary is accompanied by an 18-minute documentary short called I-Witness to 9/11, which features interviews with nine firsthand eyewitnesses who captured the footage on camera.

According to this film, most of the archival footage was in possession of the U.S. government but was released to History years after 9/11. The documentary film attracted 5.2 million viewers. The program aired on Channel 4 in the UK, France 3 in France, History Channel in Brazil on 7 September 2009, SBS6, in the Netherlands on 9 September 2009 and on ZDF in 2009 and 2010. A&E Television Networks, parent company of History, aired it across all of their cable networks on September 11, 2011 at 8:46 a.m. EDT, the exact time American Airlines Flight 11 crashed into 1 World Trade Center ten years earlier.

series:tt2309788.name: The Gatekeepers
series:tt2309788.description: A five episode special edition of the documentary film by director Dror Moreh, featuring the story of the Israeli Palestinian conflict from the point of view of six former heads of the Shin Bet, Israel's secret service whose activities and membership are closely held state secrets.

series:tt15021430.name: The Great Shaman Ga Doo-shim
series:tt15021430.description:
18-year-old Ga Doo Shim who wishes to live as a typical high schooler but is born with the undesired fate of becoming a shaman. She is a brave and strong character who will fight evil spirits as she works on solving mysterious cases.

Na Woo Soo, a nearly perfect high schooler with a wealthy background, handsome looks, and outstanding grades. When Ga Doo Shim suddenly appears in his life, he gains the ability to see evil spirits, and the two get entangled in mysterious cases together.

series:tt0088693.name: Alice in Wonderland
series:tt0088693.description: Alice is in Looking Glass Land, where she meets many creatures and attempts to avoid the Jabberwocky (Tom McLoughlin), a monster that appears due to her being afraid.

series:tt0233044.name: Dinotopia
series:tt0233044.description: After a plane crash, two opposing half-brothers find themselves on an amazing lost island where enlightened pacifist humans and intelligent talking dinosaurs have created a utopian medieval society. But imminent disaster approaches.

series:tt21081006.name: Jinxed at First
series:tt21081006.description: A cursed fishmonger meets the mysterious woman who changed his fate, sparking a thrilling journey of destiny, escape, and unexpected connection.

series:tt15387774.name: Scaredy Cats
series:tt15387774.description: Searching for answers about a beloved amulet, three friends shape-shift into cats and explore a wicked world of thrilling and not-so-chilling adventures.

series:tt13891870.name: Disney Intertwined
series:tt13891870.description: Allegra dreams of joining the Eleven O' Clock music hall company, but her mother, Caterina, won't accept that. Allegra's life changes drastically when she finds a mysterious bracelet that takes her to 1994, the year Caterina was her age and was starting her career in Eleven O' Clock while she lived in Coco's shadow. Cocó is Allegra's grandmother. Will Allegra be able to change the past?

series:tt21337664.name: Immortal Samsara
series:tt21337664.description: Yan Dan is the only descendant of an ancient tribe, the four-leaf scorpion. Since ancient times, her whole body has been a treasure of medicine. She and her twin sister Zhixi were able to cultivate into human form at the Queen Mother's Feast a hundred years in advance and encountered the biggest trial in her life - the love trial. She fell in love with Lord Ying Yuan but had to spend the next 800 years forgetting him. However, at this time, Yu Mo suddenly entered her life, and become her great support. Every day, Yu Mo takes Yan Dan out to do good deeds. One day while they were punishing evil, they meet Lord Ying Yuan's current reincarnation, Tang Zhou, who is currently a demon hunter. They help Tang Zhou search for the four ancient artifacts, and also discover a mysterious secret.

series:tt20602820.name: The Blue Whisper
series:tt20602820.description: Ji Yunhe possesses the rare ability to tame demons, but she is confined to the Demon Valley by strict imperial laws. Her life takes an unexpected turn when Chang Yi, a merman, is brought to her by a cruel princess. The princess orders Yunhe to give Chang Yi human speech and legs, forcing him to pledge loyalty. As Yunhe grows sympathetic toward the merman and falls for him, she longs to set him free. But helping him may come at a great cost, putting both their lives in danger.

series:tt15533960.name: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss
series:tt15533960.description: A doomed villainess in a dating game realizes her fate and role, and seeks to prevent her doom by romantically connecting with the game's other villain.

series:tt27460313.name: The Longest Promise
series:tt27460313.description: Bound by destiny, a banished prince becomes a teacher to a strong-minded princess - until fate makes them enemies amidst dangerous power struggles.

series:tt15358618.name: The Canterville Ghost
series:tt15358618.description: Follows a tech billionaire who buys Canterville Chase, unaware that the contents include a malevolent family ghost, who has been haunting the premises for centuries.

series:tt16255458.name: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs
series:tt16255458.description: A young man is transported into a video game world dominated by females.

series:tt27845099.name: Reign of the Seven Spellblades
series:tt27845099.description: Follows Oliver Horn as he enters a prestigious magic school named Kimberly. He discovers that not everything is as it seems, with the emergence of labyrinths, monsters, and other threats that endanger the students.

series:tt16282794.name: Tinted with You
series:tt16282794.description: A time-traveling art student becomes the exiled Crown Prince's lifeline in a dangerous royal struggle where love might be his only chance of survival.

series:tt16765650.name: Penultimate Instance
series:tt16765650.description: Maxim and Valentina work in the Department for the Distribution of Souls — 24 hours before the death of a person, they must determine where he will go — to hell or heaven. And since both are guaranteed paradise under an employment contract, Maxim is trying to earn extra money and sell a place in paradise to oligarchs, and Valentina dreams of returning her husband from hell.

series:tt17520694.name: Mood
series:tt17520694.description: Sasha, a 25-year-old wannabe singer and rapper thrown out of home, but right now she’s a bedroom artist spending her days smoking weed, stalking her ex-boyfriend on social media and avoiding her family.

series:tt13424004.name: Christian
series:tt13424004.description: Christian lives in a "city-palace" where he earns his living doing dirty work for LINO, the criminal boss of neighborhood. When stigmata appear on his hands, Christian finds physically impossible to carry out his work, but also discovers he has gained mysterious healing powers to fight against Lino. But MATTEO, a mysterious Vatican postulator in search of signs and confirmations, is tracking him down bringing too close to a truth that could upset his life and that of the whole world.

series:tt30241060.name: My Man Is Cupid
series:tt30241060.description: Star-crossed love story between a love fairy and a human girl. For humans and fairies aren’t meant to be, when he accidentally shoots himself and falls in love, their fate takes a wrong turn. The two reconnect after centuries of reincarnation. Where will this story lead?

series:tt17023468.name: Kissable Lips
series:tt17023468.description: Jun Ho is a vampire who is about to die. To survive, he will need to drink pure blood and thus become a human. One day, while searching for this pureblood, he meets Min Hyun, a human with pure blood. But another vampire named Hae Soo, who knows about Jun Ho's past traumas, causes Min Hyun and Jun Ho to fall out.

series:tt18566706.name: Immoral Guild
series:tt18566706.description: The story follows the skilled hunter Kikuru Madan, who has decided to retire out of fear of wasting his youth. One day, a guild staff member suggests that he go on a quest with a new female martial artist named Hitamu Kyan.

series:tt23056522.name: The Starry Love
series:tt23056522.description: The queen of the human tribe gave birth to twin girls. Respected by the entire tribe, the older sister Qing Kui, who is gentle and kind, is betrothed to the heavenly prince. The younger sister, Ye Tan, smart and cunning, shunned by her own people, is betrothed to the demon prince. Due to a mix-up, the two sisters are married off to the wrong husbands. It paves the way for two beautiful romances and also ignites a conspiracy that shakes the four realms.

series:tt19244410.name: Level 1 Demon Lord and One Room Hero
series:tt19244410.description: A hero defeats a demon in a great battle. Years later, the demon revives as a child, and finds the hero is now a loser. Now both must work together to revive their former glory.

series:tt19223420.name: Farming Life in Another World
series:tt19223420.description: When a godlike figure gives Hiraku a chance to live again, he wishes to be healthy, to live peacefully, to speak the local language, and to spend his days on an idyllic farm.

series:tt21197084.name: Raven of the Inner Palace
series:tt21197084.description: The Raven Consort is a special consort living deep in the inner palace who, despite her title, does not perform nighttime duties for the emperor. Some who have seen her say she has the appearance of an old woman, while others describe her as a young girl. The Raven Consort's name is Shouxue. She can use mysterious arts and will accept any favor asked of her, whether it is to find something lost or to curse someone to death. The current emperor, Gaojun, visits her one night to ask a favor. Their meeting exposes a secret that will turn history on its head...

series:tt20235634.name: Kiss Sixth Sense
series:tt20235634.description: Hong Ye-sul, a competent account executive at an advertising company, has one secret— she can see the future when her lips come into contact with another person. When Ye-sul accidentally kisses her stern team chief Cha Min-hu, she sees the impossible: herself in bed with him some time in the future. To add to her confusion and frustration, her ex-boyfriend Lee Pil-yo is attempting to win back her heart, shaking her life up even more.

series:tt21929436.name: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts
series:tt21929436.description: One hundred years ago, a grave tradition was born in a land where demons live among people: a human must be sacrificed to the King of Beasts. But when Sariphi, the 99th sacrifice, is offered to the King, she isn’t afraid at all! Intrigued by her calm and cute nature, the King decides to spare her life with plans to make her his bride.

series:tt19848464.name: From Now On, Showtime!
series:tt19848464.description: A spectacle-loving magician and his ghost crew team up with a ghost-seeing cop to solve crimes, uncovering unexpected romance and supernatural justice!

series:tt27990591.name: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP Even at Level 1
series:tt27990591.description: Ryôta Satô was reincarnated to another world, but he was burdened which his level is fixed to 1 in another world. Although he wasn't able to raise his level, he had a skill to create a cheat-like item that shouldn't exist from mon...

series:tt27148548.name: Back from the Brink
series:tt27148548.description: 20 years ago, Tianyao's bones and tendons were torn out by his lover. The appearance of Yanhui brings him hope. He begins to make use of her to look for his other body parts. Yanhui gets closer to him. He's also touched by her.

series:tt12922236.name: The Gifted: Graduation
series:tt12922236.description:
Two years have passed and the new school year begins again. With it comes the resurrection of the Gifted program,  and a hidden threat from the Ministry led by Darin, a new teacher. Time, a promising new student and member of the newest gifted generation, seek change within the school while upholding its hierarchical structure.

Filled with danger and more complications than it seems, what will the final battle be like? Who will be victorious? Will Pang and his companions be able to maintain their friendship and ideals? Can they defeat Director Supot? Or They Will Fail?

series:tt16369008.name: Vice Versa
series:tt16369008.description: After drowning, Talay wakes up in another universe in a rich kid’s body, where he must find a way home with the help of an old friend.

series:tt27531070.name: The Legend of Shen Li
series:tt27531070.description: Pressured into a political marriage against her will, Shen Li, a powerful general, fights for her freedom. Sustaining injuries, she reverts to her phoenix form and falls into the human world, crossing paths with the sickly Xing Yun.

series:tt21481210.name: Karagar
series:tt21481210.description: A prisoner appears in Akashnagar Central Jail's Cell No.145, which has been shut for 50 years, and claims immortality. Who is this mystery man, and  what secrets does he hold inside him?

series:tt28254867.name: Am I Actually the Strongest?
series:tt28254867.description: A recluse takes the opportunity to enter another world, but his status there as an overpowered hero makes his desire for a quiet life difficult.

series:tt0319957.name: Once Upon a Time There Was a Country
series:tt0319957.description: Black marketeers Marko and Blacky manufacture and sell weapons to the Communist resistance in WWII Belgrade, living the good life along the way. Marko's surreal duplicity propels him up the ranks of the Communist Party, and he eventually abandons Blacky and steals his girlfriend. After a lengthy stay in a below-ground shelter, the couple reemerges during the Yugoslavian Civil War of the 1990s as Marko sees the opportunity to exploit the situation. An extended television version of Emir Kusturica's Palme d'Or winning Underground.

series:tt22248234.name: The Golden Spoon
series:tt22248234.description: Seung Cheon gets his hands on a magical spoon that allows him to switch lives with his rich best friend. Now he has to decide which of his two possible futures is worth keeping.

series:tt28114809.name: Lost You Forever
series:tt28114809.description: In a realm of three kingdoms, princess Jiu Yao loses her identity. Disguised as a man in Qing Shui, she meets Tu Shan Jing and demon Xiang Liu who are drawn to her. Her cousin Qiang Xuan searches as her future remains uncertain.

series:tt22819614.name: Mr. Bad
series:tt22819614.description: An aspiring writer’s life takes a bizarre turn when one of her most dastardly villains comes to life and then starts to fall in love with her.

series:tt28612257.name: My Daemon
series:tt28612257.description: To save his mother, a kind-hearted boy and his tiny daemon friend set out on a journey across post-apocalyptic Japan as dark forces close in.

series:tt23712252.name: Eternal Yesterday
series:tt23712252.description: After an accident, no one can see the once-popular Koichi — except for loner Mitsuru, whose fondness for his classmate blooms into a haunting romance.

series:tt24082562.name: Unlock My Boss
series:tt24082562.description: At the brink of his death, the CEO and founder of an IT company's spirit gets stuck inside a smartphone and enlists the help of a young man to do favors on his behalf in exchange for 10 billion won.

series:tt26228426.name: The Heavenly Idol
series:tt26228426.description: Rembrary, a priest from a supernatural world, is about to defeat the Evil One, but suddenly finds himself incarnated in the body of a K-pop idol.

series:tt15850486.name: Vortex
series:tt15850486.description: After reconnecting with his dead wife through a glitch in virtual reality, a police officer tries to negate the mysterious accident that cost her life.

series:tt23951712.name: The Director Who Buys Me Dinner
series:tt23951712.description: Min Youtan remembers every past life. Dongbaek doesn’t. To break a curse, Youtan must make him fall in love—again.

series:tt25699926.name: Kokdu: Season of Deity
series:tt25699926.description: A fantasy medical drama about a high-ranking grim reaper named Kkok Du, who is the only being to exist in the underworld. Every 99 years, the cold and cruel Kkok Du must take a break from his job in the underworld and spend 49 days in the mortal realm—and this time, he winds up inhabiting the body of the human Do Jin Woo. While living as Do Jin Woo, he meets Han Gye Jeol, a female doctor who has the mysterious ability to order Kkok Du around.

series:tt27404658.name: The Aristocrat's Otherworldly Adventure: Serving Gods Who Go Too Far
series:tt27404658.description: Shiinya Kazuya died while saving young girls attacker, only to reincarnated into a world of swords and magic. It was a dream come true. He remembers his life and knowledge of Earth, now Cain von Silford, the third son of an aristo...

series:tt28100731.name: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
series:tt28100731.description: A vending machine fanatic meets his demise when he is, quite ironically, crushed by a vending machine. He finds himself reincarnated as a vending machine in another world.

series:tt27489241.name: Dead Mount Death Play
series:tt27489241.description: A necromancer in a distant era incarnates himself into a young boy in modern Tokyo. But he gets caught in a mystery about the boy and his own past.

series:tt26007176.name: Yao-Chinese Folktales
series:tt26007176.description: Yao-Chinese Folktales has eight independent story rooted in traditional Chinese culture

series:tt26134148.name: Rebooting
series:tt26134148.description: A comedy focusing on Kondo Asami, a 33-year-old single woman who lives with her parents and works at the local city hall, and suddenly finds herself starting her life over from scratch.

series:tt26085020.name: Delivery Man
series:tt26085020.description: A meticulous young man co-launches a taxi service for spirits with a ghost who can’t remember how she died. Will the duo find love – even though one of them is dead?

series:tt0074007.name: In Search of...
series:tt0074007.description: "In Search of..." was a 1976-1982 television series where the host, Leonard Nimoy, investigated mysterious phenomena.

series:tt27468571.name: The Last Immortal
series:tt27468571.description: The story of A Yin, a diligent Shuining Beast, and Gu Jin, son of the true God whose magic power was sealed. They met each other by accident and have embarked on the journey to find Feng Yin's Immortal Essence.

series:tt28247170.name: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp
series:tt28247170.description: Making up for her sins in a past life as the evil princess Elise, Aoi Takamoto dedicates her life to saving people as a doctor. But a fatal accident cuts her atonement short, and suddenly, she's back to her previous life, 10 years before her death! Will her foresight and medical brilliance help her change her past ways and heal an ailing empire, or is fate doomed to repeat itself?

series:tt16270188.name: Akuma Kun
series:tt16270188.description: Akuma Kun, a boy raised by a demon, works with his half-human partner Mephisto III as paranormal investigators to solve various murder and mysteries.

series:tt27484853.name: Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion
series:tt27484853.description: Living in a fairy tale may seem like a dream, but for this young heroine it is more like a nightmare.

series:tt29467317.name: Mr. Villain's Day Off
series:tt29467317.description: As a member of a malevolent organization, the General is tasked with invading Earth and wiping out humanity. Even an extraterrestrial being like him, however, needs a chance to rest. Not even the Rangers—a team solely dedicated to defeating the General and his colleagues—will stand in the way of him visiting pandas at the zoo, buying ice cream at the convenience store, and enjoying his well-deserved day off from committing evil deeds.

series:tt27206542.name: Undead Murder Farce
series:tt27206542.description: In a world inhabited by vampires, golems, werewolves and other creatures, Aya Rindo, along with Tsugaru Shunichi and Shizuku Hasei, travels as supernatural detective, solving mysteries while she looks for her lost body.

series:tt27250301.name: Ōoku: The Inner Chambers
series:tt27250301.description: In an alternate history where the male population is nearly decimated, eligible men serve as concubines to the woman shogun inside the walls of the Ooku.

series:tt28101962.name: The Great Cleric
series:tt28101962.description: Earth's God of Destiny lost to Galdardia's Chief God for a bet and chose ten souls to hand over. Galdardia's Chief God handed those ten souls new vessels. Among those souls was Luciel, a salaryman, who fought against his destiny o...

series:tt27548413.name: I'm Giving the Disgraced Noble Lady I Rescued a Crash Course in Naughtiness
series:tt27548413.description: What does a young noblewoman freshly betrayed by her betrothed need most? A crash course in everything naughty! And who better to teach her than the feared hermit sorcerer who for some reason can’t help but pamper her to no end?

series:tt21249134.name: What We Lose to Love
series:tt21249134.description: Satria has to face a harsh reality. His first love, Dara, even prepares a wedding with a new lover, namely Rendra. In fact, they have been dating for five years. However, the happy plan just stopped when Dara suddenly "disappeared". Dara can't touch anything around her and can't be seen by anyone, except Satria.

series:tt26686597.name: Oh No! Here Comes Trouble
series:tt26686597.description: After a near-fatal accident, Pu Yi Yong's regular life is turned upside down as he unexpectedly gains the ability to see wandering spirits. With the aid of his high school nemesis and a rookie cop, he sets out to help them rest in...

series:tt14010168.name: The Gryphon
series:tt14010168.description: Based on the fantasy bestseller. To save humanity from the Gryphon's claws, outcast Mark must confront his family's dark legacy and enter a deadly battle in the parallel world of the Black Tower.

series:tt23132598.name: The Most Heretical Last Boss Queen: From Villainess to Savior
series:tt23132598.description: A girl is reborn as the villainess of a fantasy game she once played, and now seeks to avoid her doom by carrying out heroic deeds.

series:tt30644010.name: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash
series:tt30644010.description: Stars are everything, granting abilities to Tamers. So when Ivy was born without one, her village took it as an ill omen.

series:tt26085372.name: HeartBeat
series:tt26085372.description: A thrilling romance between a vampire who desires to experience heart-throbbing love, and a cold-blooded woman.

series:tt0302739.name: The Lost World
series:tt0302739.description: An expedition leaves for the Amazon to prove the existence of dinosaurs.

series:tt29171914.name: I'm in Love with the Villainess
series:tt29171914.description: Oohashi Rei, an office worker, that's overworked to death and suddenly finds herself reincarnated as Rae Taylor, the heroine of her favorite otome game, Revolution.

series:tt27906926.name: Miraculous Brothers
series:tt27906926.description: An aspiring writer deep in debt encounters a young man with no memories and strange abilities. Together they fight injustice and form an unlikely bond.

series:tt29006388.name: A Good Day to be a Dog
series:tt29006388.description: Hae-na who is bound to inherit her family curse which is turning into a dog after getting her first kiss. The only way to break the curse is to get a second kiss. The problem is the guy who gave Hae-na her first kiss is afraid of dogs.

series:tt0095474.name: Vampire Princess Miyu
series:tt0095474.description: Kyuuketsuki Miyu is a disturbing four episode long anime series about a young immortal vampire princess named Miyu and her protector/servant/best friend and more Larva. In four episodes, a nosy spirit-hunter Himiko Se chases the e...

series:tt24326724.name: Unnamed Memory
series:tt24326724.description: Cursed as a child to never have an heir, Prince Oscar seeks the continent's most powerful witch, Tinasha, hoping she'll break his curse. To meet her, he'll have to climb her formidable tower, which grants a wish to whoever reaches...

series:tt15739134.name: The Demon Sword Master of Excalibur Academy
series:tt15739134.description: A dark lord awakens from a thousand-year slumber, only to find the world under attack from monsters and so he must ally himself the humans he once fought against to stop them.

series:tt28685624.name: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy
series:tt28685624.description: Rishe is already on her seventh time around being reborn and has had all kinds of excitement in her previous lives. But to savor the high life, she first has to marry the handsome prince, the same one who happens to be her murderer.

series:tt30495098.name: The Foolish Angel Dances with the Devil
series:tt30495098.description: Determined to protect his demon world from heavenly angels, demon Masatora Akutsu heads to earth in search of a charismatic human to rally his kin. Masquerading as a high schooler for his recruitment mission, he's captivated by the lovely Lily Amane. But he's in for a wild celestial surprise, because she's his archnemesis—an angel—and she's set on reforming his demonic ways!

series:tt28685497.name: Berserk of Gluttony
series:tt28685497.description: Fate Graphite is cursed with the skill "Gluttony". He is starving until the day he kills a thief and devours the man's strength and his soul. The true hunger of Fate's Gluttony has awakened and he will be the master of his own des...

series:tt28209430.name: Pit Babe
series:tt28209430.description: An aspiring race car driver gets the chance to join one of the biggest teams — but on one condition: he has to obey his talented teammate's every desire.

series:tt27580086.name: Trolltider – legenden om Bergatrollet
series:tt27580086.description: Trolltider – the legend of the Bergatrollet is SVT's Christmas calendar 2023, directed by Lisa Farzaneh from a script by Ola Norén and Roland Ulvselius. The series is a "reboot" to SVT's Christmas calendar Trolltider from 1979 with partly the same characters but a new story.

series:tt29657033.name: Perfect Marriage Revenge
series:tt29657033.description: Waking from a fatal accident to find herself in the past, Han Yi-joo teams up with Seo Do-guk to take revenge on the family who never loved her.

series:tt34933916.name: The Boy Next World
series:tt34933916.description: A stranger claims to be Phu’s lover from another universe. It sounds crazy—until Phu’s heart starts to believe him.

series:tt31975268.name: Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included
series:tt31975268.description: After a long day, high schooler Shintaro Tokumitsu's plans for relaxing in his studio apartment take a turn when he discovers an angel on his balcony. The divine girl, Towa, reveals she's there to study humanity, and yet, despite his skepticism, he agrees to put her up. Prepare for the most heavenly and high jinks roommate experience of all time!

series:tt1654842.name: A Drop of True Blood
series:tt1654842.description: Short mini spin-off of True Blood, in which each episode addresses a situation centered around one, two or three of the leading characters.

series:tt29367004.name: Derailment
series:tt29367004.description: Do you believe that there exist countless parallel universes that are exactly like the world you live in? Jiang Xiaoyuan finds herself struggling with her identity as she travels across parallel universes that never seem to intersect. In her original world, she is an invincible wealthy daughter, but in another place, she becomes an ordinary working girl who has absolutely nothing. Along the way, she meets the mysterious Qi Lian and together, they search for the truth involving the mystery surrounding her. Stripped of wealth, family background, appearance, and education, Jiang Xiaoyuan sets herself on a journey to find pieces of her "real" identity.

series:tt14466446.name: Domino Day: Lone Witch
series:tt14466446.description: Follows Domino, who is a powerful young witch who is haunted by her need to feed on the energy of others.

series:tt21632986.name: Sanctuary: A Witch's Tale
series:tt21632986.description: A small UK town named Sanctuary is shaken by murder accusations after a boy is discovered dead from an accident.

series:tt27960886.name: Moonlight Mystique
series:tt27960886.description: Bai Shuo, a general's daughter aspiring for immortality to repay kindness. Despite difficulties, love breaks through restrictions, embracing each other's truest stories.

series:tt28369144.name: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
series:tt28369144.description: After a shy office worker unexpectedly gains the ability to read minds, he discovers that his handsome colleague can't stop thinking about him!

series:tt31079705.name: The Sign
series:tt31079705.description: Two men join a high-stakes special ops team to solve supernatural crimes, while a hidden connection from their past lives complicates everything.

series:tt32215776.name: Revamp: The Undead Story
series:tt32215776.description: After his blood frees a century-old vampire trapped in a painting, an antique dealer must help him regain his powers before deadly Hunters close in.

series:tt31067227.name: Love for Love's Sake
series:tt31067227.description: A man winds up inside a video game where he plays a teen character who must make a tragic athlete happy — or risk dying. Can their love survive?

series:tt30368332.name: Miss Night and Day
series:tt30368332.description: A bittersweet romantic comedy about a woman who magically switches between her 20s and 50s lands an internship at the Prosecution Service, caught between two generations and a tough boss.

series:tt31976012.name: Vampire Dormitory
series:tt31976012.description: After Mito loses her parents and is fired from her job, she must fend for herself on the streets disguised as a boy. She comes across a stranger named Ruka and learns his dark secret—he's a vampire! Ruka invites Mito, still in disguise, to live in an all-boys dorm. Mito exchanges her blood for a place to stay, but a budding romance and her true identity threaten all that hangs in the balance.

series:tt28634577.name: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again
series:tt28634577.description: Shouzou and Ine Saitou have been happily married for as long as they can remember. Even in their old age with wrinkles and cracking limbs, the strength of this love is evident in their precious bond. And then, one day, they wake up to find they are young again! Despite their newfound youthful and attractive bodies, Shouzou and Ine remain the same as ever.

series:tt31173604.name: Filter
series:tt31173604.description: A super-tech product gives the ordinary Su Chengcheng the ability to change her appearance. Tang Qi, who has a connection with Su Chengcheng, keeps falling in love with all of her other identities and losing every one of them.

series:tt32174340.name: YATAGARASU: The Raven Does Not Choose Its Master
series:tt32174340.description: Welcome to Yamauchi, a world inhabited by the Yatagarasu, a race of three-legged ravens who shapeshift into humans. The land is divided into four regions—North, South, East, and West—each ruled by a noble family. Yukiya, the son of a leader in the North, is shocked by a call to attend to the Imperial Prince. Murder, mysteries, and an invasion from an unexpected enemy await in this epic fantasy.

series:tt31647393.name: Eye Love You
series:tt31647393.description: Sparks begin to fly when a telepathic woman who'd given up on love meets a kindhearted Korean student who thinks in a language she can't understand.

series:tt32499943.name: High School Return of a Gangster
series:tt32499943.description: A middle-aged gangster finds himself body-swapped into the body of a bullied teen. Now inhabited by a tough-as-nails gangster, the teen starts to fight back against the power structure at his school and change his miserable existe...

series:tt31145115.name: The Spirealm
series:tt31145115.description: Jiu Shi’s skills are pushed to the edge as he faces life-or-death challenges inside a brutal VR maze.

series:tt31261522.name: The Midnight Studio
series:tt31261522.description: Seo Gi-joo, a lonely photographer who is bound by a contract to take pictures of the dead for generations in his family, meets Han Bom, a woman who protects him from death, and realizes the preciousness of life as he faces life and death together.

series:tt30970523.name: The Magical Girl and the Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
series:tt30970523.description: An evil organization invades and destroys everything in its path. The brains of the brutal operation is the king’s right-hand man, an evil lieutenant named Mira. Everything changes when a magical girl named Byakuya Mimori tries to stop the evil group in their tracks. When Mira confronts her, he knows it’s love at first sight. What will become of Mira and Byakuya, stuck between orders and love?

series:tt0108745.name: The Dragon Ring
series:tt0108745.description: King brings an abandoned baby to his palace. The princess, jealous, suspects that the baby's mission is to seize the ring and, by extension, steal her throne. Mythological framework for a film by a specialist in the fantastic genre.

series:tt32178571.name: Nina the Starry Bride
series:tt32178571.description: Nina never imagined she would be at the center of a royal deception. She’s had a rough start in life as an orphan in the castle town of Fortna. But when Prince Azure notices that her deep blue eyes look the same as the late Princess Alisha’s, he ordains that she takes her place and marry the Prince of Galgada. Despite this uncertain fate, she finds joy in knowing someone finally needs her.

series:tt32812118.name: I'll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History
series:tt32812118.description: Woman reincarnates as Alicia, a villainess character from an otome game she admires. With foreknowledge, she aims to become the greatest villainess but soon realizes escaping Alicia's fate isn't easy.

series:tt32332970.name: My Deer Friend Nokotan
series:tt32332970.description: One day, Torako Koshi rescues a strange deer-girl hanging from some power lines on the way to school. The girl then soon transfers into her school, introduces herself as Noko Shikanoko, and begins dragging Torako into her bizarre ...

series:tt30689448.name: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
series:tt30689448.description: An elf from a dream world is transported to Japan and learns the new comforts of the country.

series:tt14872196.name: The Grimm Variations
series:tt14872196.description: Inspired by the classic Brothers Grimm stories, this anthology features six fairy tales with a dark twist, exposing the shadowy side of human desire.

series:tt32310214.name: My Marvellous Dream Is You
series:tt32310214.description:
I'm Dawan. Since I can remember, I have always had strange dreams about a quiet girl who often played with me in my dreams. One day, a new neighbor moved in, and that led to my family falling apart. My father ran away with the man next door, who turned out to be the father of Khimhan the quiet and small girl from next door. Initially, we were not close at all, but circumstances brought us closer and made us understand each other.

However, Khimhan was unaware that while in the real world we were just friends, in my dreams, she and I did things that went far beyond that. So, I kept my feelings concealed because I couldn't let her know. I never realized that in those dreams, I was not the only one dreaming.

series:tt2882382.name: Gerçek Kesit
series:tt2882382.description: A series from Turkey, which is based on real crimes and events.

series:tt32178759.name: Garouden: The Way of the Lone Wolf
series:tt32178759.description: On the run from a past crime, Juzo Fujimaki is blackmailed into joining an illicit tournament and has to face top martial artists in deadly match-ups.

series:tt33045752.name: When Destiny Brings the Demon
series:tt33045752.description: Modern-day office drone Zou Yan accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation and wakes up as Liao Tingyan, a disciple of the Qinggutian Sect. She's soon selected to serve the reclusive Grandmaster Sima Jiao, a powerful cultivator who's been secretly sealed inside a mountain for 500 years. Twisted by isolation and rage, he's cold, hot-tempered, and bent on revenge. Liao Tingyan doesn't know that "her" original identity is a demonic assassin. But to his surprise, she shows no ill will, no ambition, and no desire at all. Her nature fascinates him. Thus begins an unlikely romance between a villainous immortal and a healing-type "slacker," a connection that defies fate and spans lifetimes.

series:tt10569840.name: Tabeta Tales
series:tt10569840.description: Zizigulu is a pink fictional character who is believed to have lived on the planet Ta-be-Ta before he came to Earth and was adopted by a newlywed couple. His full name is "Zizigulu Aasi Paasi Deraakutaa Taa-be-Taa", however he is sometimes referred to as "Aasi-Poolika" and "Zizinghuli"

series:tt34621291.name: Magic Maker: How to Create Magic in Another World
series:tt34621291.description: After dying on his 30th birthday, a man is reborn as a child and embarks on a quest to learn magic!.

series:tt33246471.name: The Haunted Palace
series:tt33246471.description: In a world of folklore and mysticism, a vengeful spirit and a devoted shaman cross paths, sparking a journey of love and redemption

series:tt33058180.name: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
series:tt33058180.description: A middle-aged man is reborn as a female villainess in a dating simulation game.

series:tt34621652.name: The Daily Life of a Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
series:tt34621652.description: A middle-aged man is sent to another world, and uses his shopping skills to his advantage.

series:tt14829636.name: Exandria Unlimited
series:tt14829636.description: Within the world of Exandria, there are an unlimited amount of stories to be told — and we have only just begun. Each mini Exandria Unlimited series exists within the same world as Critical Role and allows us to expand Exandria through new adventures outside our regular campaigns.

series:tt38353703.name: The Fated Magical Princess: Who Made Me a Princess
series:tt38353703.description: When a woman wakes up as Athanasia, the ill-fated princess from the novel The Lovely Princess, she's gotta rewrite this tragedy or face execution—by her own father! She may be trapped, but she's got her wits and the doomed girl's memories to help her with a plot twist of survival. But when her escape plan fails, she has to charm her way into not being executed again.

series:tt32247408.name: Twelve Letters
series:tt32247408.description: In a small town, twelve mysterious letters and a 35-year wait intertwine to shape the lives and loves of a close-knit group of friends. Yu Nian and Shen Cheng’s world is thrown into turmoil when their parents vanish, followed by cryptic messages arriving from another time. Driven to uncover the truth, they plunge into a complex puzzle, navigating dual timelines and unraveling the secrets hidden within the letters that could explain their disappearance.

series:tt16741414.name: Summer Pockets
series:tt16741414.description: Hairi Takahara never expected summer to feel like a dream. Sent to Torishirojima to sort through his late grandmother's belongings, he's met with endless sea, quiet nostalgia, and mysterious girls, each chasing something just out of reach. As he settles into island life, lost memories begin to surface and he finds what he never knew he'd lost.

series:tt38646055.name: DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR
series:tt38646055.description: In the seaside city of Riverfield stands Decelis Academy, home to seven mysterious boys sharing the same secret: They're vampires, hiding their murky pasts. When Sooha, a female student who hates vampires, transfers to the academy, the boys find themselves irresistibly drawn to her. As strange events shake the city, old sins and buried secrets resurface, and their world begins to fracture.

series:tt36593277.name: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
series:tt36593277.description: A female knight is captured by barbarians and receives a marriage proposal from their heir. As she learns their customs, she questions her prejudices about their way of life

series:tt38221197.name: Moon River
series:tt38221197.description: In Joseon, a vengeful crown prince and a memory-lost merchant mysteriously swap bodies, unraveling a web of chaos, secrets, and unexpected fate.

series:tt34814625.name: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
series:tt34814625.description: Reborn in space, Liam aims to become the evilest overlord ever after his honest life ended in betrayal. Yet his villainous schemes keep accidentally creating peace and earning fans across the galaxy.

series:tt35437319.name: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
series:tt35437319.description: The saint Philia is rejected by her suitor and sent to another kingdom, where she makes a new life for herself.

series:tt35936938.name: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
series:tt35936938.description: Hinako lives alone by the sea, quietly drifting through life after losing her family years ago. One day, a mermaid named Shiori saves her from a monster and says she’s come to eat her—just not yet. Until then, Shiori will stay by her side and keep her safe. In that moment, a deep hope swells in Hinako: Maybe this girl can finally grant her the ending she’s been waiting for.

series:tt38037460.name: Pass the Monster Meat, Milady!
series:tt38037460.description: A noble lady with unusual tastes - she craves monsters. Branded "Voracious Villainess," she's saved from a monster attack by the "Blood-Mad Duke." Could this brutal yet charming man understand her appetite?

series:tt34930049.name: My Magic Prophecy
series:tt34930049.description: A skeptical doctor and a fortune teller must hide from a shadowy threat in a remote village, where danger and romance intertwine.

series:tt35046984.name: Veil of Shadows
series:tt35046984.description: Lu Wuyi, the youngest nine-tailed fox of the mysterious Formless Moon Sect, sets out on a mission with her friend Wu Wangyan to track down a fox demon on the run, Xiaowei. She infiltrates the Wei Mansion in Luo'an City, where she later crosses paths with Wu Shiguang, who holds a deep grudge, as well as Ji Ling and Li Jie, demon hunters from the Shilin Sect. In the process of uncovering the truth, they navigate between suspicion and cooperation, each driven by their own agendas. In their repeated struggles over the Dragon Deity's Power, their fates are changed time and again. To preserve peace in the world, they make painful sacrifices and ultimately subdue Jiu Ying, the lord of all demons, thus fulfilling an enduring quest of love and redemption.

series:tt35348180.name: The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl
series:tt35348180.description: A shy girl with superhuman gorilla power struggles to return to normalcy as others seek to take her strength.

series:tt35324277.name: Reset
series:tt35324277.description: Killed by betrayal on the night of his greatest triumph, an actor wakes 25 years earlier—ready to rewrite his fate and crush rivals who ruined him.

series:tt29366100.name: Only for Love
series:tt29366100.description: Zheng Shu Yi is a hard-working reporter for one of China's leading financial newspapers. Shi Yan, the businessman, is looking to make a series of investments. Could this blossoming working relationship also lead them on the path t...

series:tt15140592.name: Forecasting Love and Weather
series:tt15140592.description: An office melodrama that depicts work life and love life of the people working in Korea Meteorological Administration which is hotter than tropical nights and more indispensable than local heavy rains.

series:tt9599524.name: wtFOCK
series:tt9599524.description: The story of young teenagers and pupils in a high school in Antwerp, and their troubles, scandals and everyday life. Each season is told from a different person's point of view.

series:tt14899624.name: Another Self
series:tt14899624.description: Three close friends set off on a journey to Ayvalik and then to their reshaped future.

series:tt29494111.name: Envious
series:tt29494111.description: Vicky issues an ultimatum to her longtime boyfriend: marry her or she leaves. When things don't go as planned, she pursues her dream of marriage with a new partner, leading to an unexpected journey of self-discovery.

series:tt27763561.name: Hierarchy
series:tt27763561.description: The top 0.01% of students control law and order at Jusin High School, but a secretive transfer student chips a crack in their indomitable world.

series:tt22460828.name: Lighter and Princess
series:tt22460828.description: Li Xun, a top scorer and talented programmer, is uninterested in typical college life, causing friction with his classmates. Zhu Yun, a friendly and obedient young woman, is conflicted by Li Xun's disruptive nature, yet feels drawn to him. As they start to grow closer, a life-altering incident threatens to tear them apart.

series:tt7587362.name: Four Weddings and a Funeral
series:tt7587362.description: Four American friends reunite for a wedding in London. A shocking event at the altar alters their lives, leading to a tumultuous year navigating romance and heartbreak, culminating in four weddings and a funeral.

series:tt0324264.name: Tipping the Velvet
series:tt0324264.description: A tempestuous tale of love and life as a naïve girl discovers both romance and pain in the hidden, decadent world of bohemian London in the 1890s. Nan Astley embarks on a voyage of emotional and sexual discovery with Kitty Butler, a music hall male impersonator.

series:tt39039439.name: You Maniac
series:tt39039439.description: Dean and Moth, two"red flags," each in their own way, are complete opposites. But when they're forced to fake a relationship, real feelings begin to grow between them.

series:tt8769260.name: Encounter
series:tt8769260.description: Brought together by fate, a woman who seems to have everything and a young man who seems to have nothing decides to give up an ordinary life to be together.

series:tt0292414.name: McLeod's Daughters
series:tt0292414.description: Estranged sisters Claire and Tess are reunited after 20 years when they inherit their family's cattle station, Drover's Run, in the outback of South Australia, following their father's death.

series:tt13660288.name: F4 Thailand: Boys Over Flowers
series:tt13660288.description: Gorya, a girl from a poor family, is happy to enter an elite high school. However, things take a turn when she is bullied by a group of rich spoiled boys called F4.

series:tt0074021.name: Mary Hartman, Mary Hartman
series:tt0074021.description: A small-town housewife struggles to cope with the increasingly bizarre and violent events unfolding around her.

series:tt32849226.name: Our Generation
series:tt32849226.description: Lin Qile and Jiang Qiaoxi reconnect in high school after a childhood friendship and a lingering misunderstanding. As they navigate youth's ups and downs alongside their classmates, they grow through shared experiences and step into new horizons.

series:tt15181094.name: Thirty-Nine
series:tt15181094.description: Leaning on each other through thick and thin, a trio of best friends stand together as they experience life, love and loss on the brink of turning 40.

series:tt36204806.name: Blossoms of Power
series:tt36204806.description: The sole survivor of a bloodshed, Gu Qingzhi awakens under a new identity — Shen Xihe, the Princess of the Northwest. Once a proud and spirited rose of the frontier, she has now transformed into a cold, calculating figure, determined to seize control of her destiny and dominate the game of power. Crown Prince Xiao Huayong, frail in body but razor-sharp in mind, sees through the treacherous currents of the court. As their fates intertwine, they grow closer, joining forces to command the winds of destiny.

series:tt39184653.name: Doctor on the Edge
series:tt39184653.description: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

series:tt8585954.name: My ID Is Gangnam Beauty
series:tt8585954.description: Bullied for her looks, Mi-rae gets plastic surgery hoping for a better kind of life but faces new challenges in college. Based on a hit Korean webtoon.

series:tt13660938.name: Bad Buddy
series:tt13660938.description: At university, two young men raised to hate each other find music and love instead, forcing them to question family legacies and choose their own path.

series:tt0104666.name: Lady Chatterley
series:tt0104666.description: A young woman's husband returns wounded after the First World War. Facing a life with a husband now incapable of sexual activity she begins an affair with the groundskeeper.

series:tt43351313.name: Possible Love
series:tt43351313.description: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.

series:tt38646634.name: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
series:tt38646634.description: A gamer seeking hardcore challenges picks "Hell Mode" in a mysterious game and gets reincarnated as a serf named Allen, who must master his Summoner class without guides in a brutal new world.

series:tt38978132.name: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
series:tt38978132.description: Reborn as an emperor's 13th child, six-year-old Noah retains his incredible strength and gains powers that multiply with each follower. But royal life brings dangerous political intrigue beneath its luxurious surface.

series:tt36221414.name: With You, Our Love Will Make It Through
series:tt36221414.description: A shy high school girl's life changes when she meets her school's new student - a beastfolk teen. Despite initial nervousness and social prejudices, she discovers a deep connection with him that grows into something more.

series:tt38646949.name: Kunon the Sorcerer Can See
series:tt38646949.description: Kunon is blind but ambitious to see with magic. Word of his genius reaches the royal court, and is invited to study under the kingdom's most powerful magician.

series:tt13429936.name: Mirakel
series:tt13429936.description: An artificial black hole crashes straight into an old mansion. The crash means that the year 2020 is connected with the year 1920. When Mira and Rakel stand in front of the hole, something strange happens.

series:tt38652044.name: Isekai Office Worker: The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter
series:tt38652044.description: An overworked office clerk gets transported to a parallel world, where he continues his accounting career in the royal treasury with the same unwavering dedication.

series:tt36592820.name: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!
series:tt36592820.description: A white mage joins an S-rank party after being kicked from a hero's group. As his former team crumbles, Lloyd rises to prominence, unaware his support magic makes him extraordinary.

series:tt1150692.name: Lost: Missing Pieces
series:tt1150692.description: 13 never-before-seen stories taken from the 'Lost' Flashbacks. The creative team is the same and the stories give more clues about the past days of the island characters.

series:tt36600399.name: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
series:tt36600399.description: Expelled from the world's top adventuring party by a jealous leader, Dennis pursues his true passion, cooking. He opens a restaurant with fellow outcast Atelier, serving adventurers while solving their problems.

series:tt40546935.name: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
series:tt40546935.description: Bertia is reincarnated into her favorite otome game—not as the heroine, but as the villainess engaged to the perfect Crown Prince Cecil! Fully aware that her role is to sabotage his future romance, she’s determined to bloom as a wicked flower and wither away according to the story. But no matter how hard she tries to scheme, her “evil” plans only make her more endearing!

series:tt39267868.name: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring
series:tt39267868.description: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

series:tt29712397.name: The Wayfinders
series:tt29712397.description: Follows three high schoolers mistakenly transported to a brutal medieval world. Falling in with unlikely comrades caught in a civil war, the teens fight for survival as they search for a way back home.

series:tt38647627.name: An Adventurer's Daily Grind at Age 29
series:tt38647627.description: One day while questing, he entered a dungeon and discovered a young girl being partially devoured by the weakest monster type - a slime.

series:tt2788518.name: Spooksville
series:tt2788518.description: The new kid in town discovers that he holds the key to a battle between good and evil that has been taking place for centuries in a bizarre small town that plays host to a wide array of supernatural and unexplained occurrences.

series:tt38493368.name: My Secret Vampire
series:tt38493368.description: A naïve student rents a cheap mansion in Seoul, only to learn his generous roommates are vampires—and his blood is the price of admission.

series:tt39303266.name: To My Beloved Thief
series:tt39303266.description: Hong Eun Jo leads a double life: a servant and healer by day and a Robin-Hood-like thief named Gil Dong by night. Grand Prince Do Wol, brother to the King, begins to investigate the case. An encounter with a monk leads to them swapping souls, and they are forced to navigate each other's complex worlds.

series:tt3621678.name: Hanamonogatari
series:tt3621678.description: After Koyomi graduates, lonely Kanbaru hears rumors of a wish-granter "Mr. Devil." Seeking him out, she finds her ex-rival Numachi instead. Can Kanbaru help resolve Numachi's plight?

series:tt0765458.name: Hogfather
series:tt0765458.description: On the night before Hogswatch, the holiday where children anticipate presents from the beloved Hogfather, Death notices that the Hogfather's life-timer is lying broken on the floor of his castle. Could it be that Hogswatch will not happen this year?

series:tt16358754.name: The Wheel of Time: Origins
series:tt16358754.description: Experience the Origin Stories of the Wheel of Time as they bring you deeper into the world and its vast history and subjects.

series:tt0272362.name: The Legend of Lady Chung
series:tt0272362.description: A gifted female warrior is destined to marry the emperor and bring prosperity to the dynasty.

series:tt1615400.name: The Vampire Diaries: A Darker Truth
series:tt1615400.description: Follows the investigation of Jason Harris into the murder of his sister Joanne. He follows Stefan Salvatore from NYC to Mystic Falls, believing him to be a vampire and his sister's killer.

series:tt0118476.name: Spellbinder: Land of the Dragon Lord
series:tt0118476.description: Kathy is on a camping trip when she finds a bamboo boat belonging to Mek, a scientist who has discovered a way of travelling between parallel worlds. Kathy meddles with the controls, sending herself and Mek to the world of Spellbi...

series:tt0309150.name: Dreamkeeper
series:tt0309150.description: The legends of the Native American nations come to life in this epic miniseries, as two generations--a century-old storyteller and his grandson, a troubled 17-year-old boy--embark on a cross-country journey toward self-discovery.

series:tt30971467.name: 〈物語〉シリーズ オフ＆モンスターシーズン
series:tt30971467.description: Koyomi Araragi spent his last year of high school helping girls in his town resolve various supernatural afflictions. But now Araragi has departed for university, leaving his friends to fend for themselves against new problems and curses that plague them. Yotsugi Ononoki, once a human corpse and now a living doll, takes residence in Araragi's home, keeping watch over his sister Tsukihi, a girl harboring a mystical secret of her own. As part of her duties, Yotsugi fills Araragi's vacated role as occult expert, assisting others in town with their issues.

series:tt12011442.name: Burn the Witch
series:tt12011442.description: Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole are witch and protection agents for Wing Bind an organization for dragon conservation and management. Their mission is to protect and manage the dragons within London on behalf of the people.

series:tt38672679.name: Summer of 1985
series:tt38672679.description: In the summer of 1985, a young boy is found mysteriously drowned in the waters off Särsö. During a forbidden excursion to the legendary island of Svärtan, Johannes and his friends make a discovery that changes them forever.

series:tt0210294.name: Snow Queen
series:tt0210294.description: A young woman must journey through the seasons to rescue her boyfriend who has been kidnapped by the evil Snow Queen.

series:tt0249326.name: Voyage of the Unicorn
series:tt0249326.description: A grieving professor and his daughters traverse a magical realm to fulfill a prophecy, encountering mythical creatures and facing trolls while seeking a dragon's aid, with the spirit of their late mother guiding them.

series:tt0369277.name: Bible Black
series:tt0369277.description: At a harmless looking College, the teachers and staff are practicing a dark religion. By devoting their bodies to perversity, they chant their dark spells and control the lusts of the student body.

series:tt0343727.name: Gnomes
series:tt0343727.description:
Gnomes is an American 1980 animated film, based on the book of the same name by the Dutch Wil Huygen and Rien Poortvliet. The movie was nominated for an Emmy in 1981 for Outstanding Animated Program.

Several years after this film was released, the television series, The World of David the Gnome was created, which was also based on the same novel.

series:tt5274556.name: Owarimonogatari
series:tt5274556.description: The end of the saga of Araragi Koyomi. What are they fighting against? What will happen to them? And who- or what- is the darkness?

series:tt25375256.name: The Signal
series:tt25375256.description: When an astronaut mysteriously vanishes during a mission, her husband goes to investigate while navigating life as a single parent to their daughter.

series:tt0090527.name: Starman
series:tt0090527.description: An alien returns to Earth years after an earlier visit to reunite with his Earth son and together, they search for the alien's human wife.

series:tt14596212.name: Hello Tomorrow!
series:tt14596212.description: In a retro-futuristic world, charismatic salesman Jack Billings leads a team of fellow sales associates determined to revitalize their customers' lives by hawking timeshares on the moon.

series:tt1258189.name: Survivors
series:tt1258189.description: An unknown virus pandemic kills more than 90% of the world's population. Those immune must strive to survive and overcome the difficulties of this new world order, hoping that the virus will not mutate.

series:tt0112104.name: Nowhere Man
series:tt0112104.description: Thomas Veil is a documentary photographer who seemingly has to erase his entire existence in the course of an evening.

series:tt0195471.name: The Last Train
series:tt0195471.description: A group of commuter train passagers are put in accidental suspended animation and emerge years later into a devastated world.

series:tt0460686.name: Threshold
series:tt0460686.description: A team of experts are assembled after the U.S. Navy discovers an extra-terrestrial object briefly appeared near a ship in the Atlantic Ocean.

series:tt0078129.name: Quatermass
series:tt0078129.description: In the distant future, a now-elderly Bernard Quatermass investigates the disappearance of his granddaughter and a mysterious cult.

series:tt1137462.name: Kings
series:tt1137462.description: A modern day, alternate-reality drama about a hero who rises to become the King of his nation, based on the biblical story of King David.

series:tt35433285.name: My Safe Zone
series:tt35433285.description: Alin leaves her best friend Jane to study abroad. Years later, a broken engagement brings her home, where they face feelings long unspoken.

series:tt12867810.name: Start-Up
series:tt12867810.description: Young entrepreneurs aspiring to launch virtual dreams into reality compete for success and love in the cutthroat world of Korea's high-tech industry.

series:tt0302103.name: Footballers' Wives
series:tt0302103.description: Drama focusing on the players at Earls Park Football Club as well as the lives of their wives and girlfriends.

series:tt5882386.name: My Mother and Other Strangers
series:tt5882386.description: In 1943, the Coyne family and their neighbours struggle to maintain a normal life after a US Army Air Force base is set up in the middle of their rural parish.

series:tt1736398.name: Feuten
series:tt1736398.description: Butcher Wagtmans's son Bram joins prestigious Dutch frat Mercurius and becomes best mates with slick silver-spoon womanizing senior Olivier de Ruyter, who helps him survive the hazing and introduces him to join his frat house--the...

series:tt0431557.name: Orange Days
series:tt0431557.description: Yuuki Kai is a senior at a university studying social welfare psychology and trying to find a job. One day, he encounters a girl, Hagio Sae, playing the violin, and becomes intrigued.

series:tt0137330.name: Two Guys, a Girl and a Pizza Place
series:tt0137330.description: Three twenty-somethings share a Boston apartment and hang around (and work) at a pizza place.

series:tt0341281.name: Amor real
series:tt0341281.description: In 19th-century Mexico, Dr. Fuentes inherits a fortune and searches for a wife. His choice is Matilde Penalver y Beristain, from an aristocratic family whose fortune has waned.

series:tt0412162.name: Kevin Hill
series:tt0412162.description: Kevin Hill was a swinging bachelor and top notch lawyer, but after his cousin died he was left with his cousin's ten-month-old daughter, Sarah. Now Kevin must deal with being a new parent and a lawyer at a new smaller firm.

series:tt1083958.name: The Pickup Artist
series:tt1083958.description: Mystery, best-selling author and ultimate pick-up artist who has the secret to wooing women. He'll guide this group of eight lovable losers through the rough waters of romance and help them overcome their biggest fear of talking t...

series:tt0115390.name: This Life
series:tt0115390.description: A series following the lives of Miles, Milly, Warren, Egg and Anna, five young legal professionals.

series:tt0068039.name: Anna and the King
series:tt0068039.description: A stern schoolteacher clashes with an aristocratic 19th-century king.

series:tt0423651.name: Fingersmith
series:tt0423651.description: In Victorian England, young thief Sue participates in a scam to defraud a rich heiress by becoming her maid. Things take an unexpected turn and Sue's plan goes horribly wrong.

series:tt0077060.name: Pennies from Heaven
series:tt0077060.description: A travelling sheet music salesman with an uptight wife throws everything away for the love of an innocent school teacher in the romantic spirit of the music he loves, that bursts into his life in full song-and-dance numbers.

series:tt0499280.name: I jukilnomui sarang
series:tt0499280.description: A young boxer becomes a bodyguard to the actress responsible for his brother's attempted suicide. She falls in love with him, unaware of his true identity or his plans for revenge.

series:tt0063925.name: Love, American Style
series:tt0063925.description: An anthology comedy series featuring a line up of different celebrity guest stars appearing in anywhere from one, two, three, and four short stories or vignettes within an hour about versions of love and romance.

series:tt5616644.name: In Love Again
series:tt5616644.description: Zeynep flees to America, leaving behind his family. Zeynep returns to Turkey in the hands of the frustrations. On the other hand, Fatih returns to country. The story of these two people. Love Again.

series:tt0200337.name: Family Law
series:tt0200337.description: An upscale law firm specializing in family law undertakes clients with domestic conflicts.

series:tt0983950.name: Byakuyakô
series:tt0983950.description: One boy kills his father to save his first love. One girl takes the life of her mother to protect the boy. The two commit a crime to hide another, and move on with life, turning their backs against the sun.

series:tt0843195.name: Princess Hours
series:tt0843195.description: Love, tradition, and politics collide when a spirited young art student is betrothed to the crown prince of South Korea.

series:tt0312097.name: Berlin, Berlin
series:tt0312097.description: Out of school, ready to live together with friends and learn to know new friends in the big city of Berlin, where everything isn't always going according to the plan.

series:tt0057779.name: Peyton Place
series:tt0057779.description: People married and divorced, loved and lost. Murder, illicit passion, insanity, and secrets were the staples of Peyton Place.

series:tt0103437.name: Hearts Afire
series:tt0103437.description: John Ritter and Markie Post star in this comedy about two politicos that fall in love.

series:tt0085114.name: A Woman of Substance
series:tt0085114.description: The life of Emma Harte, from kitchen maid at the beginning of the 20th-century, to respected businesswoman and grandmother in the 1980s. From humble beginnings, Emma Harte starts her business with a small shop, but over the next twenty years, she expands her stores and invests in the growing textile industry in Leeds.

series:tt0294592.name: Autumn in My Heart
series:tt0294592.description: The story is about two childhood friends, Joon-suh and Eun-suh, who grew up together but were forced to part ways when Eun-suh's family moved away. Many years later, they meet again by chance and rekindle their friendship.

series:tt0108858.name: Middlemarch
series:tt0108858.description: 19th century Great Britain. The Industrial Revolution brings both the promise and fear of change. In the provincial town of Middlemarch, the progressive Dorothea Brooke desperately seeks intellectual fulfillment in a male-dominated society and is driven into an unhappy marriage to the elderly scholar Casaubon. No sooner do they embark on their honeymoon than she meets and develops an instant connection with Casaubon's young cousin, Will Ladislaw. When idealistic Doctor Lydgate arrives, his new methods of medicine sweep him into the battle between conservatives and liberals in town. He quickly becomes enamored of the beautiful, privileged Rosamond Vincy, a woman whose troubles seem bound to destroy him.

series:tt1430751.name: Lurk
series:tt1430751.description: Lurk is a 2009 Chinese television series based on a spy novel. The series is directed by Jiang Wei.

series:tt0491601.name: Falcon Beach
series:tt0491601.description: Falcon Beach is a town in cottage country by a lake in Canadian province Manitoba, where aquatic sports are part of the pleasure package which attracts many visitors during the sunny tourist season. Local adolescent blond god Jaso...

series:tt4875520.name: Iliski Durumu: Karisik
series:tt4875520.description: portrays Love, jealousy, pride, and a love game that goes hand in hand with friendship and misunderstandings

series:tt0108761.name: Ellen
series:tt0108761.description: Ellen Morgan is a neurotic bookstore owner who deals with life through comedy and extensive rambling.

series:tt0233307.name: Beautiful Life
series:tt0233307.description: A talented hairstylist meets the love of his life, a terminally ill woman.

series:tt0149453.name: F.C. De Kampioenen
series:tt0149453.description: Oscar Crucke is the coach of substandard enthusiasts soccer team F.C. De Kampioenen. His marriage to Pascale is challenged by president Boma, who loves her while renting the clubhouse to them. Teenage daughter Bieke troubles house...

series:tt0339907.name: William and Mary

series:tt0431504.name: All In
series:tt0431504.description:
All In is a 2003 South Korean television drama series that aired on SBS from January 15 to April 3, 2003 on Wednesdays and Thursdays at 21:55 for 24 episodes. Inspired by the life of professional poker player Jimmy Cha, it starred Lee Byung-hun and Song Hye-kyo in a story about one's man's rise through the fiercely competitive world of casino gambling as he clashes with his rivals over money, success, and love.

The drama was a ratings success in South Korea, with its final episode reaching a peak viewership rating of 47.7%, which is the 42nd highest-rated Korean drama episode of all time. It also won several awards, notably the Grand Prize for Lee Byung-hun at the 2003 SBS Drama Awards.

series:tt3469050.name: 90 Day Fiancé

series:tt0048845.name: As the World Turns
series:tt0048845.description: As the World Turns is an American television soap opera that aired on CBS from April 2, 1956 to September 17, 2010. Irna Phillips created As the World Turns as a sister show to her other soap opera The Guiding Light. Running for 54 years, As the World Turns holds the second-longest continuous run of any daytime network soap opera in American history, surpassed only by Guiding Light. As the World Turns was produced in New York City for all of its time. Set in the fictional town of Oakdale, Illinois, the show debuted on April 2, 1956, at 1:30 pm EST.

series:tt0085052.name: Mansfield Park
series:tt0085052.description: Mansfield Park is a British six-part television drama serial based on Jane Austen's 1814 novel of the same name. Produced by the BBC and adapted by Kenneth Taylor, it stars Sylvestra Le Touzel as Fanny Price, who is sent to live with her wealthy relatives, the Bertrams, where she is treated poorly by most except her cousin Edmund. Her life is complicated by the arrival of the worldly Mary and Henry Crawford.

series:tt0062595.name: One Life to Live
series:tt0062595.description: One Life to Live is an American soap opera broadcast on television for more than 43 years on the ABC network, from July 15, 1968, to January 13, 2012, and on the internet as a web series on Hulu and iTunes via The Online Network since April 29, 2013. Created by Agnes Nixon, the series was the first daytime drama to primarily feature ethnically and socioeconomically diverse characters and consistently emphasize social issues. One Life to Live was expanded from 30 minutes to 45 minutes on July 26, 1976, and then to an hour on January 16, 1978.

On April 1, 2009, it was announced that CBS canceled Guiding Light after a 72-year run due to low ratings. The show taped its final scenes for CBS on August 11, 2009, and its final episode on the network aired on September 18, 2009.

series:tt0270804.name: Soccer AM
series:tt0270804.description:
Soccer AM is a British Saturday-morning football-based comedy/talk show, predominantly based around the Premier League. Originally presented by Jane Hoffen, Gary Stevens and Russ Williams, they lasted just a year before Helen Chamberlain and Tim Lovejoy replaced them, where Lovejoy served for over a decade. He has since been replaced by Andy Goldstein and, more recently, Max Rushden. The show has been aired on Sky Sports 2 each Saturday morning of the football season since 1995 from 7:00am or 9:00am to noon originally and currently between 10:00am and 12:00pm. In early 2009, the 500th episode was broadcast. Although the show is filmed live from 2010 it has been broadcast on a momentary delay due to bad language and/or inappropriate content from certain guests.

The show's current sponsor is Procter & Gamble through their Head & Shoulders brand. The show was previously sponsored by Frijj, a brand of milkshake, after Dairy Crest signed a £2 million sponsorship deal.

Parts of the show have remained since the beginning, whilst new items have been introduced each season. In that respect, it is almost the same every week, the difference being new football footage and comedy skits. Every week sees a new group of celebrity guests, generally featuring at least one footballer who is free on the Saturday, and a mix of musicians, TV personalities, and other sportsmen.
