series:tt1132201.description: 15 kids find a mysterious man living in a cave with high-tech equipment. He claims to be a game developer and lets them test his creation, but once they start playing, they can't find a way to stop or exit.

series:tt1300170.name: Xam'd: Lost Memories
series:tt1300170.description: A young man imbued with a powerful entity called Hiruko during a terrorist attack must learn to control it, or risk turning to stone, while his island home is engulfed in war.

series:tt0086818.name: The Tripods
series:tt0086818.description: Cousins Will and Henry Parker, avoiding mind control by alien Masters via capping at 16, journey to find free humans after learning their world is conquered by Tripods in 2089.

series:tt3846904.name: The Hibiscus-Man
series:tt3846904.description: This science-fiction show revolves around a mad scientist, known by his friends as the "Al Ragol Al E'naab." The mad scientist concocts an elixir that gives regular human beings supernatural abilities. Though he tries to use his potion to help people, the government hinds him out and goes after him. In the midst of his manhunt, Egypt undergoes a major disaster, prompting the Egyptian government to seek out his help rather than his arrest.

series:tt6943298.name: Ending with Style
series:tt6943298.description: A conflict between men and women becomes a third world war. All humans die except for a number of men and women in Egypt. After the Haj and Hajja appear, a truce is called between the commander of the men's army (Sultan) and the leader of the women army (Karma), but what will happen during this truce?

series:tt0855326.name: A Step Into the Past
series:tt0855326.description: The main character, Hong Siu Lung (Louis Koo), is a special agent in Hong Kong (21st century).

series:tt11867066.name: AnnDroid
series:tt11867066.description: Russian scientists have created an android policeman. Perfect in all respects, Captain Anna Nikolaevna Korolkevich goes to serve in a provincial city to see real life and become a human. Colleagues think that Anna Nikolaevna is the daughter of the deputy minister, and nothing portends trouble until humanization goes too far.

series:tt13259622.name: Bee and PuppyCat
series:tt13259622.description: Bee is a young lady trying to make her way in the world. She often acts before thinking, which can lead her into trouble (and adventure!). She also has a strong, nurturing personality, and doesn’t think twice about taking in Puppycat when he needs help. Although her laid-back-space-casey attitude and lack of skills tend to keep her from maintaining a job for long in the human world, she isn’t someone who easily gives up, and with the experiences she gains at the magical temp agency she stumbles on, she’ll finally have the chance to find out what she’s meant to do with her life.

series:tt0978537.name: Ijon Tichy: Raumpilot
series:tt0978537.description:
Ijon Tichy: Raumpilot is a satiric German television series loosely based on the series of science fiction stories The Star Diaries by Stanisław Lem. The television series was created by Randa Chahoud, Dennis Jacobsen, and Oliver Jahn with Jahn playing the protagonist, space traveller Ijon Tichy. The major female role is played by Nora Tschirner.

The first season was aired from 26 March 2007 on ZDF on Mondays at 23:55 hours. Each episode used to be published online as a streaming video one week before the airing on ZDFmediathek, an online repository operated by that channel. In November 2011, the second season was aired on ZDFneo. Both seasons are available on DVD.

series:tt2309131.name: Continuum
series:tt2309131.description: A beautiful young woman awakens aboard an adrift space ship with no memory of who she is or how she got there and at the mercy of the ship's mysterious computer.

series:tt13464340.name: Alien Worlds
series:tt13464340.description: Applying the laws of life on Earth to rest of the galaxy, this series blends science facts and fiction to imagine alien life on other planets.

series:tt11210146.name: Heaven's Gate: The Cult of Cults
series:tt11210146.description: A comprehensive analysis of the UFO cult. The disappearance of 20 people, and the largest suicide on U.S. soil. Forever changing the face of modern era religion.

series:tt3152670.name: Ultimate Wolverine vs. Hulk
series:tt3152670.description: After Banner's execution for the Hulk's Manhattan rampage, reports of a mysterious creature emerge worldwide. Fury sends Wolverine to investigate, knowing he'll do whatever it takes.

series:tt10768876.name: OVNI(s)
series:tt10768876.description: A light-hearted comedy drama centred on Didier Mathure, a brilliant space engineer whose aspirations are shattered when the rocket he's spent a decade building explodes on take-off.

series:tt11916116.name: UFO Witness
series:tt11916116.description: Former FBI agent Ben Hansen travels across the US following the steps of Project Blue Book. In search of answers regarding extraterrestrial encounters, UFO's, alien life forms and alien technology.

series:tt5831366.name: The Passengers
series:tt5831366.description: Farrokh is a mid-aged man who lives with his brother Farid. They have a new family as their tenants but soon Farid discovers that they are alien who wants to research on Earth and send reports.

series:tt14028208.name: Clone High
series:tt14028208.description: Historical figures who have been cloned and placed back in high school, including Abraham Lincoln, Cleopatra, Joan of Arc, John F. Kennedy and more, as they face the trials of normal teenage life.

series:tt27507828.name: Fired on Mars
series:tt27507828.description: Jeff Cooper has to reinvent himself after being fired from his position in the space start-up Mars.Iy. With no chance to return to Earth, he has to find meaning again in a dangerous, alien, but familiar corporate landscape.

series:tt11988676.name: Hot Skull
series:tt11988676.description: In a dystopian world, as an epidemic spreads through verbal communication, a tyrannical institution pursues a linguist immune to the disease.

series:tt13865736.name: Wolf 2039
series:tt13865736.description: Second series of the WOLF franchise starts 25 years after the first outing. As alliances wear thin, and notions of global order are shattered, the world of 2039 is on the brink of total war. Dangerous technologies that exceed the grasp of humanity’s control threaten a frayed social fabric. The action-packed story will examine security and war in this near future world.

series:tt14301316.name: Creamerie
series:tt14301316.description: In the not-too-distant future, a viral plague has swept the earth. In a matter of weeks, it eradicated 99% of men. The remaining 1% were sent to The Facility in New Zealand but didn't survive. Or did they?

series:tt14578626.name: Star Wars Vehicle Flythroughs
series:tt14578626.description: Get up-close-and-personal with some of the Star Wars films’ most iconic and beloved ships and vehicles as this charming series whisks you off for fly-through tours of the Galaxy Far, Far Away.

series:tt13081200.name: Man in the Arena
series:tt13081200.description: Tom Brady shares a first-hand account of his Super Bowl appearances, and deconstructs the milestones of his legendary NFL career. Each episode explores the pivotal moments in Tom Brady's life on and off the field.

series:tt14126234.name: 100 Foot Wave
series:tt14126234.description: The globe-trotting adventures of big wave surfer Garrett McNamara, his family, and fellow surfers.

series:tt14088994.name: All American: Homecoming
series:tt14088994.description: Spinoff from 'All American' follows a young tennis hopeful from Beverly Hills and an elite baseball player from Chicago as they contend with the high stakes of university sports at a Historically Black College in Atlanta.

series:tt13850952.name: Uninterrupted's Top Class
series:tt13850952.description: Follow a new mecca of high school athletics nestled just outside of Los Angeles, the back-to-back state champion Sierra Canyon Trailblazers. Viewers get exclusive access to the team as they balance the pressures of competing on a global stage while finding success at one of the most academically elite high schools in the country.

series:tt14442878.name: The Kings
series:tt14442878.description: A four-part series featuring four champions who ushered in a boxing renaissance. The series showcases the dominance of Roberto Duran, Marvelous Marvin Hagler, Thomas Hearns and Sugar Ray Leonard and their battles in and out of the ring.

series:tt0481435.name: Baseball Tonight
series:tt0481435.description:
Baseball Tonight is a program that airs on ESPN. The show, which recapitulates the day's Major League Baseball action, has been on the air since 1990.

Its namesake program also airs on ESPN Radio at various times of the day during the baseball season, with Marc Kestecher as host.

Baseball Tonight is also the title of a daily podcast hosted by Buster Olney with frequent appearances by Jayson Stark and Tim Kurkjian.

series:tt14738480.name: AEW Rampage
series:tt14738480.description: AEW Rampage, also known simply as Rampage, is an professional wrestling television program. It is was produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW)

series:tt0329866.name: Koçum Benim
series:tt0329866.description: Students at a private high school are trained by a basketball coach not only for sports but also for life.

series:tt14220732.name: The Wasp
series:tt14220732.description: Professional dartsplayer Eddie is in a crisis. Fame gone, money gone, wife gone and physical fitness also leaves much to be desired. With the help of his old buddy Nobbe, who is also a rusty dart professional, but with a strong tendency towards alcohol, Eddie wants to find his way back into life and his career and to prove that he was not called "the wasp" for nothing. Easier said than done...

series:tt15144592.name: All or Nothing: Toronto Maple Leafs
series:tt15144592.description: Maple Leafs' on-ice action and behind-the-scenes access with players, coaches and fans.

series:tt14113324.name: All or Nothing: Juventus
series:tt14113324.description: Follow the popular Italian soccer club through the current 2020/21 season.

series:tt19851552.name: Love All Play
series:tt19851552.description: A romantic sports drama depicting the passion and affection for badminton of a male and female protagonist who are a mixed doubles group with players from the commercial badminton team.

series:tt14010212.name: FC Bayern - Behind the Legend
series:tt14010212.description: For the first time in their history, FC Bayern Munich gives us unfettered access to the locker room and behind the scenes at this top club. The 6-part documentary covers the turbulent season after their Champions League triumph in Lisbon, celebrates the legendary victories from the past, and links momentous events in Bayern's history to the current team.

series:tt14513646.name: Race: Bubba Wallace
series:tt14513646.description: This docuseries follows Bubba Wallace, the only Black driver currently in NASCAR's Cup Series, as he uses his voice and talent to change the sport.

series:tt14823452.name: Real Madrid: The White Legend
series:tt14823452.description: Real Madrid is the centenarian club that has produced a winning team in every era and generation. No other club has matched the success of the eternal champion. It is a role model for the sporting world. The club’s players and admirers take a look back at the milestones and historic adversity that have made Real Madrid the best team in the world.

series:tt18396468.name: MotoGP Unlimited
series:tt18396468.description: For the first time, viewers will get an intimate, unique, and exclusive look at the challenges faced by riders and teams during the season, both on and off the track.

series:tt0783392.name: Mike & Mike
series:tt0783392.description: Mike Golic and Mike Greenberg debate sports.

series:tt2211065.name: The Other Sport
series:tt2211065.description: The Other Sport (Swedish: Den andra sporten) is a three-part documentary series zooming in on the often harsh conditions of women's football/soccer in Sweden since the first clubs got structurally organized in the mid-1960's up un...

series:tt12116498.name: Edge of the Earth
series:tt12116498.description: Four groups of athletes embark on four never-before-accomplished missions.

series:tt14713552.name: The Captain
series:tt14713552.description: A compelling narrative revealing the man behind the icon - Derek Jeter. Amidst a time of great change in New York City, Derek Jeter’s arrival to the New York Yankees returned a struggling franchise to its traditional perch amongst baseball’s elite. As Derek forged a Hall of Fame worthy career, his second home molded him as a man.

series:tt21382958.name: La Máquina
series:tt21382958.description: After a devastating loss, Esteban “La Máquina” Osuna is at a low point in his boxing career. Lucky for him, his manager and best friend Andy Lujan is determined to get him back on top. But when a nefarious organization rears its head, the stakes of this rematch become life or death. Esteban must juggle his own personal demons and protect his family.

series:tt28299608.name: MF Ghost
series:tt28299608.description: Year 202X. Self-driving electric cars have replaced internal combustion engine-based cars, becoming ubiquitous in Japan. However, a racing circuit known as MFG, which employs traditional internal combustion cars.

series:tt14446288.name: Save Our Squad with David Beckham
series:tt14446288.description: David Beckham is coming home. Over the course of a season David joins East London club, Westward Boys, a team playing in the league where it all began for him as a boy – the Echo Premier League. Westward haven't won a game all season, and the threat of being relegated from the league looms large. David has a mammoth task at hand. Will he be able to save their squad?

series:tt24587530.name: Super League: The War for Football
series:tt24587530.description: The past, present, and future of European football collide when plans for a breakaway league emerge, leaving the game's most powerful leaders to defend or upend the traditions of the sport.

series:tt24901692.name: FC Barcelona: A New Era
series:tt24901692.description: Futbol Club Barcelona has enjoyed the best football of the world throughout its history. However, these past few years haven’t lived up to the club’s reputation. After having won every title as a captain, Xavi Hernández is chosen to manage the new project and recover the style and success of the old days.

series:tt17050700.name: Full Swing
series:tt17050700.description: Follows behind the scenes of what it takes to compete and win at the highest levels in men's professional golf, following the PGA players through their wins and losses.

series:tt27679458.name: Overtake!
series:tt27679458.description: Freelance photographer Kôya Madoka finds himself in a slump due to a certain reason. While he is at the Fuji International Speedway to work on a story, his life intersects with that of high school F4 driver Haruka Asahina.

series:tt20355702.name: Fifteen-Love
series:tt20355702.description: A former tennis prodigy makes an explosive allegation against her former coach. After the allegation, everyone is forced to reconsider what they thought they knew about their past success.

series:tt0369137.name: Fox NFL Sunday
series:tt0369137.description: The pre-game show for Fox's National Football League game telecasts under the Fox NFL brand.

series:tt26924816.name: Real Madrid: Until the End
series:tt26924816.description: On their path to one of the most remarkable endings in football history, which resulted in a record 14th Champions League triumph, they overcome the odds and doubters with the support of their ardent fans.

series:tt25050116.name: Running for my Truth: Alex Schwazer
series:tt25050116.description: After being banned for doping, Olympic medalist race walker Alex Schwazer enlists one of his accusers to help him make a comeback.

series:tt10366552.name: Boom! Boom!: The World vs. Boris Becker
series:tt10366552.description: The film will explore the life of Becker, who became a tennis sensation when he won the first of his six majors at the age of just 17 and went on to have a glittering career, including 49 major career titles and an Olympic Gold.

series:tt19296314.name: Tour de France: Unchained
series:tt19296314.description: Documentary on the journey of eight teams taking part in the world's most challenging Tour de France bike race.

series:tt13944138.name: Maggie
series:tt13944138.description: A young woman tries to cope with life while coming to terms with her abilities as a psychic. She can see everyone's futures, but her present is a mess.

series:tt13495314.name: Open Your Eyes
series:tt13495314.description: When Julia finds herself at an amnesia treatment center in the aftermath of a terrible accident that killed her family, she begins to form bonds with other patients who have experienced oddly similar traumas. She meets Adam, a mys...

series:tt12914570.name: Professor Miskovic's Notebook
series:tt12914570.description: A young journalist Bosko, along with his girlfriend Jelena and best friend Milenko, gets caught up in a conspiracy to obtain a notebook which records unexplained paranormal events.

series:tt15567434.name: Nihon Chinbotsu: Kibo no Hito
series:tt15567434.description: Japan's prime minister announces a plan to store contaminated material in deep-sea strata while entrusting a team of young technocrats to protect Japan's future.

series:tt15516280.name: Star Wars Galaxy of Sounds
series:tt15516280.description: The series explores the ambience of a galaxy far, far away through themes such as wonder, excitement, oddities, and more. Be immersed in the hum of Coruscant at golden hour, listen to the light side of the Force as Rey connects to past Jedi, and observe booming lightsaber duels. Experience the nostalgic sounds of Star Wars from across the franchise.

series:tt13880128.name: Vyzhivshie
series:tt13880128.description: A virus causes a epidemic where victims slip into comas if they sleep over 1.5 hours. Survivors team up, fighting off threats while trying to revive the "sleepers." But the awakened have a shared craving for glucose, facing a new ...

series:tt14902026.name: Infiniti
series:tt14902026.description: A dead body is found on a roof in Kazakhstan: it belongs to Anthony Kurz, an American astronaut currently on the ISS. Anna Zarathi, a French astronaut, and Isaak Turgun, a Kazakh cop, set out to solve this mysterious paradox.

series:tt17506706.name: Reset
series:tt17506706.description: The lives of a college student and a video game designer are kept being reset after an explosion on a bus. During each reset, they have to work together to find out what the reason for the explosion is. Will these two be able to save themselves and their fellow passengers? Will they be able to close the time-loop?

series:tt16442600.name: The Expanse: One Ship
series:tt16442600.description: An anthology of short webisodes of The Expanse, all relating to the Doctrine of One Ship - that there is only one ship, and it has countless parts as a single body has countless cells.

series:tt14644726.name: Silverpoint
series:tt14644726.description: The series follows a group of kids at an adventure camp who discover a strange artefact, while also drawn to the fate of four children who mysteriously disappeared twenty years ago.

series:tt13317454.name: Yakamoz S-245
series:tt13317454.description: After disaster strikes Earth, a marine biologist on a submarine research mission must fight to survive with the crew as a conspiracy comes to light.

series:tt1020167.name: Ghost Whisperer: The Other Side
series:tt1020167.description: Earthbound spirit Zach searches for answers about his death, meeting ghosts who teach him how to intersect with the living world, starring Mark Hapka as Zach.

series:tt15474794.name: The No Man Zone
series:tt15474794.description: The year is 2140. Society has undergone profound change and is now run as a matriarchy, thus removing its reliance on men. Two Hills is one of the communities founded by this new order. It is a place of perfection, where there is harmony rather than conflict, science and reason prevail and the environment is protected and respected. One of its inhabitants is the history teacher, Rada. On her birthday she takes her students on a guided tour of a special area outside of Two Hills, a place where the so-called “primates” live. The "primates" are men (and a handful of women) who have chosen to live beyond female control. However, the tranquillity of Rada’s perfectly arranged female-centric world comes under threat when she meets the young "primate", Hera. It’s a classic girl-meets-boy story, in a world where the rules have fundamentally changed.

series:tt17037878.name: Arcadia
series:tt17037878.description: Following a major catastrophe, a new society, Arcadia, is born. Resources have become scarce and a point system, known as the Citizen Score,  is introduced. It determines what you can and may do and what a citizen is entitled to.

series:tt15475278.name: Plan B
series:tt15475278.description: An anthology series centered on a mysterious agency called Plan B that allows people to travel back in time to change their lives.

series:tt1506339.name: Time of Eve
series:tt1506339.description: In a future where androids are commonplace, Rikuo notices his home android Sammy acting strangely. Following her activity logs with his friend Masaki, they discover a mysterious café that changes their perspective on artificial life.

series:tt26672563.name: Duty After School
series:tt26672563.description: A science fiction thriller that depicts all students across the country fighting against unidentified objects ahead of the CSAT and fighting for extra points.

series:tt23857504.name: Samsara
series:tt23857504.description: After celebrating his 35th birthday, time for Andrey begins to go in the opposite direction: every new day is the previous one for him. In order to return to the real flow of time, Andrey needs to correct the mistakes he made in the past.

series:tt16359848.name: Be My Favorite
series:tt16359848.description: Kawi gets a second chance at love—and revenge—when a magical crystal ball sends him back to the moment he lost everything.

series:tt0086723.name: Guest from the Future
series:tt0086723.description: A schoolboy finds a time machine and he helps Alisa, a scientist of the future, to save a mind-reading device from space pirates. Chased by the pirates and followed by Alisa he saves the device and takes it back to his own time.

series:tt23805348.name: The Cyberfarm
series:tt23805348.description: Farmer Nikolay has long ago settled on Mars with his family. He leads a peaceful life and tends to his robot-aided farmstead until the Head of a large corporation comes to Mars to get rid of the village and launch a new production...

series:tt18952884.name: Dumbsday
series:tt18952884.description: Dumbsday is a comedy-drama which plays with the conventions of post-apocalyptic TV series. The world has gone to hell in every possible way – and only seven people have survived. The show begins with our seven main characters trapped in an under-ground train tunnel in Oslo. Will they survive? And can these people really be the future of humanity?

series:tt12963502.name: Families Like Ours
series:tt12963502.description: In a not-too-distant future, Denmark faces total evacuation due to rising water levels. As the nation prepares to leave their homes, high school student Laura must choose between her divorced parents and the boy she's fallen in love with.

series:tt26760483.name: Kübra
series:tt26760483.description: When a suburban man receives messages that seem to predict the future, he develops a following

series:tt31924877.name: Extremely Inappropriate!
series:tt31924877.description: Ichiro is a PE teacher in 1986 feared by his students for a "tough love" approach, harsh tongue and frequently “inappropriate” behavior. He’s also a dad trying to raise a rebellious daughter after having lost his wife to illness. When he gets transported in time to 2024, he encounters modern sensibilities that teach him about empathy but also gives people of today a reason to rethink their own political correctness in this time traversing comedy about change.

series:tt26009468.name: The Tyrant
series:tt26009468.description: A secret project in Korea is exposed to the US so the project gets scrapped and the sample is to be handed over when a delivery accident occurs. Director Choe tries to hide the sample as Paul searches, but they end up at the same place as Jagyeong and Lim Sang. Who will seize the sample in the end?

series:tt27789542.name: Blood Free
series:tt27789542.description: After diving down a rabbit hole of tangled leads, a former bodyguard finds himself recruited to protect the CEO of a controversial lab-grown meat company who is also a survivor of the fateful attack that changed his life.

series:tt0138972.name: K-9 and Company
series:tt0138972.description: A one-episode television pilot for a proposed 1981 spin-off of the British science fiction television series Doctor Who. It features former series regulars Sarah Jane Smith, an investigative journalist played by Elisabeth Sladen, and K9, a robotic dog voiced by John Leeson. Both characters had been companions of the Fourth Doctor but they had not appeared together before. The single episode, A Girl's Best Friend was broadcast by BBC1 as a Christmas special on 28 December 1981 but was not taken up for a continuing series.

series:tt33332442.name: The Tithes
series:tt33332442.description: The Tithes is a three-part Warhammer animation anthology. It’s composed of three self-contained stories that each shine a different light on an interesting and little-explored slice of this vast, dystopian setting: The Imperial Tithe.

series:tt31158590.name: Tomorrow and I
series:tt31158590.description: Explore the intersection of futuristic technologies and Thai culture, and the unimaginable tensions and moral dilemmas that arise out of their inevitable conflict.

series:tt3857398.name: The Day After
series:tt3857398.description: Attempting to create a perfect human race, a drug company releases a virus that proves to be deadly. 11 strangers find themselves responsible for determining the future of all humanity.

series:tt35377276.name: The Hot Spot
series:tt35377276.description: Endo Kiyomi, a single mother near Mt. Fuji, works at a business hotel. One day, she meets an alien. Unlike a pure-hearted girl seeking justice, her life experiences lead her to ask the alien to solve minor work or personal issues.

series:tt37532634.name: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
series:tt37532634.description: Against the backdrop of a changing world, a tender romance between human and machine forces society to question the very essence of love, consciousness, and the bonds that make us human.

series:tt39229727.name: SNOWBALL EARTH
series:tt39229727.description: Ten years after saving Earth with his robot friend Yukio, Tetsuo returns to a planet of endless ice and snow.

series:tt0395417.name: Space Odyssey: Voyage to the Planets
series:tt0395417.description: Imagine crashing through the acid storms of Venus, taking a space walk in the magnificent rings of Saturn, or collecting samples on the disintegrating surface of an unstable comet. Seen through the eyes of five astronauts on a six-year mission to the new frontiers that make up our solar system, it reveals the spectacle - and the dangers - they face when landing on and exploring the exotic worlds of our neighbouring planets.

series:tt6197070.name: Blood Machines
series:tt6197070.description: An artificial intelligence escapes her spaceship to turn into a female ghost and challenges two blade runners to a galactic chase.

series:tt1704292.name: Battlestar Galactica: Blood & Chrome
series:tt1704292.description: The first Cylon war has been raging for 10 years and a young Ensign William Adama joins the fleet. He's disappointed not to be assigned to a fighter but to a freighter. His co-pilot, Lt. Coker Fasjovic, isn't too keen on having a rookie flying his aircraft as he has only a short time before he again becomes a civilian. Their cargo is a civilian scientist, Dr. Becca Kelly, but they no sooner leave than she has new orders for them and a new destination. She is less than forthcoming about just what her secret mission is but Adama is keen, particularly as it involves going into Cylon controlled space. Nothing is as it seems however.

series:tt2056910.name: Fallout: Nuka Break
series:tt2056910.description: A courier and his group of friends get dragged into something much bigger than delivering mail.

series:tt6162588.name: Brave and Beautiful
series:tt6162588.description: Cesur returns to his father's village with an elaborate plan to avenge the death of his father. The only thing he hadn't planned for is Suhan, the daughter of the man he believes is responsible for his father's murder.

series:tt10027946.name: My Husband Won't Fit
series:tt10027946.description: Kumiko and Kenichi meet in college and build a happy marriage together. But over time, an unusual problem threatens to destroy their relationship.

series:tt3792116.name: Love Stage!!
series:tt3792116.description: Izumi was born in a family of celebrities. His father is a singer, his mother an artist, his older brother the lead vocalist for the popular band CRUSHERZ. Izumi himself, however, is just a nerdy college student. He loves the manga "Magical Girl Lala Lulu" and dreams of becoming a manga writer himself. One day he is roped into filming a commercial where he wears a dress. Another actor on the set, Ryōma Ichijō, mistakes him for a woman and falls in love at first sight. As it turns out, though, they met ten years in the past. And Ryōma's feelings don't change when he finds out Izumi is a boy.

series:tt5858892.name: Age of Youth
series:tt5858892.description: Five college students, from different walks of life end up living together in a fictional house share called Belle Epoque.

series:tt7513452.name: Just Because!
series:tt7513452.description: Four high school students are ready for their university life, but with a new transfer student, it all changes.

series:tt0138257.name: The King of the Cattle
series:tt0138257.description: The enmity between two rancher families in territorial dispute, and the forbidden love between a drover and a landless, mysterious woman with no past.

series:tt6762348.name: Velvet Colección
series:tt6762348.description: Barcelona 1967. Ana Rivera returns from New York to launch her last dream: to make the leap from the exclusive business of haute couture in Madrid to a boutique in Barcelona with aspirations to become a global franchise.

series:tt0409594.name: North Shore
series:tt0409594.description: Intrigue abounds at the Grand Waimea Hotel, the perfect place for an exclusive Hawaiian getaway for the rich, powerful and beautiful.

series:tt3886152.name: Whichever Way the Ball Bounces
series:tt3886152.description: Katarina's, Tomislav's and Kreso's grandfather dies. He leaves them a million euros, but they can get the money only if they stay in the same house that he grew up in for a year or the money goes to the village. People from the vi...

series:tt0460654.name: Kitchen Confidential
series:tt0460654.description: A bad-boy chef runs wild in his New York City eatery.

series:tt2772104.name: Mischievous Kiss: Love in Tokyo

series:tt0118484.name: Sunset Beach
series:tt0118484.description:
Sunset Beach is an American television soap opera that aired on NBC from January 6, 1997 to December 31, 1999. The show follows the loves and lives of the people living in the Orange County coastal area named Sunset Beach, on the coast of California. Although there is a town in California called Sunset Beach, the show's beach scenes were shot on nearby Seal Beach. The show was co-produced by NBC and Spelling Television.

Sunset Beach won two Daytime Emmy Awards and was nominated another eleven times. The show also received twenty-two nominations for various other awards.

series:tt2309828.name: High Kick

The title of the show "High Kick!" has several implications, one of which is the oft-depicted high kicks of Yoon-ho, one of the main characters. The show aired in South Korea from Monday to Friday in sitcom format. Due to its popularity, the show filmed more episodes than were initially planned. Many of the characters starred in commercials and advertisements in Korea. The show's popularity also led to High Kick Through the Roof, which aired in 2009-2010, and High Kick 3: The Counterattack of the Short Leg, which aired in 2011-2012.

series:tt0403751.name: Dash Kappei
series:tt0403751.description:
The hero of the story is Kappei Sakamoto, a high school student with amazing athletic abilities who joins the basketball team of Seirin High School and quickly becomes one of the most skilled players. Kappei has one unusual handicap for a basketball player - his height; he stands not even one meter tall. His Achilles' heel is female undergarments; he has a particular interest in white panties, and is even more enthusiastic about joining the basketball team when he discovers that the team's female coach, Coach Natsu, wears white panties (although his inventive attempts to sneak a peek at said panties usually result in a physical beatdown from the hot-tempered coach). Eventually, Kappei's athletic prowess extends beyond basketball, and he tries out for - and excels at - every sport the school offers.

In the first episode, Kappei meets and becomes enamored with Akane Aki, a sweet, pretty girl who is quite athletic herself (she later joins the school's ping-pong team) and signs on as assistant coach of Seirin's basketball team. Much to Kappei's delight, not only is Akane pretty, but she also wears white panties, and Kappei sets his sights on winning her heart. Kappei eventually moves in with Akane and her family after his parents (who are rarely around) leave for the United States. However, Kappei has an unusual rival for Akane's heart - Akane's dog, Seiichiro, who has often fantasized about marrying his owner and, resenting Kappei, immediately seeks to sabotage his relationship with Akane through various tricks. Seiichiro can also speak, although only Kappei can understand him.

series:tt7817966.description: A young heir falls into a coma after being brutally assaulted. However, his mother is determined to keep him in the race for the family fortune and creates a robot to replace him.

series:tt6055498.name: Love O2O
series:tt6055498.description: A story of two popular college students who fell in love through an online game.

series:tt1757202.name: Iris
series:tt1757202.description: The National Security Service (NSS) is a secret South Korean black ops agency that takes on a secret terrorist organization, called IRIS.

series:tt1186342.name: Tess of the D'Urbervilles
series:tt1186342.description: The story of Tess Durbeyfield, a low-born country girl whose family find they have noble connections.

series:tt0085101.name: The Thorn Birds
series:tt0085101.description: In the arid 1920s Australian Outback, a Catholic priest and the beautiful niece of a vast sheep station owner stand powerless before God's will, tormented by desire. How far are they willing to go in the name of love?

series:tt6428698.name: Sotus the Series
series:tt6428698.description: A confident gay freshman at an engineering school relentlessly seduces the closeted mentoring junior who bullies him.

series:tt0790820.name: Hidden Palms
series:tt0790820.description: A rebellious teenager moves with his family to Palm Springs.

series:tt10101272.name: The Secret Life of My Secretary
series:tt10101272.description: After Do Min Ik, a competent director, loses his ability to recognise faces, he becomes dependent on Jung Gal Hee, his secretary, and eventually develops feelings for her.

series:tt10826064.name: When the Camellia Blooms
series:tt10826064.description: Dongbaek is a single mother. When a potential new love enters her life, she finds ways to defy the social stigmas surrounding her.

series:tt7817942.name: Radio Romance
series:tt7817942.description: Radio writer Song Geu Rim has passion and drive but lacks talent, staying an assistant. Radio linked her to her blind mother, shaping her career. When her show risks cancellation, she casts top actor Ji Su Ho, who depends on scripts.

series:tt4277268.name: Billy & Billie
series:tt4277268.description: A TV series that follows two step-siblings as they try and navigate their taboo romance.

series:tt1311356.name: Devil Beside You
series:tt1311356.description: When Qi Yue finally decides to confess her feelings to her longtime crush, a nervous mistake leads her to hand her love letter to the wrong person, changing the course of her college life.

series:tt8594250.name: Devilish Joy
series:tt8594250.description: Gong Ma Sung is a successor to the Sunwoo company. Life seems to be going well until he gets into a car accident while trying to help a woman.

series:tt9731288.name: Valeria
series:tt9731288.description: Valeria is a writer who's hit a dead end with both her writing and her husband. She finds solace in her three friends: Carmen, Lola, and Nerea.

series:tt2759642.name: The Last Cinderella
series:tt2759642.description: Sakura is a single 39-year-old woman who works as the assistant manager at a beauty salon. She spends her days making her customers look beautiful but doesn’t pay much attention to her own appearance. All of that changes when she goes to a party and meets Hiroto, a much younger man who is a biker. Will Sakura revel in the attention of the handsome but dangerous Hiroto or notice the constant interest of her hard-talking and hard-drinking salon manager, Rintaro?

series:tt1200618.name: Last Friends
series:tt1200618.description: Follow the life of Michiru Aida, a beauty parlor assistant who returns to Tokyo after 4 years. Bullied by her seniors at work and abused by her boyfriend, she is reunited with her best friend during high school, Ruka Kishimoto, a skilled motocross racer. Takeru, a make-up artist, is introduced to Ruka by her housemate, Eri and thus begin a journey of friendship.

series:tt0460693.name: What About Brian
series:tt0460693.description: Members of a group of Los Angeles friends are in different relationship stages: Brian questions his crush on a friend's fiancee Marjorie; other couples face starting a family, open marriage, proposing, wedding doubts.

series:tt8090388.name: Ms. Hammurabi
series:tt8090388.description: The series tells the story of the life of judges and the various disputes that they have to settle.

series:tt0460625.name: Beauty and the Geek
series:tt0460625.description: An unscripted program that pairs MENSA-worthy "geeks" with gorgeous women.

series:tt4996170.name: 5→9 From Five to Nine
series:tt4996170.description: At twenty-eight, Junko Sakuraba dreams of living and working in New York City but is stuck teaching English. While disappointed by her unfulfilled aspirations and lack of romantic experience, she attends a funeral where she meets Takane Hoshikawa, a handsome monk. After accidentally knocking a bowl of ash onto him during the service, Junko is mortified. Her embarrassment deepens when she is tricked into a matchmaking session and discovers Takane is the other party. Their unexpected encounters raise questions about whether their relationship is coincidental or destined.

series:tt10265158.name: Put Your Head on My Shoulder
series:tt10265158.description: As Si Tu Mo's graduation is nearing, she is confused about her future plans. Her ordinary days are suddenly shaken up when the genius Physics student Gu Wei Yi appears in her life. The two accidentally end up living together and chaos begins.

series:tt1569333.name: The Wallflower
series:tt1569333.description: Sunako is very happy living her life in the darkness of her room, with her skeleton friends and her horror movies to keep her company. The darkness she so loves is pierced brightly by four dazzling young men, who come to live in the same mansion as her, and she soon realizes that they have orders from her aunt to do anything to turn her into a prim and proper lady.

series:tt5079866.name: Love Me If You Dare
series:tt5079866.description: Simon is a criminal profiler from the US who returns to China. He hires Jenny to help him with his work, and they fall in love. But a serial-killer stalker is leaving calling cards for Simon in other killers' crime scenes.

series:tt10544464.name: Doctor John
series:tt10544464.description: Cha Yo-Han—an arrogant but genius doctor of anesthesiology—and Kang Shi-Young—a smart, warm resident of anesthesiology—work together to help people with mysterious cases of acute or chronic pain.

series:tt4773278.name: Hidden Truths
series:tt4773278.description: Intending to aid her family, a beautiful young girl accepts a job in a prominent model casting agency, only to discover their girls are also hired for something else.

series:tt2980110.name: First Dates
series:tt2980110.description: Initially an experiment in which real dates are filmed, and then viewers get the chance to apply to date the unsuccessful participants the following week. Later this aspect was removed and replaced with a cast of regular restauran...

series:tt0085112.name: The Winds of War
series:tt0085112.description: The trials of the Henry and Jastrow families in the early years of World War II.

series:tt1068439.name: Hotaru no Hikari: It's Only A Little Light in My Life
series:tt1068439.description: When she's not at her fancy job, Hotaru just wants to relax at home - until her landlord's son shows up, and it's none other than her fastidious boss.

series:tt0364797.name: Blue Murder
series:tt0364797.description: Single mother DCI Janine Lewis struggles with the problems of bringing up four children while leading her team of detectives in solving high-profile murders.

series:tt1834598.name: Marchlands
series:tt1834598.description: A supernatural drama telling the story of three different families living in the same house in 1968, 1987 and the present day, linked by the spirit of the young daughter of the 1960s family, who drowned in mysterious circumstances.

series:tt0090455.name: If Tomorrow Comes
series:tt0090455.description: Tracy was an innocent, in love and pregnant by the son of a wealthy family. She is sent to prison for a crime she did not commit. When she gets out, she proposes to take revenge on the people who framed her.

series:tt7077616.name: A Rooster for Esculapio
series:tt7077616.description: A young working-class man comes from Misiones (an Argentinian province) to Buenos Aires, with a fighting rooster, looking for his brother, and gets involved with low life characters, who introduce him to a world of crime.

series:tt1744638.name: Case Sensitive
series:tt1744638.description: When Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, the case divides new DS Charlie Zailer and her DC Simon Waterhouse.

series:tt1554369.name: The Booth at the End
series:tt1554369.description: An apparently random group of strangers each enter into a Faustian pact with a mysterious figure, whom they believe possesses the power to grant any wish. In return, they must carry out an assigned task and update him on their pro...

series:tt9537306.name: Possessed
series:tt9537306.description: A reluctant clairvoyant joins forces with a brusque police detective hiding a soft heart to help him solve criminal cases using her psychic abilities.

series:tt0111982.name: Get Smart
series:tt0111982.description: Maxwell Smart, now Chief of Control, has to deal with his own bumbling secret agent, his son Zach.

series:tt5203748.name: 13 Commandments
series:tt5203748.description: A serial killer reverts to the 10 commandments in order to kick society a conscience with his crimes.

series:tt3632248.name: Blue Eyes
series:tt3632248.description: Politics, extremism and violence in Sweden.

series:tt7371868.name: Pine Gap
series:tt7371868.description: Set in the intensely secretive world of intelligence and the enigmatic US/Australia joint defence facility in central Australia, the spy-thriller Pine Gap delves into the famously strong alliance between the two countries.

series:tt2649588.name: What Remains
series:tt2649588.description: A young couple move into an apartment only to find the body of a young woman that had been missing for 2 years but never registered as missing which leads to a deeper investigation into what actually happened.

series:tt8409854.name: Hidden Worlds
series:tt8409854.description: When a prominent writer finds confidential documents incriminating government officials, he decided to publish them, risking his own life and his family's.

series:tt0372091.name: Sea of Souls
series:tt0372091.description: A group of faculty and staff at a Glasgow university studies the paranormal.

series:tt8453458.name: Uspjeh
series:tt8453458.description: Follows the intertwining stories of four strangers who are bound together by a violent event.

series:tt9146104.name: The Last Empress
series:tt9146104.description: In an alternate universe where Korea is a monarchy, an actress marries the emperor. As time passes, she gets caught up in a power struggle and the investigation of a murder that threatens the regime.

series:tt7582346.name: The Dying Detective
series:tt7582346.description: A doctor orders lifestyle change to prevent heart attack. Retired detective investigates 1985 rape and murder case, following a killer in Sweden, uncertain of next steps.

series:tt32056314.name: Kabul
series:tt32056314.description: Kabul, August 14, 2021. The Taliban are at the gates of the city, and France prepares to evacuate its embassy. But the sudden fall of Kabul the next day rushes all the plans. French, Italian, German, American diplomats and the police must improvise the evacuation of hundreds of Afghans and refugees to the airport. While chaos reaches the city, the Afghans will soon have only two choices: to kneel or to run away.

series:tt11398870.name: Caliphate
series:tt11398870.description: Agent Fatima gets a tip that a terrorist act is planned in Sweden. At the same time, teenager Sulle has opened her eyes to her student assistant who opens the doors to a fascinating new world.

series:tt26743607.name: War Sailor
series:tt26743607.description: The sailor Alfred is in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean when World War II breaks out. Suddenly the sailors are in the front of the war, without any weapons.

series:tt0107423.name: Lipstick on Your Collar
series:tt0107423.description: During the Suez Crisis of 1956, two young clerks at the stuffy Foreign Office in Whitehall display little interest in the decline of the British Empire. To their eyes, it can hardly compete with girls, rock music, and the intrigue of romantic entanglements.

series:tt0081878.name: It Ain't Half Hot Mum
series:tt0081878.description: The comic adventures of a group of misfits who form an extremely bad concert party touring the hot and steamy jungles of Burma entertaining the troops during World War II.

series:tt4696944.name: Close to the Enemy
series:tt4696944.description: A British intelligence officer has to ensure that a captured German scientist helps the British develop jet aircraft.

series:tt0077078.name: The Sandbaggers
series:tt0077078.description: The missions of an elite British Intelligence covert operations unit.

series:tt0055689.name: McHale's Navy
series:tt0055689.description: The misadventures of a misfit PT boat crew during World War II.

series:tt4338336.name: X Company
series:tt4338336.description: Set in the exciting and dangerous world of the Second World War, it follows the stories of five highly skilled young recruits.

series:tt0062552.name: Dad's Army
series:tt0062552.description: A ragtag group of Home Guard volunteers prepare for an imminent German invasion during World War II.

series:tt0106138.name: Soldier Soldier
series:tt0106138.description: Drama following the life of the officers and men of the King's Own Fusiliers regiment, during their home lives, training exercises and battles.

series:tt7939218.name: Devils
series:tt7939218.description: A worldwide financial conspiracy is discovered by a group of traders of a large investment bank.

series:tt10133370.name: Stalk
series:tt10133370.description: Gifted teen hacker Lux gets humiliated at engineering school. To get revenge, he cyberstalks and befriends the popular clique, manipulating them with their own secrets until his scheme backfires.

series:tt30317229.name: La Palma
series:tt30317229.description: A Norwegian family vacationing in La Palma faces chaos when a researcher discovers imminent volcanic eruption signs that could trigger a massive tsunami.

series:tt20765320.name: Six Four
series:tt20765320.description: Follows police detective Chris and his wife, former undercover officer Michelle, whose teenage daughter goes missing.

series:tt14351748.name: Fatal Attraction
series:tt14351748.description: A deep-dive reimagining of the classic 1980s thriller, exploring timeless themes of marriage and infidelity through the lens of modern attitudes toward strong women, personality disorders and coercive control.

series:tt3489236.name: State of Affairs
series:tt3489236.description: A CIA officer is plucked from the field to become the president's daily briefer, assuming responsibility for targeting America's most critical threats while navigating the unique lifestyle that comes with such a high-powered job.

series:tt33995822.name: The Cage
series:tt33995822.description: Two casino workers discover they're both stealing from the same safe, entangling them with each other, the gangster they're robbing, and the police.

series:tt21942560.name: North Shore
series:tt21942560.description: When British and Australian detectives team up to solve a murder mystery, they uncover a conspiracy with international political consequences as well as a clash of cultures.

series:tt2181219.name: Spin
series:tt2181219.description: After the assassination of the president, the electoral campaign begins again. The president's former advisor, is trying to promote his foals. The Secretary of State, is also in the running. The dirty tricks multiply.

series:tt1048097.name: Liquidation
series:tt1048097.description: Wide-scale operation against criminality turning into something more dangerous in post-WWII Odessa.

series:tt3074646.name: The Assets
series:tt3074646.description: CIA counter-intelligence officer Sandy Grimes works to save Soviet intelligence officers from being exposed by a mole inside her organization.

series:tt5808318.name: The Halcyon
series:tt5808318.description: The story of a bustling and glamorous five star hotel at the center of London society and a world at war.

series:tt1795096.name: Behzat Ç: An Ankara Detective Story
series:tt1795096.description: An inharmonious police team in Ankara Police Force and its discredited police chief fight crime.
