series:tt16303630.name: Headhunters
series:tt16303630.description: The place is Oslo, the year is 2002, and Roger Brown is a newly employed headhunter in an exclusive recruitment agency. He is given the prestigious task of finding a new top manager for the oil company Njord Oil. Roger is willing to do whatever it takes to quickly climb the career ladder. Takes place before the novel "Headhunters" by Jo Nesbø.

series:tt22297578.name: Cat
series:tt22297578.description: A former police informant is forced to become an informant again to save the life of his brother, which forces him to come to terms with his dark past.

series:tt21351566.description: An young employee at a well known bank passes away jumping from the building rooftop. People speculate that, it is a suicide but her partner Adnan, who’s also her coworker figures out it is not just a mere suicide, rather a murder. Adnan and another coworker get on a journey to uncover the real mystery behind Jisha’s untimely death.

series:tt17676706.description: Tells the story of Roman Compte, Cuban exile, CIA operative, and general manager of the Hotel Mutiny, the glamorous epicenter of the late '70s and early '80s Miami cocaine scene.

series:tt19866040.name: Enemy of the People
series:tt19866040.description: Journalist calls down the wrath of her readers by trying to uncover the connection between the murder of a local football hero and a cryptocurrency. Searching for the truth she risks not only her reputation, but her life.

series:tt23149640.name: Bargain
series:tt23149640.description: Men are lured to a remote hotel, only to be caught in an organ trafficking ring. After a catastrophic earthquake, the survivors fight to escape.

series:tt21963650.description: Héctor Belascoarán leaves his corporate job and dull marriage to become an independent detective and tackle shocking criminal cases in 1970s Mexico City.

series:tt15768302.description: Truck driver Erwin believes that he's helping people when he smuggles refugees, but shocking consequences follow a moment of distraction.

series:tt22045768.description: Three women with different connections to one man need to find a way to get out of the monster's grip.

series:tt23826450.description: Near the Franco-German border, in the heart of the Black Forest and the binational military base; 12 bodies are found in a mass grave. All the victims are men, both French and German.

series:tt15554596.name: The Golden Hour
series:tt15554596.description: A Dutch detective of Afghan descent, Mardik gets the information stating that his childhood friend Faysal is in the Netherlands. When a terrorist attack occurs the next day, Mardik suspects Faysal and starts to investigate on own ...

series:tt20565150.description: It follows Becca, a forensics expert who, when investigating a murder, realizes that the body of the victim looks exactly like her.

series:tt22801126.description: Rowan's life spirals when son Finn is coerced into a botched drug deal by a local gang. With Finn's life on the line and a violent gang leader encroaching on her life, Rowan is faced with recuperating the money that Finn lost.

series:tt18382028.name: Copycat Killer
series:tt18382028.description: A serial killer takes advantage on the media interest over his murders, manipulating their victims, police and the media, turning the murders into a spectacle mediatic.

series:tt12966558.description: Two very different women, Alice a formidable PA and Cheryl a best-selling fantasy author, become trapped in a triangle of epic proportions with Rob an eccentric and celebrated 'ecopreneur' who may or may not be trying to destroy them both.

series:tt20453286.description: A group of old friends reunited at a funeral make a drunken pact. Rather than let each other suffer a slow and painful decline they would engineer a dignified death. But what starts out as a fanciful idea soon morphs into shocking reality.

series:tt22015782.description: It follows forensic pathologist David Hunter, who gave up his work to settle down as a doctor in the rural village of Manham. When a woman is found dead, David struggles to stay out of the investigation.

series:tt0295006.name: Villospår
series:tt0295006.description: A Kurt Wallander mystery told from the perspectives of police and criminal. A foreign teenage girl burns herself to death under inspector Wallander's eyes. Several homicides take place where the victim is not only killed but scalp...

series:tt0386620.description: In this adaption of a Henning Mankell novel, Inspector Kurt Wallander investigates a case of murder and trade of human organs.

series:tt8712456.description: It consists of the fictionalization of the story of 'Los Miami's', a criminal organization led by 'El inmortal' that controlled the cocaine trade in Madrid in the 1990s.

series:tt26773360.description: A medical mystery thriller that traces the truth of the incident of a famous plastic surgeon, who had a reputation as a righteous man, who fell into the abyss after being caught up in an unexpected incident and underwent reconstructive plastic surgery for crime victims.

series:tt18988142.name: You Would Do It Too
series:tt18988142.description: A bus is hijacked by three robbers—who end up dead before they can get away. Every passenger's story is the same: A hooded man saved the day. As the case unfolds, the line between hero and criminal begins to blur.

series:tt1720607.name: Top Chef: Just Desserts
series:tt1720607.description: A spin-off of "Top Chef," in which the express focus is desserts and the contestants are pastry chefs.

series:tt3275212.description: People from around the world are bringing back Jim Henson's creatures back to life by competing to see who is the better monster maker.

series:tt2209649.name: Tattoo Nightmares
series:tt2209649.description: Get ready for another round of Tattoo Nightmares. There's nothing worse than a bad tattoo. Three of the nation's top tattoo artists run a one-of-a-kind shop specializing in the seriously difficult art of covering up woeful ink work.

series:tt0441718.name: Iron Chef America: The Series
series:tt0441718.description: America's chefs battle the food wizardry of the resident Iron Chefs.

series:tt5320618.description: A group of friends own and operate a company that specializes in all things diesel. Not only do these guys sell parts for diesel trucks and Jeeps, they also design and build diesel-powered vehicles.

series:tt5866048.name: Fuck, That's Delicious
series:tt5866048.description: Rapper Action Bronson travels the world performing with friends, and trying new foods.

series:tt2273316.name: Das Duell um die Welt
series:tt2273316.description:
Joko gegen Klaas – Das Duell um die Welt is a German reality series, broadcast on the German television network ProSieben on prime time. In English the show is called Joko vs. Klaas – The Battle for the World .

It is a show that pins its two stars against one another in a series of challenges all over the globe. Hosts Joachim ‘Joko’ Winterscheidt and Klaas Heufer-Umlauf give each other a series of outrageous and tough challenges in countries all over the world; they know where they’re going but have no idea what they will have to do until they get there. It is a travel game show and reality series where each host tries to push the other to their limits in an attempt to be crowned the “world champion” by taking on all the obstacles and coming out on top as the one who has won the battle for world domination.

series:tt9316032.name: Instant Hotel
series:tt9316032.description: A reality television series which began airing on the Seven Network, Australia and now a Netflix original series. The series follows homeowners who have transformed their homes into hotels and are individually judged by each other...

series:tt5710198.name: Good Bones

series:tt1663613.name: Work of Art: The Next Great Artist
series:tt1663613.description: Contestants are faced with the challenge of creating unique pieces in a variety of mediums such as painting, sculpture, photography, collage and industrial design.

series:tt1509677.description: A game show where contestants aim to score the fewest points possible by guessing the least popular answers given by people in polls on various subjects.

series:tt6128376.description: An updated version of the 1970s game show that allowed people with all different types of "talent" compete before a panel of celebrity judges.

series:tt0809816.name: Thank God You're Here
series:tt0809816.description: An improvisational comedy series in which a celebrity performer is dressed up in costume before passing through a door into a room where they are welcomed with the phrase "Thank God you're here."

series:tt0259128.name: BattleBots
series:tt0259128.description: Teams of homemade robots compete against each other.

series:tt1587790.name: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn
series:tt1587790.description: A conspiracy around Laplace's Box is potentially going to start another war between the Earth Federation and Neo Zeon. Chosen by fate, Banagher Links gets the key to the box, and must follow his heart to decide what to do with it.

series:tt0109537.name: Family Album
series:tt0109537.description: Based on Danielle Steel's novel of a celebrated actress-filmmaker whose family life is marked with love and strife.

series:tt6982472.name: Kamen Rider Build
series:tt6982472.description: 10 years ago when the Pandora Box was discovered on Mars and brought to Earth, it's activated and creates a Skywall which divides Japan into Touto, Seito, and Hokuto resulting into untold chaos.

series:tt31852720.name: A Life's Worth
series:tt31852720.description: A deep dive into the Bosnian War, that tore the country apart at the dawn of the 1990s, A Life’s Worth explores with intensity the unimaginable dilemma faced by the peacekeepers sent to the region, unable to intervene in a conflict that was beyond their control. A gripping series and a much-needed look back at one of the most violent wars in recent European history, prompting an essential discussion about the weight of commitment, interventionism, and the cost of peace.

series:tt36966597.name: The Black Berets
series:tt36966597.description: During Operation Brave Flag in northern Syria, a Turkish tank unit is cut off from its main force after terrorists destroy a key bridge. Faced with a harsh choice—destroy their tank and await rescue, or dig in and fight—they must outmaneuver a ruthless warlord to make it out alive with minimal military and civilian casualties.

series:tt13580888.name: No Pains, No Gains
series:tt13580888.description: After reading a notebook from his father, Asad tries to find a treasure which is hided in the mountains, he meets Emad & Manouchehr during the story and they make a competition to find the treasure

series:tt37989030.name: Kill to Love
series:tt37989030.description: A Southern prince and a Northern assassin, bound since childhood, struggle with love and betrayal as political intrigue threatens to tear them apart.

series:tt6380170.name: Riphagen
series:tt6380170.description: During the Second World War, the notorious Amsterdam criminal Dries Riphagen worked fanatically with the Nazis. Riphagen becomes immeasurably rich by tracking down, extorting and betraying Jewish people in hiding, and feels untouchable in the process. But when he betrays an important resistance group, the young police officer and resistance fighter Jan van Liempd opens the hunt for him.

series:tt38607251.name: Founder: Orhan
series:tt38607251.description: Kuruluş: Orhan is a Turkish historical drama that follows the life of Orhan Bey, the son of Osman I and the second ruler of the Ottoman Empire. Set in the 14th century, the series portrays Orhan’s transformation from a young warrior into a visionary leader who expands his father's legacy by conquering key Byzantine cities like Bursa and establishing the foundations of a powerful empire. With political intrigue, epic battles, and complex relationships, the show explores Orhan’s rise amidst internal strife and external threats, continuing the legacy of Kuruluş: Osman with a new generation of characters and high-stakes storytelling.

series:tt0273021.name: Sword of Honour
series:tt0273021.description:
Sword of Honour is a two-part adaptation of Evelyn Waugh’s semi-autobiographical World War II trilogy, initially aired Channel 4 on 2 January 2001.

Guy Crouchback embarks on a heroic quest to regain his honour and manhood; however, his encounters with the absurd reality of life in the British Army — strewn with bureaucratic blunders, military debacles, and indelibly eccentric characters — proves to be more of a challenge than facing the enemy itself.

series:tt0461658.name: Dresden
series:tt0461658.description: In January 1945, the young nurse Anna Mauth, working at a hospital in Dresden, becomes engaged to senior physician Benjamin Wenninger. At the same time, an English Lancaster bomber is shot down. The pilot Robert Newman, the only survivor, manages to reach the city severely injured and hides in the hospital's cellar. Anna discovers him incidentally thinking he is a German deserter, but finally decides to help Robert...

series:tt0113309.name: Hiroshima
series:tt0113309.description: Hiroshima is a 1995 Japanese / Canadian film directed by Koreyoshi Kurahara and Roger Spottiswoode about the decision-making processes that led to the dropping of the atomic bombs by the United States on the Japanese cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki toward the end of World War II. A combination of dramatisation, historical footage, and eyewitness interviews, the film alternates between documentary footage and the dramatic recreations.

series:tt43658562.name: Night of a Century
series:tt43658562.description: Fifteen of july 2016. That night, heroes proved that they exist. In that very night, Turkish nation stood up against traitors. Enemies of the state were brutally beaten by the Turkish nation. This is a story of betrayal, a heinous coup and a nation fighting for her freedom.

series:tt0835977.name: Australia's Next Top Model
series:tt0835977.description: Australian version of the hit American television series, where an open call for the 'next top model' is whittled down to a handful of hopefuls. Week by week one of the girls is eliminated until only one remains and is crowned Aus...

series:tt9581778.name: The Circle France

series:tt4063608.name: The Island
series:tt4063608.description: Fourteen American men are marooned on an uninhabited Pacific island with only a handful of tools and their wits. Will these 21st century men rediscover their primal instincts and band together to survive?

series:tt1713288.name: Extreme Weight Loss
series:tt1713288.description: ABC's Extreme Makeover: Weight Loss Edition is a new weight loss show for anyone who has 200 pounds or more to shed. In this trans-formative new experience, we bring the tools and tips to change your life straight to you! Each wee...

series:tt0390700.description: The property show that helps prospective buyers find their dream home.

series:tt6069204.name: The Selection: Special Operations Experiment
series:tt6069204.description: Civilians train like members of the U.S. military's special-operations unit from veterans of the Navy SEALs, Green Berets and Army Rangers.

series:tt4838586.description: Port Protection Alaska shows a real way to define expectations when Nature commands attention for essentials in a subsistence group of men and women numbering under 100.

series:tt7518558.name: The Big Family Cooking Showdown
series:tt7518558.description: Competitive food show celebrating the families who make ordinary food extraordinary, presented by Zoe Ball and Nadiya Hussain.

series:tt8887956.name: Death by Magic
series:tt8887956.description: Magician Drummond Money-Coutts travels the globe, sharing his infectious love of his craft and attempting feats that proved fatal to other magicians.

series:tt0490547.name: Solitary
series:tt0490547.description: Contestants compete for prizes by enduring tough conditions such as solitary confinement and sleep deprivation.

series:tt11168116.name: Sugar Rush Christmas
series:tt11168116.description: Four sets of bakers compete in Christmas themed baking challenges. First round is cupcakes, second round confections, and final round cakes. After each challenge, one group is eliminated and the winner of the final challenge gets ...

series:tt6645582.description: A group of New Yorkers share a house on the weekends in the luxurious Hamptons, where they go to escape the stress of city life and the only things guaranteed are sun, fun and drama.

series:tt1970923.name: Kenny Hotz's Triumph of the Will
series:tt1970923.description: Actor Kenny hotz puts himself through a series of morally difficult challenges . Will he triumph in the end ?

series:tt1395384.description: Do you have a huge snake? A raccoon family living in your attic? Or are you so backwater redneck that you're attracted to your sister? If so then call billy to help you out.

series:tt4875336.description: Kortney and Dave Wilson breathe new life into rundown homes in Nashville.

series:tt7332358.name: The Great Canadian Baking Show
series:tt7332358.description: A group of amateur Canadian bakers are convened for a baking competition. There is a theme to each week's competition, generally in the vein of the type of goods the competitors are to bake.

series:tt1248289.name: Scream Queens
series:tt1248289.description: Ten unknown actresses compete for a role in a horror movie from Lionsgate Films.

series:tt6369836.name: Documental
series:tt6369836.description: Ten artists pay a participation fee of one million Japanese yen to enter a room together for six hours.

series:tt3593456.name: Dr. Oakley, Yukon Vet
series:tt3593456.description: Dr. Oakley is the only vet in her area of the Yukon. She treats domestic pets, endangered wildlife, farm animals--basically anything that walks on fours, crawls, flies. All of that- plus she's a wife and a mom of three girls.

series:tt0240267.name: GameSpot TV
series:tt0240267.description: 'Gamespot TV' renewed as 'Extended Play' and later as 'X-Play' is a video game show that reviews video games.

series:tt6906110.name: Maine Cabin Masters
series:tt6906110.description: Chase Morrill, his sister Ashley, Ashley's husband Ryan Eldridge, team members Matthew Dix, Jared Baker, Brad Weston, and Lance Gatcomb, and other team members, breathe new life into their clients' cabins across the Great State of...

series:tt2078994.name: Graveyard Carz
series:tt2078994.description: The world is littered with the decaying uni-body's of former muscle cars, but at Graveyard Carz, no classic Mopar is too rusted for it to not get restored. These blue-collar technicians live by the motto: it's Mopar or it's No Car.

series:tt9812514.name: Portals to Hell
series:tt9812514.description: Jack Osbourne and paranormal researcher Katrina Weidman search for ghosts.

series:tt2815618.name: Ladies of London
series:tt2815618.description: Think British high society is all tea parties and politeness? Think again. These social climbers know all too well that living in London luxury has its pitfalls.

series:tt0977628.name: The Great British Menu
series:tt0977628.description: Top British chefs compete against each other and are scored by a panel of acclaimed judges for the chance to cook one course of a four course banquet.

series:tt0278249.name: Trading Spaces
series:tt0278249.description: Two teams, two days, $1000. This show pits neighbor against neighbor in a race to redecorate a room in each-other's homes. Can a friendship survive this weekend?

series:tt0341864.name: Location, Location, Location
series:tt0341864.description: No floorboard is left unturned as dynamic property experts Kirstie Allsopp and Phil Spencer help house-hunters find the perfect home in the perfect location.

series:tt0416359.name: The Contender
series:tt0416359.description: Hosts Sylvester Stallone and Sugar Ray Leonard give 16 young boxing hopefuls a shot at the big time in this Mark Burnett and Jeffrey Katzenberg reality drama.

series:tt12176398.name: Cooked with Cannabis
series:tt12176398.description: Cooked with Cannabis is a competitive cooking show where three chefs make cannabis infused meals for a chance to win $10,000. Co-hots Kelis and Leather Storrs judge the contestants with the assistance of their "best buds" who are ...

series:tt6588218.name: Terrace House: Aloha State
series:tt6588218.description: Terrace House: Aloha State focuses on six young people living in beautiful Hawaii. The camera crew follows the cast 24 hours-a-day to capture events in their lives as each pursues their dream.

series:tt0842903.name: Ace of Cakes
series:tt0842903.description: Chef and owner of Charm City Cakes in Baltimore, Maryland, Duff Goldman, and his crew of decorators attempt to create amazing and awe-inspiring cakes for their clients each week.

series:tt1114705.name: Celebrity Rehab with Dr. Drew
series:tt1114705.description: Eight celebrities check into rehab under Dr. Drew for 21 days.

series:tt0115227.name: Judge Judy
series:tt0115227.description: Judge Judy Sheindlin, a former judge from New York, tackles actual, small claims cases with her no-nonsense attitude in which damages of no more than $5,000 can be awarded.

series:tt2432822.name: Flea Market Flip
series:tt2432822.description: Contestants buy and repurpose flea market finds to earn a profit.

series:tt0264263.name: Jackass
series:tt0264263.description: The cast performs various crazy stunts for our amusement.

series:tt4181892.name: On the Spot
series:tt4181892.description: Rooster Teeth Productions' official weekly game show that pits two Rooster Teeth teams against each other and “on the spot” to earn points.

series:tt1318007.name: Celebrity Juice
series:tt1318007.description: A comedy TV show starring the fictional character Keith Lemon.

series:tt0103363.name: The Big Breakfast
series:tt0103363.description:
The Big Breakfast was a British light entertainment television show shown on Channel 4 and S4C each weekday morning from 28 September 1992 until 29 March 2002 during which period 2,482 shows were produced. The Big Breakfast was produced by Planet 24, the production company co-owned by former Boomtown Rats singer and Live Aid organiser Bob Geldof.

The programme was distinctive for broadcasting live from former lockkeepers' cottages commonly referred to as "The Big Breakfast House", or more simply, "The House", located on Fish Island, in Bow in east London.

The show was a mix of news, weather, interviews, audience phone-ins and general features, with a light tone which was in competition with the more serious GMTV and even more serious BBC breakfast programmes.

series:tt0069608.name: Match Game
series:tt0069608.description: Host Gene Rayburn's five-day-a-week syndicated successor to the popular CBS game show, where two contestants could compete to match fill-in-the-blank phrases with answers provided by a panel of six celebrities.

series:tt0166064.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
series:tt0166064.description: A game show created in the United Kingdom, in which contestants attempt to answer general knowledge questions in an intimidating atmosphere in order to scoop the £1 million top prize. The original series was hosted by Chris Tarrant, and its modern-day revival is hosted by Jeremy Clarkson.

series:tt0211178.name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
series:tt0211178.description: Contestants are chosen based on their ability to arrange 4 answers to a question in the correct order the fastest. They then have 15 multiple-choice questions correctly to win increasing amounts of money, the largest is $1,000,000.

series:tt2245386.name: The Taste
series:tt2245386.description: Sixteen competitors, from pro chefs to home cooks, cook dishes attempting to impress four of the world's most notable chefs. The catch is all the dishes will be judged in a blind taste test.

series:tt1811179.name: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
series:tt1811179.description: Aspiring magicians from all over the world perform their best tricks to try and fool Penn and Teller, the world-famous magician duo. If the two can not guess how the trick was done, the "fooler" gets to be on their Las Vegas magic...

series:tt2345459.name: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
series:tt2345459.description: A raunchy spoof edition of Countdown (1982) with the stars of 8 Out of 10 Cats (2005).

series:tt3037520.name: Hollywood Game Night
series:tt3037520.description: Features two contestants, each with a team of celebrity guests, competing in pop culture party games for a chance to win $25,000.

series:tt7865962.name: Run BTS!
series:tt7865962.description: Run BTS (Dallyeola Bangtan!) is a South Korean show by the boy band BTS (Bangtan Sonyeondan). The show is all about BTS doing activities, challenges, games and lots more.

series:tt27763346.name: Lies Hidden in My Garden
series:tt27763346.description: The story depicts the life of a woman who starts to doubt her happy daily life and two women struggling to escape from their unhappy daily lives.

series:tt24018168.name: The Others
series:tt24018168.description: Two neighboring couples are shocked after their teenage children's fight, with absurd consequences. What could be a common misunderstanding grows and reveals the limits and influence of parents in raising children.

series:tt27598784.name: Myself Allen Swapan
series:tt27598784.description: Year 2018, Cox's Bazar. Government's anti-narcotic raid is underway with great intensity. News spreads that the infamous drug dealer, Allen Swapan, is killed in a crossfire. Meanwhile, someone resembling him, going by the name of Shamsur Rahman, appears in Dhaka city. Who is this Shamsur Rahman?

series:tt18246900.name: Two Sides of the Abyss
series:tt18246900.description: Police officer Luise Berg heads for an inevitable catastrophe after her daughter’s murderer is released early from prison. A psychologically complex game of confusion begins in which the boundaries of guilt and innocence, perpetrators and victims, law and justice are constantly blurred.

series:tt20833168.name: Barracuda Queens
series:tt20833168.description: It tells the story of a group of young women who carry out burglaries to liberate themselves from the expectations on women.

series:tt27664007.name: Bitch X Rich
series:tt27664007.description: Kim Hye-in has to transfer to Cheongdam International High School after witnessing a murder. She crosses paths with Baek Je-na, a bully who happens to be connected to the case.

series:tt21327000.name: Burn the House Down
series:tt21327000.description: Follows Anzu Murata, who thirteen years after the home of the wealthy Mitarai family was burned in an fire, infiltrates the house of the Mitarais as a housekeeper in order to reclaim the house and family that was taken from her.

series:tt21132302.name: Safe Home
series:tt21132302.description: Twenty-something Phoebe leaves her job at a prominent law firm to work at a family violence legal centre. Pressure mounts to save the centre as relationships are tested.

series:tt11861938.name: Munkkivuori
series:tt11861938.description: In early 1980s a young child disappears. The lack of police support pushes the concerned parents to take justice into their own hands and launch a desperate manhunt that is seen from the perspective of the local children.

series:tt26471649.name: The Killing Vote
series:tt26471649.description: In a world where criminals evade justice, citizens vote via text for the death penalty, executed by "Dog Mask" if over 50% agree.

series:tt21441628.name: Anoniem
series:tt21441628.description: History teacher Jurre and public prosecutor Sarah each battle the criminal world in their own way. Although the two have been married for years, they keep their double life a secret from each other in order to protect each other and their family. The situation is getting more and more dangerous and their children are no longer safe either.

series:tt8637336.name: Burden of Proof
series:tt8637336.description: After his sister's disappearance, a brother is determined to find the truth no matter the cost.

series:tt26689977.name: Numbers
series:tt26689977.description: The story of Jang Ho-woo, a high school graduate accountant, realizing justice against the absurdity of a giant accounting firm.

series:tt23876278.name: For Her Sins
series:tt23876278.description: Follows a perfect woman whose mask begins to crack when a charismatic stranger arrives on the scene.

series:tt16305210.name: Home School
series:tt16305210.description: When children are unwanted by their parents, they are sent to the best boarding school in the country: Home School. However, Home School seems more like a prison than a school with its strict rules and regulations. Its curriculum is unique.

series:tt27723333.name: Club Hooligans
series:tt27723333.description: After vicious infighting, two brothers are expelled of their beloved team’s gang. Alone, without money or political protection, they start a war that puts their brotherhood to the test.

series:tt28229356.name: When Nobody Sees Us
series:tt28229356.description: Set in Morón de la Frontera, follows Lucía Gutierrez, a sergeant in the Spanish Civil Guard who investigates weird incidents at the first Holy Week float processions as well as the inexplicable suicide of a neighbor there.

series:tt13437388.name: Hükümsüz
series:tt13437388.description: Esma is a beautiful, ambitious and strong woman who is the second boss of her father's law firm. Filiz is a stubborn but fragile lawyer candidate. One murder will cross the paths of these two different women. But how?

series:tt28623191.name: 6ixtynin9 the Series
series:tt28623191.description: After losing her job, a woman discovers a mysterious package on her apartment doorstep and her life takes a turn for the worse.

series:tt15866282.name: Offline
series:tt15866282.description: BeHappy is a secret invisible application that serves to buy drugs through a smartphone. Its users face a serious opponent who hides under the name of Anonymus. He informs them that he has managed to disclose the data of everyone who has ever used this application and now he gives them a choice - to go to the police and confess everything or play a game with death. What happens if you lose this game becomes clear when Be Happy users receive a photo of kladen with his throat cut.

series:tt28486727.name: Boyhood
series:tt28486727.description: Jang Byeong-tae is a small and weak boy living in Onyang in South Chungcheong Province. He's at the bottom of the school's social ladder and when he transfers to the neighboring Buyeo Agricultural High School, he faces an unexpected incident that becomes a turning point in his life.

series:tt27787857.name: Thursday's Widows
series:tt27787857.description: Teresa finds her husband and his two best friends dead in the lavish community where they live. As the truth comes to light, so will dark secrets.

series:tt23848182.name: The Night Caller
series:tt23848182.description: The story of Tony, a Liverpool taxi driver who begins to form an unhealthy obsession and twisted world view of a late-night radio talk show host.

series:tt27554366.name: A Bloody Lucky Day
series:tt27554366.description: An ordinary taxi driver becomes entangled with a customer that turns out to be a serial killer.

series:tt15689870.name: Gray
series:tt15689870.description: Cornelia Gray a CIA spy, is coming in from the cold after 20 years in hiding, dodging the government agents who suspected her of being a traitor.

series:tt29195231.name: Pact of Silence
series:tt29195231.description: Thirsty for revenge, a big-time social media influencer infiltrates the lives of four women to discover which of them is the mother who abandoned her at birth and uncover why she was left alone.

series:tt14962342.name: The Therapy
series:tt14962342.description: The story of a psychiatrist who, years after her disappearance, must learn to deal with the loss of his daughter.

series:tt22054934.name: The Well
series:tt22054934.description: The main character – philosophy professor Radomir Pavlovic is at the peak of his power when he sets out on that journey – young enough and yet not old enough to understand everything that will befall him on that journey.

series:tt15894440.name: Milky Way
series:tt15894440.description: Follows 17-year-old Maria, a high school senior with dreams of becoming a dancer, whose starry-eyed plans for the future are put on hold when she gets pregnant by her boyfriend Tasos.

series:tt21266652.name: Platform 7
series:tt21266652.description: It tells the story of Lisa who witnesses a cataclysmic event on platform 7 of a railway station and in her memory finds a connection between her own life and the event she just witnessed.

series:tt27470288.name: Per Elisa: An Italian Crime Story
series:tt27470288.description: Reconstruction of one of the most shocking crime news events in recent decades: the murders of Elisa Claps and Heather Barnett by Danilo Restivo. The story begins on 12 September 1993 and takes place over a period of about twenty years between Potenza and the English coast of Bournemouth.

series:tt21278506.name: Los Farad
series:tt21278506.description: It follows Oskar, who dreams of setting up a gym. He ends up entering the world of the Costa del Sol, all due to the Farads, a family that offers him a future, but with the most unexpected of trades: arms trafficking.

series:tt27447991.name: Die Quellen des Bösen
series:tt27447991.description: When a girl's body is found, two investigators (Fahri Yardim and Henriette Confurius) join forces to solve the case. They come across a strange series of murders with connections to Germany's past.

series:tt21987088.name: Deca zla
series:tt21987088.description: A masked perpetrator murders a prominent politician and leaves an old, golden coin in his hand. Nikola Bobic, a defence attorney, reluctantly takes a case and plunges into a dangerous game that will change his life forever.

series:tt29667906.name: LTNS
series:tt29667906.description: The days when they burned with sexual desire are behind them, and Woo-jin and Samuel have become a somewhat withered couple, emotionally and physically.

series:tt28655955.name: The Black Cloud
series:tt28655955.description: 20-year-old Olya is not an easy character. Friends say that Olya is evil. Olya goes to a psychologist and in sessions with him tries to give his anger a place, to release anger. She tells the psychologist about all the people who infuriate her, and wishes them death in terrible agony. A teacher at the institute, best friend, boyfriend, father, mother… They all annoy Olga very much. And suddenly they all start dying one by one under mysterious circumstances.

series:tt26456880.name: One Trillion Dollars
series:tt26456880.description: John works as a bike courier in Berlin. One day, lawyers reveal to him that he is the heir to one trillion dollars, accumulated over the last 500 years. But this wealth comes with a prophecy and an impossible task for John...

series:tt30221618.name: Safe Harbor
series:tt30221618.description: Tobias, a gifted hacker and his ambitious best friend Marco, intent on cracking into the tech billionaires club. They are plunged headfirst into the chaos of organized crime when they cross paths with the Irish mob.

series:tt32021861.name: The Confidante
series:tt32021861.description: After witnessing the harrowing November 13, 2015 terrorist attacks, Christelle "Chris" Blandin quickly latches onto a community of survivors. Claiming that her best friend Vincent was one of dozens critically injured at the Bataclan Theatre, Chris becomes an indispensable resource for the group but discrepancies begin to pepper her story – raising serious doubts among the true victims of the tragedy.

series:tt3428202.name: Dhuwan
series:tt3428202.description: An action-packed story of five friends that join to form a crack team of police commandos tackling criminal activities as vigilantes in Quetta, Pakistan.

series:tt21612864.name: The Call
series:tt21612864.description: Anica Reljic, a former police inspector who now works in a call center, receives a call from Sonja Tosic, a rich single mother who wants to know the identity of the person who is threatening her on the phone. As Anica investigates the threatening calls, she realizes that they are connected to a criminal group from her past life. She tries to warn Sonja, but Sonja disappears, prompting Anica and Tiana, Sonja's rebellious daughter, to go in search of her. They soon discover that Sonja may be the key to uncovering the truth behind an environmental scandal rocking the country: the mysterious poisoning of three boys.

series:tt27349153.name: Insomnia

series:tt0101236.description: What Would You Do? was a 30-minute television show hosted by Marc Summers shown on Nickelodeon from 1991 to 1993. Robin Marrella acted as the on-camera stagehand for the show's first season. Both Summers and Marrella performed their respective duties on Double Dare, also on Nickelodeon. The show was produced in Nickelodeon Studios at Universal Studios in Florida; some early segments were produced at Universal Studios in Hollywood.

series:tt0054560.name: Password
series:tt0054560.description:
Password is an American television game show which was created by Bob Stewart for Goodson-Todman Productions. The host was Allen Ludden, who had previously been well known as the host of the G.E. College Bowl.

Password originally aired for 1,555 daytime telecasts each weekday from October 2, 1961 to September 15, 1967 on CBS, along with weekly prime time airings from January 2, 1962 to September 9, 1965 and December 25, 1966 to May 22, 1967. An additional 1,099 daytime shows aired from April 5, 1971 to June 27, 1975 on ABC.

The show's announcers were Jack Clark and Lee Vines on CBS and John Harlan on ABC.

Two revivals later aired on NBC from 1979–1982 and 1984–1989, followed by a prime time version on CBS from 2008–2009.

In 2013, TV Guide ranked it #8 in its list of the 60 greatest game shows ever.

series:tt0118515.name: Win Ben Stein's Money
series:tt0118515.description:
Win Ben Stein's Money is an American television game show created by Al Burton and Donnie Brainard that aired first-run episodes from July 28, 1997 to January 31, 2003 on the Comedy Central cable network, with repeat episodes airing until May 8, 2003. The show featured three contestants who competed to answer general knowledge questions in order to win the grand prize of $5,000 from the show's host, Ben Stein. In the second half of each episode, Stein participated as a "common contestant" in order to defend his money from being taken by his competitors. The show won five Daytime Emmy awards, with Stein and Jimmy Kimmel, the show's original co-host, sharing the Outstanding Game Show Host award in 1999.

As noted in a disclaimer during the closing credits, prize money won by contestants was paid from a prize budget furnished by the producers of the show. Any money left over in that budget at the end of a season was given to Stein. If the total amount paid out during a season exceeded that budget, the production company paid the excess, so Stein was never at risk of losing money from his own pocket.

Stein's co-host was Jimmy Kimmel for the first three years. Kimmel left in 2000 and was replaced by Nancy Pimental, who co-hosted the program through 2001. Kimmel's cousin, Sal Iacono, who took over the role in 2002, was the show's last co-host. Although Jimmy Kimmel left the program in 2000, he occasionally made guest appearances afterward, and hosted College Week episodes in 2001.

It was presented by Northern Irish comedian Roy Walker from 1986–1999; followed by Nick Weir from 2000–2002, and Mark Curry in 2002.

The show's mascot, a golden robot called "Mr. Chips", appears in many of the animations. In the revived version of the show, the same format remains, but there are three contestants.

In August 2012, it was announced that Stephen Mulhern would host a revived version of the show beginning on 7 April 2013. On 21 August 2013, it was confirmed that Catchphrase has been re-commissioned for a second series, following the success of the first.

movie:tt34254116.description: Middle schooler AJ finds himself joining forces with faculty and friends to save the world from an alien invasion.

movie:tt43640339.name: Resident Dead
movie:tt43640339.description: A father battles hordes of undead with his stricken daughter to reach the cure before she turns. If he reaches the lab with the vaccine in time he believes his daughter will be safe. Unfortunately, the most horrific challenge awai...

movie:tt12116566.name: Blight of Humanity
movie:tt12116566.description: A Sunday walk through the late summer landscape leads not only to a small lake, but also to the abyss of human existence. Dominance and oppression, superiority and humiliation serve for an alleged "incarnation".

movie:tt40210362.name: The Last Temptation of Becky
movie:tt40210362.description: Now a CIA field agent, Becky goes undercover in Poland to infiltrate a family running an inn at The Wolf's Lair, one of Hitler's WWII bunkers. When she learns the father, Wilhelm Reuss, plans to spark the Fourth Reich, Becky must ...

movie:tt38077943.name: Hexed
movie:tt38077943.description: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

movie:tt38953026.name: Lion Fist
movie:tt38953026.description: Martial Arts Fighter Joe goes to prison for 4 years and takes his wife's blame for a Drug Bust. After his release he finds out that his ex gave birth to his son and started a new life with a Drug Lord.

movie:tt36303063.name: Unbearable Christmas
movie:tt36303063.description: Out-of-work weatherman Troy Tipton has one Christmas mission: retrieve the beloved teddy bear he pawned for holiday cash. With wife Becca, mother-in-law Dawn, and the kids in tow, Troy hits the road from Ohio to Florida in his old news van. But the family road trip gets even wilder when they discover the cherished bear is actually a priceless Teddy Roosevelt antique worth millions.

movie:tt34512981.name: Ice Age: Boiling Point
movie:tt34512981.description: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

movie:tt34966140.name: Focker-in-Law
movie:tt34966140.description: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, stepdad Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

movie:tt43658893.name: Paradise Lost
movie:tt43658893.description: A bus full of children mysteriously vanishes. When an altered version of a grieving mother's son returns years later, she must grapple with the technologically revised reality she has created.

movie:tt36408401.name: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
movie:tt36408401.description: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

movie:tt33184695.name: Rolling Loud
movie:tt33184695.description: A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.

movie:tt39276601.name: Crossing
movie:tt39276601.description: A retelling of the Red Army crossing the Chishui River four times to outmaneuver 400,000 enemy troops.

movie:tt43646922.name: The Jeweler
movie:tt43646922.description: After being caught one too many times, Amr El Barouqy, a famous jeweler with a weakness for women, is forced to put aside his traditional male pride. When his strong-willed wife Yasmine insists on building a healthier and more balanced life together, the couple turn to relationship counselor Dr Kareem and embark on an unconventional therapy program to save their marriage. However, instead of bringing them closer, each step unleashes a new wave of chaos, turning their attempt to fix their relationship into a series of escalating disasters.

movie:tt37846373.name: Comédie-Française
movie:tt37846373.description: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

movie:tt34380971.name: White Blast
movie:tt34380971.description: At a remote train station covered in heavy snow, a station master Gap-su is facing the last day of his life-long dedication to the station. Devastated by the sudden layoffs, Gap-su keeps waiting for his young replacement, who still hasn’t yet come. As the hush reigns throughout the station, Gap-su sees the breaking news that dozens of convicts escaped from the overturned prison bus, and just then, a young man walks into the station claiming himself as the one Gap-su has been waiting for.

movie:tt20259240.name: Cloud Girl
movie:tt20259240.description: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

movie:tt46666760.name: Three Generations, One Christmas
movie:tt46666760.description: Set in a close-knit American town, The Starlight is a beloved local supper club and longtime community gathering place where generations have gathered to celebrate music, family, and Christmas traditions. Frank—a legendary song-and-dance man—prepares to sell the family’s beloved restaurant lounge after 40 years. With the future of The Starlight in question, three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey that reminds them what is worth preserving — and how faith, family, and home can quietly lead us back to where we belong.

movie:tt9213874.name: Breeder
movie:tt9213874.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there's a catch.

movie:tt32557122.name: The Angry Birds Movie 3
movie:tt32557122.description: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

movie:tt39399214.name: Rock Bottom
movie:tt39399214.description: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. But when he’s falsely accused and exiled after a plot to overthrow his father, Gungo is forced to prove himself in the brutal Caveman Games—an ancient competition where strength and bravery determine who leads. Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

movie:tt34385689.name: Paper Tiger
movie:tt34385689.description: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

movie:tt35514120.name: Werwulf
movie:tt35514120.description: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

movie:tt46000907.name: Rammstein – Live in Mexico City
movie:tt46000907.description: A three-night compilation that captures their spectacular October 2022 shows at the Foro Sol Stadium in Mexico City during the Stadium Tour era. This live has become the band's most massive and longest one of their entire career.

movie:tt42643242.name: The Influencer Project
movie:tt42643242.description: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

movie:tt34686688.name: Marrow
movie:tt34686688.description: A Vodcast host declining in popularity receives the career opportunity of a lifetime when a mysterious stranger invites her into its dangerous world.

movie:tt37438659.name: Cool Books
movie:tt37438659.description: Hilario is a frustrated 40-year-old writer, trapped between nostalgia for classic literature and cynicism about the contemporary publishing world. While his novel is rejected by all Spanish publishers, he makes a living selling books at the bookstore La Ménsula and teaching an online writing workshop for older ladies, although his caustic attitude and disdain for sentimental stories only serve to alienate them.

movie:tt29870331.name: Appofeniacs
movie:tt29870331.description: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

movie:tt39571626.name: The Meltdown
movie:tt39571626.description: 1992, Chile. Nine-year-old Inés' parents are away on business, leaving her in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a teenage European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.

movie:tt39233100.name: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
movie:tt39233100.description: Jang Taeyoung, who believes he has everything after building a successful online casino business, loses it all to his former best friend and namesake, Park Taeyoung. The two reunite on the international poker circuit for a high-stakes battle of revenge.

movie:tt26735127.name: Jumanji: Open World
movie:tt26735127.description: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

movie:tt33086020.name: Son of Revenge – The Story of Kalevala
movie:tt33086020.description: Karelia in the 11th century. A brutal feud between Kalervo and Untamo leads to the massacre of an entire village. The sole survivor is Kalervo's son, Kullervo, whom Untamo decides to raise as his own. As he grows, Kullervo's immense strength and rebellious nature make him feared by those around him. When he learns the truth about his past, his path becomes clear: revenge. His journey takes him across a harsh and treacherous land and into the hands of slave traders, only to uncover a devastating secret that will change his fate forever.

movie:tt33044571.name: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
movie:tt33044571.description: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

movie:tt35051162.name: The Isolate Thief
movie:tt35051162.description: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost, outwitting them amid a deadly winter where survival becomes a game of cunning and betrayal.

movie:tt39094466.name: Look Back
movie:tt39094466.description: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

movie:tt40188305.name: The Odyssey
movie:tt40188305.description: After being falsely accused of treason by a jealous king, the legendary warrior Alexander is exiled to a forbidden monster filled realm and tasked with an impossible challenge: slay three ancient Titans or die trying. Armed with a mystical medallion, a legendary sword, and the help of unlikely allies, Alexander embarks on an epic quest to save the woman he loves, reclaim his honor, and prevent a tyrant from seizing his kingdom.

movie:tt34718200.name: The Debut
movie:tt34718200.description: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movie:tt33514933.name: Wings of Dread
movie:tt33514933.description: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back to China. With his extremely high professional ethics, he fights desperately to stop the hijacker, and a life-and-death struggle that takes place at an altitude of ten thousand meters begins.

movie:tt49813814.name: The Pursuit: F1 ACADEMY
movie:tt49813814.description: Offering unparalleled behind-the-scenes access to the 2025 F1 ACADEMY season, follow a group of elite female drivers, including Doriane Pin, Maya Weug, Chloe Chambers and Alisha Palmowski, as they navigate the pressures of competition and the personal sacrifices required to break into one of the most demanding sports in the world.

movie:tt29452783.name: Reawakened Man
movie:tt29452783.description: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

movie:tt34374553.name: Victorian Psycho
movie:tt34374553.description: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

movie:tt39382724.name: Our Secret
movie:tt39382724.description: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

movie:tt37957361.name: Frostbite
movie:tt37957361.description: A "controlled” avalanche blast goes terribly wrong, and environmental officer Martia and her family find themselves trapped under the ice in a crashed cable car. Battling their wounds, the cold, and inner demons, they soon learn that, just as bad as they want out, something wants in.

movie:tt39328391.name: Coward
movie:tt39328391.description: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

movie:tt34385184.name: Misty Green
movie:tt34385184.description: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

movie:tt18270542.name: Ray Gunn
movie:tt18270542.description: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

movie:tt36639956.name: Iron Boy
movie:tt36639956.description: In rural France, 10-year-old Christophe tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner... A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?

movie:tt32400586.name: God's Lawyer
movie:tt32400586.description: Daniel is a newly graduated lawyer who faces family conflicts due to disagreements with his father's business dealings; his father is a federal congressman. Alongside a friend, the young man becomes involved in a case that dates back to past lives, discovering he is connected to a complex spiritual web.

movie:tt39216132.name: Attack of the Kraken
movie:tt39216132.description: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.

movie:tt35669487.name: No Rest for the Wicked
movie:tt35669487.description: 1862. Baldur lives a fisherman’s life on the isolated Faroe Islands far to the north in the Atlantic Ocean. His world is turned upside down when a stranger arrives: Helge, a rugged whaler, who awakens deep emotions within him. A mutual attraction starts to grow. When tragedy strikes, their forbidden passion unleashes natural forces so disturbing that the villagers rally to keep evil at bay. But Baldur and Helge refuse to let their love be buried. They will fight till the end – and after.

movie:tt50141720.name: The Mad Pooper
movie:tt50141720.description: Follows the investigation of the mysterious "Mad Pooper" case, in which a female jogger repeatedly defecated on lawns in Colorado Springs, exploring archival coverage, resident accounts and law enforcement interviews to uncover the truth.

movie:tt37601810.name: Bad Beast
movie:tt37601810.description: An orphaned girl named Atenea lives in isolation with other children. When adopted by a family, she glimpses a chance at belonging, but her fear of losing this newfound home drives her to extreme measures.

movie:tt42854785.name: Kaali Kheti
movie:tt42854785.description: A story of inheritance land, legacy, trauma and the cost of trying to bury the past to grow the future.

movie:tt32243339.name: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
movie:tt32243339.description: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

movie:tt24250020.name: Cottonmouth
movie:tt24250020.description: When Ed Dantes is framed and condemned to the tortures of a territorial prison in the 1895, he must learn the ways of the outlaw to escape and exact his revenge.

movie:tt36948856.name: Inherit
movie:tt36948856.description: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.

movie:tt30850718.name: April X
movie:tt30850718.description: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

movie:tt44842744.name: Paach Futaacha Bachchan
movie:tt44842744.description: Just five feet tall, Raju is a spiritual speaker known for her sharp wit and charm, earning the nickname 'Paach Futacha Bachchan' across Maharashtra. The film traces her rise to fame and fall, reaching a deeply human realization.

movie:tt50880016.name: Postcards for Christmas
movie:tt50880016.description: Hannah Norton moves to Mistletoe Valley for the holidays to work at the post office alongside her best friend from college. She discovers that the post office is full of undeliverable mail, including several love letters from the same man. Hannah sets out to solve the mystery - with the help of Ford Montgomery, a DJ at a local radio station.

movie:tt37498793.name: Children of Heaven
movie:tt37498793.description: Two siblings, Ali and Zahra, who agreed to keep the matter of Zahra's missing shoes a secret, which Ali had brought in for repair. To solve the problem, they decided to share Ali's worn-out shoes. Zahra would wear them in the morning during her school schedule, and after returning home, she would run as fast as she could so Ali could wear them to school in the afternoon. New hope emerged when Ali learned of an inter-school running competition with a prize of a pair of shoes for the third-place winner. Ali signed up, determined to win the competition so he could buy Zahra new shoes.

movie:tt49735612.name: My Son’s Sugar Mama
movie:tt49735612.description: A protective mother discovers a wealthy, older woman is showering her young son with gifts and money. As she sets out to expose her, she discovers the woman's obsession with her son is far more dangerous than she ever could have imagined.

movie:tt43669175.name: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
movie:tt43669175.description: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

movie:tt38574367.name: The Twin Who Lived
movie:tt38574367.description: After discovering she once had a twin sister who died when she was a child, Claire begins receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What at first seems like a cruel prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of Claire's life.

movie:tt31970593.name: Witch on the Holy Night
movie:tt31970593.description: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

movie:tt35935357.name: The Beekeeper 2
movie:tt35935357.description: Pulled back into the fight when the Beekeeper organization goes rogue and sets its sights on controlling the government, Clay must take on the very group that made him.

movie:tt39379748.name: Austerity
movie:tt39379748.description: Mona is a young woman and bookworm with no formal education, living in the social housing project Nøjsomheden in Helsingør. She falls head over heels in love with Nikolaj, who comes from a more well-off neighborhood on the other side of town. Meanwhile, she is also desperately trying to get her pusher cousin Frederik to realize that he must visit his dying mother, Mona's beloved and all-embracing Aunt Tut. Will Mona succeed in getting Frederik to reconcile with his mother - and how? Can she match the intellectual Nikolaj - or is the class gap too great?

movie:tt4540534.name: The Nightingale
movie:tt4540534.description: The lives of two sisters living in France are torn apart at the onset of World War II. Based on Kristin Hannah's novel 'The Nightingale'.

movie:tt37108970.name: Always Lalisa
movie:tt37108970.description: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

movie:tt27050858.name: Drishyam: The Conclusion
movie:tt27050858.description: Follows the Salgaonkar family as they try to cover up a murder.

movie:tt38192494.name: Suriya 47
movie:tt38192494.description: Follows an eccentric police officer and his quirky team whose lives take an unexpected turn after they are assigned a new mission.

movie:tt45692999.name: Chiram
movie:tt45692999.description: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

movie:tt36413910.name: The Mosquito Bowl
movie:tt36413910.description: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

movie:tt34934816.name: My Wife Cries
movie:tt34934816.description: An ordinary working day on a construction site. Thomas, a 40-year-old crane operator, receives a call from his wife asking him to pick her up from the hospital. He finds her crying.

movie:tt39029729.name: The Mouths
movie:tt39029729.description: Seeking a late-night thrill, four university friends visit a legendary cursed tree in a haunted cemetery. When one of them disappears and the others are haunted by terrifying visions of a ghostly woman, they discover some legends demand a deadly price. Feature-length adaptation of Sesuji's "Kuchi ni Kansuru Ankēto".

movie:tt43723233.name: Drones
movie:tt43723233.description: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

movie:tt33344480.name: Hana Korea
movie:tt33344480.description: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

movie:tt37964718.name: Christmas at Fields Ranch
movie:tt37964718.description: When city broker Daisy inherits a ranch before Christmas, she’s torn between selling it or keeping it. Reconnecting with an old crush, she falls in love with the property and must choose between her career and her heart before the season ends.

movie:tt39402072.name: Love, Ted Bundy
movie:tt39402072.description: As America's most notorious serial killer Ted Bundy awaited execution, he exchanged a series of death row letters with the woman who loved him like a brother - his cousin, Edna Martin.

movie:tt34386603.name: Speed Demon
movie:tt34386603.description: Aboard a high-speed train, a nun who has lost her faith must perform her first exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

movie:tt44751019.name: Honey's Christmas Wish
movie:tt44751019.description: After a variety of mysterious gifts and good deeds pop up around Honey's Guesthouse, Brittany tries to uncover who amongst the visitors is behind it in this charming Christmas whodunnit.

movie:tt22406048.name: Spider Island
movie:tt22406048.description: A bunch of young men and women just want to have some fun in the sun. What could go wrong?

movie:tt39303509.name: The Raid
movie:tt39303509.description: When an anti-narcotics raid goes disastrously wrong, officer Chen Fei is left with the devastating loss of her undercover partner. Lin Xiao’s final sacrifice delivers crucial evidence, propelling Chen Fei into a high-stakes mission to dismantle an international drug trafficking network once and for all.

movie:tt33512134.name: Drive Through Fire
movie:tt33512134.description: An addict war veteran turned ride share driver tries to help a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

movie:tt16995302.name: The Man with the Bag
movie:tt16995302.description: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

movie:tt36415529.name: Behemoth!
movie:tt36415529.description: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

movie:tt39637432.name: Manhood
movie:tt39637432.description: “Manhood” follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies — and their insecurities — on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, “Manhood” examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity.

movie:tt13884466.name: Model Citizen
movie:tt13884466.description: A man awakes from a coma to find that his well-being is now the responsibility of an avatar provided by the government.

movie:tt37970935.name: Camouflage
movie:tt37970935.description: 2021. When 22-year-old Vitaly leaves his mother Tetyana and his beloved sister Eugenia behind in Ukraine, he dreams of starting a new life in Munich, Germany. Struggling to find where he belongs in a foreign country, he eventually joins a student theater group. Everything changes with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, as Eugenia and Tetyana are forced to flee. Overnight, two harsh realities land on Vitaly’s doorstep: the global political situation and his own family conflicts.

movie:tt37694048.name: New Group
movie:tt37694048.description: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. One day, the people in her school inexplicably start to form a human pyramid. The principal and other teachers start to act weird and encourage taking part in it, and the various gymnastic formations start to spread and take over the whole town. Eventually only Ai and Yuu, a transfer student who finds it hard to fit in, are left to rebel against the conformity madness.

movie:tt43714202.name: Sex Drive
movie:tt43714202.description: Sheltered Sasha joins her uninhibited best friend Kelly on a getaway, but rescuing an amnesiac man turns their sexy escape into a deadly game of truth and deception.

movie:tt39284988.name: The Train
movie:tt39284988.description: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

movie:tt27541205.name: Queen at Sea
movie:tt27541205.description: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

movie:tt37809949.name: Dulhaniyan Le Aayegi
movie:tt37809949.description: A big Fat Indian wedding goes wrong .

movie:tt46082332.name: Confession
movie:tt46082332.description: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

movie:tt26443610.name: Gatto
movie:tt26443610.description: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.

movie:tt41740111.name: Kiku Chiranjeevi
movie:tt41740111.description: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

movie:tt43655690.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — Sting of Death
movie:tt43655690.description: The storied history of Mystery Science Theater includes many, MANY cheap rubber monster suits... and somehow, some way, Sting of Death may have the worst so far. MSTies might recognize director William Grefé as the director behind the MST3K Season 2 experiment Wild Rebels. You'll be happy to know he made Sting of Death first, so Wild Rebels was a movie he made as an even more experienced filmmaker. As an added bonus, this movie also features the aptly titled "Do The Jellyfish" by Songwriting Hall of Fame inductee Neil Sedaka. Does this tune warrant TWO extended dance sequences? Probably not, but it is an earworm that will still be drilled into your head long after the credits roll.

movie:tt41516436.name: Summerween
movie:tt41516436.description: A former circus clown escapes a mental institution on the tenth anniversary of his first kills. Now, as unsuspecting high schoolers throw a Summerween party at the clown’s abandoned mansion, a police officer and father to one of the party goers must rescue his daughter before the clown kills again.

movie:tt36107185.name: La Gradiva
movie:tt36107185.description: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

movie:tt33086904.name: ‎Chroniques D'un Indic
movie:tt33086904.description: When you've already sold everything, can you still redeem your soul? Lakhdar, an old informant who's seen it all, is on the sidelines. Threatened with losing custody of his daughter, he throws himself body and soul into the pursui...

movie:tt39715372.name: You Are the Film
movie:tt39715372.description: Madoka writes plays. Kazuma composes music. One day, they decide to go to the cinema. But once there, they realise they can interact through the screen itself, sending fiction into joyful freefall in an absurd and inventive adventure.

movie:tt39219651.name: The 12 Dates of Christmas
movie:tt39219651.description: Follows Christina Walker, a successful shop owner who has devoted her energy to her career at the expense of her dating life, as she goes on 12 dates in the 12 weeks leading up to Christmas hoping to find Mr. Right.

movie:tt39163347.name: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movie:tt39163347.description: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

movie:tt37593192.name: Bad Day
movie:tt37593192.description: On one of the worst and wildest days of her life, single mom Joy fights to keep one little promise to her daughter.

movie:tt37799273.name: Species
movie:tt37799273.description: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

movie:tt38781172.name: Santo António - Lisbon Love
movie:tt38781172.description: Lisbon's traditional Saint Anthony's Weddings have hit rock bottom. At least, that's what Stardust, a major French multinational poised to take over the event, believes. Carmo and Valentim, two Lisbon City Hall employees who have spent more than 25 years organizing the celebrations, are given a harsh ultimatum: reinvent the event and turn it into a modern success, or lose their jobs. Directed by the filmmaker behind The Gilded Cage, Saint Anthony is a vibrant comedy and a heartfelt love letter to Lisbon. A celebration of human connection, identity, and cultural resilience in an increasingly globalized world.

movie:tt44930432.name: Christmas Cover-Up
movie:tt44930432.description: Best friends Tori, Gwen, and Sam are stuck in entry-level jobs at Marty's Pay Day Loan, enduring low wages, sexism, and a terrible boss. They have joked for years about killing Marty, but their fantasy becomes a nightmare when he turns up dead in a Santa suit just hours before an in-store Christmas promotion. Afraid their long-running complaints will make them prime suspects, the women hide the body and keep the business running as if nothing happened. As customers, coworkers, security, and unexpected visitors crowd the store, every new complication threatens to expose their improvised cover-up. Bound by a homicide and forced to rely on one another, Tori, Gwen, and Sam scramble to uncover what really happened, avoid jail, and survive the most chaotic Christmas of their lives.

movie:tt36412781.name: Redemptions
movie:tt36412781.description: Marcel, a retired hitman, is forced back into action and commits two murders in Montreal. In doing so, he unwittingly sets in motion a chain of unforeseen events that will ultimately endanger the life of his own daughter in Paris.

movie:tt38497662.name: Honestino
