movie:tt38497662.description: Arrested five times for his activism, student leader Honestino Guimarães was kidnapped in 1973 at the age of 26 and is one of the hundreds of people who disappeared during the Brazilian military dictatorship.

movie:tt28023987.name: Pratap
movie:tt28023987.description: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

movie:tt36593129.name: The Comeback King
movie:tt36593129.description: A country western star named Aubrey must return to college to earn his long-abandoned degree after a false rumor that he cheated on his girlfriend throws his career into free fall.

movie:tt39382808.name: The Loneliest Man in Town
movie:tt39382808.description: Blues musician Al Cook lives in an apartment filled with memories. Outside, the world carries on without him. But when his home is slated for demolition, out of the ruins of his existence, a long-forgotten dream suddenly resurfaces.

movie:tt37345055.name: A Royal Christmas Secret
movie:tt37345055.description: When chef Emily Parker takes a job at Verdonia's royal palace for Christmas, she begins a romance with the castle's handyman Nick. But she doesn't know he's really Prince Nicholas and that his parents already have a bride picked for him.

movie:tt36298555.name: Bird in Hand
movie:tt36298555.description: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

movie:tt43621069.name: Lilo & Scratch
movie:tt43621069.description: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

movie:tt37200939.name: Parivarik ManuRanjan
movie:tt37200939.description: Helen, a property manager, arrives to oversee a vast ancestral mansion only to discover its sole occupant is Ranjan, an unmarried man. In the quiet town, an unexpected romance blossoms between them.

movie:tt18468926.name: Concessions
movie:tt18468926.description: As the Royal Alamo Cinema closes its doors for good, jaded staff, eccentric patrons, and an unhinged manager stumble through one last night at the movies—grappling with busted dreams, bad popcorn, and hard goodbyes.

movie:tt44276076.name: Judaa
movie:tt44276076.description: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

movie:tt38361305.name: Forty Love
movie:tt38361305.description: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

movie:tt36933185.name: Dead Howling
movie:tt36933185.description: A werewolf hunts zombies after losing his family. He meets two humans seeking sanctuary and joins their quest, protecting them with his powers. Their journey grows perilous as zombies start evolving.

movie:tt16744566.name: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
movie:tt16744566.description: The fourth installment in the Sonic the Hedgehog film franchise. Plot TBA.

movie:tt17055444.name: Hershey
movie:tt17055444.description: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

movie:tt32213169.name: Way of the Warrior Kid
movie:tt32213169.description: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

movie:tt30057115.name: Killing Castro
movie:tt30057115.description: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

movie:tt14523706.name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
movie:tt14523706.description: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

movie:tt37983543.name: Just After Dawn
movie:tt37983543.description: Returning from the Atlas lunar mission, the astronauts discover an Earth where humanity has vanished. Cut off from everything, they find themselves confronted with an unfathomable mystery that defies reason.. and threatens their very existence.

movie:tt31830814.name: Forgive Us All
movie:tt31830814.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus has transformed humans into violently deranged cannibals. A bereaved mother has lost everything and takes refuge in an isolated mountain cabin, until a desperate wounded stranger arrives with a story of hope.

movie:tt46076042.name: Our Holiday Playbook
movie:tt46076042.description: When Lexi Bell returns home for the holidays, she faces a beloved family tradition she'd rather avoid: the fiercely competitive Bell Bowl, an annual Christmas flag football showdown between her father and uncle that has fueled decades of sibling rivalry. But when an injury sidelines her brother-in-law, it looks like Lexi's family's losing streak will remain unbroken. To give them a fighting chance, she strikes a deal with Eddie, a former local football star-turned teacher: Lexi will use her baking know-how to help Eddie best his brother in their annual bake-off if he'll pose as her boyfriend and meet the "eligibility requirement" to play on their team. As they navigate each other's festive family gatherings, traditions and celebrations, what started as a transactional partnership begins to become something more as Lexi and Eddie find themselves feeling less and less like their romantic relationship is just pretend.

movie:tt47597050.name: Ugly Duckling Ms. Maeng
movie:tt47597050.description: Ms. Maeng, a small-town teacher, unexpectedly joins the team responsible for creating South Korea’s most important exam: the College Scholastic Ability Test. She thought it would be all about academic prestige and scholarly debate but instead finds herself locked away under spy-level security, her phone confiscated and surrounded by office politics. Can this unlikely underdog turn test stress into test success, or just test everyone's patience?

movie:tt34771515.name: La noche de los tres fuegos
movie:tt34771515.description: Never provoke a quiet man, because you might awaken his demons

movie:tt31068334.name: Liberated from Paradise: Resonance of the Heart
movie:tt31068334.description: In 2400, most of humanity still lives without physical bodies inside the digital paradise DEVA, but Angela Balzac's rebellion left consequences its security forces could not erase. During the chaos, numerous agents escaped to Earth after stealing material bodies and hardware containing their personal data, then vanished from DEVA's surveillance.  These fugitives, now called the Fallen, have become a threat whose true purpose is unknown. Agents Gabriel, Arma, and Daniel are sent to track them across the surface, where the lingering Nano Hazard makes the environment itself dangerous. The closer they come to the Fallen, the harder it becomes to trust everything they were told about Angela's revolt and the 'paradise' they have been ordered to protect.

movie:tt9077514.name: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
movie:tt9077514.description: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

movie:tt35665715.name: Zutaten fürs Glück
movie:tt35665715.description: Berger is a gifted chef. When a serious accident turns his life upside down, he can’t wait to get back to the kitchen. Handicapped but unflinching, he plans the reopening of his lakeside restaurant. While the crew vacillate between loyalty and chaos, his estranged daughter Sarah comes from London to help. She still has old wounds to deal with and her arrival confronts a father who was never there for her, but who now needs her support. In the midst of memories and aromas, Berger discovers what he has never sought and yet needed the most: a second chance at happiness.

movie:tt36501161.name: Death Knight
movie:tt36501161.description: Through dark magic, a medieval knight awakens in the 21st century, leaving a path of destruction.

movie:tt34969899.name: KINKI
movie:tt34969899.description: After an editor of an occult magazine suddenly vanishes, his friend Chihiro and his co-worker Yusei set out to discover the reason behind his disappearance.

movie:tt37967547.name: Ink
movie:tt37967547.description: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

movie:tt39026173.name: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
movie:tt39026173.description: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

movie:tt42025545.name: Letters This Christmas
movie:tt42025545.description: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.

movie:tt31382021.name: Levitating
movie:tt31382021.description: In a town where pleasure equals being possessed by spiritual beings, Bayu aspires to be the shaman of a trance party so he can fundraise enough money to prevent an impending eviction.

movie:tt34812467.name: Killing Time
movie:tt34812467.description: In an era of economic despair and record-high unemployment, where becoming a YouTuber is the ultimate dream job, the popular YouTube crew 'Killing Time' collapses overnight after an unforeseen accident claims a team member's life during a live broadcast. Desperate for a successful comeback, the members plot to return with far more extreme and sensational content. However, just as success seems within reach, mysterious figures appear and propose the 'real' Killing Time.

movie:tt34798706.name: Extra Geography
movie:tt34798706.description: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood — friendship, boys, studies, and growing up — and embark on their school project, falling in love.

movie:tt36778423.name: Dong Bei Jing Cha Gu Shi 3
movie:tt36778423.description: Li Hongqi came from the streets of Northeast China to a tropical island, intending to prepare for his wedding, but instead embarked on a journey to catch criminals once again.

movie:tt29634374.name: Above the Below
movie:tt29634374.description: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

movie:tt39126701.name: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
movie:tt39126701.description: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

movie:tt41162761.name: Do Or Die
movie:tt41162761.description: When a realtor becomes the target of a mysterious and dangerous game, his career, his family, and his very sanity are all put on the line.

movie:tt43504996.name: Insidious Possession
movie:tt43504996.description: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.

movie:tt39368153.name: Tombé du ciel
movie:tt39368153.description: Lyès, a fan of life in Roubaix, fails the high school diploma twice. After a fire during the mock exams, he is fired and charged. He must join a Catholic boarding school in Burgundy, where he faces major cultural shocks.

movie:tt38517861.name: Der Schimmelreiter
movie:tt38517861.description: North Friesland today: After the death of his father-in-law, Hauke Haien takes on two important roles in coastal protection - dyke count and director of coastal protection. Professionally, Hauke is the best man for the job; he is a visionary who lives and thinks in harmony with nature. Only people are not his cup of tea. As a loner, Hauke hardly knows how to inspire an audience and win over fellow campaigners. His warnings about the effects of climate change are dismissed as hysteria in the village, even though the coastal inhabitants know that a drastic change of course in climate policy is unavoidable. Fortunately for Hauke, his wife Elke supports him. She manages to make him heard. But Hauke does not enjoy his success for long, because when it becomes known that his plans are much more radical, he is met with incomprehension and anger. Resistance and pressure wear on him. Disaster can no longer be averted.

movie:tt32880884.name: The Ultimate Planet
movie:tt32880884.description: After an accident, memories of his service on the Ninth Planet flash in the mind of auto mechanic Dima Khrust: amazing landscapes, the base of earthlings, battles with monsters, friends and his beloved girl Polina, whom he once saved... Khrust's colleagues twist their fingers at their temples, because theirs is completely different - ordinary army memories. But when Dima meets Polina in real life, he no longer doubts: someone corrected their memories. Who and why? The truth can only be found out by returning to the dangerous planet.

movie:tt46832540.name: Second Chance Holiday
movie:tt46832540.description: Dating expert Chelsey (Ayesha Curry) is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame (Matthew Daddario), she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.

movie:tt46076002.name: The Nights Before Christmas
movie:tt46076002.description: One Christmas Eve, Marty (Hynes), whose life is in a bit of a rut, finds himself wishing he had more time. Thanks to some holiday magic, he awakes the next morning to discover it's Christmas Eve – again. Confused at first, Marty l...

movie:tt39369076.name: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe - Part 1
movie:tt39369076.description: Set against the backdrop of the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy, army officer Maki Staufenberg is assigned to Valkyria II, the second planet in the Asgard system, where she is tasked with investigating Ash Vamps, a soldier who has earned the nickname of “Witch” because of her habit of being the sole survivor in missions assigned to her ragtag band of soldiers on punishment detail.

movie:tt5500064.name: The Thomas Crown Affair
movie:tt5500064.description: Third take on the Thomas Crown Affair movies.

movie:tt35111865.name: Dog Day Evening
movie:tt35111865.description: A hostage situation occurred at a TV station. The kidnapper K was not after money, he just wanted to terminate the monthly subscription to the TV station.

movie:tt38814489.name: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
movie:tt38814489.description: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

movie:tt34984724.name: Traveler's Hell
movie:tt34984724.description: On an isolated road late at night, a young woman, driving alone, comes across a stranded male driver whose car has broken down on a mountain road notorious for disappearances and murders. Choosing empathy over a creeping sense of foreboding, she offers him a ride to the nearest station. That single choice unleashes a harrowing chain of strange and terrifying events in the dead of night, turning a simple gesture of kindness into a real-life nightmare.

movie:tt30235784.name: Winter of the Crow
movie:tt30235784.description: Warsaw, 1981. Martial law shuts down the country, turning it into a prison overnight. Taxis are replaced by tanks, citizens are treated like criminals, and visiting British Professor Joan Andrews finds herself trapped. After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police, Joan herself becomes the target.

movie:tt35453594.name: Cicadas
movie:tt35453594.description: The story of a friendship between two dissimilar women: On the one hand, single mother Anja, who tries to keep herself and her daughter afloat with various jobs. On the other, Isabell, who looks after her parents in need of care and whose relationship with her husband Philipp is put to the test.

movie:tt39309264.name: Crazy Kalyanam
movie:tt39309264.description: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

movie:tt27530512.name: Toxic
movie:tt27530512.description: As Portuguese rule crumbles in Goa, Raya rises through betrayal and bloodshed to claim the city's underworld, only to learn that power always demands a price.

movie:tt34375721.name: Operation Kabul
movie:tt34375721.description: A Hungarian doctor's story intertwines with soldiers' sacrificial fight and desperate refugees' escape from a war-torn city.

movie:tt42667014.name: After-School Exorcism Club: Girls' Night
movie:tt42667014.description: At Palja Girls' High School, where ominous energy seems to be part of the curriculum, strange incidents unfold one after another. The principal secretly recruits five girls whose fates are perfectly aligned, tasking them with a mission to exorcise ghosts haunting the school. After 30 years, the After-School Exorcism Club of Palja Girls' High returns!

movie:tt44879019.name: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
movie:tt44879019.description: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

movie:tt37424290.name: Jupiter
movie:tt37424290.description: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

movie:tt38454494.name: El Director
movie:tt38454494.description: War correspondent David Jiménez becomes editor of El Mundo newspaper and discovers hidden deals with elites while pushing digital changes. His fight for editorial independence leads to his removal after a year.

movie:tt37424336.name: Per te
movie:tt37424336.description: In 2021, an 11-year-old boy named Mattia Piccoli was named Standard-bearer of the Republic by President Sergio Mattarella for "the love and care with which he daily follows his father's illness." This film tells his story and that of his father, Paolo, who, in his early forties, slowly begins to lose pieces of his memory. But just as the world begins to fade, he chooses to stay close to what truly matters, strengthened also by the love of his wife Michela. Together with his son, he embarks on a journey of shared daily life, sudden laughter, and silences that speak.

movie:tt26689745.name: Summer Illusion
movie:tt26689745.description: At the end of summer, a young couple, Eric and Anna, make the drastic decision to run away from home and embark on a road trip with no clear destination. What initially seems like a liberating journey soon becomes an oppressive experience.

movie:tt22183852.name: Tangles
movie:tt22183852.description: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

movie:tt49317292.name: Ruki Vverh! 2
movie:tt49317292.description: Thirty years after the story of the band Ruki Vverkh! began, Sergey Zhukov together with his children revisits memories of his youth: his first love, his first big dreams, friendship, family, and the journey to the stage.

movie:tt38072958.name: Savage Prey
movie:tt38072958.description: In the remote Scottish Highlands, a desperate mother searches for her missing son, finding herself trapped in a twisted struggle for survival.

movie:tt39562962.name: Il faut brûler maman
movie:tt39562962.description: A comedy of manners set in a funeral home.

movie:tt42826707.name: A Place to Heal
movie:tt42826707.description: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

movie:tt37544051.name: Bamboo Revenge
movie:tt37544051.description: After a party, three male friends wake up tied to the ground in a forest. Eve, who suspects them of being responsible for her sister’s disappearance, has planted a special variety of fast-growing bamboo right under them. Either they confess, or they die impaled before the end of the day.

movie:tt38984314.name: Se domani non torno
movie:tt38984314.description: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

movie:tt38281377.name: Il rumore delle cose nuove
movie:tt38281377.description: A vividly interwoven tale of secrets and connections, Il rumore delle cose nuove centers on three families whose lives have quietly overlapped in the streets of Milan—unaware of each other—for years. Andrea, a photographer, and Andreina, a nurse, share a haunting truth: Andreina has given a part of herself to keep Andrea alive. Umberto finds solace in alleviating others’ pain at work, yet at home he inflicts suffering upon Alba, once hopeful, now dreamless. In another household, Ralph, who crafts sounds, and Viola, an actress who yearns to live as freely as she performs, are quietly struggling—alongside Mirko, a ten‑year‑old whose presence echoes loudly. As the story unfolds, their ordinary routines unravel under the weight of these “noisy” secrets—some seemingly trivial, others utterly unbearable. Chaos tumbles over the fragile bonds holding them together, forcing confrontations with truths they can no longer ignore.

movie:tt37543956.name: The Nameless Ballad
movie:tt37543956.description: Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

movie:tt35494574.name: Women on Trial
movie:tt35494574.description: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever

movie:tt41973396.name: Un tranquillo funerale di famiglia
movie:tt41973396.description: The day of the funeral of the patriarch of the Mancuso family, long-repressed grudges re-emerge between his children Daria and Riccardo. A solemn ceremony reveals the frailties and contradictions of a family that is anything but perfect.

movie:tt37601990.name: God Laughs
movie:tt37601990.description: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

movie:tt37740990.name: The Phantom of the Opera
movie:tt37740990.description: Anastasia, an 18-year-old ballet dancer at the Opéra Garnier, becomes the obsession of a disfigured man living in the opera's underground labyrinth.

movie:tt43645716.name: A Woman Today
movie:tt43645716.description: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

movie:tt36899180.name: Moulin
movie:tt36899180.description: In June 1943, Jean Moulin, leader of the French Resistance, is arrested while attempting to reunite the forces of the "Armée Secrète." Interrogated by Klaus Barbie, the head of the Gestapo in Lyon, Moulin is drawn into a relentless confrontation.

movie:tt37801321.name: The Perfect Holiday
movie:tt37801321.description: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

movie:tt39969491.name: Words of Love
movie:tt39969491.description: For 14 years, Erika has been the anchor of a household that rarely stands still, doing her best to raise teenage Abigail, her whirlwind little brother, Yoni, and a dog with an extreme devotion to cheese. When Abi’s desire to meet her absent father grows into a full-blown obsession and word spreads he’s been seen nearby, Erika fears the fragile balance will collapse for good. Instead, the unpredictable journey that follows brings mother and daughter to see each other anew, steering their lively, lovable family toward a happy new chapter.

movie:tt37405791.name: Hanging by a Wire
movie:tt37405791.description: On a Tuesday morning in August 2023, a group of kids set off for school, climbing into a makeshift cable car for the journey across a mountain pass in northwest Pakistan. What happened next would make headlines around the world. Suddenly, 900 feet above the ground, two cables snapped, putting the teenagers in mortal danger.

movie:tt35450621.name: Karma
movie:tt35450621.description: In a village in northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Jeanne's six-year-old godson mysteriously disappears and Jeanne becomes the main suspect.

movie:tt44842464.name: Le Roi du Game
movie:tt44842464.description: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

series:tt1352421.name: Natsume's Book of Friends
series:tt1352421.description: When Natsume Takashi inherits a book that belonged to his late grandmother he realizes the book is filled with the names of spirits she defeated and bound to her will. He then decides to return their names so they can be free once...

series:tt0118289.name: Cow and Chicken
series:tt0118289.description: The program focuses on the misadventures of two unlikely yet somehow biological siblings: Cow and Chicken.

series:tt2549176.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard
series:tt2549176.description: There are now billions of card game players in the world, to an extent where card games have become a necessity, a part of our lives.

series:tt11034066.name: Welcome to Demon-School, Iruma-kun
series:tt11034066.description: When Iruma's parents sell him to a powerful demon, the kindhearted 14-year-old doesn't expect to be adopted and sent to a demon high school.

series:tt3042608.name: Uncle Grandpa
series:tt3042608.description: The misadventures of a magical uncle and grandpa to everyone in the world and his friends.

series:tt27432264.name: Renegade Immortal
series:tt27432264.description: Renegade Immortal follows the captivating story of Wang Lin, a young man born with a crippled soul. Undeterred by his limitations, Wang Lin embarks on a determined path to cultivate immortality and achieve unimaginable power.

series:tt2150751.name: Chihayafuru
series:tt2150751.description: Chihaya meets a boy named Arata, a talented karuta player who thinks that she has a potential to become a great player. Chihaya then takes on a new dream of becoming Japan's best karuta player.

series:tt1308089.name: A Certain Magical Index
series:tt1308089.description: Index flees from powerful organizations that seek to extract its knowledge, sparking conflicts. Helped by Touma, Misaka and friends from the Academy, she struggles to survive.

series:tt1401882.name: WWE Superstars
series:tt1401882.description: WWE Superstars is a minor WWE show that started in 2009. It usually airs in Fridays.

series:tt0101198.name: Silk Stalkings
series:tt0101198.description: Homicide detectives investigate crimes of passion among the affluent and glamorous in Palm Beach, Florida.

series:tt1470837.name: The Garfield Show
series:tt1470837.description: A lasagne-loving pussycat adventures and explores the differences between good and bad, and right and wrong.

series:tt1316554.name: Black Butler
series:tt1316554.description: Ciel Phantomhive takes care of the many unsettling events in Victorian England. Aided by Sebastian Michaelis, his loyal butler with seemingly inhuman abilities. But is there more to this black-clad butler than meets the eye?

series:tt17050076.name: Swallowed Star
series:tt17050076.description: This series follows the protagonist, Luo Feng, in a post-apocalyptic world full of intelligent Monsters, as he becomes a warrior (superhuman) and gradually improves by overcoming various difficulties.

series:tt0055686.name: The Lucy Show
series:tt0055686.description: The wacky misadventures of a forever-scheming woman, her reluctant best friend, and her cantankerous boss.

series:tt3874528.name: The Irregular at Magic High School
series:tt3874528.description: Siblings Tatsuya and Miyuki are pitted against each other when they enroll at Magic High School.

series:tt6148376.name: Ben 10
series:tt6148376.description: Ben 10 is the fifth iteration of the Ben 10 franchise. It serves as a reboot of the television series loosely based upon the original series.

series:tt1133480.name: Shugo Chara!
series:tt1133480.description: Shugo Chara! centers on elementary school girl Amu Hinamori, whose popular exterior, referred to as "cool and spicy" by her classmates, contrasts with her introverted personality. When Amu wishes for the courage to be reborn as her would-be self, she is surprised to find three colorful eggs the next morning, which hatch into three Guardian Characters: Ran, Miki, and Su.

series:tt12432936.name: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
series:tt12432936.description: Tired of endless war, Demon King Anos decides to be reincarnated into a peaceful future. Enrolling in school, he doesn't get the welcome he hoped for.

series:tt0101177.name: The Red Green Show
series:tt0101177.description: Red Green airs his handyman show from Possum Lodge, Canada, and also experiences some zany adventures in real life.

series:tt13292830.name: Batwheels
series:tt13292830.description: The Batwheels are a team of sentient super-powered crimefighting vehicles that help Batman, Robin and Batgirl—as well as a host of additional DC Super Heroes—keep Gotham City safe. Created only recently by the Batcomputer, our mechanized heroes must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super-team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

series:tt0086734.name: Hunter
series:tt0086734.description: Rick Hunter is a renegade cop who bends the rules and takes justice into his own hands. Partnered with the equally stunning and rebellious Sgt. McCall, he sets out to crack down on L.A.'s slimiest criminals.

series:tt0044263.name: Four Star Playhouse
series:tt0044263.description: This show featured four rotating stars, Charles Boyer, David Niven, Ida Lupino, and Dick Powell in individual episodes consisting of everything from comedy to drama.

series:tt10885406.name: Ascendance of a Bookworm
series:tt10885406.description: Urano, a young Japanese soon-to-be librarian, dies in an earthquake. She is reincarnated in another world as a young girl named Mayne, but learns books are scarce and only provided to prestigious elites.

series:tt3426342.name: Jodha Akbar
series:tt3426342.description: A sixteenth century political marriage of convenience between a Mughal emperor Akbar and a Rajput princess Jodha Bai. The show focuses on how their political marriage brings love between them to an extent that it changed the fate ...

series:tt1276525.name: Chi's Sweet Home
series:tt1276525.description: The story follows a cute little cat named Chi and her fun family friendly adventures.

series:tt4148744.name: PJ Masks
series:tt4148744.description: When young friends Connor, Amaya, and Greg put on their pajamas and activate their animal amulets, they turn into their alter egos: Catboy, Owlette, and Gekko as they embark on adventures that are filled with action.

series:tt11755260.name: The Daily Life of the Immortal King
series:tt11755260.description: Wang Ling is a near-invincible existence with powers far beyond his control. But now that he's sixteen, he faces his greatest battle yet - Senior High School.

series:tt1584000.name: Durarara!!
series:tt1584000.description: Tired of his mundane life, Mikado Ryugamine decides to move to Ikebukuro, a district in Tokyo, when a friend invites him. Ikebukuro is full of connected mysteries where people's pasts intertwine with the present.

series:tt28022382.name: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan
series:tt28022382.description: The Tang Sect in a turbulent world. There is nothing but martial spirit here. Ten thousand years after the founding of the Tang Sect, it is in relative decline. An extremely talented man was born. Can the new Shrek Seven Monsters revive the Tang Sect and bring it back to glory? A soul beast of over one million years old; Electrolux who can pick stars; The new soul utensil system that led to the decline of the Tang Sect... A lot of secrets are to be revealed. Can the secret weapons of the Tang Sect be sharp again? Can the Tang Sect regain its former glory?

series:tt11858104.name: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
series:tt11858104.description: Young Dai embarks on an epic journey to become a legendary hero, training with his loyal companions to save the world from the resurrected Demon King.

series:tt19902148.name: Throne of Seal
series:tt19902148.description: Six thousand years ago, the Demon God appeared and creatures were turned into demons. The mankind created six Temples to fight the demons. Long Haochen joins the Knights Temple. As he grows, an adventure unfolds. He wins the recognition of others and fights with the Six Temples against the demons for the sake of human beings. He sacrifices himself to protect the people. Could Long win the Throne of Seal and be granted the highest honor in the Knights' Temple? All remained to be revealed.

series:tt5704228.name: Ode to Joy
series:tt5704228.description: Five women in Shanghai's 22nd-floor apartment: a reclusive businesswoman, a wealthy newcomer, an HR executive, a small-town girl, and a recent graduate. They form friendships and support each other through life's challenges.

series:tt11645760.name: Digimon Adventure:
series:tt11645760.description: Taichi is preparing for a summer camping trip until he encounters a strange phenomenon that sweeps him up into the Digital World along with the other DigiDestined.

series:tt8019790.name: Apple & Onion
series:tt8019790.description: Set in a world populated by anthropomorphic food, Apple and Onion, a pair of childlike newcomers to the big city, attempt to fit in to their new surroundings.

series:tt1140100.name: Chowder
series:tt1140100.description: In Marzipan City, excitable young food-loving Chowder is the apprentice of Mung Daal, a very old chef who runs a catering company with his wife Truffles and assistant Shnitzel.

series:tt12287748.name: Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon
series:tt12287748.description: An adventure following Sesshomaru's half-demon twin daughters, Towa and Setsuna, as they discover the mysteries of their past along with Moroha, the daughter of Inuyasha and Kagome.

series:tt1178180.name: The Marvelous Misadventures of Flapjack
series:tt1178180.description: The comical seafaring adventures of a young, enthusiastic boy, his pirate captain mentor, and the talking whale that raised him from birth.

series:tt21050232.name: Bugs Bunny Builders
series:tt21050232.description: At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage an inept crew of builders. By working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety, and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

series:tt12502782.name: Shaman King
series:tt12502782.description: Shaman King follows the adventures of a 13-year-old shaman and his teammate a samurai warrior spirit, who traverse the world fighting evil spirits and misguided shamans on their journey to be the next Shaman King.

series:tt0092325.name: The Bold and the Beautiful
series:tt0092325.description: Continuing drama combining romance and intrigue set against the glittering backdrop of Beverly Hills and the American fashion industry.

series:tt2301807.name: Naruto SD: Rock Lee & His Ninja Pals
series:tt2301807.description: Naruto SD: Rock Lee & His Ninja Pals is story of Rock Lee's adventures from Rock Lee's perspective.

series:tt20228550.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse
series:tt20228550.description: As a prophecy of doom unfolds on the peaceful land of Britannia, a purehearted boy sets out on a journey of discovery — and revenge.

series:tt2942218.name: Log Horizon
series:tt2942218.description: 30,000 Japanese players trapped in MMORPG, unable to log out. Veteran gamer Shiroe leads exploration of this new reality, negotiating with NPCs to bring order to the virtual city of Akihabara.

series:tt0092484.name: Wiseguy
series:tt0092484.description: Vincent Terranova is an agent with the Organized Crime Bureau infiltrating dangerous criminal organizations, struggling to remain true to himself while becoming close to the criminal leaders he is sworn to bring down.

series:tt9547400.name: Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story
series:tt9547400.description: A magical girl, Iroha Tamaki, searches for her missing sister in the mysterious city of Kamihama, where it is rumored that magical girls can achieve salvation.

series:tt12882132.name: Hitori No Shita - The Outcast
series:tt12882132.description: Cho Soran leads an ordinary college student's life until he becomes involved in a terrible incident in a small town. While walking through a cemetery, Cho Soran is assaulted by zombies.

series:tt5193172.name: Dawn of the Croods
series:tt5193172.description: Eep, Grug, Thunk, Ugga, Sandy and Gran are back. Follow them as they meet new friends, outrun new creatures and encounter "firsts" the world has never seen - such as school, slumber parties, hiccups and elections.

series:tt13303478.name: We Baby Bears
series:tt13303478.description: Follow Grizz, Panda and Ice Bear – as their younger baby selves – traveling in a magical box to fantastic new worlds searching for a place to call home. Along the way, they meet new friends, learn a few lessons and discover that “home” can mean wherever they are, as long as they’re together.

series:tt0983962.name: Hayate, the Combat Butler
series:tt0983962.description: The Yakuza is after Hayate due to his irresponsible parents' huge gambling debt. He runs into an heiress who falls for him and hires him to be her butler/bodyguard.

series:tt13167196.name: Edens Zero
series:tt13167196.description: A young boy cut off from the world meets his friends and sets off on a hard, long journey to be reborn.

series:tt21107718.name: Oddballs
series:tt21107718.description: It tells the story of James. His observations on life fuel his comedic rants at everyday inconveniences and elevates them to absurd heights.

series:tt0062601.name: Rowan & Martin's Laugh-In
series:tt0062601.description: The original rapid fire sketch comedy show.

series:tt6286394.name: WWE: 205 Live
series:tt6286394.description: A World Wrestling Entertainment weekly show that features superstars from the Cruiserweight division.

series:tt27442011.name: Dragon Raja -The Blazing Dawn-
series:tt27442011.description: A letter from Cassell College broke the calm life of the youth. The unexpected admission notice, the frightened interview, the surprise rescue under the full view of the public, and the day of freedom to display their heroic spirit. When Lu Mingfei decided to choose the hidden option, the ordinary youth embarked on the legendary road of fighting against the dragon race.

series:tt0456785.name: My Fair Princess
series:tt0456785.description: A street-smart girl accidentally becomes a princess. While navigating palace life, she falls for a prince, clashes with the empress, yet aims to restore her sworn sister's rightful title.

series:tt0996695.name: Eyeshield 21
series:tt0996695.description: High school freshman Sena, frequently bullied for his small stature, discovers a talent for running. Football maniacs Hiruma and Kurita recruit Sena, concealing his identity behind the "Eyeshield 21" persona.

series:tt18311412.name: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a
series:tt18311412.description: Animated adaptation of NieR: Automata (2017), where a long-running war on post-apocalyptic Earth between androids and machines soon unveils the truth of the world.

series:tt14670820.name: The Smurfs
series:tt14670820.description: The 3D animated remake of the popular series The Smurfs (1981).

series:tt7446086.name: Kaitou Sentai Lupinranger VS Keisatsu Sentai Patranger
series:tt7446086.description: The Lupinrangers aim to reclaim the stolen Lupin Collection to rescue loved ones. The Patrangers pursue the Gangler thieves to recover the collection and serve justice. Both teams battle each other and the Gangler in their missions.

series:tt32840498.name: Good Partner
series:tt32840498.description: Cold and hot human court office drama between Cha Eun-kyeong (Jang Na-ra), a star lawyer whose divorce is her calling, and Han Yoo-ri (Nam Ji-hyun), a new lawyer whose divorce is her first time.

series:tt14650074.name: Dhindora
series:tt14650074.description: It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

series:tt36982492.name: Sunshine Through the Rain
series:tt36982492.description: The stubborn girl Zheng Yu as she meets the lonely boy Chen Yanzhou. It's like one isolated island encountering another, filled with cautious probing and unspoken concern. Fortunately, in the storm of life, they find each other.

series:tt6069250.name: Uchu Sentai Kyuranger
series:tt6069250.description: Earth has been taken over by invaders. With the universe under their thrall, the tears of the people awaken the nine ultimate saviors, chosen by the KyuTama, and they are here for the galaxy's salvation. Nine different people with...

series:tt38734657.name: River of No Return
series:tt38734657.description: In the Ming Dynasty, Crown Prince Zhu Zhanji races 2,200 miles from Nanjing to Beijing in 15 days to save himself and the empire.

series:tt6396082.name: Carpool Karaoke
series:tt6396082.description: Based on the segment that has become a global, viral video sensation on The Late Late Show with James Corden, the new CARPOOL KARAOKE series features 16 unique pairings, with new stars every episode.

series:tt37156236.name: Silent Echoes
series:tt37156236.description: When two women's bodies are discovered in a lake, investigators must uncover a long-buried truth and give a voice to the victims who can no longer speak.

series:tt2061527.name: Tiger & Bunny
series:tt2061527.description: In a world where superheroes have corporate sponsors and are the stars of their own reality TV show, a new superhero team is born as the veteran hero Wild Tiger is assigned to be partners with rookie Barnaby Brooks Jr.

series:tt14878970.name: Bhagya Lakshmi
series:tt14878970.description: Hailing from a middle-class family, Lakshmi’s life is upended when she realises that her marriage to Rishi Oberoi, an industrialist’s son, is a sham to keep his death at bay.

series:tt41400834.name: Taming the Husband
series:tt41400834.description: Amid the turmoil of canal transport and court politics, butcher’s daughter Jin Baozhu is forced into marriage with Xie Yan, the disgraced and disabled heir of a powerful shipping family. What begins as a relationship built on conflict gradually turns into an alliance, as the two navigate mounting dangers and personal struggles.

series:tt50252733.name: The Rules
series:tt50252733.description: Haunted by his past, Metha takes a night shift at a mysterious convenience store where breaking its strange rules leads to supernatural death, forcing him to confront both the store's dark secrets and his own sins.

series:tt18224594.name: Blade Runner 2099
series:tt18224594.description: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

series:tt38961437.name: Silent Night
series:tt38961437.description:
Christmas Eve, 1976. Snow, silence, darkness. Three young people—a pregnant woman, her husband, and his younger brother—are killed by a bus while on their way to Midnight Mass.

No one saw anything. Or perhaps no one wants to talk. Instead of answers, there is a wall of silence. The incident is officially ruled an accident. But the victims’ mother and a young police officer named Maczek refuse to believe it was just a coincidence. He risks his career; she risks everything she has left. The deeper they dig, the more shocking revelations come to light. And the truth? It might just prove to be worse than the lie.

series:tt37148648.name: Blossom in Darkness
series:tt37148648.description: Qi Fengyin, a feared demon lord blamed for all evil, encounters Ya Mao, a girl whose flesh is coveted for its extraordinary powers. Forced into a bond, the two clash yet gradually become each other's salvation. Together, they unravel six bizarre mysteries involving deadly curses, demons, resurrection, and forbidden love. As they expose a hidden conspiracy, they clear their names, free the world from its shackles, and give lovers a chance to stay together.

series:tt34423706.name: Let's Go
series:tt34423706.description: During the Republic of China era, a veterinarian named Wang Laowu accidentally becomes the magistrate of Fuhu County and hilariously battles endless chaos, showing how ordinary people shaped a grand era.

series:tt39276740.name: Bill's Included
series:tt39276740.description: Well-meaning, overly enthusiastic divorcee Bill opens up his home to students for extra cash - creating a mismatched, bumbling houseshare in the process. Starring Rob Brydon.

series:tt41295083.name: A Certain Dark Item
series:tt41295083.description: In Academy City, psychic powers promise a brighter future. But beneath the city's peaceful surface lurks a merciless dark side. ITEM, an elite team of four girls with deadly abilities, carries out dangerous missions that can never see the light of day. When a fifth girl enters their lives, ITEM is drawn deeper into a world of violence, brutality, and moral corruption.

series:tt30461072.name: Natural High
series:tt30461072.description: Come and join Shen Teng and his friends as they step away from the bustling crowded cities and reconnect with the beautiful wild nature.

series:tt38483587.name: Gènesi
series:tt38483587.description: In the 1980s, a young Ferran Adrià happens to enter the kitchens of elBulli. What begins as a temporary job turns into the start of a gastronomic revolution that will forever change his life—and the history of cooking worldwide. Decades later, in 2025, Glòria Canabach—a retired critic haunted by guilt—returns from the United States following her father’s death. There, she reconnects with her niece, Lola, and together they decide to reopen the family restaurant, Can Canabach. As Ferran bids farewell to elBulli and Glòria seeks to forgive herself, both will find in the kitchen a way to heal and start anew.

series:tt40385667.name: Treasure Island
series:tt40385667.description: Jim Hawkins discover a treasure map, but his mother Bess's actions put them both in danger. Aboard The Hispaniola, they navigate threats from pirate John Silver and Agent Aaron Graham as alliances shift and survival hangs in the b...

series:tt47657141.name: The Perfect Lie
series:tt47657141.description: After a heart-fluttering date, Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night. The next day, they meet at a police station with completely different memories. A shocking polygraph result turns their lives upside down.

series:tt38939893.name: Tensei Shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hitakakusu

series:tt37479351.name: Still a Family
series:tt37479351.description: In 2008, a Jiaodong Peninsula family’s demolition windfall uncovers decades of dysfunction. Patriach Sai Duoxi controls his five children—from the spineless eldest to the adopted youngest—until cancer shakes his authority. As they confront moral bonds, the family realizes love thrives on equality, not patriarchal power.

series:tt43650242.name: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!

series:tt43119470.name: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
series:tt43119470.description: Student Kurumi Fukuga starts FX trading to recover her late mother's 20 million yen loss. She discovers a volatile world of gains and losses. With friends Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko, she navigates this risky money game's highs and...

series:tt17371078.name: The Ark
series:tt17371078.description: Follows the remaining crew of a spacecraft known as Ark One, who must become the best versions of themselves to stay on course and survive after experiencing a catastrophic event that caused massive destruction and loss of life.

series:tt36329495.name: Honey
series:tt36329495.description: East Berlin, 1982. Marta, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois.

series:tt36983579.name: When I Meet the Moon
series:tt36983579.description: Shy and socially anxious Yun Li enrolls in graduate school to prove her independence and unexpectedly reunites with her high school crush, the brilliant Fu Shize. Determined to win his heart, she steps out of her comfort zone and pursues him. Their love flourishes, but past traumas and personal differences drive them apart. When Yun Li moves abroad, Fu Shize is forced to confront his deeply suppressed trauma. Fu Shize, now a renowned researcher, is determined to win Yun Li back when she returns. Through growth and perseverance, they find their way back to each other.

series:tt32117300.name: Crash
series:tt32117300.description: A drama about Cha Yeon-ho, a reasonable individualist from KAIST, and Min So-hee, a traffic investigation ace with cool judgment and warm sensitivity at the Traffic Crime Investigation (TCI).

series:tt27171564.name: Infinity and Beyond 2023
series:tt27171564.description: This show takes the theme of different eras and features competitions to recall the "Chronicles of Chinese Music" with local characteristics, creating an "Infinity and Beyond" album of an era with the audience.

series:tt39087958.name: Between Steps
series:tt39087958.description: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

series:tt35324004.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
series:tt35324004.description: Princess Danyang, Mu Wanyao, a formidable and arrogant royal, is married to Yan Shang, a cunning scholar of humble origins. Amid court intrigues, they move from rivalry and mutual suspicion to reconciliation, becoming powerful allies who join forces to break political deadlocks and safeguard peace.

series:tt33258199.name: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
series:tt33258199.description: The last boss of a great battle with heroes returns 200 years after her defeat to explore the world and its changes since her time.

series:tt40225961.name: Infamy
series:tt40225961.description: A troubled lawyer becomes obsessed with solving a decades-old disappearance, forcing her to confront her childhood trauma and powerful forces determined to keep the truth buried.

series:tt42026819.name: Nord Sud Ovest Est: La leggendaria storia degli 883

series:tt39443739.name: The Crow Club
series:tt39443739.description: Four couples form part of the mysterious Crow Club, where supernatural cases and dangerous missions lead to unexpected romantic bonds.

series:tt42727894.name: Romelia Senki: Mao o Taoshita Ato mo Jinrui Yabasou Dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita

series:tt38715296.name: Small Town Remedy
series:tt38715296.description: A talented doctor named Liu Zhengliang (played by Xiao Zhan) encounters a setback in life and is forced to return to his hometown to start from scratch. He gathers a group of "unreliable" people and passionately tackles the "most ...

series:tt44757191.name: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
series:tt44757191.description: At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

series:tt44914557.name: ROCK PAPER LANDMINE
series:tt44914557.description: Glico, Daruma-san ga Koronda... A game everyone knows—transformed into the ultimate battle of wits!?

series:tt39029630.name: Lovers & Gangsters
series:tt39029630.description: In 1956 Bangkok, a fierce war between rival gang leaders Hongsen and Zeng gets dangerously complicated when love blossoms across enemy territory.

series:tt45114341.name: Melania Rea
series:tt45114341.description: The tragic story of Melania Rea, whose case reveals a toxic marriage marked by lies and manipulation.

series:tt40002142.name: Blue Planet III
series:tt40002142.description: The third series of this nature documentary uses the very latest in underwater filming techniques to reveal brand new and untold stories from magical underwater worlds focusing on five major underwater habitats: the tropical seas, temperate seas, polar seas, high seas and deep seas. Venture deeper beneath the waves. David Attenborough reveals ocean life more surprising, more intelligent and more precious than we ever realised.

series:tt41266040.name: The Northumbria Mysteries
series:tt41266040.description: Set on Northumberland's coast, the series follows unlikely partners Joe Ruby, a jack-of-all-trades marked by regrets, and Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell, a brilliant intellectual, as they solve crimes together.

series:tt0806910.name: Tatort
series:tt0806910.description: An anthology series that follows the work of homicide detectives in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

series:tt37781201.name: The Great Long March
series:tt37781201.description: The Long March (1934-1937): From strategic retreat to victory, showcasing communist resilience under Mao Zedong and Marxism's adaptation to China's revolution.

series:tt43691412.name: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
series:tt43691412.description: When enchantment mage Rein is dismissed from his guild after buffing all their gear, he reclaims every enhancement for himself. Armed with only basic equipment and stolen power, he embarks on an overpowered adventure from scratch.

series:tt28313387.name: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special
series:tt28313387.description: Just when he thinks it's the end, Desir wakes up 13 years in the past. Can he make the changes needed to save the world from destruction?

series:tt49931644.name: Oh! My Guard
series:tt49931644.description: A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

series:tt50901064.name: Happy Anding
series:tt50901064.description: The story of three unknown comedians who are running towards their dreams and a woman whose life has collapsed, getting back up and finding her dream.

series:tt49795345.name: Political Lupin
series:tt49795345.description: A master thief infiltrates politics to slyly pull off the ultimate heist of corrupt political funds.

series:tt46622693.name: Love on Hire
series:tt46622693.description: Thitinan will take any job—being a fake girlfriend and breaking up a relationship, or, special just for Miss Chat, becoming a bedroom coach.Adapted from the novel "Love on Hire" (รับจ้าง(เลิก)รัก) by Yuufuku

series:tt41939482.name: Sacred Jewel
series:tt41939482.description: Set during the final years of the Mongol invasions of Korea, the story follows a group risking everything to recover and protect the sacred Avalokitesvara Jewel on a perilous mission across the Goryeo Dynasty. As war rages, Commander Baek-gyeol, Princess Wang-hee, and their companions must navigate love, sacrifice, and political turmoil in a fight for their nation's future.

series:tt25531288.name: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
series:tt25531288.description: Everyone knows the most powerful soldier, the Ice Sword Wizard who led the country to victory three years ago, but few know his real name: Ray White.

series:tt31262522.name: Celeste
series:tt31262522.description: A tax inspector, Sara Santano, is tasked with proving that Celeste, a Latin music superstar, is a Spanish resident and must pay taxes. A high-stakes pursuit within the dreary world of the Tax Agency.

series:tt47596978.name: Summer Vacation
series:tt47596978.description: An ordinary teen girl longs for something new – will meeting a handsome boy in a countryside village change her life?

series:tt47983833.name: Fool in Love
series:tt47983833.description: A powerful heir uses business to pursue an aristocrat, only to become hopelessly entangled in a romantic trap of his own making.

series:tt39443954.name: The Grim Lover
series:tt39443954.description: It follows a young man who is saved from suicide by Death itself, who then begins to claim his life, as the two develop a forbidden relationship between love and fate.

series:tt43619474.name: Strange: Junji Ito's Tales for Sleepless Nights
series:tt43619474.description: Live-action anthology Series adapting from Junji Ito's selected works.

series:tt5676412.name: Sin Senos Sí Hay Paraíso
series:tt5676412.description: A girl goes on to live difficult times when she chooses to step outside the path her parents had laid out for her.

series:tt28651453.name: Jade Dynasty
series:tt28651453.description: Zhang Xiaofan, who turned into an orphan overnight, becomes a disciple of the Qingyun Sect. After five years of training, he performs well in the Seven Peak Martial Arts Competition. He's sent to the Kongsang Mountain to defeat the evil. During the journey, he and his senior, Lu Xueqi, met with an accident, and got to know and save the lady of the cult, Bi Yao. At the same time, new danger is ahead of him.

series:tt41293320.name: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
series:tt41293320.description: High school sophomore Ito was excited for a new dad when her mom remarried, but she may have gained more than she bargained for when she found four younger stepbrothers waiting at home. There’s blunt but secretly caring Gen, calm Raku, reclusive Syu, and cheerful little Rui. Now, Ito must go from the quiet of being an only child to learning how to be the eldest sister of a lively household.

series:tt43691408.name: Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita
series:tt43691408.description: Lorna was disowned by her family for having the useless skill of collecting information. However, she uses this skill to find new powers and skills and become the strongest witch.

series:tt50776122.name: One of a Kind Romance
series:tt50776122.description: A romance driven by personal desire that unfolds when top actor Tak Mu-i and idol Ryu Min enter the ordinary daily life of job seeker Gong Yu-il.

series:tt28450216.name: Student of the Year: After Dark
series:tt28450216.description: When the queen bee of St. Teresa's is found dead in a frozen lake, her twin sister is determined to uncover the truth, no matter the cost.

series:tt36475261.name: Pride and Prejudice
series:tt36475261.description: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr and Mrs Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr Darcy, an outwardly, misunderstood curmudgeon.

series:tt15295490.name: Campus Diaries
series:tt15295490.description: Campus Diaries is a coming-of-age drama of six students at Excel University.

series:tt38688809.name: The Countess of Monte Cristo
series:tt38688809.description: 1815. When her fiancé is wrongfully imprisoned and her rescue attempt ends in tragedy, Mercédès vows revenge against those who destroyed her life.

series:tt10912430.name: The Legend of Luo Xiaohei
series:tt10912430.description: The story begins on a rainy night, when a homeless little black cat is brought home by a young girl Luo Xiaobai. She names the cat Luo Xiao Hei. However, Luo Xiao Hei is no ordinary cat: he is a supernatural entity that hosts several small creatures called Heixiu. As Luo Xiao Hei new life soon threatened by the mysterious Diting, who commands three winged wolves.

series:tt45831796.name: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring
series:tt45831796.description: Satoru Takahashi, a young man who inherits his late father's apartment complex in a modern world where humans and yokai (supernatural creatures) coexist.

series:tt43599762.name: The D Dorm
series:tt43599762.description: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

series:tt35932166.name: Mr. Fanboy
series:tt35932166.description: A devoted fan lands a role alongside his idol, only to discover unexpected feelings for the star's partner as his fantasy becomes reality.

series:tt38578088.name: I Kill the Bear
series:tt38578088.description: A comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why, after 100 years, they’ve decided to make this film their last.

series:tt30006118.name: Frenchie Shore
series:tt30006118.description: Following in the footsteps of reality TV shows such as 'Jersey Shore' and 'Geordie Shore,' the ten biggest party-goers in France have come together in Cap d'Agde for a dream holiday.

series:tt26692417.name: Pokémon Horizons
series:tt26692417.description: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

series:tt41359588.name: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
series:tt41359588.description: Forced into a fake relationship, college rivals Podduang and Jinna team up to solve an actor's murder using a supernatural earpiece that guides them.

series:tt10759006.name: Arcanjo Renegado
series:tt10759006.description: Mikhael is a sergeant in charge of BOPE, always on dangerous missions in Rio de Janeiro. But after getting involved in a controversial operation that culminated to a slaughter, he is transferred to a police unit at the state count...

series:tt27497430.name: The Demon Hunter
series:tt27497430.description: Meng Chuan witnessed his mother killed before his eyes, so he trained very hard hoping to one day avenge her death. But his peaceful days were broken as his wedding engagement being called off, an invasion by foreign forces, the sanctuary fallen into enemy hands… In order to protect the people of Ning City, he picked up his sword and vowed to be the strongest. This is a heavy responsibility and a long journey…

series:tt46653736.name: Welsh & Shedar
series:tt46653736.description:
Zabelle Sheran Sharm, queen of Bonta and guardian of the Ebony Dofus, dreams of uniting the nations of the World of Twelve. But her tyrannical reign and thirst for power have plunged the lands into misery. A prophecy, proclaimed by her son Shedar, foretells her fall and that a boy with azure blue eyes will bring an end to her power.

This boy is Welsh, a young cook from Brassica. His life is upended when a black dragon, Asalar, attacks his village. To save his world, Welsh must find the Ivory Dofus, the only artifact capable of defeating Zabelle. Accompanied by his faithful friend Béchamel and the adventurers Joris and Khan Karkass, Welsh discovers his true origins and embraces his fate as a hero. Together, they must face unsuspected dangers to free the World of Twelve from Zabelle's clutches.

series:tt43650323.name: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner
series:tt43650323.description: Amona, a dark summoner and demi-human girl who's too weak to resist her desires, and Roni, an overly serious priest! Roni welcomes Amona as a new member to his adventuring party. Everyone expected the two would clash and become sworn enemies. But, to their surprise and on their first day together, they have a one-night stand...!

series:tt41298100.name: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusen Mochi Datta no de, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei Toshite Jiyuu ni Ikitai

series:tt27634695.name: Mordach
series:tt27634695.description: An undercover investigator seems to be personally involved in the murder of a young woman. It is in a Bavarian village, and the cop is of Turkish origin. The village is united against the foreigner.

series:tt47712459.name: Love Me to Hurt Me
series:tt47712459.description:
Song is a glamorous jewellery mogul; she has everything but peace. Haunted by the woman who broke her heart, she seizes the change for revenge when her former lover, Oh, unexpectedly becomes her mother's private nurse. Bound by a contract and trapped under one roof, Oh endures Song's cold cruelty while hiding the painful truth behind their separation.

As old wounds reopen, resentment gradually gives way to longing. When the secrets finally surface, however, Song realises she has been punishing the woman who sacrificed everything for her. Is there a second chance for love, or is it already too late?

series:tt37196475.name: Frisco King
series:tt37196475.description: New Orleans gangster Russell Lee Washington Jr. lands in Frisco, Texas, where he transforms small hustles into big business, with the help of an ambitious protégé, a loyal driver, and a growing network of eccentric partners.

series:tt41296506.name: Magical Explorer - Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shita Kedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru

series:tt49215477.name: Echo of a Letter
series:tt49215477.description: Reunited sixteen years after rehab, a strategic CEO and his secret guardian team up in Macau to fight corporate threats and reconnect.

series:tt43691424.name: #I'm Looking for a Zombie
series:tt43691424.description: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

series:tt12915960.name: The Patrick Star Show
series:tt12915960.description: Follow a younger Patrick Star living at home with his family, where he hosts his own variety show for the neighborhood from his television-turned-bedroom.

series:tt33501934.name: Tales of Herding Gods
series:tt33501934.description: An ancient ruin holds an old proverb. Chin Mu, an adopted baby, grows up and leaves his home one night. Guided by blind words, Qin Wu embarks on a dark path, becoming a villain.

series:tt0922037.name: La que se avecina
series:tt0922037.description: Follow the lives of the residents of a relatively luxurious block, the problems of sharing housing, the housing bubble, and young people's difficulties finding apartments.

series:tt49276663.name: Shadows of the Ten Ninja
series:tt49276663.description: When Ieyasu Tokugawa declares war on the Toyotomi, the Sanada Ten Braves come together in a decisive battle against the current ruler of Japan.

series:tt50645449.name: Francesca Next Door
series:tt50645449.description: Woo-ju, a dedicated student preparing for medical school, has his life turned upside down when Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. As he becomes her keeper and helps her navigate school life, their constant clashes lead to unexpected feelings that leave Na-young questioning whether it's love or simply her vampire instincts.

series:tt27497198.name: The Great Ruler
series:tt27497198.description: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

series:tt39181351.name: Psyren
series:tt39181351.description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya-who possessed the same card-suddenly vanis...

series:tt39387287.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
series:tt39387287.description: Hosted by Aryan Simhadri, it features behind-the-scenes stories, cast and crew interviews (including Rick Riordan), and fun insights that celebrate the world and fandom of Percy Jackson.

series:tt37109705.name: The Lament of Autumn
series:tt37109705.description: In the turbulent era of the Republic of China, student Ye Pingjun takes a job at a Western Hunan meeting house to fund her mother’s medical care. However, she's unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of an assassination attempt against the powerful Yu family’s fifth son, Yu Changxuan, and ends up accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Pingjun strikes a bold bargain: if Changxuan cannot identify the true culprit within ten days, he must clear her name. What begins as a high-stakes investigation quickly evolves into a calculated courtship as Changxuan maneuvers to win her heart while hiding a complex web of secrets. Will their blossoming romance survive the encroaching shadows of war, or will the secrets of their past pull them apart?

series:tt42487863.name: VERTEX FORCE
series:tt42487863.description: Akira Todo has always lived in the shadow of his sister, Haruka, who secretly wields their father’s mysterious “Engine.” But when a mysterious enemy comes for his family, Akira is forced into a battle that threatens the entire world. He may have inherited none of his father’s power, but now he must find a way to fight back. Or risk losing everything he cares about.

series:tt51592860.name: Till I See You
series:tt51592860.description: A man recovering from eye surgery falls for the tender stranger caring for him, only to lose him before they can truly see each other.

series:tt39469996.name: Newlyweds
series:tt39469996.description: A mature romance about a free-spirited woman and a reserved professor who marry quickly after a brief, passionate courtship.

series:tt39127238.name: LOVEx3
series:tt39127238.description: Six students navigate secret crushes, old promises, and unexpected heartbreaks when forced to enroll in a mandatory school curriculum about love.

series:tt30985733.name: Hello Saturday
series:tt30985733.description:
"Hello, Saturday" is the rebranding of the popular Chinese show "Happy Camp", hosted by He Jiong and with a fixed group of regular celebrity members.

The program showcases the talent of various stars as well as social topics through creative and diverse content and games. It aims to spread positive energy while keeping up with the current trends and leading youth culture.

series:tt4083422.name: Doraemon
series:tt4083422.description: The misadventures of Doraemon, a robot cat from the future, who with his gadgets, is sent back in time to help make Nobita Nobi, a boy without much talent, a better person.

series:tt21095396.name: The Hammer and The Rose: A Behzat Ç. Story
series:tt21095396.description: The Hammer and the Rose: A Behzat Ç. Story is a Turkish-made detective, adventure, comedy, and action internet series inspired by the novel of the same name by Emrah Serbes, which will be published in 2022.

series:tt50546087.name: The Awakened
series:tt50546087.description: A man awakens from suspended animation with memories of 1955 and reunites with his grandson, while a boxer begins recovering mysterious memories connected to secrets beneath the sea.

series:tt49276654.name: LOST10
series:tt49276654.description: A detective investigates the truth behind a deadly Hokkaido mountain-tour accident, where conflicting testimonies, betrayal, and entrenched power intertwine.

series:tt50164002.name: The Substitute
series:tt50164002.description: A top high school student is blackmailed into taking a substitute college entrance exam, leading to a manipulation crime thriller.

series:tt36843594.name: Dig
series:tt36843594.description: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

series:tt15823370.name: Catch! Teenieping
series:tt15823370.description: Set free on Earth, fairies with magical powers begin influencing people's emotions. Now, it's up to a princess from a faraway kingdom to stop them!

series:tt43613803.name: Fool Night
series:tt43613803.description: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

series:tt41492493.name: The Witch Farm
series:tt41492493.description: Follows Bill and Liz Rich who move to a remote Welsh farmhouse in 1989 for a fresh start, but after Liz sees a ghostly figure during a traumatic home birth, they face escalating paranormal disturbances.

series:tt45373165.name: KERORO☆
series:tt45373165.description: Sergeant Keroro lands on Earth with one mission: conquer it! But after he's captured by middle schooler Fuyuki and his older sister, Natsumi, he's stuck living with the Hinata family instead. As Keroro plots world domination and befriends Fuyuki, his grand invasion takes an unexpected turn, launching him into a hilarious new life and adventure on Earth!

series:tt45786669.name: Decoding You
series:tt45786669.description: Krit, a data analytics CEO pressured by a scandal and his mother, enters a fake marriage with his adopted brother Nont. As Nont attracts others, Krit's hidden feelings emerge, forcing him to choose between his family empire and love.

series:tt43583640.name: Different Lives
