series:tt43583640.description: For Emir and his friends—Hasan, Sadık, and Mert—who grew up in Ziyankâr, a working-class neighborhood on the outskirts of Istanbul, life feels like a game they’ve lost before it even began. Trapped between poverty, violence, and despair, these four young men see soccer as their only chance to change their fate. They try to break free from this darkness through their friendship and their dreams.

series:tt43691365.name: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me

series:tt27187054.name: The Elusive Samurai
series:tt27187054.description: After a massacre, Tokiyuki flees with loyal retainers including Suwa Yorishige, who predicts Tokiyuki will rule Japan. Their priority is escaping enemy territory.

series:tt44385073.name: Last One Laughing UK: Halloween
series:tt44385073.description: Jack Dee, Daisy May Cooper, Phil Wang, Lou Sanders, Reece Shearsmith, Harriet Dyer and Tom Allen face off in a tense mind game, aiming to crack rivals without losing composure. Jimmy Carr returns as host, with Roisin Conaty back a...

series:tt39240299.name: Magical Girl Raising Project: Restart
series:tt39240299.description: Once again, sixteen Magical Girls have been assembled for a high-stakes challenge. Every three days, their Magical Phone pulls them into an RPG-like simulation where they have to work together to fight enemies, solve puzzles, and earn Magical Candy to advance. A staggering ten billion yen reward awaits them at the end—but only for the players who land the finishing blow. With such a tantalizing prize on the line, it's only a matter of time before the girls turn on each other—and if their hit points drop to zero, a game over will be the least of their worries...

series:tt44923500.name: The Hidden Shadows
series:tt44923500.description: After finding her twin sister Mutta’s body, Munin assumes her identity to uncover the truth behind her death and seek revenge. She targets powerful minister Nopnopha and her family, causing scandals that destroy careers and relationships.

series:tt27517921.name: Against the Gods
series:tt27517921.description: Hunted for possessing a heaven-defying object, Yun Che is a young man in both that life and the next. Throwing himself off a cliff to spite his pursuers, Yun Che is reincarnated as Xiao Che, a recently poisoned teen in another realm. Just as hated in this life as the previous one, Che must overcome his own hostile clan, his own inability to cultivate, and his own frosty fiancée.

series:tt41278592.name: Red River
series:tt41278592.description: After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

series:tt38642046.name: Next Level Baker
series:tt38642046.description: Holiday baking competition where contestants create festive treats in a winter wonderland setting. Gordon Ramsay's classic show gets a magical makeover with twinkling lights, snow, and seasonal spirit across all three levels.

series:tt36220283.name: Where the Sun Always Shines
series:tt36220283.description: Where the Sun Always Shines follows Tom (Per Lasson) and Petra (Lisa Linnertorp), a successful couple who have built up a large Ica Maxi store in Linköping and sold it for a record sum. They have been living a life of luxury in Mallorca with their sons for a month, ready to enjoy an eternal vacation. But their lives take an unexpected turn during Tom's 50th birthday party, leading his brother Timmy (Erik “Jerka” Johansson) and his wife Maja (Rakel Wärmländer) to move their family to the sunny climes of Mallorca, where chaos ensues.

series:tt43643492.name: Love on the Menu
series:tt43643492.description: A cheerful side dish shop owner and a chef hiding a secret cross paths at a local market, but their path to romance won't be easy.

series:tt40550160.name: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku
series:tt40550160.description: Ephtal reincarnates in a magical world but dies talentless and frustrated. Reborn 400 years later with his memories intact, he finds magic has declined so drastically that his once-mediocre abilities now make him the strongest mag...

series:tt49909449.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
series:tt49909449.description: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

series:tt40103598.name: Under Her Rules
series:tt40103598.description: Alice, a fresh graduate, meets her intense and alluring boss Nannalin. As boundaries blur between work, desire, and power, Alice must decide—escape her demanding boss or surrender under her rules?

series:tt15791630.name: The Kardashians
series:tt15791630.description: Follow the Kardashian family as they celebrate new ventures and navigate through their new normal: motherhood, relationships, and career goals.

series:tt13884052.name: The Detective Is Already Dead
series:tt13884052.description: A detective's assistant risks opening old wounds when he stumbles into a new case threading murder, global conspiracy, and his dead partner!.

series:tt2771780.name: Teen Titans Go!
series:tt2771780.description: Superhero roommates Robin, Cyborg, Starfire, Raven and Beast Boy love saving the day, but what happens when they're done fighting crime?

series:tt41296544.name: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tenseishita kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musou Roku

series:tt43691398.name: TETSURYO! Meet with Tetsudou Musume
series:tt43691398.description: Misaki wants to escape her everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere. And while she doesn’t yet know what she will be in the future, Misaki knows for certain that she wants to find something she is passionate about. Soon after arriving on campus to start her college life, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Club. Misaki’s heart now beats with excitement for the new world that lies ahead on the railway.

series:tt37246098.name: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
series:tt37246098.description: Yoi Takiguchi is a first-year high school student, admired for her handsome looks and honest heart, which earned her the nickname “Prince.” One day, she bumps into Kohaku Ichimura, an upperclassman and another “Prince.” As the two grow closer, is what blossoms between them friendship or love? A youthful love story about a boy and a girl who are both called “Princes” begins.

series:tt8467296.name: Love Island Australia
series:tt8467296.description: An Australian dating reality show based on the British series Love Island.

series:tt38718507.name: School Trip: Joined a Group I'm Not Close To
series:tt38718507.description: An awkward teen joins a group of popular classmates on a school trip, sparking an unexpected romance with the most popular and charming boy in school.

series:tt49205110.name: The Red And The Black
series:tt49205110.description:
The series “Scarlet and Black” tells a love story set against the backdrop of history. It follows an artist whose life suddenly takes an unexpected turn, leading him down a very different path…

“History is written by the victors, but this is the story of the defeated.”

series:tt12004706.name: Panchayat
series:tt12004706.description: A comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a Panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh.

series:tt35335557.name: When It Rains, It Pours
series:tt35335557.description: Trapped in unfulfilling relationships, two coworkers find unexpected intimacy through secret messages that challenge everything they believe about love.

series:tt50688819.name: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
series:tt50688819.description: Oobah Butler sets his sights on the world’s biggest industries and most powerful institutions. To infiltrate the worlds of wine, wellness, royalty, and more, Oobah hatches elaborate and increasingly audacious schemes by gaming online reviews, assuming made-up personas, and launching fake companies with entirely bogus backstories.

series:tt43685621.name: Beyond Time's Gaze
series:tt43685621.description: In a monster-filled wasteland, Xu Qing rises from scavenger to cultivator using a purple crystal. He joins Seven-Blood Pupil, practices Golden Crow art, and reaches Foundation Establishment.

series:tt45115286.name: Khom Khlang
series:tt45115286.description: A Bangkok police officer hunting a supernatural human trafficking kingpin teams up with a mysterious spiritual master. As they uncover dark magic and ancient rituals, they discover they are fated soulmates.

series:tt43650265.name: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers

series:tt43650454.name: My Girlfriend's Friend
series:tt43650454.description: For the first time in my life, I have a girlfriend. But her friend tempts me with a body that's so seductive... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend came on to you like this?

series:tt32813343.name: Magic Knight Rayearth
series:tt32813343.description: Three high school girls get transported to a fantasy world, bestowed with magical powers. They team up to save the world from destruction by rescuing a kidnapped princess whose prayers keep it alive.

series:tt43691343.name: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
series:tt43691343.description: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

series:tt50816261.name: Valentín: La muerte del Gallo de Oro
series:tt50816261.description: Twenty years after the murder of the Mexican regional music icon, the production reconstructs the hours that shaped his story and revisits the questions that, two decades later, remain unanswered.

series:tt38413198.name: Halef
series:tt38413198.description: A successful Istanbul surgeon who escaped his traditional Urfa roots is forced to return home when his family demands he assume leadership as agha and marry Yildiz to end a decades-long feud. Already secretly married to Melek, he becomes trapped between two women, two worlds, and a web of family obligations. As buried secrets surface, love, duty, and revenge collide inside a deeply divided and tradition-bound family.

series:tt49692512.name: Final Table
series:tt49692512.description: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.

series:tt49250618.name: The Fall of El Mayo
series:tt49250618.description: Co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, longtime partner of "El Chapo", and a ghost to authorities for over three decades. The documentary that tells the story of his downfall.

series:tt95079544.name: The Scent of Karma
series:tt95079544.description: A popular boy band idol, Yu Cheng, suffers a serious injury in an accident and seeks treatment from Zhao Jin An, a mysterious and reserved doctor. As they grow closer, romance begins to blossom. But Zhao Jin An harbors a shocking secret: he has lived for thousands of years, and anyone who falls in love with him is doomed to suffer terrible misfortune! As secrets from their past lives come to light, Yu Cheng defies the curse and bravely pursues his love. Can they break their thousand-year fate, heal each other's wounds, and finally find their happy ending?

movie:tt43587924.name: Ohh My Dog
movie:tt43587924.description: A young child forms an unexpected bond with a stray dog, embarking on an adventure that reveals the profound ways animals and humans can heal each other's hearts.

movie:tt10627720.name: Ne Zha
movie:tt10627720.description: Born with unique powers, a boy is recruited to fight demons and save the community that fears him.

movie:tt35621542.name: Remain
movie:tt35621542.description: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

movie:tt27052307.name: Maserati: The Brothers
movie:tt27052307.description: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

movie:tt42423557.name: What is the matter?
movie:tt42423557.description: Four couples. One night that was supposed to be perfect… but everything turned into chaos. Between expectations, pressure, and inexperience, every story takes an unexpected turn. Awkward situations, wrong decisions, and endless disasters…

movie:tt46075976.name: My Christmas Cowboy
movie:tt46075976.description: Meg set aside her newscaster aspirations after a disastrous audition experience in college and has been happy as a news producer in her small town of Fern, Texas. Billy Kane, her former college crush and audition partner, is a well-known celebrity host in Hollywood on the brink of losing his career after an on-camera gaffe. At the advice of his publicist, Billy begrudgingly returns to Texas to lay low and spend the holidays with his sister and her family. When Meg and Billy cross paths he’s happy to see her but her feelings are on the frostier side: she’s still upset he took advantage of her failed audition to get the gig himself. Meg finds herself seeing Billy more than she’d like since his nephew Graham is in the horse therapy program her dad runs at their ranch. With the annual Reindeer Roundup holiday event coming up, Meg’s dad gets sidelined after an injury and enlists Billy to serve has its host, much to Meg’s chagrin.

movie:tt31145438.name: The Floaters
movie:tt31145438.description: Struggling musician Nomi accepts a last-resort job from her overachiever best friend Mara: mentoring misfit campers, the “Floaters,” at their childhood Jewish summer camp. As the camp struggles to survive amidst competition with a longtime rival, Nomi, the Floaters, and Mara must overcome their differences to bring the community together and save the camp.

movie:tt38691481.name: Everest: The Other Side
movie:tt38691481.description: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

movie:tt39640040.name: The Hotline
movie:tt39640040.description: Portrait of an anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using, and volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, forging collective hope amid addiction.

series:tt50661693.name: Per och Marie - historien om Roxette

series:tt42751057.name: To Love Is To Care
series:tt42751057.description: After a devastating flood leaves her with nothing, physiotherapist Adriana finds work as a caregiver for Arthur Brandão, a reclusive jewelry tycoon surrounded by ambitious heirs. The trust that develops between them leads to a marriage of convenience designed to protect Arthur’s legacy, but the arrangement turns tragic when he is murdered on their wedding night.​ Wrongfully convicted of the crime, Adriana spends six years in prison, losing her identity and her future.​Now free, she embarks on an intense journey of revenge and justice to unmask the real killer, reclaim her life, and confront a forbidden love from her past.

series:tt38934633.name: My Secretary
series:tt38934633.description: A new level of celebrity care is about to begin! Going far beyond the duties of an ordinary manager, the Secretary Squad becomes the ultimate personal support system for some of the biggest stars. From managing their official schedules to handling the private matters they may hesitate to share with anyone else, these dedicated secretaries stay close by their side. As they step into the stars’ most personal worlds, they uncover their unfiltered charms, unexpected sides, and deepest thoughts like never before.

movie:tt11057644.name: The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two
movie:tt11057644.description: Kate Pierce, now a cynical teen, is unexpectedly reunited with Santa Claus when a mysterious troublemaker threatens to cancel Christmas--forever.

movie:tt0038109.name: Spellbound
movie:tt0038109.description: A psychiatrist protects the identity of an amnesia patient accused of murder while attempting to recover his memory.

movie:tt14814040.name: Not Okay
movie:tt14814040.description: An ambitious young woman finds followers and fame when she poses as the survivor of a deadly attack, but she soon learns that online notoriety comes with a terrible price.

movie:tt8970448.name: Adopt a Highway
movie:tt8970448.description: An ex-felon discovers a live baby left in a dumpster.

movie:tt7983894.name: Ammonite
movie:tt7983894.description: 1840s England, acclaimed but overlooked fossil hunter Mary Anning and a young woman sent to convalesce by the sea develop an intense relationship, altering both of their lives forever.

movie:tt10482504.name: The Trip to Greece
movie:tt10482504.description: Actors Rob Brydon and Steve Coogan travel from Troy to Ithaca following in the footsteps of the Odysseus.

movie:tt10793644.name: The Vigil
movie:tt10793644.description: A man providing overnight watch to a deceased member of his former Orthodox Jewish community finds himself opposite a malevolent entity, in writer-director Keith Thomas' electrifying feature debut.

movie:tt0131400.name: Footrot Flats: The Dog's Tale
movie:tt0131400.description: Featuring the characters from Murray Ball's "Footrot Flats". Questions will be answered as the small town of Raupo comes to life on the big screen.

movie:tt0054892.name: Francis of Assisi
movie:tt0054892.description: In 13th century Italy, Francis Bernardone, the son of an Assisi merchant, renounces a promising army career in favor of a monastic life and starts his own religious order, sanctioned by the Pope.

movie:tt0266452.name: Death to Smoochy
movie:tt0266452.description: A children's television host is fired due to corruption, and his replacement soon discovers the dark side of the industry.

movie:tt1334553.name: The Perfect Host
movie:tt1334553.description: An on-the-run convict looking for temporary cover finds it at the house of a very colorful character.

movie:tt0988102.name: Darfur Now
movie:tt0988102.description: An examination of the genocide in Sudan's western region of Darfur.

movie:tt0052905.name: The Hound of the Baskervilles
movie:tt0052905.description: When a nobleman is threatened by a family curse on his newly inherited estate, detective Sherlock Holmes is hired to investigate.

movie:tt29567519.name: Voodun
movie:tt29567519.description: When two young women go missing while on a road trip, Detective Brett O'Shea is tasked with investigating the case after the girls' car is found abandoned. But when O'Shea himself disappears, local Reporter - Lisa Shaffer, begins ...

series:tt29605390.name: Gushing Over Magical Girls
series:tt29605390.description: Hiiragi Utena, a normal girl, is very passionate about magical girls; after being misled into joining an evil organization, she learns that there's also a twisted side to said passion.

series:tt6352180.name: Little Witch Academia
series:tt6352180.description: Akko enrolls at the Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy. She's not the best student, but her bright attitude is the key to her and her friends' success.

series:tt0386180.name: Drawn Together
series:tt0386180.description: A parody of reality shows cast with spoofs of several famous types of animated characters.

series:tt5105452.name: School-Live!
series:tt5105452.description: A young girl pretends to live a normal school life with her friends, unable to perceive what is truly happening around her.

series:tt1659175.name: Transformers Prime
series:tt1659175.description: In this new set of adventures the Autobots live on Earth and maintain their secret identity. They are joined by 3 teens as they battle the Decepticons.

series:tt4964074.name: Alex Hugo
series:tt4964074.description: The former Marseille police officer Alex Hugo, nicknamed "La Tendresse", chose to abandon the city and a violence he could no longer endure to isolate himself in the mountains, driven by his need for freedom.

series:tt0426711.name: Hikaru No Go
series:tt0426711.description: A sixth-grader Hikaru Shindo accidentally awakens the spirit of a deceased Go prodigy Fujiwara no Sai who then accompanies Hikaru and helps him develop his Go skills.

series:tt37196425.name: Pierre
series:tt37196425.description: West London duty solicitor Pierre is a force of nature: charming and funny, a glamorous character in an unglamorous profession, juggling the pressures of his job, a fragile personal life and just keeping his head above water financially.

series:tt13110256.name: Song Exploder
series:tt13110256.description: Get inspired as musicians dig deep into the creative process of songwriting and reveal their intimate thoughts in a series based on the hit podcast.

series:tt16373480.name: Zatima
series:tt16373480.description: Follow Zac and Fatima as they navigate the ups and downs of their relationship.

series:tt5768632.name: Love Doesn't Understand Words
series:tt5768632.description: Hayat is a country girl with strict parents. She is in a love hate relationship with her boss Murat. Hayat is full of secrets that can ruin her career and relationship.

series:tt4113712.name: Nightwing: The Series
series:tt4113712.description: When his girlfriend is supposedly shot and killed, Dick Grayson quits as Robin and goes off to fight crime as Nightwing. While doing so he comes into the path of Deathstroke and has to defeat him before he kills again.

series:tt13837672.name: Crime Scene: The Vanishing at the Cecil Hotel
series:tt13837672.description: College student and tourist Elisa Lam vanishes, leaving behind all of her possessions in her hotel room. The Cecil Hotel grows in infamy.

series:tt0065272.name: All My Children
series:tt0065272.description: All My Children is an American television soap opera that aired on ABC for 41 years, from January 5, 1970 to September 23, 2011, and on The Online Network since April 29, 2013 via Hulu, Hulu Plus, and iTunes. Created by Agnes Nixon, All My Children is set in Pine Valley, Pennsylvania, a fictitious suburb of Philadelphia which is modeled on the actual Philadelphia suburb of Rosemont.

series:tt0072559.name: Ryan's Hope
series:tt0072559.description: The trials and tribulations of The Ryans, an Irish-American family in New York City.

series:tt0283724.name: Doc
series:tt0283724.description: Clint Cassidy, a rural Montana doctor with traditional values ​​and simple methods, moves to bustling New York City to work at a Manhattan clinic, where he must adapt to a cold, modern medical system while trying to maintain his integrity and help his patients in a humane way.

series:tt50596623.name: I Miss You
series:tt50596623.description: Reunited long-time friends travel together through extreme landscapes, exploring life and rediscovering true friendship.

series:tt50828583.name: What a Boss Wants
series:tt50828583.description: A struggling CEO's only hope to turn his career around lies in an indie singer – but neither of them expected to fall for each other.

movie:tt0119670.name: The Mighty
movie:tt0119670.description: Kevin suffers from a Morquio's syndrome, which weakens his heart and stunts his growth. Maxwell has dyslexia and towers above his classmates. The two couldn't be more different, but, when Kevin is asked to help Maxwell, they soon ...

movie:tt38449190.name: Where Fireflies Dance
movie:tt38449190.description: Sadie Leggett, a quiet elementary school teacher, is left to return to her small hometown during summer vacation. When she runs into her high school sweetheart, Jack Ryland, she must confront everything that was left unsaid all those years ago.

movie:tt0114306.name: Rumpelstiltskin
movie:tt0114306.description: The wish of a young widow to see her police officer husband, killed on the line of duty, frees a demonic creature who wants to claim the soul of her baby.

movie:tt43515101.name: All Wishes Come True!
movie:tt43515101.description: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the "Eight Immortals."

movie:tt37171180.name: Artificial
movie:tt37171180.description: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

movie:tt32423384.name: The Maharashtra Files
movie:tt32423384.description: The story follows a woman from the Banjara community who battles bureaucratic corruption and a political nexus to secure fair compensation for land acquired by the government

movie:tt32139293.name: The Invisible Doctrine: The Secret History of Neoliberalism (& How It Came to Control Your Life)
movie:tt32139293.description: George Monbiot deconstructs the roots, secretive propagation and deep impact of a doctrine that has played a profound role in transforming our economics, politics, environment, and how we've come to view ourselves.

series:tt0072560.name: S.W.A.T.
series:tt0072560.description: The missions of a major city's police department's Special Weapons and Tactics unit.

movie:tt37887501.name: One Night Only
movie:tt37887501.description: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

movie:tt39311354.name: Sad Girlz
movie:tt39311354.description: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers on their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in Paula has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the duo are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

movie:tt32432428.name: Violent Night 2
movie:tt32432428.description: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

movie:tt6149154.name: Waiting for the Barbarians
movie:tt6149154.description: At an isolated frontier outpost, a colonial magistrate suffers a crisis of conscience when an army colonel arrives looking to interrogate the locals about an impending uprising, using cruel tactics that horrify the magistrate.

movie:tt20917338.name: Scrooge: A Christmas Carol
movie:tt20917338.description: A supernatural, time-travelling, musical adaptation of Charles Dickens's cult Christmas story.

movie:tt10298810.name: Lightyear
movie:tt10298810.description: While spending years attempting to return home, marooned Space Ranger Buzz Lightyear encounters an army of ruthless robots commanded by Zurg who are attempting to steal the fuel source of his ship.

movie:tt0462538.name: The Simpsons Movie
movie:tt0462538.description: After Homer pollutes the town's water supply, Springfield is encased in a gigantic dome by the EPA and the Simpsons are declared fugitives.

movie:tt0165196.name: Molokai
movie:tt0165196.description: The true story of the nineteenth century priest who volunteered to go to the island of Molokai, to console and care for the lepers.

movie:tt7755856.name: Banana Split
movie:tt7755856.description: Over the course of a summer, two teenage girls develop the perfect kindred spirit friendship, with one big problem: one of them is dating the other's ex.

movie:tt0063759.name: Hour of the Wolf
movie:tt0063759.description: While vacationing on a remote German island with his younger pregnant wife, an artist has an emotional breakdown while confronting his repressed desires.

movie:tt0058333.name: The Masque of the Red Death
movie:tt0058333.description: A European prince terrorizes the local peasantry while using his castle as a refuge against the "Red Death" plague that stalks the land.

movie:tt1202514.name: Accident
movie:tt1202514.description: A troubled assassin, who works by orchestrating "accidents", suspects that an accident that happens to his team is not an accident at all.

movie:tt2186819.name: Howling
movie:tt2186819.description: Veteran detective Sang-gil and beat cop Eun-yeong are in charge of a case that seems to involve a simple act of self-immolation. Sang-gil initially thinks that it was an accident, but dog bite marks discovered on the body lead him...

movie:tt28766949.name: Uranus 2324
movie:tt28766949.description: Bonded in their youth and separated by tragedy, an astronaut and a free diver bend the laws of space and time in their efforts to be together again.

movie:tt0138946.name: The Yards
movie:tt0138946.description: Ex-con Leo tries to go straight, but his plans are derailed after reuniting with his old crew and a well-connected railway contractor.

movie:tt0104466.name: Husbands and Wives
movie:tt0104466.description: When their best friends announce that they're separating, a professor and his wife discover the faults in their own marriage.

movie:tt3062976.name: Learning to Drive
movie:tt3062976.description: As her marriage dissolves, a Manhattan writer takes driving lessons from a Sikh instructor with his own marriage troubles. In each other's company they find the courage to get back on the road and the strength to take the wheel.

movie:tt12965010.name: Eureka
movie:tt12965010.description: A cowboy arrives in a town in search of his daughter, a native policewoman arrests various offenders in a snowy landscape, while her niece, a basketball coach, reunites with her grandfather for a decisive journey that will shape her future, and a bird flies through time and space and begins to enter the minds and dreams of a native tribe in the Amazon jungle.

movie:tt0090956.name: Eastern Condors
movie:tt0090956.description: A group of Asian prisoners is recruited, trained, armed and sent to Vietnam to destroy a cache of American weapons left behind after the Vietnam War, before the Vietcong discovers its location.

movie:tt1650060.name: SGT. Will Gardner
movie:tt1650060.description: A troubled Iraq War veteran struggling to reintegrate into society sets out on a cross-country journey with the hope of reuniting with his young son.

movie:tt51165610.name: Battle Through the Heavens Movie：Duel of the Two Dou Emperors

movie:tt38221401.name: Ikatan Darah
movie:tt38221401.description: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.

movie:tt14500286.name: The Yeti
movie:tt14500286.description: Merriell Sunday Sr. and Hollis Bannister vanished in Alaska. Ellie and Merriell Jr. mount a search, but an ancient threat stalks their expedition into the wilderness, hunting them as they seek the truth behind the disappearances.

movie:tt47597255.name: Rob Lowe: The Outsider
movie:tt47597255.description: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.

movie:tt46668554.name: A Very Arctic Christmas
movie:tt46668554.description: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

series:tt8232636.name: Cunk on Britain
series:tt8232636.description: Investigative reporter Philomena Cunk returns with this landmark mockumentary series journeying through British history. She asks eminent figures important questions such as: "Is a rock made of stone, or is a stone made of rock?"

series:tt11876490.name: DOC - Nelle tue mani
series:tt11876490.description: Doctor Andrea Fanti suffers a severe injury after the father of one of his patients shoots him in the head and he loses the memory of the last twelve years of his life. He struggles to recover professionally and emotionally.

series:tt5797194.name: W
series:tt5797194.description: Yeon-joo discovers that W, a webtoon created by her father, is a living world and saves the protagonist, Kang Chul. A confused Kang Chul falls in love with her and follows her to the real world.

series:tt1828246.name: Missing
series:tt1828246.description: When a woman's son goes missing under suspicious circumstances, she will do anything it takes to find him.

series:tt2140663.name: When the Streetlights Go On
series:tt2140663.description: The residents of a small town grapple with the ruthless killing of a young girl and a teacher.

series:tt20224612.name: Granite Harbour
series:tt20224612.description: Royal Military Police Sergeant Davis arriving in Aberdeen as a new recruit with Police Scotland. After completing his last assignment with the Royal Military Police, Lindo dreams of becoming a detective at New Scotland Yard.

series:tt12742136.name: Street Food: Latin America
series:tt12742136.description: In this vibrant docuseries, Latin American chefs tell their stories and bring a taste of tradition and innovation to their delicious offerings.

series:tt13007964.name: Becoming You
series:tt13007964.description: How a child's first 2,000 days shape the rest of their lives.

series:tt11165808.name: When Missing Turns to Murder
series:tt11165808.description: British true crime documentary series using powerful and emotional testimony from families and friends when a missing persons enquiry turns into a murder investigation.

series:tt31141567.name: 2.5 Dimensional Seduction
series:tt31141567.description: When cosplayer Ririsa joins Okumura's manga club, the line between 2D and 3D blurs when she asks him to be her photographer.

series:tt2732442.name: Star Trek Continues
series:tt2732442.description: The further adventures of the crew of the USS Enterprise.

series:tt40260395.name: The Tale of Nargis
series:tt40260395.description: Crushed by society’s expectations, a sterile, divorced woman in her mid-30s attempts to start over… until her obsession with being a mother transforms her from victim to predator.

series:tt12409194.name: Battle Through the Heavens
series:tt12409194.description: Xiao Yan is the genius boy of discipline. When he was 4 years old, he started to practice asceticism. And when he was 10 years old, he got Level9 of the practice asceticism.

movie:tt1078588.name: My Sister's Keeper
movie:tt1078588.description: Anna Fitzgerald looks to earn medical emancipation from her parents who until now have relied on their youngest child to help their leukemia-stricken daughter Kate remain alive.

movie:tt1757831.name: Paranormal Whacktivity
movie:tt1757831.description: A sexy and hilarious spoof about a couple who have just moved into a new home to consummate their relationship, but find peril around every corner due to an evil presence that haunts them whenever they attempt to be intimate.

movie:tt13452544.name: Graphic Desires
movie:tt13452544.description: When reclusive Franklin cheats on his partner with a mysterious girl he meets on a dating app, it becomes the start of a deadly obsession.

movie:tt41054296.name: Christmas at Moose Lake
movie:tt41054296.description: When successful New Yorker Alyssa Dawson retreats to her family's lakeside cabin for Christmas to heal from a painful breakup, she is forced to confront shifting family dynamics and past grief. But as she reconnects with Sean, a t...

movie:tt37363222.name: Elsinore
movie:tt37363222.description: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

movie:tt0384766.name: The Empire Strikes Back
movie:tt0384766.description: The epic saga continues as Luke Skywalker, in hopes of defeating the evil Galactic Empire, learns the ways of the Jedi from aging master Yoda. But Darth Vader is more determined than ever to capture Luke. Meanwhile, rebel leader Princess Leia, cocky Han Solo, Chewbacca, and droids C-3PO and R2-D2 are thrown into various stages of capture, betrayal and despair.

movie:tt39390582.name: Hanuman Ansh
movie:tt39390582.description: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

movie:tt38573816.name: Red Code Blue
movie:tt38573816.description: Young police detective Romāns Skulte joins the Riga Central Precinct in the mid-1990s. In no time at all, Skulte’s youthful enthusiasm clashes with the harsh reality of the streets, leading him to the realisation that in order to purge the city of crime, ethical and legal boundaries must be breached.

movie:tt39316936.name: Clashing Through the Snow
movie:tt39316936.description: After weather grounds all flights east for the holidays, two work rivals competing for the same job begrudgingly embark on a cross-country road trip that brings them closer together in ways they never imagined.

movie:tt42238634.name: Soul Snatcher
movie:tt42238634.description: In 2014, Hung lost his wife in a life-and-death situation filled with disinfectant smell and strange spiritual phenomena beside a burnt wooden spinning top. Twelve years later, he became a pragmatic journalist, always denying spirituality and distancing himself from Khoa – his 12-year-old son who always lives in the world of "virtual friends." The peak of their rift was when Khoa burned all his achievements in protest against his father's indifference, prompting Hung to take his son on a camping trip to mend their relationship.  On the journey to the "Village of Happiness," an mysterious accident pushed them into a haunted clinic shrouded in fog. There, while Hung was surrounded by bizarre supernatural phenomena, Khoa gradually fell into the trap of a force seeking to steal his soul. To save his son at the "Hellfire Bridge.

movie:tt39195686.name: Saayavanam
movie:tt39195686.description: Sita tries to live an honest and truthful life following all religious and social norms of her upbringing while unraveling the true agenda of men around her. In this process, she emerges victorious as a strong and brave woman.

movie:tt51131583.name: UFC Fight Night 294: Procházka vs. Stirling
movie:tt51131583.description: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 21, 2026, at the Ali Bin Hamad al-Attiyah Arena in Al Rayyan, Qatar. A light heavyweight bout between former UFC Light Heavyweight Champion (also the inaugural Rizin Light Heavyweight Champion) Jiří Procházka and Navajo Stirling headlined the event.

movie:tt32321285.name: Josephine
movie:tt32321285.description: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

movie:tt38629260.name: Beyond the Witching Hour
movie:tt38629260.description: When two paranormal Youtubers travel to the cottage that once belonged to a legendary Derbyshire witch, they find out that many of the local myths hold true – and the real story may be even darker than the rumours…

movie:tt37267166.name: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris
movie:tt37267166.description: Paris, 1830. As cholera threatens to ravage the city, a hunchback hunted for medical experiments is caught between political turmoil and impossible love.

movie:tt31969655.name: The Paradise
movie:tt31969655.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

movie:tt37535100.name: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
movie:tt37535100.description: Follows a couple with a significant age difference as they navigate their romantic relationship.

movie:tt35444710.name: Detective Conan: One-Eyed Flashback
movie:tt35444710.description: Detectives Conan and Kogoro Mouri are pulled into a mystery connected to the past of police inspector Kansuke Yamato.

movie:tt39309870.name: Black Trumpet
movie:tt39309870.description: After 10 years of living abroad, the famous writer Maksim Grahovac returns to his birthplace, the Montenegrin village of Grahovo, with the intention of visiting his brother and agreeing on the estate that was left to them as an inheritance.

movie:tt35708159.name: Woodwalkers 2
movie:tt35708159.description: For shapeshifter Carag and his friends Brandon, Holly, and Lou, a new school year begins at Clearwater High. But first, the Woodwalker Council must decide whether Carag's mentor and patron of the school, Andrew Milling, is guilty of attacking humans. Carag is in a dilemma: he wants to put a stop to Milling's actions, but Milling promises to take him to his true puma family if he covers for him before the council.

movie:tt31339071.name: CoComelon: The Movie
movie:tt31339071.description: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.

movie:tt38947524.name: The Fatal Dealz
movie:tt38947524.description: When a phone scam unexpectedly strikes, Dang Thuc — who once thought he had a stable life — is drawn into a dangerous spiral of money, family, and trust, where every choice comes at a cost not only of wealth, but of the people he loves most.

movie:tt38961362.name: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
movie:tt38961362.description: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

movie:tt37025712.name: Crusty Fouler
movie:tt37025712.description: A couple in mourning set off on an impromptu sail, each with a dark secret in tow….

movie:tt50770800.name: Nanhey Dil
movie:tt50770800.description: Set against the contrasting worlds of Mumbai's slums and elite educational institutions, Nanhey Dil follows the journey of Raghu Jadhav, the young son of a dhobi whose life takes an unexpected turn when he secures admission to a prestigious school. The opportunity comes through Principal Anthony, who believes that every child deserves access to quality education, rega...

movie:tt38267641.name: Hungarian Wedding
movie:tt38267641.description: András and Péter are two young men trying to make it big with their rock band in Budapest in the early 1980s. When the opportunity arises to attend the wedding of András's cousin in Transylvania, they decide to take it as a chance to raise some money. Once there, they embark on an unexpected adventure.

movie:tt6779038.name: Children of Blood and Bone
movie:tt6779038.description: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

movie:tt46076055.name: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
movie:tt46076055.description: On-set veterinarian Goldie MacKenzie (Cahill) leaves the glamour of Hollywood behind to buy a family-run veterinary clinic in tight-knit Blue Dog Valley, arriving just in time for the town's cherished Christmas season. When Dr. Gable, the clinic's longtime owner, unexpectedly ends up out of town, Goldie is hosted by his handsome son Cohen (Walker), the black sheep of the family because he decided to forego their expectation of becoming a vet. Cohen and Goldie get off on the wrong foot, but when the folks of Blue Dog Valley cold shoulder "the newcomer," Cohen teams up with Goldie to win over even the frostiest of community members. Goldie is also aided by the mysterious canine she dubs Blue whose spontaneous appearances always seem to guide Goldie to exactly where she needs to be. As Goldie works hard to prove herself to the townspeople when furry and Christmas crises arise, she finds herself pulled towards the very heart of her new-found home... and a certain black sheep.

movie:tt46668463.name: Love on the Vineyard
movie:tt46668463.description: Jordan Wilson, a D.C. real estate executive who returns to Martha’s Vineyard and reconnects with her former summer love while fighting to save a historic Oak Bluffs inn.

movie:tt46064711.name: Double Booked for the Holidays
movie:tt46064711.description: The one thing identical twins — quiet and bookish Abigail and globe-trotting event planner Charlie — can agree on is that this first Christmas without their mom will be difficult. When they unexpectedly get a last-minute chance to travel to Wales and spend a week running the Story Shoppe, an AirBnb/bookshop in Hay-on-Wye, they jump at the opportunity. Abigail is particularly excited, given the town’s role as the backdrop of the bestselling Winterton Chronicles, her all-time favorite Regency holiday romances.

movie:tt33317763.name: Tristes Tropiques
movie:tt33317763.description: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.

movie:tt42813482.name: The Eyes
movie:tt42813482.description: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

movie:tt39556297.name: The Ultimate Duo
movie:tt39556297.description: Jae-hyuk was once a star detective in the regional investigation unit, but after losing his marriage and missing promotions, he's now a washed-up small-town cop whose life has completely fallen apart. His new partner is Jung-ho, a rookie detective and former influencer armed with sharp intelligence, ambition, money, and youth. The mismatched duo doesn't click at all, but one day they arrest a thief who stole from a church donation box and discover he's a prime suspect in a Gangnam murder case. However, the case has already been closed with another perpetrator arrested. To catch the real killer, they head to Seoul on a business trip. With prosecutor Mi-ju's promise to support are investigation, they request cooperation from Gangnam Police Station. But their questionable teamwork - or is it team-killing? - puts the case in jeopardy.

movie:tt39931233.name: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
movie:tt39931233.description: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.

movie:tt39314834.name: Camembert
movie:tt39314834.description: Stan meets his girlfriend Cléo's large, upper-class family for the first time. Everything seems perfect - until the group decides to play a game of Trivial Pursuit.

movie:tt43675661.name: WWE Survivor Series: WarGames 2026
movie:tt43675661.description: The 2026 Survivor Series: WarGames, also promoted as Survivor Series: WarGames Houston, is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the 40th annual Survivor Series and will take place on November 28, 2026, at Daikin Park in Houston, Texas. This will be the fifth annual Survivor Series based around the WarGames match, a team-based steel cage match where the roofless cage surrounds two rings placed side by side.

movie:tt44980509.name: Final Interview
movie:tt44980509.description: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. Growing closer as they prepare for the group discussion, they dare to dream that all six might make it — until the day before the interview, when the company announces its verdict: only one will be hired. On the day of the interview, mysterious envelopes arrive, each containing one of their secrets — and suspicion begins to take hold. Who among the six is the liar?

movie:tt31383175.name: Red Rocks
movie:tt31383175.description: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.

movie:tt39368183.name: Permis de détruire
movie:tt39368183.description: Dominique is struggling to make her Corsican dream a reality, caught between her medical practice—which is still under construction—and her fight against a controversial power plant. When Olivier, her psychoanalyst friend who is going through a divorce, shows up to start a new life on the island, the two pinzuti (mainlanders)—with the help of their Corsican friend Santu—will do everything they can to fit into the island culture, for better or for worse.

movie:tt28228084.name: King
movie:tt28228084.description: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

movie:tt36576750.name: Cold War 1994
movie:tt36576750.description: In 1994, a tycoon's kidnapping shook Hong Kong, threatening its financial standing. Police pursued personal gain while OCID Superintendent Li Wenbin risked everything to navigate conflicting interests and expose the truth.

movie:tt35727399.name: A Mouse Hunt for Christmas
movie:tt35727399.description: A small mouse family plans a quiet Christmas outside the city, but their celebration is disrupted when humans unexpectedly appear. As the mice try to hide their preparations, the humans react to the noises behind the walls with determination.

movie:tt39120291.name: Mitti De Putt
movie:tt39120291.description: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

series:tt7742120.name: Laid-Back Camp
series:tt7742120.description: Nadeshiko, a high school student who has moved from Shizuoka to Yamanashi, decides to see the famous Mount Fuji.

series:tt15433166.name: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
series:tt15433166.description: A compassionate girl enrolls herself in the Asticassia School of Technology in Planet Mercury that is run by the Beneritt Group that creates robotic mobile suits.

series:tt15978968.name: Miss Shachiku and the Little Baby Ghost
series:tt15978968.description: From sunup to sundown, Fushihara-san works ’round the clock. She spends so much time there that even the ghosts worry about her well-being! One night, Fushihara-san was working late as usual when a little ghost girl whispered to her, “Leave now”—an encounter that would change her life forever. Be healed by the heartwarming daily life of the cute little ghost and Fushihara-san!

series:tt2942228.name: Yowamushi Pedal
series:tt2942228.description: Onoda is a cheerful otaku looking to join his new school's anime club, eager to finally make some friends. Unfortunately, the club has been disbanded and somehow he stumbled into the bicycle club.

series:tt3496230.name: Alvinnn!!! And the Chipmunks
series:tt3496230.description: A single dad has his hands full raising six rambunctious chipmunks in this animated comedy.

series:tt43650419.name: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash in with a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!

series:tt43650300.name: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!

series:tt43691418.name: Yowaki MAX Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta

series:tt42576855.name: Where the Mask Ends
series:tt42576855.description: Wei Rao was a young noblewoman from the residence of the Count of Cheng'an. Due to family vicissitudes, she was forced to leave her home at an early age. Despite the difficulties, she took on all the responsibility with love and b...

series:tt4718304.name: The Powerpuff Girls
series:tt4718304.description: Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup use their superpowers and super cuteness to save the city of Townsville from evil villains and all things icky.

series:tt34959964.name: The Silent Storm
series:tt34959964.description: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

series:tt35995459.name: Hotel Inhumans
series:tt35995459.description: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one's identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

series:tt39309223.name: Shakedown
series:tt39309223.description: A tragedy. A cover-up. A reckoning still owed. Robodebt was the cruel and illegal government scheme that took lives and cost millions. These are the stories of those who protected the scheme, and those who paid for it.

series:tt43691315.name: From Far Away
series:tt43691315.description: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

series:tt48391033.name: HORROR COLLECTOR
series:tt48391033.description: Not all urban legends are myths. Some are real, and they’re coming to life. Fushigi roams Japan in a red hood, sealing them inside his magical notebook, with Jimmy, his human-faced dog, by his side. Each phenomenon brings him one step closer to capturing Himitsu, the girl responsible for manifesting the supernatural beings.

series:tt36984433.name: SWAT Exiles
series:tt36984433.description: A SWAT team veteran is pulled out of retirement to lead a last-chance experimental unit comprised of untested and unpredictable recruits.

series:tt49410334.name: Dreamland
series:tt49410334.description:
Ever since his moth­er died in a fire, Ter­rence has seclud­ed him­self in an emo­tion­less world.

He goes through his dai­ly teenag­er life apa­thet­i­cal­ly… with one excep­tion! The sim­ple sight of a flame plunges him into a world of fear, an awak­en ver­sion of his night­mares – for, every time he falls asleep, he help­less­ly relieves the trag­ic event, thus rekin­dling his pyro­pho­bia. Until that one night he can’t bear it any­more and stops run­ning away from the dev­il­ish flames. Lit­tle does he know that, by doing so, he over­came his great­est fear and became a Trav­el­er: a very spe­cial kind of Dream­er, able to explore Dream­land, the dimen­sion born from mankind’s dreams… and nightmares!

series:tt39045402.name: A la deriva
series:tt39045402.description: In 1970, the fishing village of Batuel is devastated by the shipwreck of a vessel carrying several local men; none of them are found. Two years later, five of the fishermen—previously presumed dead—reappear, sending shockwaves through the entire village. Yet, alongside the joy of their survival, their return also brings to light conflicts and secrets that were thought to be buried.

series:tt45114223.name: Third Person
series:tt45114223.description: Chris, a young woman suffering from amnesia, is recovering and living with her loving partner, Nadia, after an accident four years ago. Everything seems to be going well, but then the arrival of a strange woman named Sun begins to shake Chris's beliefs.

series:tt24512262.name: Fightland
series:tt24512262.description: A disgraced boxing champion is released from prison and returns to London to take revenge on the crime family that betrayed him.

series:tt39044730.name: Oxytoxin
series:tt39044730.description: The elite, popular girls known as Toxxxxin rule the school, but an unexpected bond with a scholarship student could unravel their carefully kept secrets.

series:tt15660128.name: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP
series:tt15660128.description: The story follows the unfolding of the U-17 World Cup, which takes place at the KCC Arena, in Melbourne, Australia. A total of 32 countries are participating in this long-awaited competition, and only 16 of them will manage to qualify for the final stages…

series:tt42938834.name: Suikoden: The Anime
series:tt42938834.description: Two young boys… the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom – a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

series:tt30003786.name: The Great Indian Kapil Show
series:tt30003786.description: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

series:tt37511063.name: Police in Love
series:tt37511063.description: A bickering inspector and his subordinate marry for six months to break a curse, but living together turns their fake marriage into real love.

series:tt51056478.name: Enchanted
series:tt51056478.description: In the quiet town of Iskra, where people don't even know they're in the neighborhood of otherworldly forces, two witch sisters live. They are twins, but very different. For the excellent student Zlata, fate is sealed — she will inherit from her mother the role of guardian of the border between the worlds of people and shadows. And Marya doesn't know who to be. She doesn't want to cram spells just like that, but dreams of living a full human life. But everything changes dramatically when Marya opens a portal to the World of shadows on Kalinov Bridge out of a desire to win an argument from the arrogant Sonya, the adopted daughter of the mayor of the city. In an attempt to fix what happened, Zlata dies, and now Marya has 9 days to find living water and save her sister.

series:tt40548570.name: Onegai AiPri
series:tt40548570.description:
Konomi Inori, who had just moved to Onegai Town, is a first-year middle school student who absolutely loves singing and dancing to AiPri! While praying to the goddess statue in the plaza, she happens to run into the popular AiPri idol Aoi Yumemiya and the stuffed animal plushie Fortu.

Aoi is searching for an AiPri who can grant Fouchuu's wishes. By that, opening the special Mirror Pact given by Aoi... Inori, makes her her long-awaited AiPri debut!

Although Aoi and Fortu felt destiny in their encounter with Inori... What kind of encounters await them in AiPri from now on?

series:tt31510539.name: Family Plan
series:tt31510539.description: A story about a group of people with special abilities who disguise themselves as family members to survive and use unique methods to overcome the vicious criminals who threaten them.

series:tt39443960.name: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt
series:tt39443960.description: Every morning, Sakuradaimon-kun enforces the rules at the school gate, stopping Poem-chan for her too-short skirt. But when they’re thrown together in remedial class, she discovers his secret—the serious, uptight Sakuradaimon-kun is hopeless at studying! As they clash, bicker, and stumble through school life together, the two opposites slowly draw closer and form an unexpected friendship.

series:tt1158101.name: Project Runway Canada
series:tt1158101.description: Aspiring fashion designers compete for an industry breakthrough. Each week, a designer is eliminated from the competition after exhibiting their work in front of a judges' panel.

series:tt10627882.name: The Story of Chuaner
series:tt10627882.description: "The Story of Chuaner" is the first special program in China that presents the Chinese people's barbecue culture. It focuses on showcasing the unique barbecue culture from various regions across the country and covers over 500 legendary barbecue stalls in nearly 30 cities. Unlike previous barbecue programs, "Life on a Skewer" has a strong sense of grassroots and shifts its focus from the grand halls to the ordinary stalls, truly showcasing the carefree spirit and distinctive flavor of barbecue.

series:tt51549904.name: Ballz
series:tt51549904.description: Julian actually has a plan. He lives with his best friend Sami in a chaotic shared apartment, is currently building a fitness startup with him, and wants to finally propose to his true love, Noemi. Everything seems to be going in the right direction. Until a routine checkup turns his life upside down: Julian has testicular cancer.

series:tt8819906.name: Love Island USA
series:tt8819906.description: U.S. version of the British show 'Love Island' where a group of singles come to stay in a villa for a few weeks and have to couple up with one another.

series:tt2821850.name: Document 72 Hours
series:tt2821850.description: An unusual documentary series that delves into human dramas through chance encounters with ordinary people at selected spots. Filmed over 72 hours in a single location, the show captures glimpses into people's lives as they open up and share their stories.

series:tt36200170.name: Happy Kanako's Killer Life
series:tt36200170.description: When Kanako accidentally applies to work at an assassination agency, the timid office worker discovers that she has a knack for bumping people off. Will she ever earn the respect of Sakurai, her prickly and kinda hot co-worker–and why is she still having silly workplace problems when she’s employed with hitmen?!

series:tt31812476.name: Beast Games
series:tt31812476.description: A reality-competition show, in which over 1,000 contestants play for a single $5 million cash payout.

series:tt42798488.name: kiDnap GAME
series:tt42798488.description: Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.

series:tt42498501.name: GIFT
series:tt42498501.description: A reclusive genius astrophysicist takes on the challenge of transforming a struggling wheelchair rugby team into Japan’s champions, discovering teamwork, resilience, and purpose along the way.

series:tt35930629.name: Ayda!
series:tt35930629.description: Grisha, a teenager from a privileged family, moves from Volgograd to Kazan and finds himself in the midst of a street gang war. He is a stranger in this world, but in order to survive, he has to learn its cruel rules. Zakharevich, the ideologue of the Tyap-Lyap gang, becomes an unexpected mentor for him. He is an intelligent, educated and ambitious manipulator who created a system for dragging teenagers into organized crime. The only one who is aware of the impending threat is the head of the criminal investigation department Nikonov. It will take time for him to understand that this is not just a criminal outburst, behind which there are non-ordinary figures, but the beginning of large-scale processes capable of destroying the country.

series:tt43493882.name: Not Yours
series:tt43493882.description: A young man moves in with his wealthy creditor as a "sugar baby" to pay off his bankrupt father's debts, but their contractual arrangement gets complicated when a celebrity idol enters the picture.

series:tt37096911.name: The First Jasmine
series:tt37096911.description: Eldest daughter Ye Li marries the crippled Prince Mo Xiuyao, while her sister Ye Ying weds Prince Mo Jinglei the same day. A descendant of Lishan, Ye Li secretly seeks revenge on those who wronged her clan. Suspected by her husband, who also hides a revenge plan, the couple gradually become allies. Meanwhile, Prince Jinglei plots to seize the throne. In the end, Ye Li and Mo Xiuyao join forces to defeat their enemies and restore peace to the empire.

series:tt48376831.name: Hakone Ekiden: Our Story
series:tt48376831.description: A fierce struggle unfolds as a university team fights for a comeback in the Hakone Ekiden while TV producers battle behind the scenes to broadcast their story.

series:tt39551287.name: Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madousho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tataki Tsubushimasu

series:tt39047437.name: Star Detective Precure!
series:tt39047437.description: On her 14th birthday, Anna Akechi meets a magical fairy and suddenly time-slips from 2027 to 1999! There, she befriends Mikuru, a spirited girl who dreams of becoming a detective. When mysterious thefts stir rumors of the Phantom Thieves, the two transform into Detective Precure, using courage, deduction, and friendship to solve cases and uncover the secret of Anna's journey through time.

series:tt14986786.name: Perfect World
series:tt14986786.description: Born into a unique world where, the main character, Shi Hao, is a genius blessed by the heavens. His journey will bring him through unknown lands until he is able to become a person that can truly shake the world.

series:tt38074086.name: Sins and Roses
series:tt38074086.description: As a boy, Serhat lost both his father and fortune but built an empire on family and integrity. His world shatters when his wife Berrak hides a devastating secret and falls into a coma. While searching for answers, his heart hardens—until he meets Zeynep, a passionate florist chasing the same truth, igniting a journey of trust, passion, and redemption.

series:tt38493347.name: The Journey to Killing You
series:tt38493347.description: Ordered to guard—and secretly kill—his underboss, a vengeful yakuza begins to fall for the very man he swore to destroy.

series:tt27865962.name: Beyblade X
series:tt27865962.description: Beginner blader Robin Kazami joins up with influencer Multi Nana-iro and former champion Jaxon Cross to form this unlikely trio - ready to climb to the top of The X and win the title of champion blader!

series:tt43709984.name: Hook Your Heart
series:tt43709984.description: It follows Photsawat, a former famous boxing champion who was forced to leave the sport after being accused of throwing a match—to make matters worse, his ex-wife absconds with all his hard-earned savings. Now living hand to mouth, he works as a motorcycle taxi driver to support his daughter.  By chance, he meets Homerun, a young man who once suffered from depression because of his difficult past. Inspired by Photsawat, Homerun manages to turn his life around and make a fresh start. He asks Photsawat to become his boxing coach so that he can pursue his dream of becoming a champion. However, his true goal is not only to win in the ring, but also to win his coach’s heart.

series:tt39443161.name: This City Never Sleeps
series:tt39443161.description: Macau, Asia's wealthiest hub, is a battleground for power and greed. The Lam brothers, co-CEOs of a hotel empire, feud fiercely. To crush his rival, one weds a vengeful prosecutor, forging a deadly alliance. In this twisted game, ambition is virtue—only the ruthless reign supreme.

series:tt33004920.name: The Trials of Karen Read
series:tt33004920.description: An accident, a deadly fight or an elaborate cover-up? This true-crime series digs into the murder trials of Karen Read that sparked viral conspiracies.

series:tt21056976.name: Dragon Striker
series:tt21056976.description: In a world where sports and magic combine, farm boy Key discovers his ultrapowerful natural talent and learns he could be the legendary Dragon Striker.

movie:tt34691287.name: In a Holidaze
movie:tt34691287.description: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, an aimless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

movie:tt33295857.name: Karōshi
movie:tt33295857.description: In a near-future Manhattan corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker's death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface.

movie:tt41835771.name: Silver Bells at Christmas
movie:tt41835771.description: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.

movie:tt35224721.name: Neglected
movie:tt35224721.description: Detective Shaw discovers a serial killer has buried his son alive and must solve three murders to find him before he dies.

movie:tt32293052.name: The Fall of Sir Douglas Weatherford
movie:tt32293052.description: In the Scottish village of Arberloch, Kenneth, a grieving tour guide, is devoted to preserving the legacy of the town's sole historical figure—eighteenth-century inventor Sir Douglas Weatherford. But when a fantasy series chooses Arberloch as its filming location, and the town turns its back on Weatherford in favour of fan culture, Kenneth descends into madness.

movie:tt47660488.name: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit
movie:tt47660488.description: UFC 334: Gane vs. Hokit (branded as Polymarket UFC 334 for sponsorship reasons) is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that is scheduled to take place on November 14, 2026, at Madison Square Garden in New York City, New York, United States.

movie:tt13152476.name: Untitled James Bond Film
movie:tt13152476.description: The 26th installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

movie:tt39139918.name: Cosmic Samson
movie:tt39139918.description: Aspiring filmmaker working as a pizza delivery guy whose ordinary life takes an extraordinary turn when mysterious forces unlock hidden superpowers within him, pulling him into a secret fantasy world and launching him on an epic, action-packed adventure beyond anything he has ever imagined.

movie:tt33253206.name: The Last Kiss
movie:tt33253206.description: After a tragic class trip, a teen gains the ability to see people's deaths through kissing. She races against time to save her classmates from their foreseen demises related to the incident.

movie:tt43202763.name: The Christmas Rewrite
movie:tt43202763.description: Elle is guided by the magical Mary Clause and a mischievous helper named Rudy, Ellie learns she is trapped inside her own story and can only return home if she finds true love before midnight on Christmas Day.

movie:tt39149806.name: Hugo
movie:tt39149806.description: Imbued with Victor Hugo, the actor Robert Zucchini searches for his place between the stage and life. Every evening, he fills theaters by sharing his love of words. Until the day his daughter, whom he hasn’t seen grow up, reappears.

movie:tt36415524.name: The Gentleman Thief
movie:tt36415524.description: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a $100M yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

movie:tt30093348.name: Mr. Irrelevant
movie:tt30093348.description: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

movie:tt38708063.name: The Assassin(s)
movie:tt38708063.description: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

movie:tt37833661.name: Man of Tomorrow
movie:tt37833661.description: Superman and Lex Luthor find themselves forced to work together—to a certain degree—against a much, much bigger threat when Brainiac sets his sights on Earth.

movie:tt38410650.name: Eine Nacht in Bangkok
movie:tt38410650.description: Katharina and Hektor who used to be married ten years ago meet again after their daughter Lilith is suspected of serial burglary.

movie:tt33481705.name: ZombieCON Vol. 1
movie:tt33481705.description: A group of cosplaying friends trigger a zombie apocalypse and are forced to traverse a zombie-infested Los Angeles to save their loved one.

series:tt41153966.name: The Vermilion Mask
series:tt41153966.description: The mask brings calamity. The mask revels in slaughter. The mask has a will of its own... Peru, a traveling mask merchant, possesses the ability to craft mysterious masks that give its wearers unique powers. In a city shrouded in ...

series:tt31131310.name: Mission: Yozakura Family
series:tt31131310.description: Taiyo Asano has been on his own ever since his parents died and the only one who seems to care for him is his childhood friend and classmate, Mutsumi Yozakura. But Mutsumi has a secret—she is the head of a family of spies! And on top of that, her brother Kyoichiro is dangerously protective of her! To stop Kyoichiro from killing him, Taiyo and Mutsumi must take the ultimate leap—marriage! Because in the Yozakura family, family cannot kill family.

series:tt43691383.name: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin

series:tt40649134.name: R91
series:tt40649134.description: The aircraft carrier *Charles de Gaulle* has just set sail for a strategic mission in the Eastern Mediterranean, a region where the situation is volatile. Shortly after departure, however, a female crew member is found dead and another is reported missing. Despite the danger, the operation continues, and a military investigator is urgently dispatched on board. When a new victim is discovered, the *Charles*—a veritable floating city of 1,800 men and 240 women—turns into a trap where a killer, mounting tensions, and unfolding events threaten the crew and perhaps even the country itself.

series:tt31512174.name: Neuromancer
series:tt31512174.description: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

series:tt49691783.name: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part

series:tt51546475.name: The Devil's Plan B
series:tt51546475.description: Contestants from "The Devil's Plan: Dead Again" reunite to reveal their true feelings, dissect fan theories and relive the intense competition.

series:tt38366250.name: I Am Helen
series:tt38366250.description: Helen and Steve (Nicola Coughlan and Joe Cole) seem to have a loving relationship, but as Steve begins to consume misogynistic online porn and the rhetoric of the manosphere, their dynamic shifts.

series:tt38752562.name: Magical Sisters LuluttoLilly
series:tt38752562.description: Two distant sisters gain secret powers for a year, transforming into idols as they chase dreams, unaware they share the same hidden fate.

series:tt8534992.name: Güldür Güldür Show
series:tt8534992.description: Güldür Güldür Show, which has won the admiration of everyone with its legendary cast, continues to bring a new approach to many topics from family to love, fame to technology, football to friendship with its unique sense of humour.

series:tt41295113.name: Battle Spirits [Re] ZEKKAI NO KU
series:tt41295113.description: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu's journey—and sets history in motion.

series:tt39029595.name: Good Boy
series:tt39029595.description: Reborn at 17 to fix past mistakes, Jiraphat finds his life taking an unexpected turn when he falls deeply for his long-forgotten childhood friend, Ruth.

series:tt27487379.name: On the Run
