series:tt27487379.description: Five years post-apocalypse, a group flees continuously, seeking safety from an insidious new threat stalking the wasteland while navigating treacherous terrain and scavenging to survive.

series:tt39029588.name: Gunshot
series:tt39029588.description: A young police officer investigating a murder case falls for a mysterious glass artist, unaware his new love might be the killer he's hunting down.

movie:tt17277414.name: Jeanne du Barry
movie:tt17277414.description: Jeanne Vaubernier, a young working-class woman hungry for culture and pleasure, uses her intelligence and allure to climb the rungs of the social ladder one by one until she meets and begins a scandalous relationship with King Lou...

movie:tt1137450.name: Death Wish
movie:tt1137450.description: A dedicated Chicago trauma surgeon transforms into a ruthless street vigilante after a brutal home invasion leaves his wife dead and his college-bound daughter comatose, exposing the complete failure of the local police.

movie:tt4348012.name: Mayhem
movie:tt4348012.description: A virus spreads through an office complex, causing white-collar workers to act out their worst impulses.

movie:tt22246514.name: A Magical Christmas Village
movie:tt22246514.description: It follows Summer's life as her mother Vivian and daughter Chloe move in with her. Vivian sets up a miniature Christmas village. As Chloe begins setting up the figurines, real-life events seem to mimic the scenes she creates.

movie:tt36378945.name: Alien Stage
movie:tt36378945.description: Alien Stage, a reality audition program, has taken the alien world by storm, and its upcoming season is planned to be just as exciting. Contestants must sing for their survival, as the loser faces on-the-spot termination. As the competition heats up, a mysterious girl emerges, whose involvement may hold the key to humanity's fate...

movie:tt0087039.name: Cento giorni a Palermo
movie:tt0087039.description: In the late 1970s and early 80s, assassinations in Sicily get the attention of Communist deputy, Pio La Torre, who appeals to General Carlo Alberto Dalla Chiesa to become prefect in Palermo and take on the Mafia. Dalla Chiesa appr...

movie:tt1848832.name: Crawl
movie:tt1848832.description: A seedy bar owner hires a mysterious Croatian to commit murder, but a planned double-crossing backfires when a young waitress is taken hostage. A suspenseful, yet darkly humorous chain of events builds to a bloodcurdling climax.

movie:tt0120654.name: Dirty Work
movie:tt0120654.description: Mitch and Sam must find $50,000--fast. The only problem: neither can keep a job. Mitch finds a way to make money by exploiting their only talents by opening a "Revenge for Hire" business.

movie:tt0118772.name: Breaking Up
movie:tt0118772.description: A couple circa 30 breaks up after 2 1/2 years - or do they?

movie:tt0064793.name: The Passion of Anna
movie:tt0064793.description: A recently divorced man meets an emotionally devastated widow and they begin a love affair.

movie:tt0117397.name: Project: ALF
movie:tt0117397.description: Captured by the Alien Task Force, ALF was rescued by two officers who found out that the project shall be canceled - and also ALF.

movie:tt5901530.name: Zero Sum
movie:tt5901530.description: Ruth (Aimee-Ffion Edwards) wakes inside a featureless spaceship; she's no memory and is kept alive by a plastic tube connected to her lower back. Ruth removes the tube and as the searing pain subsides, her memory begins to return. She looks out of the window and sees hundreds of identical ships orbiting a green planet. Ruth remembers the pledge she made to begin a new life, light years away from the earth. Suddenly there's a noise from the other side of a dividing screen and Ruth realises that she's not alone.

series:tt8651972.name: The 2000s
series:tt8651972.description: A TV documentary miniseries chronicling the trends, pop culture, and important events that took place from 2000 to 2009.

movie:tt38631727.name: The Dangerous Seduction
movie:tt38631727.description: A hardworking husband is torn between loyalty to his family and the dangerous allure of a wealthy widow.

movie:tt34515768.name: O.M: Operation Mole
movie:tt34515768.description: A man saves twenty woodcutters arrested by police in a forest in Tiruvannamalai.

movie:tt49073562.name: The Responders: Breaking the Silence
movie:tt49073562.description: The untold story of September 11th, 2001, both from the uncensored experience of the First Responders who risked their lives that day, as well as from those who have since responded to the call to speak the truth, whatever the cost.

movie:tt35331003.name: The North
movie:tt35331003.description: A decade after they were best friends and roommates, Chris and Lluis set out on a 600 kilometer hike through the Scottish Highlands to reconnect with each other, nature and parts of themselves they lost.

series:tt48307350.name: Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette - A Love Untold

movie:tt26594761.name: The Baby in the Basket
movie:tt26594761.description: In 1940s, the nuns of a remote Scottish island convent ready for an impending storm, but when a baby is left on their doorstep, Sister Agnes becomes convinced he is the Devil and wants to kill the child. After Agnes is locked away a grim series of events ensue as the storm rages, and as her Sisters begin to question faith and reality, Sister Eleanor must try to repent and survive the dark events at St Augustine’s.

movie:tt51547822.name: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing
movie:tt51547822.description: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.
